agnews:train:14756.para: The Europe Ryder Cup team's composition is nearing completion following the BMW International Open's conclusion on Sunday. Although not outstanding, it could potentially be sufficient to fulfill its intended role.

agnews:train:14865.para: Expressing gratitude and bidding farewell to Sir Bobby of Robson, which party do you believe is more disheartened by his exit? Will it be the News of the World or Barclaycard that feels this way more acutely?

agnews:train:14915.orig: Juniper boosts end-point security Juniper Networks is beefing up security on its VPN gear to make sure that machines connecting to a network are safe. On Monday, the company announced updates to its NetScreen Secure Access SSL VPN product.
agnews:train:14915.para: On Monday, Juniper Networks announced enhancements to its NetScreen Secure Access SSL VPN product, aiming to strengthen the security of devices connecting to a network.

agnews:train:15006.orig: Britain seeking support to stop stem cell ban LONDON - Britain #39;s leading scientific institution said yesterday it is calling for support from other countries to stop a possible ban on stem cell research as part of a global treaty to ban human cloning.
agnews:train:15006.para: The UK's top scientific body is urging international backing to prevent a potential prohibition on stem cell studies, which could be included in a worldwide agreement aimed at outlawing human cloning, as reported in LONDON.

agnews:train:15092.orig: Microsoft Taking on Apple's Music Store (AP) AP - Microsoft Corp., hoping to take a bite out of Apple Computer Inc.'s highly popular online music service, is gearing up to launch its own Web site for selling songs over the Internet.
agnews:train:15092.para: Microsoft prepares to challenge Apple's successful online music platform by setting up its own website for selling music over the Internet, as reported by AP.

agnews:train:15106.orig: Expedition 9 Crew Prepares for Final Spacewalk (SPACE.com) SPACE.com - The two astronauts aboard the International Space Station (ISS) will step outside their orbital home one more time next week during the fourth and final spacewalk of their mission.
agnews:train:15106.para: The crew of Expedition 9 is gearing up for their concluding extravehicular activity (EVA) next week, marking the fourth and ultimate spacewalk of their mission, as reported by SPACE.com.

agnews:train:15218.orig: Bombing Suspect Detained At Afghanistan Airport KABUL, Afghanistan -- NATO troops in Afghanistan have detained a man at Kabul airport who had traces of explosives on his hands, a day after a US security firm was bombed, killing 10 people, including three Americans.
agnews:train:15218.para: NATO forces in Afghanistan have apprehended an individual at Kabul airport, where explosive residues were found on his hands, following a day marked by a bombing incident that resulted in the death of 10 individuals, among them three American citizens.

agnews:train:15267.orig: High Court Petitioned on Cable Net Access Rule (washingtonpost.com) washingtonpost.com - The Bush administration has asked the Supreme Court to overturn a decision that requires cable companies to open their high-speed Internet networks to rival online providers.
agnews:train:15267.para: The Bush administration petitioned the Supreme Court to reverse a ruling mandating cable firms to allow competing online service providers access to their high-speed Internet infrastructure, as reported by washingtonpost.com.

agnews:train:15530.orig: Volz in the clear over injury to fan Fulham full-back Moritz Volz will not face police action after he collided with a pensioner during the Premiership match with Portsmouth at Fratton Park.
agnews:train:15530.para: Moritz Volz, the Premiership's fan full-back for Fulham, will not be subjected to police measures following his accidental collision with an elderly individual during the match against Portsmouth at Fratton Park.

agnews:train:15632.orig: Convention Boasts State-of-Art Technology The Republican National Convention has more than 40,000 miles of cabling to operate high speed computer systems, telephone lines and live television broadcasts.
agnews:train:15632.para: The Republican National Convention showcases cutting-edge technology, featuring over 40,000 miles of wiring to manage high-speed computers, telecommunication lines, and real-time television transmissions.

agnews:train:15827.orig: Video Game Sales Seen Pausing After Record 2003 (Reuters) Reuters - Video game sales soared to a record\ #36;18.2 billion last year, but the days of strong growth are on\pause as players await a new generation of consoles in 2005 and\2006, a new study showed on Wednesday.
agnews:train:15827.para: According to a study released on Wednesday, video game revenue reached a peak of\ #36;18.2 billion in the previous year, yet the era of rapid expansion has temporarily halted as consumers anticipate the arrival of next-gen consoles in 2005 and 2006, as reported by Reuters.

agnews:train:15883.orig: UK no longer top asylum nation The UK has been replaced by France as the top destination for asylum seekers in the industrialised world, says the UN.
agnews:train:15883.para: The UN reports that France has surpassed the UK as the leading destination for asylum seekers in industrialized nations.

agnews:train:15913.orig: For CEOs, offshoring pays U.S. companies that send the most jobs overseas handsomely reward their CEOs, a new study says.
agnews:train:15913.para: According to a recent study, the practice of offshoring brings substantial financial benefits to U.S. corporations, particularly in the form of lucrative compensation for their top executives.

agnews:train:16074.orig: Miss Universe, Olympians in Australia Poll Bout  SYDNEY (Reuters) - The first face-to-face bout in  Australia's election campaign was staged inside an airport  hangar on Wednesday with prime ministerial contenders sparring  with Miss Universe and hundreds of Olympians before a phalanx  of cameras.
agnews:train:16074.para: In Sydney, the inaugural in-person clash of Australia's election campaign unfolded within an airport hangar on Wednesday, featuring prime ministerial hopefuls engaging in a verbal duel with Miss Universe and numerous Olympians, all under the watchful eye of a multitude of cameras, as reported by Reuters.

agnews:train:16130.orig: Microsoft strips Longhorn of WinFS NEW YORK, September 1 (New Ratings) - Microsoft (MSFT.NAS) reportedly intends to ship Longhorn, its next version of Windows operating system, without WinFS, the next-generation file system.
agnews:train:16130.para: Microsoft plans to release Longhorn, its upcoming Windows OS iteration, excluding WinFS, the advanced file system technology, as per reports from New York, September 1 (New Ratings).

agnews:train:16202.orig: Tougher policy in works In the wake of leaked grand jury testimony that implicated superstars Barry Bonds and Jason Giambi in the BALCO steroid scandal, Major League Baseball and the Players Association may be close to forging a tougher new policy on drug testing.
agnews:train:16202.para: In response to the exposed grand jury evidence linking Barry Bonds and Jason Giambi to the BALCO steroid controversy, Major League Baseball and the Players Association are nearing an agreement on implementing a stricter drug testing policy.

agnews:train:16366.orig: Mitsubishi Pleads Not Guilty to Cover-Up TOKYO Sept. 1, 2004 - Mitsubishi Motors Corp. and three former executives pleaded not guilty Wednesday to falsifying data on a vehicle defect that caused a wheel to fly off a truck and kill a pedestrian, the company said.
agnews:train:16366.para: Mitsubishi Motors Corp. and three ex-officers asserted their innocence Wednesday regarding the alleged manipulation of data related to a defect in a vehicle that led to a wheel detaching from a truck and resulting in a pedestrian's death, as per the company's statement.

agnews:train:16395.orig: Cybercafe nets nomination for style A funky Melbourne cybercafe in an Elizabeth Street basement has been named one of the best internet cafes in the world in a survey by search engine company Yahoo.
agnews:train:16395.para: A trendy internet café located in a basement on Elizabeth Street, Melbourne, has been recognized as one of the top internet cafes globally, according to a survey conducted by the search engine firm Yahoo.

agnews:train:16487.orig: Stocks Are Mixed as Oil Prices Rise Stocks were trading mixed today following a lower reading on manufacturing activity and a spike in oil prices
agnews:train:16487.para: Today's stock market exhibits a varied performance amidst an increase in oil prices, following a subdued report on manufacturing activity.

agnews:train:16565.orig: Mountaineers prepared to lead the new-look Big East The Mountaineers open the season in The Associated Press top 10 for the first time in school history. There are great expectations in Morgantown these days.
agnews:train:16565.para: The Big East's Mountaineers are gearing up for a revamped season, marking their debut in the AP's top 10, a first in the institution's chronicles. The city of Morgantown is buzzing with high hopes.

agnews:train:16702.orig: Three Killed in Rush for IKEA Vouchers Three men were trampled to death in a rush to claim vouchers at the first IKEA furniture showroom in Saudi Arabia Wednesday, hospital officials said.
agnews:train:16702.para: Three individuals perished amid the frenzy to obtain IKEA discounts at the inaugural IKEA store in Saudi Arabia, as per hospital authorities' reports.

agnews:train:16735.orig: Longhorn cuts delay Microsoft Business Framework By cutting WinFS from Longhorn and indefinitely delaying the storage system, Microsoft Corp. has also again delayed the Microsoft Business Framework (MBF), a new Windows programming layer that is closely tied to WinFS.
agnews:train:16735.para: Microsoft's decision to remove WinFS from Longhorn and postpone the storage system has also resulted in a further postponement of the Microsoft Business Framework (MBF), a new Windows programming layer that is closely associated with WinFS.

agnews:train:16772.orig: Powell Says U.N Must Act Now on Iran Weapons  WASHINGTON (Reuters) -  Secretary of State Colin Powell  said on Wednesday the time had come for the United Nations to  take punitive action against Iran for its alleged nuclear  weapons program.
agnews:train:16772.para: On Wednesday, U.S. Secretary of State Colin Powell asserted that the United Nations should immediately implement punitive measures against Iran due to its suspected nuclear weapons program, as reported by Reuters in Washington.

agnews:train:16818.para: Despite the Yankees' composure following a 22-0 setback against the Indians, George Steinbrenner, the team's proprietor, expressed his thoughts to his team less than a day after enduring the franchise's most lamentable defeat.

agnews:train:16827.orig: Hundreds Held Hostage at Russian School, UN Demands Their Freedom The UN Security Council has strongly condemned the seizure of up to 400 people at a school in Russia, as the tense standoff enters its second day Thursday.
agnews:train:16827.para: The UN Security Council has vehemently criticized the captivity of approximately 400 individuals at a Russian educational institution, marking the second day of a fraught impasse Thursday.

agnews:train:16889.orig: Spam shows signs of levelling off but don #39;t hold your breath It might be too early to celebrate, but according to Symantec #39;s numbers, the rate of increase of internet spam is easing a bit.
agnews:train:16889.para: According to Symantec's data, the escalation of internet spam appears to be plateauing, though it's premature to rejoice just yet.

agnews:train:16911.orig: U.N. agnews:train:16911.para: A high-level Bosnian Serb official was found guilty by the U.N. war crimes court of torture, forced displacement, and other offenses against Bosnian Muslims and Bosnian Croats, yet was cleared of genocide charges. The court handed down a 32-year prison sentence.

agnews:train:17037.orig: Sorry, E.T., but Parcel Post May Beat Phoning Home A physicist and an electrical engineer claim it is more efficient to send a long message as a physical package, a cosmic FedEx, than as radio wave or laser pulse.
agnews:train:17037.para: Regrettably, E.T., but dispatching a lengthy message as a tangible parcel, akin to a cosmic delivery service, could prove more efficient than transmitting it via radio waves or laser pulses, asserts a physicist and an electrical engineer.

agnews:train:17049.orig: Cubs scratch out a win MONTREAL -- If this were gymnastics, the Cubs would get low scores from the judges for awkward form at times in Wednesday night #39;s 2-1 victory in 11 innings over the Montreal Expos.
agnews:train:17049.para: In a 2-1 triumph over the Montreal Expos in a marathon 11-inning game on Wednesday night, the Cubs would likely receive modest scores from gymnastics judges due to their occasionally clumsy execution.

agnews:train:17183.orig: Eurozone rates unchanged at 2 The European Central Bank leaves eurozone interest rates on hold at 2, and upgrades its economic growth forecasts.
agnews:train:17183.para: The European Central Bank maintains eurozone interest rates at 2 percent and enhances its projections for economic expansion.

agnews:train:17195.orig: Up to the Challenge The Redskins contend that last week's debacle in the secondary against the Rams isn't a true gauge of life after Champ Bailey.
agnews:train:17195.para: The Redskins argue that the previous week's setback in the defensive backfield against the Rams doesn't accurately reflect the post-Champ Bailey era.

agnews:train:17296.para: Microsoft refines SharePoint enhancements, introducing significant improvements in support, search capabilities, and update functionalities.

agnews:train:17435.orig: Risks on both sides seen in Kobe Bryant civil case EAGLE, Colo. -- In pressing on with her civil suit against NBA star Kobe Bryant, the woman accusing him of rape will not have to meet the higher standard of proof required in a criminal case.
agnews:train:17435.para: The woman pursuing a civil lawsuit against NBA luminary Kobe Bryant does not need to satisfy the more stringent evidence threshold typical in criminal proceedings. This situation unfolds in Eagle, Colorado.

agnews:train:17450.orig: 'Zippy' chipper despite loss A couple of the somebodies around here are going to walk away from Flushing Meadow with a million bucks apiece in their petty cash stash. You can call them champ.
agnews:train:17450.para: A few individuals in this vicinity will depart from Flushing Meadow with a million dollars each in their modest funds. They deserve the title of champion.

agnews:train:17465.orig: Three Turkish hostages believed killed  BAGHDAD -- A Paris newspaper editor said there had been positive movement in the effort to free two captive French journalists yesterday, while a separate militant group said it had killed three Turkish captives.
agnews:train:17465.para: According to a Paris newspaper editor, there was progress in the rescue operation for two French journalists detained yesterday. Meanwhile, a different militant faction claimed responsibility for the deaths of three Turkish hostages.

agnews:train:17481.orig: Red Sox Sweep Angels Derek Lowe pitches effectively into the eighth inning, and Boston takes control of the wild-card race Thursday night by completing a three-game sweep of Anaheim.

agnews:train:17591.orig: Security alert identifies Oracle holes Software security companies and US-Cert, the US government #39;s computer monitoring body, have issued warnings about security vulnerabilities in Oracle software.
agnews:train:17591.para: Oracle's software has been flagged for security weaknesses by security alert entities, including software security firms and US-Cert, the US's computer surveillance authority. They have alerted about the security vulnerabilities in Oracle's software.

agnews:train:17619.orig: EU commission proposes new interpretation of eurozone budget rules (AFP) AFP - The European Commission said it had adopted a plan to adapt eurozone rules intended to control budget deficits in order to improve the way they work and their credibility.
agnews:train:17619.para: The European Commission has introduced a revised approach to the eurozone's fiscal regulations aimed at managing budget deficits, with the goal of enhancing their functionality and trustworthiness. (Source: AFP)

agnews:train:17664.orig: Calif. agnews:train:17664.para: California educational institutions have alerted approximately 600,000 students and staff about potential risks of identity theft due to incidents involving the loss or unauthorized access to their personal data stored on computer hard drives.

agnews:train:17782.orig: Iraqi Sunni Leaders Aim to Build on Shia Peace Gains It has been a week since a peace deal was struck in the Iraqi city of Najaf, bringing an end to three weeks of fighting and opening the predominantly Shia city up to millions of dollars in reconstruction aid.

agnews:train:17950.orig: Hundreds die in commando raid MORE than 200 people - including children - are believed to have died after the school hostage crisis in Russia came to chaotic and bloody end today.
agnews:train:17950.para: Over 200 individuals, including children, are presumed to have perished in the tumultuous and violent conclusion of the school hostage situation in Russia today.

agnews:train:17961.orig: Job Picture Brightens with August Hiring The US job market brightened modestly in August as employers added 144,000 workers to payrolls and weak hiring tallies for the two prior months were revised up, the Labor Department said on Friday.
agnews:train:17961.para: The US employment landscape saw a modest improvement in August with the addition of 144,000 workers to the payrolls, as the Labor Department announced on Friday. The previous two months' hiring figures were also adjusted upwards.

agnews:train:18060.para: The European Commission imposed a fine of E222.3 million on six companies, including Outokumpu and IMI, for colluding to set the prices of copper tubing utilized in residential plumbing systems, as announced on Friday.

agnews:train:18081.orig: Ch. 11 threat for US Airways flier miles US Airways is at risk of filing Chapter 11 bankruptcy, which has frequent fliers thinking about cashing in miles, Boston.com reports.
agnews:train:18081.para: Chapter 11 bankruptcy looms over US Airways, prompting regular flyers to consider redeeming their miles, according to a report by Boston.com.

agnews:train:18121.orig: Statham Moves Forward Quarterback Joel Statham has emerged as the team's clear starter who will lead 22nd-ranked Maryland against Northern Illinois on Saturday.
agnews:train:18121.para: Joel Statham advances as the unquestionable leader of the squad, set to guide the 22nd-placed Maryland in their upcoming clash with Northern Illinois on Saturday.

agnews:train:18214.orig: Spoon #39;s summer drought JD WETHERSPOON embarked on a fresh round of price promotions yesterday to win back drinkers after a dismal summer for the pubs chain.
agnews:train:18214.para: JD WETHERSPOON initiated a new series of discount campaigns yesterday, aiming to regain patronage following a challenging summer period for the pubs group.

agnews:train:18247.orig: Report: More than 200 dead after troops storm school The operation to end the school hostage crisis in Russia is over but more than 200 people have died after troops stormed the building.
agnews:train:18247.para: The report concludes that over 200 fatalities have occurred following the military's assault on the school premises to resolve the ongoing hostage situation in Russia.

agnews:train:18366.orig: Away on Business: Islands of Refuge  CHICAGO (Reuters) - Today's highly stressed business  travelers may need islands of respite to restore the spirit and  calm the tensions that build with security checks, crowded  flights and navigating a car in unfamiliar territory.
agnews:train:18366.para: In the realm of corporate travel, today's overworked professionals might require sanctuaries to rejuvenate their spirits and alleviate the stress that accumulates from security procedures, packed air travel, and driving in unknown locales. (Reported by Reuters)

agnews:train:18370.orig: Woods right on course There have been signs of danger he has read about, warnings of trouble told to him.
agnews:train:18370.para: The path he's following is clear, with indications of peril he's been made aware of, cautionary tales of potential issues relayed to him.

agnews:train:18526.orig: Pakistan swears in 27 more ministers for new cabinet ISLAMABAD (AFP) -- Pakistani President Pervez Musharraf on Saturday swore in another 27 ministers, three days after inducting a 32-member cabinet headed by newly elected Prime Minister Shaukat Aziz, officials said.

agnews:train:33864.para: Impressive Australians showed no concerns as Adam Gilchrist observed a distraction-free zone within the Edgbaston indoor nets centre on Monday. He reflected on the vast space with only three stumps positioned at one end.

agnews:train:34272.orig: Fed Seen Boosting Rates Despite Worries (Reuters) Reuters - Federal Reserve policy-makers were\expected to raise U.S. interest rates on Tuesday for a third\time this year, continuing to lift borrowing costs from\rock-bottom levels despite some signs of economic softness.
agnews:train:34272.para: According to Reuters, it is anticipated that the Federal Reserve will increase U.S. interest rates for the third occasion in a year on Tuesday, persisting in elevating borrowing costs from their lowest points even though there are indications of a softening economy.

agnews:train:34316.para: An expert in aviation predicts that Air New Zealand and Qantas may revise their approach, opting to collaborate on resource sharing rather than merging into a joint venture.

agnews:train:34320.para: Most economists argue that the Federal Reserve wields more power than presidents do in shaping economic outcomes, despite the latter often attributing successes and being blamed for failures. Critics perceive political bias in these attributions.

agnews:train:34484.para: In Haiti, the number of fatalities due to flooding and landslides caused by Tropical Storm Jeanne has surpassed 660 as of Tuesday, with government representatives still working hard to access isolated regions submerged by floodwaters, according to Reuters.

agnews:train:35674.para: The Iraqi authorities have announced plans to liberate a woman in captivity, following demands from Islamic militant kidnappers who have warned of harm to a third Western hostage if their plea is ignored.

agnews:train:35808.para: The Ministry of National Defense announced today that the 2,800 South Korean forces dispatched to support the US-led mission in Iraq have reached their destination in the Kurdish region of the north without incident.

agnews:train:35891.para: Following the impact of Hurricane Ivan, U.S. inventory figures revealed a significant reduction in fuel reserves, propelling oil prices above \$48 per barrel on Wednesday, as reported by Reuters.

agnews:train:36148.para: Kevin Willis, a free agent, was recently signed by the Atlanta Hawks on Wednesday, marking nearly a decade since he concluded an 11-year tenure with the same team, as reported by the Sports Network.

agnews:train:37242.para: The company Nokia promotes its latest smartphone, set to launch in October, featuring an integrated high-resolution camera. Additionally, they are planning a wireless system for home surveillance.

agnews:train:45730.para: Before market opening on Monday, Navistar International Corp.'s stock saw a 2.7% increase, as the company projected an uptick in both fourth-quarter earnings and revenue, according to Reuters.

agnews:test:5.orig: Open Letter Against British Copyright Indoctrination in Schools The British Department for Education and Skills (DfES) recently launched a "Music Manifesto" campaign, with the ostensible intention of educating the next generation of British musicians. EMI has apparently negotiated their end well, so that children in our schools will now be indoctrinated about the illegality of downloading music.The ignorance and audacity of this got to me a little, so I wrote an open letter to the DfES about it. But I hope you find it useful, and perhaps feel inspired to do something similar, if or when the same thing has happened in your area.
agnews:test:5.para: The recent "Music Manifesto" initiative by the British Department for Education and Skills (DfES), aimed at nurturing future British musicians, has also partnered with the music industry, including EMI and various artists. The blatant ignorance and boldness of this move prompted me to pen an open letter to the DfES. While the letter may come across as pedantic, it's necessary when addressing government officials. I trust it will be beneficial and may encourage similar actions in your region if faced with a similar situation.

agnews:test:6.para:
According to a six-month report by antivirus firm Sophos, Sven Jaschan, who confessed to creating the Netsky and Sasser viruses, was accountable for 70% of virus infections in 2004. German authorities apprehended the 18-year-old in May after he confessed to crafting both the Netsky and Sasser worms, a fact verified by Microsoft experts. The teenager's arrest was facilitated by a Microsoft antivirus reward initiative. agnews:test:2754.orig: Supernova Warning System Will Give Astronomers Earlier Notice Duke University -- A Supernova Early Warning System (SNEWS) that detects ghostlike neutrino particles that are the earliest emanations from the immense, explosive death throes of large stars will alert astronomers of the blasts before they can see the flash.     SNEWS "could allow astronomers a chance to make unprecedented observations of the very early turn-on of the supernova," wrote the authors of an article about the new system in the September issue of the "New Journal of Physics."     They also noted that "no supernova has ever been observed soon after its birth."     Big stars end their lives in explosive gravitational collapses so complete that even the brilliant flashes of light usually announcing these extremely rare "supernova" events stay trapped inside, unseen by astronomers, for the first hours or days...
agnews:test:2754.para: A system designed to forewarn astronomers about impending supernovas, known as SNEWS, will alert them to the presence of elusive neutrino particles that are the first signals from the colossal, cataclysmic demise of massive stars. This system could provide astronomers with a unique opportunity to observe the initial stages of supernovas before they become visible through light. The authors of a study on this system, published in the September issue of the "New Journal of Physics," highlighted that no supernova has ever been detected immediately after its formation. They explained that the final moments of large stars culminate in such a powerful gravitational collapse that the typical light signals, which usually signify these infrequent "supernova" occurrences, remain confined within the star and invisible to astronomers for the initial hours or days.

banking77:train:3034.para:
Navigate the process of obtaining a digital payment card by following these steps:

1. Identify a reputable online platform that offers virtual card services.
2. Create an account with the necessary personal and financial information.
3. Complete the application form, ensuring all details are accurate and up-to-date.
4. Await approval from the platform, which may take a few days.
5. Once approved, download and install the virtual card application on your device.
6. Link the virtual card to your existing bank account or credit card for seamless transactions.
7. Familiarize yourself with the security features and usage guidelines to ensure safe and efficient use of your virtual card.
8. Begin utilizing your virtual card for online purchases, bill payments, and other digital transactions.

yelp:train:130.orig:
I usually have nothing but good things to say about this place. I've dealt with Fran and others and have had very good experiences. However, this time was very different. I called to find out how much they might charge to install some brakes and rotors that I had, i was reffered to Mark, the mechanic. I made the appointment with him for Tuesday Sept 30th, he quoted me between $179 - $200 for the work (though the first person I spoke to quoted $150-$179) and told me to bring it at 8am and it would be finished the same day.when I brought it on Tuesday, Septempber 30th at 8 am, Mark forgets that i even made the appointment with him (or didnt bother to make a note of it) saying, ""oh, I thought you were supposed to bring this by yesterday"". He says I should expect this to probably be done before 3pm. 

I soon recieve a call from Mark at 10:25am, where he tells me the charge will actually be $240 (for four hours of labor + $13 worth of materials, before even getting started to see how long the job would actually take) and that the car would be ready by 3pm, if not possibly before that. Also for good measure he decides to randomly throw in, ""oh, and we don't take checks"". 

Th
yelp:train:130.para:
Typically, I express my satisfaction with this establishment, having positive interactions with Fran and others. Nevertheless, my recent encounter was notably distinct. I reached out to inquire about the cost of installing brakes and rotors I possessed, and was redirected to Mark, the mechanic. I scheduled an appointment with him for Tuesday, September 30th, during which he provided a price range of $179 to $200 (compared to the initial quote of $150 to $179) and assured me the task would be completed on the same day, starting at 8am. However, upon my arrival on Tuesday, September 30th at 8am, Mark seemed to have forgotten our appointment, suggesting I had brought it in the previous day. He then mentioned I could expect the job to be finished by 3pm at the latest.

Shortly after, I received a call from Mark at 10:25am, where he informed me the final charge would be $240 (comprising four hours of labor and $13 worth of materials before commencing the job) and that the car would be ready by 3pm, potentially even earlier. To add to the surprise, he also mentioned that they do not accept checks as a form of payment.

Th

yelp:train:679.para:
Sharia and Becky are not fond of it. 

On a warm Tuesday evening, my boy and I visited Casbah, a restaurant with a cozy outdoor patio that wasn't crowded. Our waitress was amiable and provided detailed information about the drink and food selections. 

We enjoyed a bottle of Mission la Caminade (Malbec, French), a well-balanced wine. 

Despite positive reviews from many customers about Casbah's bread and pesto, I found better sourdough elsewhere and the pesto lacked distinction. 

For an appetizer, I had asparagus soup with crab, which was served chilled and seemed fresh, but something was amiss, and I only consumed half. 

I ordered the orecchiette pasta with grilled chicken and cranberries in a goat cheese cream sauce. Unfortunately, it was quite unremarkable, with cranberries being the only notable flavor. 

My boy chose the ricotta cavatelli pasta in a marinara sauce with sausage and ricotta, which was disappointingly flavorless. The ricotta was simply added on top and didn't enhance the dish. 

We briefly looked at the dessert menu afterward.

yelp:train:1071.orig: Nick's used to be good with the previous owner, that all changed. Which is pretty sad.
yelp:train:1071.para: Nick's relationship with the former owner was positive, but it has since deteriorated, which is quite disheartening.

yelp:train:1296.orig: I used to live in the area and would always patronize and recommend this business.  However with the last experience I will have to rethink that. My aunt and uncle ordered a gift basket for my grandmother for her birthday. When it was delivered it looked beautiful.  However once opened not so much.  Inside it was filled with....Dollar General brand goods. When I stopped down to tell them the owner and another worker told me what do you expect. If it was a busy season we would have gotten stuff from the strip. So moral of the tale. If you want to pay a whole lot of money for stuff from the Dollar Store you know where to go. To make it even more special the owner will provide a blank stare and a warm welcoming attitude that clearly shows she does not care.
yelp:train:1296.para: I previously resided in this vicinity and consistently supported and suggested this establishment. Nevertheless, following my most recent encounter, I must reconsider my previous endorsements. My relatives purchased a birthday gift basket for my grandmother from this place. Upon its arrival, it appeared quite appealing. However, once it was unpacked, the contents were disappointing. The basket was filled with items from the Dollar General brand. When I expressed my concerns to the proprietor and a colleague, they responded with a sense of resignation, implying that during peak times, we might have received items from the commercial strip. The lesson here is that if you're willing to spend a significant amount on products from the Dollar Store, you're aware of where to find them. The owner's indifferent demeanor, characterized by a blank expression and a seemingly warm welcome, further underscores their lack of genuine care.

yelp:train:1799.orig: First time ever in Pittsburg and had to have Primanti Bros. Sandwich was awesome! (Cheesesteak) and a tall Yuengling to go with. Perfection!
yelp:train:1799.para: For the first time visiting Pittsburgh, I indulged in an exceptional Primanti Bros. Cheesesteak sandwich, complemented by a tall Yuengling, achieving a state of culinary perfection.

yelp:train:1817.orig: So an honest review.  Bland.  Service good prices cheap but food very bland and pre made.  I ordered the new black bean burger sandwich.  Bread not toasted, burger tasted a lot like my morning star black bean burger that I get frozen.  Cole sale was a lot better with the hot sauce I smothered on it.  The best part was by far the fries which weren't all that great.  I am glad that those were home made.  I picked all the bread off ate mostly the fries and was not very impressed.  The beer makes everything tastes better so order at least two beers before eating.  I'm not a big foodie but I like my food taste better.  I still ate because I was hungry and it's not uneatable, just bland and kinda of boring.  It's still a must do in Pitts so go ahead and do it at least once, but skip the rest of your stay.
yelp:train:1817.para: A truthful critique reveals a lackluster experience. The service was commendable, prices were reasonable, yet the cuisine was uninspired and pre-packaged. I opted for the recently introduced black bean burger sandwich, only to find the bread un-toasted and the flavor reminiscent of my usual frozen morning star black bean burger. The Cole sale offered some relief with the added hot sauce, but the fries, despite being homemade, fell short of expectations. I removed most of the bread and focused on the fries, leaving me unimpressed. The beer did enhance the overall taste, so it's recommended to have at least two before dining. Although not a connoisseur of fine dining, I prefer my meals to have a more distinctive flavor. Despite the food not being inedible, it was rather dull and monotonous. While it's worth visiting at least once in Pittsburgh, it's advisable to forego the remainder of your visit.

yelp:train:2062.orig: We came here to see the play \""You say Tomato I Say Shut Up!\"" and what fun we had! The stage is visible from any seat, the waitress was never too far and the food was satisfying. We really had a great time and enjoyed watching a play while eating and drinking. Great time and we can't wait to come back for another show.
yelp:train:2062.para: Our visit to witness the performance of \"Tomato, I Say Silence!\" turned out to be a delightful experience! The stage was easily visible from all positions, the service was consistently attentive, and the meals were thoroughly enjoyable. We thoroughly relished the unique blend of theatre and dining, and are eagerly anticipating our return for another performance.

yelp:train:2436.orig: After walking around the Strip District, this certainly hit the spot. We did the buffet, and I got the pasta trio. I was not disappointed. Endless amounts of great pasta, plus everything else that came with the buffet table. It's a classy place, but people from all walks of life were eating there, from people dressed in Steelers gear to older, well-dressed couples. I'd definitely come back or go to her other restaurant.
yelp:train:2436.para: Exploring the Strip District, I found it quite satisfying. I opted for the buffet and chose the pasta trio, which exceeded my expectations. There was an abundance of delicious pasta, along with a variety of other offerings from the buffet. Despite its upscale ambiance, it welcomed a diverse crowd, from Steelers enthusiasts to mature, elegantly attired pairs. I'm inclined to return or visit her other dining establishment.

yelp:train:3078.orig: This is up there in my top 5 thrift stores. While it doesn't have a lot in the way of furniture (a few pieces downstairs), it has plenty of everything else. My first visit was meant to be a short browse, but it turned into a marathon 2.5 hour shop. There were shelves and shelves of bric-a-brac to sort through, kitchen supplies galore, and so many clothes I couldn't even think about looking through them all. The only downsides were the out of control kids running around, and the constant traffic jams of shopping carts in the aisles. Otherwise, I highly recommend this place for the serious thrifter/new apartment dweller/anyone looking to kill a few hours.
yelp:train:3078.para: Among my favorite thrift shops, this one ranks in the top five. Although it lacks extensive furniture (just a few items on the ground floor), it overflows with various other items. My initial trip was intended to be a brief perusal, but it evolved into an extensive 2.5-hour shopping spree. There were countless racks of knick-knacks to sift through, an abundance of kitchenware, and an overwhelming array of clothing that made it impossible to consider examining each piece. The only drawbacks were the unruly children and the frequent congestion caused by shopping carts in the corridors. Nonetheless, I wholeheartedly endorse this establishment for avid bargain hunters, individuals moving into new residences, or anyone seeking to pass time.

yelp:train:3123.orig: If you're seeking bland, salty, Chinese food where every entree tastes exactly the same as the other...this is your place!
yelp:train:3123.para: Should you desire monotonous, salt-infused Chinese cuisine where each dish mirrors the flavor of its counterparts...this establishment is what you're looking for!

yelp:train:3150.orig:
The appetizer was bruschetta.  Essentially three pieces of toast with various toppings.  Two of the three were good, but the brocolinni topped one was not my taste.  Certainly, this was NOT worth the $12 price.  Our dinner was pizza.  The crust was very good - almost like a soft, warm, flat breadstick.  Sadly, the pizza was sparsely topped with cheese and sausage.

Our server was attentive, almost to a fault.  The restaurant was excessively loud - we couldn't hear the waitress rattle off the soup, appetizer or entree specials (seven specials in total).

While the food was not bad, I can't justify the prices or quantities.  In fact, I really didn't pull up Yelp to rate this restaurant...I'm actually looking for a place to go eat since I'm still famished after ""eating"" here.
yelp:train:3150.para:
The starter consisted of bruschetta, which is essentially three slices of toast with different toppings. Out of the three, two were enjoyable, but the one with broccoli didn't suit my palate. It was undeniably not a fair exchange for the $12 cost. Our main course was pizza, which had a delightful crust resembling a soft, warm, flat breadstick. However, the pizza was disappointingly lightly topped with cheese and sausage.

Our waiter was overly attentive, bordering on intrusive. The restaurant's noise level was overwhelmingly high, making it difficult to hear the waiter mention the seven specials.

Although the food wasn't terrible, I can't justify the high prices or the portion sizes. In fact, I didn't feel compelled to rate this restaurant on Yelp. I'm actually on the lookout for a new place to dine since I'm still hungry after this meal.

yelp:train:3364.para:
The renowned "Birthday Coupon" led us to this spot, which had been on our wish list for some time. I managed to persuade my spouse to join us for a special evening. 

The only available seating without a booking was at the bar, and we were one of the few patrons there, making it an ideal quiet setting. 

We were welcomed by the bartender, who was both well-informed and amiable. He handed us drink menus and gave us plenty of time to choose. 

We began with the hamachi sashimi, a delightful combination of pomegranate, pear, and avocado with amber jack tuna. Accompanied by a spicy sauce, the blend was truly delicious. The presentation was also impressive. 

My main dish was the Thaikkal curry, a unique and informative experience for me. The eggplant was fire-grilled and perfectly complemented the curry sauce. It was served with bean sprouts and fresh mango slices, a combination I had never considered with a curry. The roti was fried, which wasn't my preferred choice. 

My partner opted for the seafood hot pot. A generous portion of seafood with rice, this substantial dish was quite filling.

yelp:train:3471.orig:
One of my favorite things to do is consignment shop. On a dreary day I decided to look up a few local shops to hit up and my finale trip was to Hey Betty's.

Hey Betty's seemed to be very organized. It was a small area, but had a lot to offer without seeming to give you a garage sale vibe. The men's clothing was next to none but I can still appreciate nice things even when they are not for my gender. There were tons of hat boxes and great jewelry pieces to pick from.

The reason for the 2 star review is the service. The woman working the counter who I'm assuming to be the owner was not friendly at all. We greeted her before she greeted us which I find rude. She did not ask us anything when we were shopping. She just sat there and read a magazine. The only time she interacted with us is when we basically forced her. It was quite the turnoff.

To me customer service is everything. If you cannot greet your customers or educate them about your items/services you're providing then that's one less store I need to go back to. I would recommend it to someone who is looking for vintage clothing but not to someone who is looking for a great customer service experience.
yelp:train:3471.para: On a gloomy day, I chose to explore some nearby consignment stores, culminating in a visit to Hey Betty's. The store exuded a sense of orderliness, occupying a compact space yet abundant in offerings, devoid of a garage sale feel. Despite the limited selection of men's attire, I can still admire quality items regardless of gender. The store boasted numerous hat boxes and exquisite jewelry selections. However, the 2-star rating stems from the subpar service. The presumed owner, a woman at the counter, displayed an unfriendly demeanor. She greeted us only after we initiated the interaction, which I perceived as impolite. Her lack of engagement during our shopping experience, save for our insistence, was disappointing. In my view, exceptional customer service is paramount. A store that fails to greet and inform its customers about its merchandise or services diminishes its appeal. I would suggest Hey Betty's to those in search of vintage clothing, but not to individuals seeking superior customer service.

yelp:train:3611.para:
Pittsburgh boasts a Four Seasons experience!

Though it lacks the amenities of a larger hotel, such as conference rooms or a spa, as a B&B, it stands out remarkably.

yelp:train:4841.orig: TWC IS THE WORST!\n\nUnfortunately, TWC has basically monopolized the Charlotte area.  I am very jealous of all the people who have AT&T Uverse available to them.  I have contemplated DirectTV because TWC is so awful. yelp:train:4841.para: TWC is exceptionally poor!\n\nRegrettably, TWC has nearly established a monopoly in the Charlotte region. I am envious of those who can access AT&T Uverse services. I've considered switching to DirectTV due to TWC's subpar performance. Every few months, the supposed "promotion" on my plan ends, and when I reach out, they claim to offer the most favorable promotion they rarely provide to other customers by reducing $5...how considerate. They genuinely don't prioritize their customers' dissatisfaction as they are aware of their limited alternatives for digital TV. If other options are available, it's advisable to utilize them!

I had high expectations considering that I was in the South.  I love the food in the South!  However the experience here was not very good!  

I grew up eating most of the food on the menu, and I tend to make strong comparisons against that home cooking.  In addition, I love food, and I have a wide taste bud ranging from various regions of the world.

The food was delivered to me at my table very very very very very hot.  I was unable to comfortably eat for approx. 7 to 10 minutes.   I ordered Fried Chicken, Greens, Yams, Catfish, and Banana Pudding.  The previous day, my business colleague order and ate the red beans and rice.

Service was good.  The menu needs help.

1) The Fried Chicken wasn't really fried.  It looked like baked chicken that was dried out.  Not crispy looking, not seasoned. Not very tasty.
2) The Catfish was a complete fish with bones.  The taste was pretty good! However, I would have enjoyed it more had I not had to de-bone every bite.
3) The Greens were good!
4) Yams were good!
5) Corn bread was just ok
6) Banana Pudding was very good!
7) Red beans rice and sausage was not good.

All and all, the Merts was just ok,  However, if in town again, I
yelp:train:4932.para:
I anticipated a delightful culinary experience due to my Southern location. I have a deep appreciation for Southern cuisine! Regrettably, my encounter here fell short of expectations. 

Having grown up consuming a majority of the dishes on the menu, I am accustomed to making robust comparisons with my homemade meals. My love for food and a diverse palate that spans various global regions further enhance my dining experiences. 

The food arrived at my table excessively hot, making it uncomfortable to eat for about 7 to 10 minutes. I ordered Fried Chicken, Greens, Yams, Catfish, and Banana Pudding. The previous day, my business associate enjoyed the red beans and rice. 

The service was commendable. However, the menu requires improvement. 

1) The Fried Chicken lacked the expected crispiness and seasoning, resembling dried-out baked chicken. It was not very appetizing. 
2) The Catfish, although tasty, was served with bones, which detracted from the overall enjoyment. 
3) The Greens and Yams were satisfactory. 
4) The Corn bread was average. 
5) The Banana Pudding was exceptional. 
6) The Red beans and sausage did not meet my expectations. 

In summary

yelp:train:4972.orig:
I'm somewhat embarrassed about this review as I work in Uptown, love this kind of cooking, have known Mert's existed but have never gone!  Remedied that on Wednesday morning and seriously had perhaps the best breakfast I've ever had.

I got just the basics - scrambled eggs, sausage, home fries, biscuit and a buttermilk pancake on the side.  OMFG!  Perfectly cooked eggs, two huge sausage patties that were seared on the outside and moist/tender on the inside (yes they were cooked through!)  :)  Everything was just as I would order a breakfast if it were my last breakfast on earth.  My wife had similar but substituted bacon, grits and a sweet potato pancake. she was in breakfast nirvana as well.  Even the coffee was a notch above your typical breakfast joint fare.

AND...  As I sat there eating this deliciousness, I had to stare at the lunch special menu board and there was not one thing on it I wouldn't have ordered.  There is no doubt I'm coming back soon for lunch.

On the service side it was fast, friendly and really nice teamwork among the servers with everyone paying attention to coffee cups getting low, etc.  What a jewel for the Queen City!
yelp:train:4972.para:
I feel slightly awkward sharing this critique since I'm employed in Uptown and appreciate this style of cuisine, though I've never visited Mert's before. However, I rectified that on a Wednesday morning and experienced what might be the most exceptional breakfast I've ever savored.

I opted for the foundational items - scrambled eggs, sausage, home fries, a biscuit, and a side of buttermilk pancake. Wow! The eggs were flawlessly cooked, and the sausage patties were crispy on the outside yet soft and juicy on the inside, thoroughly cooked. Everything matched my ideal breakfast order, even if it were my final meal. My partner enjoyed a similar but with bacon, grits, and a sweet potato pancake, reaching a state of breakfast euphoria. The coffee surpassed the usual breakfast joint standard. 

While indulging in this culinary delight, I glanced at the lunch special menu and found nothing I wouldn't have chosen. I'm certain I'll return soon for lunch. 

The service was prompt, amiable, and demonstrated excellent teamwork among the staff, with everyone attentive to details like coffee cups running low. It's a treasure for the Queen City.

yelp:train:5153.orig:
Oowee. This is some seriously great Italian. If you like your meals to take time, then this place is five stars. The food is five stars. But the slooooow service drops it a notch.

Our server didn't have an extensive knowledge of the beer list. This probably shows my naivete with regard to what you're supposed to order at a restaurant like Luce, but still, a good server knows EVERYTHING, or at least acts like it. Thus, Peroni. [sigh]

My appetizer was the veal cutlets, just little thin slices of tender baby calf with a dallop of sauce and capers. I'm going to spend a few more months in Purgatory for eating veal, but MAN, it will be worth it!

My main course was the cheese rolled in pork, the Fraciti I believe it was called (I can't seem to pull up the menu online) with gnocchi. Seriously great stuff. I ended with the custard and berries, which was okay. I wouldn't send it away, but perhaps I was expecting something more after the faaaaaantastic appetizer and entree.

Whew. Again, the only drawback was the 2.5 hour meal. An entire tenth of my day was spent at this restaurant. In some sense it was worth it, just be prepared. Go GO GO!
yelp:train:5153.para:
Wow, this is exceptionally delicious Italian cuisine. If you appreciate leisurely dining, this establishment deserves a five-star rating. The food quality is undeniably five stars. However, the leisurely pace of service slightly diminishes its perfection.

Our waiter seemed to lack a comprehensive understanding of the beer selection. This might reflect my inexperience about what one should order at a place like Luce, but a proficient server should be well-versed in everything. Hence, my choice of Peroni. [sigh]

My starter was veal cutlets, thin slices of tender calf meat with a dollop of sauce and capers. I'll be in a state of regret for consuming veal for a while, but the taste will be worth it!

My main dish was cheese wrapped in pork, known as Fraciti, accompanied by gnocchi. It was truly outstanding. I concluded with custard and berries, which was satisfactory. I wouldn't discard it, but I might have had higher expectations after the incredibly delightful starter and main course.

Phew. The only downside was the 2.5-hour dining experience. A significant portion of my day was invested in this restaurant. In a way, it was justified, but be ready for it. Get set, go!

yelp:train:5210.orig:
I was here this past weekend for a charity event.  It was absolutely packed and the bartenders were working extra hard.  I mean literally breaking a sweat!    Despite it being very crowded, the restaurant stayed clean and cool!  

We ordered a Margarita pizza which was freaking delicious.  Every ingredient was fresh and tasty.  Even the mozzerella was fresh, not the shredded typical stuff.  I would definitely order this pizza again.  Although this time I did not order a salad, I have in the past ordered the Brixx Salad and it is also quite excellent.  

The price point is nice on the wallet.  Our pizza was $9.95 and can easily serve 2 people for dinner.  

In terms of atmosphere, it is more casual but in a classy, Italian way, not a sports bar type of way.  I will be going back for sure!
yelp:train:5210.para:
During the previous weekend, I attended a fundraising gathering. The venue was incredibly full, and the staff behind the bar were tirelessly laboring. They were genuinely exerting themselves, perspiring profusely. Despite the high density of attendees, the dining area remained spotless and refreshing. 

We indulged in a Margarita pizza that was utterly mouthwatering. Each component was fresh and flavorful. The mozzarella was notably fresh, unlike the usual shredded variety. I am certain to order this pizza again. Although I didn't opt for a salad this time, I've previously enjoyed the Brixx Salad, which is also highly commendable. 

The cost is reasonable for the budget. Our pizza, priced at $9.95, can comfortably feed two individuals for a meal. 

The ambiance is laid-back yet elegant, with a distinctly Italian flair, steering clear of a sports bar vibe. I am certain to revisit.

yelp:train:5361.orig:
Connolly's is a great Irish Pub with no food, but great bartenders and an even better time. Beware though, if you have never been, you will be floored at how dark it is! I have a friend who told me the story of when he first moved to Charlotte and stumbled into what he thought was pronounced ""Cannolli's"". He walked in, ran into a table, couldn't see anything and ran back out because he had no idea what he had just walked into. Ha! 

But your eyes will adjust and you will be fine after you grab a Guinnes or a cider. Most of the people that work there are actually from Ireland or another country such as Australia. The experience in a pub is just that much more enjoyable when accents are involved (especially with hot guys). 

While you're there, take in the music, which is sometimes Irish, sometimes hip hop, and the decor of the room. On the walls you will find all authentic effects from Ireland, such as street signs and sports memorabilia. If you are there on a busier night (which sometimes can be every night) head upstairs if you can. The upstairs is usually open Thursdays through Saturdays, I think. It's much roomier up there and you can always find a few young people danci
yelp:train:5361.para: Connolly's Pub stands out as a fantastic Irish establishment, devoid of a menu, yet boasting exceptional bartenders and an even more delightful atmosphere. However, be cautious if you're unfamiliar with it, as its dim lighting might initially surprise you. A friend recounted his confusion upon mistaking it for "Cannolli's" when he first arrived in Charlotte, unable to see anything and quickly exiting. Laughter ensues! \n\nOnce your eyes adapt, you'll be comfortable, especially after enjoying a Guinnes or cider. The staff predominantly hail from Ireland or other countries like Australia, adding a unique charm to the pub experience, particularly with their distinct accents. The ambiance is enriched by the occasional Irish or hip hop tunes and the room's authentic Irish decor, including street signs and sports memorabilia. During busier evenings, which can occur frequently, consider ascending to the upstairs area, typically open from Thursday to Saturday. It offers more space and is often filled with energetic youngsters dancing.

yelp:train:5382.orig:
The bagels here aren't as good as everyone said they would be. I actually think I like the Einstein's Bagel's bagel-cream cheese combo better. I personally prefer the plain bagel and cream cheese over the egg sandwiches because the eggs are kind of weird and microwavy tasting. The nice thing about this location is that it's on the 2nd floor of the epicenter and you can get there directly from the Aloft.

They have some very good deals on breakfast bagels that are CHEAPER than Smoothie King. Damn you delicious expensive smoothies!

Tip: I wasted $2 on a very very disgusting and watered down Iced Coffee. Avoid at all costs. Minus 1 star for that.
yelp:train:5382.para: The bagels at this place don't live up to the high praise they've received. I personally find the bagel and cream cheese pairing at Einstein's to be superior. I have a preference for the simple bagel and cream cheese combination over the egg sandwiches, as the eggs have an unusual and overly processed flavor. The advantage of this spot is its convenient location on the second floor of the main hub, offering direct access from Aloft. \n\nThey offer some excellent breakfast bagel deals that are more affordable than those at Smoothie King. I must express my frustration with the overpriced and disappointing smoothies. I strongly advise against spending money on this unsatisfactory Iced Coffee, which I rate a full 1 star due to its poor quality and diluted taste.

yelp:train:5853.orig: We were in Charlotte this past weekend and we were in the mood for Italian, so we went to Mama Ricotta's. I am glad we made the choice to come here. From the moment we walked in, the staff was pretty friendly and accommodating. We got the Burrata & Prosciutto appetizer, it was lovely. Our entrees were Penne Alla Vodka and Rigatoni with Meat Sauce. The ingredients were fresh and flavorful; just like Italian food should be. \n\nWe noticed that the dessert portions were enormous so we asked if we could be served just half of a tiramisu. Our waitress was absolutely accommodating and she made it happen. We weren't expecting to pay half price for the dessert we just didn't want the rest to go to waste, but she did charge us half price. I wish this place was in DC, we would be here all the time.
yelp:train:5853.para: During our visit to Charlotte last weekend, we craved Italian cuisine and decided to dine at Mama Ricotta's. I'm pleased with our decision to choose this place. Upon entering, the welcoming and helpful staff immediately stood out. We savored the Burrata & Prosciutto starter, which was delightful. Our main courses included Penne Alla Vodka and Rigatoni with Meat Sauce, both made with fresh and tasty ingredients, true to Italian culinary standards. \n\nWe observed that the dessert servings were quite large, so we requested a half portion of tiramisu. Our server was incredibly accommodating and fulfilled our request. Although we didn't anticipate a discounted price for the dessert, she surprisingly charged us half the price. If this restaurant were located in DC, it would be our go-to place.

yelp:train:6760.orig: This is by far the best Japanese place in Charlotte.  We had our nephew who lives in Japan come by to see how authentic it was.  He said it felt just like home.  The food is always great and the employee there are very kind.\n\nMy family and I go there for lunch all the time!
yelp:train:6760.para: This establishment in Charlotte is undoubtedly the top Japanese restaurant in the area. We invited our relative from Japan to assess its authenticity, and he remarked that it was incredibly familiar. The cuisine consistently impresses, and the staff are exceptionally hospitable. My family and I frequently dine there for our midday meals.

yelp:train:6858.orig: Late afternoon dinner at the Palm... I wanted to leave when we were not received for about 10 minutes, but we gave them some time to realize there were customers up front. After someone in the kitchen finally noticed us, we were seated at a table, with no menus... Then, our waiter introduced himself, took away extra silverware, and gave us no menus. We asked... Should we get out own menus? He said he would get us some. He then proceeded to chat with some waiter buddies in plain view. Since the restaurant was almost completely empty, it looked like we were interrupting a break. After several minutes of chit-chat, the waiter finally delivered some menus (how hard is that?). Perusing the menu, it was clear the Palm doesn't believe in meals, which I guess is because meals are... gauche. You can order a steak for $45, but you won't get a salad or a side unless you buy a separate $8 plate of veggies or $8 salad. I just couldn't believe a 9 oz. piece of meat would be worth that much (plus, I'd rather a 6 oz. filet). So, we ordered the Veal and Chicken Parm. (~$35), which do not come with any noodles unless you pay $4 extra (thus bringing the Parms. up to ~$40). I also ordered a coffee, wh
yelp:train:6858.para: In the late afternoon, we dined at the Palm, feeling frustrated when we were overlooked for about 10 minutes. We gave them a chance to acknowledge our presence, and once the kitchen staff finally did, we were directed to a table without any menus. Our server, upon realizing our confusion, assured us he would provide menus. He then engaged in casual conversation with colleagues while we waited, making us feel like we were intruding on their break time. After a while, he brought the menus, which seemed to suggest the Palm doesn't prioritize meals. The menu options were limited, with steaks priced at $45 and no salads or sides included unless you opted for an additional $8 plate of vegetables or salad. Disappointed by the high price of a 9 oz. steak, we decided to order the Veal and Chicken Parm for around $35, which didn't include noodles unless we paid an extra $4, making the total around $40. I also ordered a coffee.

yelp:train:7211.orig: Had the tamales and chimi. Food was excellent. Don't let the location intimidate you. It conveniently located near CLT airport and the nearby hotels.

Enjoyed tamales and chimi, with the food being exceptional. The place's proximity to CLT airport and surrounding hotels shouldn't deter you.

yelp:train:7703.orig: CVS Pharmacy is your basic drug store. Ample parking, large store, pretty clean, decent selection, lots of sale items. The pharmacy here is very busy, at times you will have to wait for your pickup. Some days it seems that there are too many pharmacists and not enough people for customer service; however they are generally very apologetic when things run behind.  Everyone must be using CVS Covermark, busiest pharmacy in the area.
yelp:train:7703.para: CVS Pharmacy serves as a fundamental drug retailer. It boasts ample parking, a spacious facility, and maintains a tidy appearance, offering a satisfactory range of products with numerous discounted items. The pharmacy often experiences high activity levels, occasionally leading to wait times for service. On certain occasions, it appears there are an abundance of pharmacists relative to customers, but they typically express regret when service delays occur. It is the most frequented pharmacy in the vicinity, with all patrons utilizing CVS Covermark.

yelp:train:7842.orig: The service was great but the food was not. All the pasta for our party was undercooked; there were 14 of us. Other customers also were returning meals. The manager told us they were using a new pasta and had to \""learn to cook it\"". She did make an adjustment on our bill to make up for the bad meals.
yelp:train:7842.para: The service provided was commendable, however, the quality of the food did not meet expectations. Our group of 14 encountered undercooked pasta, and it was a common issue as other patrons also had to send back their dishes. The manager acknowledged the switch to a new pasta variety and admitted the need to master its preparation. To compensate for the unsatisfactory dining experience, she adjusted our bill accordingly.

yelp:train:8325.orig:
Was here for a gala at the adjoining conference center.  Service was terrible. The waitress kept slamming food and drinks on the  table. She only brought dinner for half the table and the rest had to wait for 15 minutes. One of the guests had to wait about 20 minutes for the meal. Horrible!
I've been to many Marriotts before and hold a frequent visitor card, but this one has been the worst experience so far.

I know this isn't a review that completely reflects the hotel or any restaurants inside it, but the fact that this service was under the Marriott name prompted this review and rating
yelp:train:8325.para:
Attended a ball at the neighboring conference facility. The service was abysmal. The server aggressively placed food and beverages on the table. Dinner was served only to half the attendees, leaving the others to wait for a quarter-hour. One individual endured a 20-minute wait for their meal. This was an exceptionally poor experience.

Despite my history of frequent stays at Marriotts and possession of a loyalty card, this particular visit has been the most disappointing to date.

This feedback does not fully represent the hotel or its dining establishments, but the service's association with Marriott led to this critique and score.

yelp:train:8448.orig:
Authentic Italian food! Our goal of the night was to have a nice Italian dinner and not feel rushed to eat. Vin Santo successfully met our goal and went beyond. Walking in to Vin Santo felt like walking into your Italian Grandmothers kitchen (in the best ways). Our server was fantastic and remained attentive to us throughout the meal. Most may find it expensive, however, for $99 two people were able to share a bottle of wine, share a desert, and we both had an entree that provided leftovers for the next day. 

CON: Too many good options and I could only order one entree.

We will definitely be going back there soon to try their other items on the menu.
yelp:train:8448.para:
Our mission for the evening was to savor a delightful Italian meal without the pressure of quick consumption. Vin Santo triumphantly fulfilled our objective and surpassed expectations. Entering Vin Santo was akin to stepping into the warm embrace of an Italian nonna's kitchen (in the most delightful ways). Our attentive server maintained a high level of service throughout our dining experience. While some may consider it costly, for $99, two individuals could share a wine bottle, a dessert, and each enjoyed an entree with enough for leftovers for the following day. 

Drawback: The abundance of excellent choices limited me to selecting only one entree. 

We are eager to return to this establishment soon to explore the other offerings on their menu.

yelp:train:8848.orig: A wash may be better priced than others but you'll get what you pay for. My husband brought out 2008 Prius for a wash and vacuum and it doesn't look like anything has been cleaned! The carpet in the hatch and floors are still dirty and none of the interior was wiped down. We will be going to Octopus or we'll just do it ourselves next time.
yelp:train:8848.para: The car wash might offer a lower price, yet the quality of service doesn't match the cost. My spouse took our 2008 Prius for a cleaning and vacuuming session, but it appears the work was subpar. The hatch area and floors still bear dirt, and the interior remains untouched. We'll consider going to Octopus for future cleanings or opt to handle it ourselves.

yelp:train:8861.orig: The bacon commercial with non stop fries, only says \""HEART ATTACK!!!!!\""   Thanks Applebee's
yelp:train:8861.para: Applebee's bacon advertisement featuring uninterrupted fries, boldly proclaims "HEART ATTACK!!!" with gratitude.

yelp:train:9109.orig: I have only been to cafe Zoma once, and I didn't even order anything.  My friends got coffee to go, and there were two customers ahead of them in line.  I had no idea that it could take a half hour to serve four people coffee, but the Clap your Hands Say Yeah listening idiots behind the counter at Cafe Zoma made it possible.\n\nI gave this place an extra star because my friends thought their coffee was pretty good.
yelp:train:9109.para: I visited Cafe Zoma just a single time without placing any order. My companions opted for takeaway coffee, and they encountered two patrons in front of them in the queue. I was unaware that serving four individuals with coffee could span a half-hour, yet the Clap your Hands Say Yeah enthusiasts working behind the counter at Cafe Zoma facilitated it.\n\nI awarded this establishment an additional star as my friends found their coffee to be quite commendable.

yelp:train:9227.orig:
My first ever trip to Woody-Anne's involved a lady at the bar a) showing off a pic that proved ghosts exist cuz of an ""orb"" that is inexplicably present(?), b) flashing me her boobs for a drink that she never actually took me up on, and c) giving me an epicly gross (DRIPPING) wet willy, all in the span of Fleetwood Mac's ""Landslide"" which soundtracked the whole experience.

The evening ended with me and the bartender watching a M.A.S.H. rerun in what was by then an otherwise empty bar.

Needless to say, this is my New Favorite Place.
yelp:train:9227.para:
My inaugural visit to Woody-Anne's was marked by a woman at the counter a) displaying a photo allegedly demonstrating the existence of spirits due to a mysterious "orb", b) revealing her cleavage for a beverage she declined, and c) presenting me with a highly unpleasant (LEAKING) damp cock, all under the backdrop of Fleetwood Mac's "Landslide".

The night concluded with me and the barkeep engrossed in a M.A.S.H. replay in a now vacant bar.

Undoubtedly, this has become my preferred spot.

yelp:train:9449.orig:
Although it wasn't totally terrible, David's Jamaican Cuisine is not a restaurant to which I will return. A friend and I met for lunch at David's a few days ago -- he had previously eaten there and didn't love it, but agreed to go again because I wanted to try it after reading all the great reviews on Yelp and other review sites. When we arrived, I was surprised to see a lunch buffet set up. Previous experience with lunch buffets at other restaurants has caused me to interpret buffets as warning signs, but, since we were already there, we decided to stay.

We ordered sodas, which arrived in cans. Not a big deal, but worth mentioning because I know some people prefer to drink out of cups.

The lunch buffet had approximately 15 options ranging from jerk chicken and jerk pork to plantains to rice to mango chicken to pineapple slaw with tofu. The jerk chicken was good, though not as flavorful as I had expected or hoped, but the other foods I tried ranged from blah to bad.

Based on the outstanding reviews David's has received, I was very surprised and disappointed by my experience. I'm tempted to give this restaurant one more try, but really can't decide if it's worth the money a
yelp:train:9449.para:
Despite not being utterly disappointing, I won't be revisiting David's Jamaican Cuisine. My companion and I had lunch there recently, following his less-than-stellar previous visit and my desire to sample it, influenced by glowing Yelp and similar reviews. Upon arrival, we were taken aback by a lunch buffet, which I usually view as a red flag. However, we chose to stay since we were already there. We opted for sodas, served in cans, which was a minor detail but worth noting as some individuals favor cup service.

The buffet offered around 15 dishes, including jerk chicken, jerk pork, plantains, rice, mango chicken, and pineapple slaw with tofu. The jerk chicken was decent, but it lacked the expected or desired flavor intensity. The other dishes I sampled were mediocre to poor.

Given the high praise David's has garnered, my experience was unexpectedly underwhelming. I'm considering giving it another chance, but I'm undecided about its value for money.

yelp:train:9519.orig: Upswing in furniture recently which has made this my go-to before St. Vinny when it comes to looking for random pieces to add to my pad! The staff is lovely, quick to help me load things in my coche, and prices are unbeatable for pieces that are in really great shape. Nabbed a desk recently for $20 that's super solid and looks swell in my space. \n\nYou might have to bounce around to a few ReStores before you find what you're looking for, and you have to wade through all the tile, cabinets and random pieces of wood. But you're down to do some digging, stellar furniture finds await!
yelp:train:9519.para: Lately, there's been a surge in furniture sales, making it my preferred choice over St. Vinny for sourcing unique items to enhance my living area. The team is delightful, promptly assisting me with loading my vehicle, and the pricing is exceptional for items in excellent condition. I recently acquired a desk for $20 that's robust and complements my space beautifully. \n\nYou may need to visit several ReStores to locate your desired item, as you'll encounter various tiles, cabinets, and assorted wooden items. However, the effort is worthwhile for the potential of discovering outstanding furniture pieces.

yelp:train:9715.orig:
I've been going to Long's Garage for about 5 years now and have been very happy with their service.  They've always been honest with me.  The prices are comparable to other shops. The repairs are done quickly and professionally.  My truck is 16 years old, yet it drives like it's only a few years old thanks to Long's. 

The only criticism I would have would be if you need something done with a truck topper.  I didn't know what to do with the rubber seal that was falling off.  Their body work person offered to epoxy it, but that didn't stay on very long.  I didn't know at the time that I could get a new seal at Truck Trends in Champaign.
 
Something that really impressed me though was how honest their detail person was about the state of the paint on my truck.  I wasn't sure how salvageable it was, and he was honest in telling me that my paint was too thin to try polish on (would rub the last of the paint off), but he did give me some recommendations on how to keep what paint I have left on the truck for years to come.  I followed the recommendations and get compliments on how good my truck looks all the time.  What impressed me was that the detail person didn't try to convince m
yelp:train:9715.para:
For the past half-decade, I've frequented Long's Garage and have consistently been satisfied with their customer service. Their transparency has been commendable, and the pricing aligns with other establishments. The repair work is executed swiftly and with expertise. Despite my vehicle being 16 years old, it performs remarkably well, thanks to Long's.

The sole critique I have pertains to the lack of guidance for a truck topper issue. The rubber seal that was detaching was offered to be epoxy-fixed by their bodywork specialist, but the adhesive proved ineffective. Unaware at the time, I could have sourced a new seal from Truck Trends in Champaign.

What truly stood out was the detail person's forthrightness regarding the condition of my truck's paint. I was uncertain about its restorability, and they candidly informed me that the paint was too delicate for polishing. However, they provided valuable advice on preserving the remaining paint for the truck's longevity. I adhered to their suggestions, and I frequently receive praise for the truck's appearance. The detail person's honesty, rather than persuasion, was impressive.

yelp:train:10658.orig: I would have ordered from this place again if the driver hadn't of scammed me for an extra dollar.  Look at your receipt!
yelp:train:10658.para: Had I not been deceived by the driver into paying an additional dollar, I would have considered returning to this establishment. Check your receipt for proof.

yelp:train:11475.orig:
The Blue Fin is my favorite Teriyaki stop in the valley.  

To begin, the service here is awesome!  For such a casual restaurant, they really know how to make you feel welcome.

I absolutely love the food here too.  Great appetizers, spring rolls, inari, sunomono, etc.  Being vegetarian, I always order the same...Steamed Vegetable Bowl.  For the money, you get a TON of food here.  The teriyaki sauce is perfect, not too sweet like some of those chain places.

Did I mention that the service here is the best?

The only thing wrong with The Blue FIn; they are not opened on the weekends, Monday through Friday only.
yelp:train:11475.para:
My preferred spot for Teriyaki in the region is The Blue Fin. 

To start with, the customer service here is exceptional! Despite its laid-back atmosphere, they excel in making patrons feel at home. 

I am utterly enamored with the cuisine here as well. Delicious starters, spring rolls, inari, sunomono, and more. As a vegetarian, I consistently opt for the Steamed Vegetable Bowl. The value for money is impressive, with a generous portion of food. The teriyaki sauce strikes the right balance, avoiding the overly sweet flavor found in some chain restaurants. 

Additionally, I must highlight that the service here is unparalleled. 

The sole drawback of The Blue Fin is that it's only open from Monday to Friday, not on weekends.

yelp:train:11675.orig: I am only giving -THIS- location a 1 star because of their horrible early hours!! yelp:train:11675.para: I'm rating this spot a single star solely due to their extremely early closing times! They shut down by 7 pm on weekdays and were already shut down by 3 pm on Sunday! yelp:train:11965.orig: When HRC was on Camelback, we frequented the bar for happy hour.  During that time, we befriended the bartenders, who are still there  They create a neighborhood feel to this international chain.  Phoenix HRC is different than the other ones I've been to because of this.  When they moved downtown we continued to frequent the bar. yelp:train:11965.para:
While HRC was located on Camelback, we often visited the bar during happy hour. During that period, we developed friendships with the bartenders, who remain in place.
