yelp:train:13310.orig:
I did a driveby of this place earlier in the day, and did some research.  I heard it closed at 8pm, and was told they have Chihuly glass on display.  That is all I needed to hear.

Parking was free, and was plenty of it- I managed to get a front row spot!  We got there around 5:30 pm, thinking there would be plenty of time to see everything...

Well I was wrong!  It started to get dark around 6:30, and for that, I missed out on about 2-3 trails- that sucked because I wanted to see everything... Hopefully since it is daylight savings now, you can enjoy the gardens now at a later time...

The parts that I did see were fascinating, although at parts it did get kind of boring (we started from the left and worked our way around).  I was told there was even a concery there for the evening- which sounded cool- but I wanted to explore, having never been there.

I would like to go back and see what the entire garden has to offer, since the desert portion at the Atlanta Botanical Garden just doesn't do it justice.

I think it is cool how it is next to the zoo (which I didn't get to visit), and two parks.
yelp:train:13310.para:
I conducted a quick visit to this location earlier, followed by some investigation. I learned it shuts down at 8pm, and they showcase Chihuly glasswork. That information was sufficient for me.

Free parking was available, and there was ample space - I secured a front row parking spot! We arrived around 5:30 pm, assuming we'd have enough time to explore everything...

Unfortunately, I was mistaken! It began to darken around 6:30, causing me to miss out on approximately 2-3 trails - a disappointment as I intended to see everything. Hopefully, with daylight saving time in effect, you can now appreciate the gardens at a later hour...

The sections I managed to see were intriguing, though at times it felt monotonous (we started from the left and proceeded clockwise). I was informed there was an evening event, which seemed appealing - but I was keen on discovering more, as I had never been there before.

I'm eager to return and discover what the entire garden has to offer, as the desert area at the Atlanta Botanical Garden doesn't quite meet my expectations.

I find it interesting that it's situated next to the zoo (which I didn't have the chance to visit), and two parks.

yelp:train:13701.orig:

1) Yes, we take credit cards! They have them everywhere - even on vending machines. Awesome for me because I hate carrying cash.

2) Bring in what you want and nee

yelp:train:14340.para:
During my initial visit, I am absolutely certain I won't return. I will NEVER go back, with a strong sense of dissatisfaction. I will NEVER go back, expressing my frustration through actions like kicking, dragging, and screaming.

yelp:train:14378.orig: This place is dirty, the owner is miserable and the food is terrible. It's amazing they have been in business this long.

yelp:train:14389.orig:
This location is right next to my house, convenient, and have always had great service, but I will remember to never try and ship something from here again.

I needed to ship a few T-shirts and a small picture to California. I was approached by a trainee who was training a trainee and when I asked for one box, he proceeded to put the picture into a separate box with bubble wrap. I told him I didn't want two boxes to be shipped that I wanted it all together and he said he couldn't do that because it was a fragile item. Instead I would have to pay $12 for the additional small box. I told them I preferred one box and they could put the small frame between the shirts and he said they were not allowed to do that... I even asked for a size and price sheet for their boxes but because they were remodeling they didn't have one?
Forcing individuals to buys separate boxes and packaging is a poor way of 
up-selling. Then they messed up on the address and after that I just decided to cancel everything all together.
The process seemed unorganized, took way too long, and the staff did not help out with any shipping options.
yelp:train:14389.para: This spot is adjacent to my residence, offering ease of access and consistently excellent service, yet I will not attempt to send anything from this point in the future.\n\nI required to dispatch a couple of T-shirts and a petite frame to California. A novice was instructing another novice when I requested a single box. He opted to place the frame in a distinct box with cushioning. I expressed my desire for a consolidated shipment, but he claimed it was a delicate item and he couldn't combine them. He suggested an extra small box for $12. yelp:train:14452.para: Exceptional customer support. Faced issues with pedal replacement; brought it in on a weekend and they promptly addressed it, detailing the upkeep during the process.

yelp:train:14843.orig:
SunUp makes some decent brews, but the food leaves a lot to be desired. Here's what we had:

Ahi Sliders: Bland coleslaw and tuna were overpowered by the oversized and mediocre bun.

Shrimp tacos: Way too salty and overcooked. Fortunately, there were only two shrimp per taco, so the disappointment at how they tasted was mitigating by the sheer lack of content.

Macaroni & Cheese: Not bad, but it's mac & cheese.

The service was great and there's plenty of space, but there's really no reason to eat here, and, in my opinion, there are better places to get beer.
yelp:train:14843.para:
While SunUp offers some satisfactory drinks, the quality of their food is lacking. Here's a breakdown of our experience:

Ahi Sliders: The bland coleslaw and tuna were overshadowed by a large, average bun.

Shrimp tacos: Excessively salty and overdone. The limited shrimp count per taco somewhat lessened the disappointment in taste due to minimal filling.

Macaroni & Cheese: It's passable, but nothing more.

The service was commendable and the venue is spacious, yet there's no compelling reason to dine here. In my view, superior beer options are available elsewhere.

yelp:train:15135.orig:
Well let me just say I did not go here on my own. Dear sister raved and raved about it until I agreed to go with her. I will break it down like this, I thought there was to much on the menu yet nothing caught my eye maybe I just wasn't in the mood to have so many choices. 

1. Our server was an ass! There was no one in the place yet he waited on us like they were full to capacity and he was the only server. He couldn't have been less concerned about serving us. 

2. The tempura we ordered was very blah, nothing to write home about. 

3. My sister went on and on about how good her dish was. Mine was way to spicy I asked for mild. So the manager offered to change it to something else. I ordered pad Thai no tofu again mild. How can you go wrong with Pad Thai. You can it was a glutenous mess. The noodles were so over cooked it was disgusting. 

4. The decor was cute. That's the only good thing I can say. 

I have not been back. My sister has but my experience left a bad taste in my mouth literally. You get 2 stars one for decor and one because my sister likes it.
yelp:train:15135.para:
I must clarify that I didn't decide to visit this place independently. My sister kept praising it until I consented to accompany her. Here's my breakdown: 

1. The waiter was quite unprofessional. Despite the restaurant being empty, he acted as if it was packed and seemed indifferent towards our service. 

2. The tempura I had was rather unremarkable, lacking any distinctive qualities. 

3. While my sister enjoyed her meal, mine was excessively spicy, even after requesting a milder version. The manager suggested a replacement, and I opted for mild Pad Thai without tofu. However, it turned out to be a sticky, overcooked disaster. 

4. The only positive aspect I can mention is the charming decor. That's the sole reason I'll give it two stars. The only other reason is that my sister seems to enjoy it. I won't be returning, but she has. My experience left a truly unpleasant impression.

yelp:train:15246.orig:
Came to this place on a random yelp find for lunch.  The first thing to mention is if you don't get here before noon good luck finding a parking spot.  You will need to park in the neighborhood and take a nice walk.  

Walking in the front door it's a very small and quaint place with a few tables and some booth seating.  

We were seated by the door and it was definitely a little warm like some of the tips said.  

I ordered the Korean spicy beef.  The portion size was perfect and the flavors were on point.  Just enough spice to make you sweat a little but not burn your mouth off.  The beef was tender and had a good mix of veggies.  Over all great price and portion size for the dish. 

I also ordered one of slices of blueberry banana bread which was a perfect finish to the meal. 

All in all great place and I will be back for sure.
yelp:train:15246.para:
Arrived here by stumbling upon a Yelp recommendation for a midday meal. The first thing to note is securing a parking spot can be challenging if you don't get here before noon; you'll have to park in the vicinity and enjoy a pleasant stroll. 

Entering through the front door, you'll find a cozy, compact establishment with a handful of tables and some booth seating. 

We were seated near the entrance and it was noticeably warm, as some reviews suggested. 

I opted for the Korean spicy beef, which was served in an ideal portion size with flavors that were spot-on. It had a moderate level of spiciness that made you perspire slightly without scorching your tongue. The beef was succulent and accompanied by a variety of vegetables. Overall, it was a great value for the dish. 

I also sampled a slice of blueberry banana bread, which served as a perfect conclusion to the meal. 

In summary, it's a fantastic spot and I'm certain I'll return.

yelp:train:15569.orig:
I am really shocked at all of the decent reviews for this place.  The only reason I am giving it one star is because the service was fast and friendly.  I ordered the Seafood Bento box and my husband got the chicken teriyaki and a beef bowl. 

Midway through, we discussed going through the Wendy's drive through.  It just seemed like the lowest quality of everything was used- gross rice, fish with a weird texture, even the chicken seemed of a lower quality then you get at the Asian food places in the mall.

Tokyo Express actually was recommended to us, unfortunately, we wish we would have stayed home and cooked.

I would not recommend.
yelp:train:15569.para:
I'm astonished by the numerous positive comments about this establishment. Despite that, I'm rating it one star due to the exceptional speed and warmth of the service. I opted for the Seafood Bento box, while my spouse chose the chicken teriyaki and a beef bowl. 

During our meal, we contemplated using the Wendy's drive-thru, but it appeared to be the epitome of subpar quality - the rice was unpalatable, the fish had an unusual consistency, and the chicken seemed inferior compared to what's available at mall-based Asian eateries. 

Although Tokyo Express was suggested to us, we regret not choosing to stay in and prepare our own meal. 

I strongly advise against it.

yelp:train:15858.para: Explored a hidden culinary treasure during the Arizona Restaurant week, where the cuisine was sublime, service impeccable, and the atmosphere delightful. The sole drawback is its positioning in a somewhat neglected neighborhood.

yelp:train:16116.para: Enjoy the savory chicken fried steak.

yelp:train:16903.orig: Lamb tikki masala and garlic naan are delicious. I try to come at least once every couple weeks for lunch. Great food every time and the owner and his wife are hands on and very kind. Definitely recommend this place.
yelp:train:16903.para: Lamb tikki masala and garlic naan offer a delightful taste. I make it a point to visit at least once every fortnight for a midday meal. yelp:train:17472.orig:

A
yelp:train:17472.para:
Apologies for not evaluating this establishment earlier. I've frequented Deemo's at the Esplanade since its inception, where the cuisine and service were exceptional. The Portabello mushroom burger was my preferred choice! Regrettably, their quality has declined. 

The last time I sampled the burger, it was noticeably different, despite their assurances of consistency. My palate confirmed it was subpar, possibly even frozen. The large mushroom component was the sole redeeming factor. 

I recently sampled the Philly cheese, but I'd rather have meat in my sandwich. This was the most disappointing Philly steak I've ever had, with minimal meat and substandard bread.

Today, I ordered eggs over medium and crispy bacon. Instead, I received eggs over easy and precooked bacon that was so thin it was almost transparent. The price of 6.17, plus tax, doesn't justify the poor quality of the eggs and bacon. It's a letdown.

yelp:train:18075.para: Exceptional coffee coupled with warm hospitality ensures a top-tier, five-star encounter.

yelp:train:18247.orig: I usually won't give a one-star review, but in extreme cases. I was horrifically disappointed with the food and the service. yelp:train:18247.para: Generally, I refrain from rating a restaurant one star, but in exceptional circumstances. The food and service left me profoundly dismayed. The lowest prices they quoted me was almost $400, and that was with a 60%+20% off coupon!!! i decided to try Framin works, and saved over $100 off the lowest price that Michael's had quoted me. Granted, this price included a 25% off coupon, but I still thought the price was very fair. When I brought the picture in, the owner was very fair and didn't try to oversell me. He actually, told me that all I really needed for the picture was a new frame. He said the glass was fine, and that matting was in pretty good shape. I ended up replacing the matting and the frame. The finished product was great. I will definitely be back!
yelp:train:18604.para: Discovered Framin Works on Yelp and was thoroughly satisfied. I had a massive image that required framing. Previously, I opted for the straightforward approach, purchasing from Michaels for all my framing requirements. The size of the image I possessed led me to contact them, providing the dimensions and my desired outcome. The most affordable quote they offered was nearly $400, even with a substantial discount coupon. I chose to give Framin Works a shot and managed to save upwards of $100 compared to the lowest price from Michaels. Despite the discount, I found the cost reasonable. Upon presenting the image, the proprietor was honest and not pushy. He informed me that a new frame was all I needed, as the glass was still usable and the matting was in decent condition. I replaced the matting and frame, resulting in a satisfactory outcome. I'm committed to returning.

yelp:train:19737.orig: After hearing about this place for years, and finally being able to get a parking spot close by, I decided to try it. Besides the uncomfortable claustrophobic atmosphere, it was frustrating finding a spot to wait for my food without being pushed in a corner or up against a display. And sorry, the food was good but those had to be magic avocados for the price I paid for that personal pizza.
yelp:train:19737.para: Having been informed about this location for a long time and securing a nearby parking spot, I opted to give it a shot. However, to my surprise, the pizza joint was packed, leading me to a disorganized and densely populated market offering the same dishes. The cramped and suffocating environment added to the annoyance of locating a place to wait for my meal without being squeezed into a tight spot or against a showcase. Although the meal was decent, it seemed like the avocados were exceptionally magical to justify the cost of my custom pizza.

yelp:train:19870.orig:

yelp:train:21129.orig:

I'm sure it's because they had a few large groups of people who'd already sat down before us in the banquet room, wherever that is. But we waited for over an hour for our food. When it arrived, my burrito had cheese in it (I am lactose intolerant and asked for none). The waiter was courteous and zipped back to get me my correct order, but came back a mere ten seconds later with a cold burrito. Really? I know I've already waited, but at least give it to me warm.

All in all, the server generally ignored us because the table to our left was angry they weren't getting any food, and the table to the right of us had a solid 30 people in it. So, I get it in a sense. But it would've been nice to have them tell us straight out that they had a 46 person table on the other side of the restuarant th
yelp:train:21129.para:
I recently departed from this eatery 15 minutes prior and opted to post a critique on Yelp. 

Let me clarify, Aunt Chilada's, prior to this evening, was an average dining spot close to my significant other's workplace. We occasionally visited for a swift meal when hunger struck, and the salsa was commendable. Thus, it served as our go-to option when no other alternatives were available. However, this evening turned out to be a complete letdown.

I'm convinced it's due to the presence of several large groups who had already claimed their seats in the banquet area before us. We endured a wait of over an hour for our meal. When it finally arrived, my burrito contained cheese, despite my lactose intolerance and explicit request for none. The waiter was polite and promptly returned to rectify the mistake, but delivered a chilled burrito just ten seconds later. I understand the wait, but a warm meal would have been appreciated.

In summary, the server seemed to overlook us, likely due to the table to our left expressing frustration over their lack of food, and the table to our right accommodating around 30 individuals. While I comprehend their situation, a direct communication about the large table on the opposite side of the restaurant would have been considerate.

yelp:train:21611.orig: I have a passion for great pizza.  It's been my favorite food since I was a kid. I've outgrown my fondness for the typical pep & sausage as my tastebuds have been seeking out new flavors. The first time I tried the Gourmet White Pizza at Stumpy's I believe I heard the chorus to Hallelujah! Another favorite of mine is the Hot Blue Chicken Wing Pizza...an explosion of flavorful deliciousness! So good...I am actually salivating over my keyboard just thinking about it! Anyway...Stumpy's is by far one of my most favorite pizza places. Another giant plus? The owners and staff are the most amazingly friendly people I have ever met. They greet everyone with a warm smile and a wonderful pizza!
yelp:train:21611.para: My love for exceptional pizza has always been a constant since childhood. I've moved past my preference for standard pepperoni and sausage, now craving diverse tastes. The initial experience of the Gourmet White Pizza at Stumpy's felt like a hallelujah moment to me. I also adore the Hot Blue Chicken Wing Pizza, a burst of scrumptious delight! The mere thought of it makes me drool at my keyboard. In my opinion, Stumpy's is undoubtedly my top pizza spot. A significant advantage is the incredibly welcoming nature of the owners and staff. They offer a heartfelt smile and an outstanding pizza to everyone.

yelp:train:21641.orig:
I wanted breakfast that didn't require a long wait or making it myself.  I was probably off best by just sucking it up and making breakfast at home because Lantana Grille was pretty disappointing.
We arrived and thought the place was actually closed because there was not a single car in the parking lot and when we walked in, there was no hostess.  But we saw some people sitting so I asked if we just seat ourselves and they replied with ""Sure!""-- I guess that is what I would say too if someone asked me mid breakfast at Lantana Grille what to do upon walking in.

There was a large party in the back, they mentioned that they were in town for a wedding so I am guessing they must have walked over from the Pointe Hotel.  (this explained no cars in the lot).

It is set up like a breakfast buffet, you pay $15 or $16/person and eat whatever in the buffet.  The choices are limited and not that good.  The best part was the made to order omlets and that is it.  Even the sauasage and bacon seemed to taste off.  HOW does that happen?  So the buffet had scrambled eggs (don't eat those-ick), sausage, bacon, french toast, syrup, cereal, fruit.  oh and the omlets-- best bet are the omlets.
yelp:train:21641.para:
I sought a morning meal that didn't necessitate extended waiting or personal preparation. I likely made the most of the situation by deciding to cook breakfast at home, as my experience at Lantana Grille left much to be desired.

Upon arrival, we mistook the establishment for being closed due to the absence of cars in the parking area and the lack of a hostess. However, we noticed some patrons already seated, leading me to inquire if we could join them. They responded affirmatively, suggesting that's what I would advise during a breakfast at Lantana Grille.

A large gathering was taking place in the rear, with the hosts explaining they were there for a wedding, which likely accounted for the empty parking lot. 

The place operates like a breakfast buffet, with a fee of $15 or $16 per person. The selection is somewhat limited and not particularly impressive. The highlight was the freshly prepared omelets, which stood out as the only notable item. The taste of the sausage and bacon was also subpar, leaving us questioning how such a situation could occur. The buffet offered scrambled eggs (which I was advised to avoid), sausage, bacon, french toast, syrup, cereal, and fruit. The omelets, however, were the clear standout choice.

yelp:train:21948.orig: As I try to chew my rubbery, non-spicy General Tso's chicken, I'm writing this review with a feeling of  regret for spending $30 at this place. yelp:train:21948.para: While I'm attempting to eat this tough, flavorless General Tso's chicken, I'm composing this critique with a sense of disappointment for parting with $30 at this establishment. yelp:train:22080.para: The food quality at this large fast food corporation was anticipated, yet the exceptionally subpar customer service today stood out. yelp:train:22223.orig: I would give negative stars if I could. I went in last weekend to purchase/look for a helmet, jacket and gloves. yelp:train:22523.para: PetSmart stands as the sole destination for purchasing pet necessities, given its roots in Arizona, and aligns with the "shop local" initiative. yelp:train:22657.orig:
Walked in to get a new FREE tablet that was advertised on internet...got my bill of $187.55...normally my bill is $75.00..I called NICK the manager to have him explain..my bill shows a $49.00 charge...yes I bought accessories totaling $56.22

 I love the coverage of VERIZON, but service is horrible....and cheat their customers. My plan is the same as a friend has and she pays $49.00 a month...why all the differences. The longer you stay with a company it should be cheaper...SHE'S a NEW customer..VERY UNHAPPY!!!!
BUYER BEWARE!!!

yelp:train:22657.para: Upon entering the store, I was enticed by an advertised complimentary tablet on the internet, only to be presented with an $187.55 bill, a stark contrast to my usual $75.00 charge. yelp:train:23311.para:

yelp:train:23498.orig: The salad was excellent.  The bread and butter was incredible.  I thoroughly enjoyed the main entree of fettucini Alfredo.  It was obviously made from scratch and tasted so good!  Dont let the location fool you. What a great find.
yelp:train:23498.para: The salad was outstanding. The bread and butter was phenomenal. I thoroughly relished the primary dish of fettuccine Alfredo. It was clearly handcrafted and had such a delightful flavor! Don't let the place's appearance deceive you. It's a fantastic discovery.

yelp:train:23517.orig: The chips and salsa are fantastic...that's what keeps bringing us back.  This is my one year olds favorite restaurant as she loves the salsa.  The food is pretty good...I have to admit it's not the best Mexican food I've ever had, but it's always consistently good.
yelp:train:23517.para: The delightful chips and salsa are what draw us repeatedly. This place is my toddler's top choice as she adores the salsa. The cuisine is commendable...I must concede it doesn't top the best Mexican dishes I've tasted, but it consistently delivers quality.

yelp:train:23660.orig:
We are pretty much regulars at Brennans now. It is a reliable place to watch the game with cheap drinks. There is a great view of the TV from almost every spot.

The bartenders are AWESOME. They are quick,  friendly, and really seem to care about providing good service. 

The servers are good too. Very sweet and take care of their regulars. There is confusion among them sometimes about who is helping our table but it is usually resolved quickly and they are apologetic.

The food that is good is very good, the food that is bad is pretty bad. Luckily, the number of items on the menu that is good outnumbers the bad. Here is a rundown on the good stuff- the Irish Nachos, Mexican pizza, cheese curds, potato skins, wings, enchiladas. All pretty good. Oh, and salsa too. It's freshly made and very zippy!

I would stay away from the zucchini and mozzarella sticks. Both are too greasy and lacking in flavor. The mozzarella stick is ginormous, which seems appealing at first but it is just too much cheese and too little breading. 

I wish they had more food specials because the appetizers will set you back 7-10 bucks a plate. But the portions are huge. They do have an amazing mexican
yelp:train:23660.para: We've become regulars at Brennans, a dependable spot for game viewing with affordable beverages. The TV reception is excellent from most locations. The staff, particularly the bartenders, are exceptional - they're fast, amiable, and genuinely invested in excellent service. The servers are also commendable, sweet and attentive to their loyal customers. Occasionally, there's some confusion about table assignments, but it's swiftly sorted out and they express regret. The quality of food is generally high, with favorites like Irish Nachos, Mexican pizza, cheese curds, potato skins, wings, and enchiladas. The salsa is fresh and lively. However, zucchini and mozzarella sticks are overly oily and flavorless, with the mozzarella stick being excessively cheesy and under-breaded. I'd recommend avoiding these. The appetizers are priced between 7-10 dollars per plate, but the servings are generous. There's a need for more food specials, but the Mexican offerings are truly impressive.

yelp:train:23916.orig: My 3 children and I had the pleasure of taking this tour with Tim and a great Aussie family.\nThis otherwise long 4 hour ride was fun and entertaining. Tim kept us interested by providing us with tons of facts about AZ and joking with us the whole way.  We stopped for lunch at the Indian Reservation and did some light shopping.  The Grand Canyon was spectacular and Tim was so accommodating taking our pictures along the way.  \nTim was the highlight of the trip.  He provided the visiting Australian family with tips on visiting Sedona and showed us some great things along the way.  He had a supply of water he kept encouraging us to drink. My daughter left our camera in the car and he graciously returned it that very night.  Thanks Tim and SouthWest for providing us with a great experience.
yelp:train:23916.para: We enjoyed a 4-hour journey with Tim and a delightful Australian family. The trip was engaging and amusing, with Tim sharing numerous Arizona facts and maintaining a light-hearted atmosphere throughout. We paused for a meal at the Indian Reservation and engaged in minor shopping. The Grand Canyon's magnificence was awe-inspiring, and Tim was exceptionally helpful in capturing our memories. Tim stood out as the trip's star, offering the Australian visitors advice on Sedona and revealing wonderful sights during the journey. He also had a water supply, urging us to stay hydrated. When my daughter misplaced our camera in the vehicle, Tim promptly returned it that evening. We are grateful to Tim and SouthWest for a memorable experience.

yelp:train:24388.para:

yelp:train:25580.orig:
I describe Ranch Market as the Disneyland of Supermarkets. 

Seriously, this is not the place to shop too late at night or you'll never get to sleep from all the excitement you just experienced!  The music is loud, the lights bright and festive, and the smell of the food makes your mouth salivate.

I mainly shop here for three things:
1) I always buy my nieces birthday cakes there.  The price is fantastic for a customized cake for kids.  The selection is incredible!
2) If you are familiar with the Mexican baked goods - this place is a one stop shop!  For for a nice change from traditional french bread, try a ""bolillo"" (a Mexican roll).
3)  Rotisserie Chicken.  

But ....just so you know...the produce is great and less costly than Frys.

Two warnings .  First it's difficult to get in and out of the Ranch Market on S. Central on the weekends -- it's VERY VERY CROWDED!  Second, this is an ""ethnic"" experience.   My husband, a ""gringo,"" has, on occasion, encountered some language barrier challenges, but has always been successful in navigating it. - so don't let it stop you!

The Ranch Market is always on the tour for out-of-town-guests who visit us from the Eas
yelp:train:25580.para:
I portray Ranch Market as the amusement park of Supermarkets. 

In truth, it's not advisable to shop there late at night as the thrill can keep you awake. The atmosphere is vibrant with loud music, dazzling lights, and a tantalizing aroma of food that makes you crave it. 

Here are my primary reasons for shopping there:
1) I consistently purchase birthday cakes for my nieces. The cost is exceptional for a personalized cake for children, and the variety is astounding.
2) For those acquainted with Mexican baked goods, this place is your go-to destination! Swap the usual French bread for a "bolillo" (a Mexican roll).
3) Rotisserie Chicken.

However, it's worth noting that the produce is of high quality and more affordable than Frys.

Two cautions: Firstly, navigating the Ranch Market on S. Central during weekends can be challenging due to the immense crowd. Secondly, it offers an "ethnic" experience. My husband, a non-Mexican, has occasionally faced language barriers but has always managed to overcome them. Don't let this deter you!

The Ranch Market is a popular choice for visitors from out of town.

yelp:train:26507.orig:

yelp:train:26507.para:
Absolutely, I am an enthusiast. It bears resemblance to "Fresh choice" in California, yet I appreciate the diversity and the crispness of the meals. The salad bar remains unchanged, so I won't elaborate further. We typically visit on Sundays post-service for a meal.

What I find appealing is the soup bar, offering 5 to 6 different types of soups that are incredibly tasty, including (chicken noodle, clam chowder, Irish potato lech, spicy chili bean, minestrone lentil).

Freshly baked items are replenished every hour, featuring items like corn bread, blueberry muffins, pizza, and french rolls.

They also have a daily changing stir fry section, with my personal favorite being the cheesy macaroni. There's also an option for baked potatoes with various toppings.

The standard dessert selection includes: fresh fruit, jello, pudding, and chocolate/vanilla soft serve.

A special bonus: occasionally, a server will bring freshly baked chocolate chip cookies.

However, despite the place's health-focused image, the all-you-can-eat option can lead to overindulgence.

yelp:train:27173.orig:
We were from out of town, and this was the best restaurant we hit all trip. The dining experience starts off with a quick hello to the huge cow outside the restaurant. Once inside, after checking in, you are guided to a slide you can go down to enter the downstairs/eating area of the restaurant. There's also stairs, but the slide was fun :) all the staff is dressed in cowboy attire, which is cool. We go an awesome table at the window with an awesome view. Our dinner started with a bang...
1. bread/butter: they brought it out, Indian fry bread (which is SOO yummy) and biscuits, which are also great. there's a normal butter and a delicious cinnamon butter, or honey to top it off with. 
2. salad! it had a lot of dressing but it was good. served family style 
3. THEN we ordered... among my whole family, we were able to try a lot of foods.. I got the grilled chicken and I loved it! bbq'd to perfection with great sauce. the corn was great, and my family was all very happy with their meals too (ribs, shrimp, etc). overall awesome food. 
4. finally they brought out complimentary cotton candy! it was funny to get, and you can't go wrong with cotton candy. 

just remember..
- Come ear
yelp:train:27173.para:
We hailed from a different city, and this place turned out to be the finest dining spot we encountered throughout our journey. The meal commences with a friendly greeting to a large bovine statue outside the eatery. Upon entry, post registration, you're escorted to a slide for access to the subterranean dining zone. There are also stairs, but the slide adds a touch of amusement. The entire team is adorned in cowboy gear, which is quite appealing. We secured a remarkable table by the window with a splendid view. Our meal commenced with a flourish...

1. Bread/butter: they presented it, Indian fried bread (which is incredibly delicious) and biscuits, which are equally delightful. There's a standard butter and a scrumptious cinnamon butter, or honey to enhance it. 
2. Salad: it was generously dressed but tasted good. Served in a family-style manner 
3. Then we ordered... among my entire family, we were able to sample a variety of dishes. I opted for the BBQ-grilled chicken and it was fantastic! Perfectly charred with excellent sauce. The corn was also excellent, and my family was all very satisfied with their meals too (ribs, shrimp, etc). Overall, the food was outstanding. 
4. Last

yelp:train:27403.orig:
STAY AWAY

poor service, but i don't blame the server herself.
my boyfriend and i dined in a few months ago and SO MANY things went wrong. it was a weekday and they were terribly understaffed. it took about 15 minutes for our out-of-breath waitress to come get our drink orders. she was trying her best, however it was clear that she had way too many tables to take care of. an expo took our food out, and my salad had no dressing! nobody was to be found to ask for some dressing... or refills... i kindly asked the host to speak to a manager, and with an attitude he said the manager was too busy to come talk to us. 
mediocre food, but i wouldn't really expect more from an applebees
yelp:train:27403.para:
Avoid this place

I acknowledge the subpar service, but I don't hold the server responsible.
My boyfriend and I had a disappointing dining experience a few months back. It was a weekday, and the restaurant was severely short-staffed. Our thirsty waitress took nearly 15 minutes to serve our drink orders. She was doing her best, but it was evident she was overwhelmed with too many tables. Our food was served incorrectly, and my salad was missing its dressing. No one was available to assist with dressing or refills. I politely requested the host to address a manager, but he responded with an unhelpful attitude, stating the manager was too occupied to engage with us. 
Average food quality, but I wouldn't anticipate better from an Applebees.

yelp:train:28077.orig: My DH & I  went for our anniversary last night, 03/27/10. The staff were friendly when we arrived and told us \""Happy Anniversary\"", we received a card, as well. We went with their winter 3 course menu for $35. I got the lettuce wraps, tiger shrimp, and chocolate souffle. My husband got the rock shrimp tempura, salmon, and guava tart. Both of our appetizers were ok, nothing special. The entrees were about the same, nothing special, the shrimp were overcooked, and the salmon had too much sauce on it, you couldn't taste the salmon, the ingredients were good, but the way they prepared both entrees, were not very good. The highlight of the evening were the desserts, they were both good! \n\nWe've been to Roy's before, and we enjoyed our experience, so this was a complete disappointment.  Last year we went to Noca, and the food and experience was much better.
yelp:train:28077.para: On our anniversary date, 03/27/10, my spouse and I visited a restaurant where the staff greeted us warmly and congratulated us on our special day, providing us with a card. We opted for their winter 3-course menu priced at $35. I chose lettuce wraps, tiger shrimp, and a chocolate souffle, while my spouse selected rock shrimp tempura, salmon, and a guava tart. Both of our starters were satisfactory but lacked any particular excellence. The main courses were similarly average, with the shrimp being slightly overdone and the salmon excessively sauced, masking the true flavor of the fish. However, the desserts managed to stand out as the evening's highlight, proving to be enjoyable. Despite our previous positive experiences at Roy's, this visit fell short of expectations, especially when compared to our delightful time at Noca the previous year.

yelp:train:28156.orig: I remember the first time going into the Elephant Bar and thinking the has to extensive a menu.  For me that is usually a sign that overall the food is not going to be consisten, just to much  of a variety.  My compliments to the chef, I have never had anything that hasn't been quite good.  That is saying something as I over all over the menu.  My dining companion has looked at what at my entree more than once and said \""you are going to eat that?\""  The ambience of the Elephant Bar is rather nice as well.  Not that you don't see the cutoffs and flip flop crowd but it is some place that one can enjoy dressing a bit for a nicer casual dinner.  \n\nThe only drawback of the Elephant Bar is the service.  As a whole it is usually very good but occasionally you do get a zinger.  To the management's credit, those people usually don't last.
yelp:train:28156.para:
I recall my initial visit to the Elephant Bar and was struck by the sheer breadth of their menu. Typically, such extensive selections hint at inconsistency in the food quality, but I've found that to be an exception. I extend my praise to the chef, as I've sampled every dish and found them all commendable. This is significant, given my thorough exploration of the menu. My dining partner has scrutinized my chosen dish more than once, questioning, "Are you really going to eat that?" Despite occasional sightings of casual patrons and the occasional disheveled appearance, the Elephant Bar offers a pleasant atmosphere suitable for a more elegant, casual dining experience.

The primary downside of the Elephant Bar is its service. Generally, it's excellent, but there are instances of less-than-stellar service. However, it's worth noting that such instances are often short-lived, thanks to the management's swift action.

yelp:train:28819.orig: This has gone to the point of absurd.  We have been told we owe a balance of $307 for no insurance.  We have insurance, we have always had insurance.  In the past when our baby has been sick, they have refused to see us because of this past due bill.  My wife has spoken to the billing manager twice who has told us she will run it through our insurance.  My wife has called our insurance company multiple times and has been told that they have NEVER attempted to run this bill through our insurance.  My wife has talked to her human resources department at her work and they have verified that our daughter is on our insurance and always has been.\n\nThe bottom line, our end is taken care of.  There is proof that Mesa Pediatrics has made zero attempt to run this through our insurance though everyone in the billing department says they'll \""do it\"".  The lack of effort from their billing department has just made every experience with trying to see a Doctor a difficult one.  I am sure if we had a 0 balance in their system we would be treated differently but the front desk people who have access to letting us see doctors do not care what our excuses are, they will not make an appointment f
yelp:train:28819.para:
The situation has escalated to the level of ridiculousness. We are informed that we owe $307 due to lack of insurance, despite having it consistently. Previously, when our child fell ill, they declined to provide care because of this overdue amount. My spouse has communicated with the billing supervisor twice, who assured her that they would process it through our insurance. However, my spouse has reached out to our insurance provider several times and was informed that they have never tried to process this bill through our insurance. Additionally, my spouse has consulted with her work's human resources, confirming that our child has been and always will be covered by our insurance.

In essence, our issue is resolved. There is evidence that Mesa Pediatrics has not made any attempt to process this through our insurance, even though everyone in the billing department claims they will. The billing department's lack of effort has made every attempt to consult a doctor a challenging experience. I am confident that if we had a zero balance in their system, we would be treated differently. However, the front desk staff, who have the authority to schedule appointments, do not seem to be concerned with our reasons, they will not make an appointment.

yelp:train:28948.orig:
Visit #1 Extremely poor service. The waitress was rude and obviously poorly trained. She dropped the food and drinks off at the side of the table, was a bit sassy, frowning, and never came to check on us or ask if we needed anything else. As someone who has worked in the service industry, I know its not that hard to at least pretend you like your job and do things right. My friend's icecream had hair in it, the mocha I got was just an iced coffee, and another friend's sprite was extremely watery. To top it off, the manager wasn't even apologetic and seemed completely unconcerned with our less-than-enjoyable experience. I eat out frequently, and have of course had some crappy servers and food, but this was one of the worst.


Visit #2 Tried it again to see if maybe it was just a bad day for them... Was still really let down. My friend received her pie that had whipped cream in the picture with no whipped cream. Upon asking for some, she was informed that she would be charged $3 for it... She then pointed out that it was on the picture, which the waiter then went on to argue that it was something else. However, he did go off to ask a manager afterwards and bring her some whipped c
yelp:train:28948.para:
Visit #2 Decided to give it another shot, hoping it was just an off day for the staff... Unfortunately, the disappointment persisted. My companion was presented with a pie depicted with whipped cream, but upon request, was told it would cost $3 to add it. She highlighted the discrepancy, leading to a debate with the waiter. Eventually, the manager intervened and provided the missing whipped cream. Despite this, the overall dining experience remained subpar, leaving me disheartened. As a regular diner, I've encountered my fair share of substandard service and food, but this instance was particularly disheartening.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the same meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent as the original text, while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is roughly the same as the original text.)

yelp:train:29218.orig: We had dinner there today. Very poor service. They didn't answer when we pushed the order button. The drive through was out of order. I went into the kitchen to make an order. We probably won't be back. So sad cause we like Sonic.
yelp:train:29218.para: Today's dinner experience at Sonic was disappointing due to subpar service. When we attempted to place an order, there was no response to our push button. The drive-through system was non-functional, leading us to order directly from the kitchen. Regrettably, we won't be returning, despite our fondness for Sonic.

yelp:train:29699.orig: Salesman was persistent on trying to update my $19 wash to a $99 detail. He was borderline argumentative and aggressive, I would not recommend this place at all. The entire establishment is ran by shady looking people, it's not a good sign when you look at other customers and they all look nervous. The lady waiting next me mentioned how she would just be happy if all her belongings are still in the car when they were done. :(
yelp:train:29699.para: The salesman relentlessly pushed for an upgrade of my $19 wash to a $99 detail, coming across as almost combative and forceful. I strongly advise against patronizing this establishment, as it appears to be managed by individuals with a suspicious demeanor. Observing other patrons, they all seemed anxious. The woman beside me expressed relief if her possessions remained in the vehicle post-service. :(

yelp:train:29861.orig: As good as it gets for fast food and you can have it however you like. Breakfast is good also.
yelp:train:29861.para: You'll find the fast food experience here at its peak, with the freedom to customize your meal. The breakfast selection is equally commendable.

yelp:train:30221.orig: You can expect: cold fries , gross or uncarbonated drinks , cold burgers that have been sitting there ect. I usually don't write reviews but with flu , fever , and gross food; I'll be going hungry tonight. \nSave yourself a trip and go to Ellsworth.
yelp:train:30221.para: In light of illness, including flu and fever, coupled with unappetizing food options like chilly fries, unsavory beverages, and stale burgers, I'll forgo dining tonight. To avoid this, consider visiting Ellsworth instead.

yelp:train:30542.orig: I had 3 bad experiences here before and started using another car wash.  In an emergency I had to use this one again as my regular one was closed.  Same result as the past year.  This place does not care about customer service at all.  Ordered the WORKS.  Prep was ridiculous.  Employees were more interested in playing around and getting each other wet than doing the car.  The equipment is old and does not work very well.\nThe people who dry the car were the same.  Not too concerned with doing a decent job, let along a good one.  Had to ask to have the tire dressing done again because they only did part of two tires.  When I got home I looked closely at the car.  Front windshield still had crud on it.  Interior on drivers side was good but passenger side looked as if they never bothered to wipe the door at all.  The back windshield was streaked so bad I had to wipe it clean myself.  There are too many good car washes in the area to bother with this one.
yelp:train:30542.para: Previously, I encountered three unsatisfactory experiences at this location, prompting me to opt for a different car wash. However, due to an urgent need, I resorted to this place once more when my usual one was unavailable. The outcome mirrored the previous year's disappointment. Customer service was completely disregarded here. I placed an order for WORKS, but the preparation was laughably inadequate. The staff seemed more interested in frivolous activities than in properly washing the vehicle. The outdated equipment performed poorly. The car drying staff also failed to deliver a satisfactory job, with some neglecting to finish the tire dressing on two tires. Upon inspecting the car at home, I noticed the front windshield still had residue, while the interior on the driver's side was acceptable, but the passenger side appeared untouched. The back windshield was so dirty it required my own cleaning. Given the abundance of superior car washes in the vicinity, I deem this one unworthy of my patronage.

yelp:train:30657.orig: Purchased a 60 inch sharp led TV at Tempe marketplace, got it home, and it was cracked. Went back the next day to this store to do an exchange after reading bad best buy reviews all day about them not taking back cracked screens, and they made it very simple and quick here for me. Eased my nerves immediately. They even offered to open the other tv, check it out, and repackage it.
yelp:train:30657.para: Acquired a 60-inch ultra-clear LED TV from the Tempe marketplace, but upon arrival, it was found to be fractured. I returned the following day to the same store, having spent the day perusing negative Best Buy feedback regarding their policy on broken screen returns. The store staff provided a hassle-free and expedited exchange process, which instantly alleviated my anxiety. They also kindly offered to inspect the alternative TV, perform a check, and repackage it for me.

yelp:train:30682.orig: Took more than 2 hours for front tire changes and a patch. Only reason I came here was because I had a coupon. When I got the bill, it was more than what I was quoted on the phone.  When we went over the bill, they had double charged me for some items.  Be very careful when you go here!!!  Will not go back again.
yelp:train:30682.para: I spent over two hours on front tire replacements and patching. I visited primarily due to a coupon I possessed. Upon receiving the bill, it exceeded the amount I was informed of over the phone. During the bill review, I discovered they had erroneously doubled the charges for certain items. Exercise caution when visiting this place, as I've decided not to return.

yelp:train:31714.orig:
I send flowers every week and I wanted to make sure this flower shop could accommodate.  I called the store to speak with the manager and he was out to lunch. I was told by the girl working there that he would call me back when he returned.  He never returned my call. 

A couple days later I sent an email and no response.

If this is what they call customer service,  they are not worth my money.
yelp:train:31714.para:
I regularly dispatch floral arrangements and sought confirmation from the shop's manager regarding their capacity. Upon reaching out, I discovered the manager was unavailable due to a midday meal. The employee informed me they would return my call upon the manager's availability. Unfortunately, there was no callback. 

A few days later, I attempted to communicate via email, but received no reply. 

If this level of customer service is deemed acceptable, they are not deserving of my financial investment.

yelp:train:31755.orig: Overpriced and 2 weeks later i call to find out where my computer is and they say \""It's on the bench , just finishing up\"" twice this happened. $149 quote at lessors and $75 at another place and they called in one day.
yelp:train:31755.para: After paying $149 at a lessor and $75 at a different location, I contacted them two weeks later to inquire about my computer's whereabouts. They informed me it was "just finishing up" on the bench, a situation that has recurred.

yelp:train:32070.orig: Rude sales people.  Sales guy said I needed a wax and leather cleaner for the seats.  I told him my son has a friend I use for this service.  He said \""you don't know how many times I have heard that one\"".  Seriously, don't talk down to the customers, they won't be back.  I know I won't come back.
yelp:train:32070.para: Impolite sales representatives. The salesperson suggested I require a wax and leather cleaner for the car seats. I informed him that my son's friend provides this service. The salesperson remarked, "You've heard that before." It's crucial not to belittle customers, as they are unlikely to return. I am certain I won't be returning either.

yelp:train:32118.orig: I went for a yearly check up and apparently, you are not allowed to ask questions. If you ask any questions they charge extra (in my case,over $300!), which of course was not communicated to me at the time. Now my appointment that should have been covered by insurance I'm having to pay a sizeable amount out of pocket. When I called the billing office to find out why I was charged the extra fee I was told they charge the extra fee if you need a prescription for birth control too. Having been to a gyno for 16 years I've never been charged for asking questions or needing a birth control script. The visit with the doctor itself was nothing special, the doctor was mildly friendly tho somewhat frazzled. It was also a bit odd that they do not have a front desk, just assistants with tablets who sit in the waiting area and approach you as you enter to check you in.  I had previously gone to the Maricopa office and had NO problems. I will not be returning.
yelp:train:32118.para: During my annual examination, it was discovered that inquiring about your health is not permitted, and any questions lead to additional charges (I was charged over $300 in my situation), a fact that was not disclosed to me initially. Consequently, the cost of my insurance-covered appointment is now a significant out-of-pocket expense. Upon inquiring with the billing department about the unexpected fee, I learned they impose this charge when a prescription for birth control is also required. Throughout my 16 years of gynecological visits, I have never encountered such a fee for asking questions or needing birth control medication. The consultation with the doctor was unremarkable, though the doctor seemed slightly amiable yet somewhat overwhelmed. It was unusual that there was no front desk, only assistants equipped with tablets who wait in the lobby to greet patients upon arrival. Having had a hassle-free experience at the Maricopa office, I have decided not to return.

yelp:train:32417.orig: Great service! terrible food, a shame.  The Ceasar salad had the wrong type of lettuce, wrong dressing. Came with tomatos!  Lasagna bland and mushy!  And why. The Tv??!
yelp:train:32417.para: Exceptional customer support, but disappointing culinary experience. The Caesar salad contained incorrect lettuce and dressing, and came with tomatoes. The lasagna was tasteless and overly soft. Additionally, the presence of a TV was perplexing.

yelp:train:32627.orig:
Surprised I haven't written a review for this place earlier since Pita Jungle is only a few blocks away. This place is Vegetarian, Non-Vegetarian, and Vegan friendly so really you can find something for everyone at this place. In addition, there is outdoor sitting by the lake, which is just perfect when the weather cools down.  Just don't mind the ducks. ;)

The food here is really good and fresh. This evening I'm having the Couscous salad with a Passion Fruit iced tea, but I've also had many of the other menu items throughout my several visits to this spot. I can usually never finish the salads since they are so huge, but they taste just as good the next day. The Hummus is a must, and any kind will do they're all really good. If you're watching carbs, you can order it with cucumber slices instead of a pita which is fantastic and very refreshing on a warm day. 

All in all, I really like this place and the service is great. Not too slow, but not too rushed either. This is one of my go-to places when I really crave something super healthy.
yelp:train:32627.para:
I've held off on posting a review for this eatery as it's merely a short walk from Pita Jungle. This establishment caters to all dietary preferences, including Vegetarian, Non-Vegetarian, and Vegan options, ensuring a meal for everyone. Outdoor seating by the lake is ideal for cooler weather. Just be aware of the ducks. 

The cuisine here is both delicious and fresh. Tonight, I'm indulging in a Couscous salad with a Passion Fruit iced tea. I've sampled numerous other dishes during my multiple visits, and I often find myself unable to finish the generous salads, but they remain tasty the following day. Hummus is a staple here, and they offer a variety of excellent choices. For those monitoring their carb intake, opting for cucumber slices instead of pita is a refreshing and healthy alternative. 

Overall, I'm quite fond of this place and appreciate the attentive service. It strikes a balance between being neither too slow nor too hurried. It's a top choice for me when I'm in the mood for a nutritious meal.

yelp:train:33120.orig:
So, the 2 stars is because I typically would give it 4 but our horrible Thanksgiving dinner at this location would warrant 1 star. 
Clearly they overbooked for Thanksgiving...this became apparent because I made a reservation a MONTH ahead and we were told it would be a 45-50 minute wait when we walked in the door at 1:45 pm.  What point is a reservation then really? 
Only because another gal told us it would be 15 minutes and we were rather vocal about the situation did they manage to acquire a booth for us about 20 minutes later. 

Then there was the food...past years we ate at another Mimi's and thoroughly enjoyed our meal and the crowd was managed much better. Additionally, there were snacks and drinks available for those having to wait to be seated (Note to Chandler location: this is extremely helpful when people are hungry and not expecting a long wait time after booking a reservation).  The salad and bread were sadly the best part of the meal...the sweet potatoes were so sweet none of us ate them and half of us wouldn't try the green bean casserole and the other half regretted that they did.  
Additionally my husband and I ordered red wine and they ran out of wine glasse
yelp:train:33120.para:
The rating of 2 stars stems from my usual 4-star expectation, which was significantly impacted by the subpar Thanksgiving dinner experience at this venue. It was evident that they had overbooked for the holiday, as I had booked a month in advance and were informed of a 45-50 minute wait upon arrival at 1:45 pm. The value of a reservation was questioned in this scenario. 

Despite another customer's assurance of a 15-minute wait, we were vocal about our dissatisfaction, which led to us being seated approximately 20 minutes later. The food quality was disappointing compared to previous visits to another Mimi's location, where the crowd was better managed and snacks and drinks were available for those waiting. The salad and bread were the only redeeming aspects of the meal, while the sweet potatoes were overly sweet, and opinions on the green bean casserole were divided.

Furthermore, my husband and I faced a shortage of red wine, as they had run out of wine glasses.

yelp:train:33179.orig: Don't go through the drive through. They F you in the drive through. Multiple different times throughout 3 years, I have been F'ed consistently. Hamburgers with no meat (hard to validate when driving through). Missing items. Just go in and check your order.
yelp:train:33179.para: Over the past three years, I've repeatedly encountered being deceived while ordering through the drive-thru. Instances include receiving hamburgers devoid of meat and missing items. It's advisable to enter the establishment and verify your order.

yelp:train:33694.orig: I decided I needed to write a review since the 5 star review I saw was from 2008!!! Since it is 2014- here is my take: I would give it no stars - except that the front desk managers are amazing!!! They are friendly and even when our dog was annoying other guests with his barking, the gentleman at the front offered to watch him while we went to dinner- way above the call of his job!! We are in the process of relocating to Chandler and the relocation company put us up here for 11 days while we wait to get in our apartment...for a Hilton, I'm very disappointed!! Guests shouldn't even hear our dog if the walls weren't so thin!! We are at the end of the hallway and away from any other room but the quality of this hotel is so very low! The beds are DOUBLE size and for 2 adults, doubles just are too small for numerous days. Hampton Inn which is next door and also Hilton seems like a better option! The coffee at Homewood Suites is mediocre at best- for people who enjoy the Hampton Inn Robust, this is terrible!! The rooms are clean but not Hilton quality
yelp:train:33694.para: In 2014, I felt compelled to share my thoughts on this establishment, despite a five-star review dating back to 2008. Here's my perspective: I'd rate it zero stars, though I must commend the front desk staff for their exceptional friendliness and helpfulness. They even went the extra mile to accommodate our dog during our dinner outing, surpassing their expected duties. Currently relocating to Chandler, we were accommodated here for 11 days by a relocation company, but as a Hilton, my expectations were not met. The thin walls allowed our dog's barking to disturb other guests, and despite being at the end of the hallway, the hotel's quality was disappointingly low. The double-sized beds were inadequate for two adults over several days. Comparatively, the nearby Hampton Inn and Hilton seemed like superior choices. Additionally, the coffee quality at Homewood Suites was subpar, especially for those who appreciate the Hampton Inn's robust flavor. While the rooms were tidy, they fell short of Hilton standards.

yelp:train:34173.orig: Baja Fresh is going down hill.  The burrito size is shrinking, and the price  is growing!  WTF!  Did they think I wouldn't notice?  I still like their burritos, I just don't think it's worth it now.  I can get a much more filling burrito from my friends at Chipotle for less $.  Oh and I normally like mango salsa but this time theirs tasted like dookie.
yelp:train:34173.para: The quality of Baja Fresh's burritos is declining, with diminishing sizes and escalating costs. It's perplexing that they assumed I wouldn't be aware. Although I still enjoy their burritos, I now question their value. I can find a more satisfying burrito from my pals at Chipotle for a lower price. Additionally, I usually prefer mango salsa, but this time it tasted off.

yelp:train:34221.orig: With $1.00, I can either get 4 gum balls from the gum ball machine at the mall, or choose an item from the plethora found on Wendy's value menu.  I rarely choose the gum balls.  I give Wendy's 5 stars because in my opinion it is everything you could ask for in a fast food joint: Value, friendliness, and most importantly, speed.  I like to play a game called 'How many seconds from the time I finish placing my order until the time I have my order in hand and am driving away?'.  Today it was 24 seconds - now that's fast food!  They are so quick when taking the order, charging at the first window, and delivering your food to you at the second.  And that was around the time of the lunch hour rush.  My favorite game, however, is called 'Don't come to a complete stop when picking up my food'.  Since they usually have my order hanging out the window before I even get there, I can just roll right through, grab my food while still in motion, and be on my way (With a \""Thank you\"" of course).  This location usually has hot girls working there too.  Did I mention that the girls at both windows said \""have a good day!\""?.  Well now I did.  In fact, the second one even asked me how I was doi
yelp:train:34221.para: With a single dollar, I can opt for 4 pieces of gum from the mall's gum ball dispenser, or select an item from Wendy's extensive value menu. I seldom pick the gum. I award Wendy's a 5-star rating as I believe it perfectly embodies the essence of a quick-service restaurant: affordability, cordiality, and above all, rapid service. I engage in a timed challenge, measuring the duration from when I complete my order to when I receive it and start driving, which today clocked in at 24 seconds - exemplifying the speed of fast food. Their efficiency is evident in the swift order-taking, immediate payment processing, and prompt food delivery. This was observed during the peak lunch hour. My preferred game involves not coming to a full stop when collecting my food, as they typically have it ready on the window, allowing me to swiftly grab it and continue my journey, all while expressing gratitude. Additionally, the presence of attractive staff at both counters adds to the experience, with one even inquiring about my well-being. Indeed, I had a pleasant day.

yelp:train:34994.orig: This place is amazing I have been going here for at least 10 years, great food, family owned and run business.
yelp:train:34994.para: I'm in awe of this location; I've frequented it for a decade or more, offering delectable cuisine in a family-operated enterprise.

yelp:train:35316.orig: First visit and not a good experience. My breakfast came minus the biscuit and gravy and with no assigned server (you stand in line to order and food runners bring your plate) I had to go back inside (we sat in the outside patio) and request the rest of my breakfast. My breakfast was served but not the other two in my party. After a ten minute wait I started to eat it because it was getting cold. We stopped two different  food runners and asked about the rest of our order and were told \""I'm sure it will be right up\"". We waited forty five minutes and nothing. The only thing they did right was refund the charge for the food that never came. They did apologize for the lousy service but we won't be going back.
yelp:train:35316.para: Upon my initial visit, the experience was unsatisfactory. I was served breakfast without the biscuit and gravy, and there was no dedicated server, forcing us to order in line and wait for food delivery. I had to return indoors to complete my meal, despite our seating in the outdoor area. The rest of our breakfast remained unserved after a ten-minute wait, leading us to inquire with two food deliverers who assured us it would arrive shortly. However, after a forty-five-minute wait, our order still hadn't arrived. The only positive aspect was the refund for the unserved food. Despite their apology for the poor service, we decided not to return.

yelp:train:35663.orig:
Was here today for the Peach Festival and could not believe how rude the lady making the pancakes was! I think this is Carrie Schnepf since she was the one I saw on the news. I was standing over by the refrigerator where the water bottles are kept looking for a sign posted stating the price of a water bottle. I had made brief eye contact with her and she screamed, ""What??!"" and threw her hands up in the air obviously annoyed by my very presence. I was so appalled and just responded with asking how much the water was. Then she screamed ""$2.00!!"". 

Maybe she is a nice person, I don't know but I do know that is no way to treat a customer that contributes to keeping your business alive. A little kindness and courtesy is all I'm asking for - especially from the owner and especially after paying $12.00 for pancakes I could have made better myself.

Other than that it was a pretty fun day. I do think the farm could use some overall clean up. There were just random objects laying around every where that didn't appear to have much purpose. Just makes the place a little junky looking.
yelp:train:35663.para:
Attended the Peach Festival today and was shocked by the unpleasant demeanor of the woman flipping pancakes. I suspect this is Carrie Schnepf, as I had previously seen her on television. I was near the fridge, searching for a price tag on water bottles when I accidentally caught her eye. She erupted in frustration, "What?!" and gestured wildly, clearly irritated by my mere presence. I was taken aback and inquired about the water's cost, which she angrily declared to be "$2.00!".

While I can't judge her character, I am certain that her behavior towards a customer, who helps sustain the business, was unacceptable. I'm requesting a bit of basic politeness and respect, particularly from the proprietor, especially after spending $12 on pancakes that I could have easily prepared myself. 

Apart from this incident, the day was enjoyable. However, I believe the farm could benefit from a general tidying up. There were numerous misplaced items scattered around, giving the place a somewhat disheveled appearance.

yelp:train:36569.orig: Love their breakfast! Waffles are just like home cooked. If you need breakfast in a hurry this is the place, with in 5 mins of ordering your food is at the table.
yelp:train:36569.para: Enjoy their morning meal! The waffles taste as if they were made at home. For those in a rush, this is the ideal spot, delivering your order to your table within a mere five minutes.

yelp:train:36631.orig: I booked this place through priceline during the heart of spring training season and the prices were reasonable (less than $150/night).  The hotel reflects local architecture with cacti everywhere.  The room was more than adequate for our 3 night stay.  We stayed at one end of the hotel so walking to the main lobby area did get a bit annoying but our room's location was very quiet and peaceful.  We used both pools/jacuzzi's - very nice and not that crowded.  The coffee bar was great for morning breakfasts.  The location was very convenient - only a few minutes drive to the fashion mall.  Very good value!
yelp:train:36631.para: During the peak of spring training, I secured this accommodation via Priceline, noting the cost was under $150 per night. The hotel showcases regional design elements, adorned with cacti. Our 3-night reservation was satisfactorily accommodated in a room that provided ample space. Although positioned at one end, resulting in some inconvenience when reaching the central lobby, the room offered a serene atmosphere. We enjoyed both the pools and jacuzzis, which were enjoyable and sparsely populated. The coffee bar served as an excellent spot for our morning meals. The property's proximity to the fashion mall was highly practical, offering excellent value for money.

yelp:train:36829.orig: Gas is decently priced but if you are a smoker, one of the best priced around.
yelp:train:36829.para: The cost of gas is reasonably affordable, and it stands out as a particularly cost-effective option for individuals who smoke.

yelp:train:36844.orig:
I must admit, based on the reviews I was a bit nervous taking my photos there to be developed, but they seem to be one of the last 3 local, pro camera places left in Phoenix that develops pictures.  Walgreens, Walmart and Target are awful for pictures (I don't have a Costco membership), and I'm one of those weird people who still likes to have an actual photo instead of an electronic image.

Wilson's was open on Saturday (Tempe Camera, get with the times, no weekend hours for photo developing?).  I dropped my pics off and they were ready by Tuesday.  4 x 7 glossy, just like I ordered, of my vacation pics.  The quality was superb!  Rivals Jones Photo in Tucson who I used for 30+ years until moving to Phoenix.  Wilson made good pics look even better.  Color and detail were great.

Service both on Sat. and Tues. was very friendly and fast.  I'm no pro and can't tell you anything about their cameras, prices, classes... just their photo developing.  I'll definitely be back again!
yelp:train:36844.para:
I confess, after perusing the feedback, I felt apprehensive about sending my photos to be processed at this location, as it appears to be among the final three professional camera development shops in Phoenix. Unlike Walgreens, Walmart, and Target, which I find subpar for photo development (and I don't have a Costco account), I'm an individual who prefers tangible photographs over digital ones.

Wilson's was operational on a Saturday (Tempe Camera, modernize your hours, why no weekend photo development?). I entrusted my images there, and they were prepared by the following Tuesday. The output was 4 x 7 glossy prints, precisely as I had requested. The image quality was exceptional! Compared to my longstanding patronage of Jones Photo in Tucson for over three decades before relocating to Phoenix, Wilson's managed to enhance the quality of my photos. The color and detail were outstanding.

The service on both Saturday and Tuesday was exceedingly amiable and prompt. Although I'm not a professional and can't comment on their camera equipment, pricing, or educational offerings, I can speak highly of their photo development services. I'm certain I'll return in the future.

yelp:train:36928.orig: Unbelievable that a \""egg\"" restarunt does not know how to poach an egg. 3x for eggs benedict and still wrong. 2xs eggs not cooked 3x killed them. I gave up.
yelp:train:36928.para: It's astonishing that a restaurant specializing in eggs fails to master the art of poaching an egg. Despite offering eggs benedict thrice, the issue persists. Twice, the eggs were undercooked and ruined the experience. I've decided to stop patronizing them.

yelp:train:37510.orig: Have dined there many times. Best chicken piccata around. But got bad Salmon on Sat. night ended up with food poisoning,tasted OK but very sick later. Will avoid the salmon at all cost.
yelp:train:37510.para: Frequently visited this place; their chicken piccata is exceptional. Unfortunately, on a Saturday evening, the salmon was unpleasant and led to food poisoning. I'll steer clear of the salmon in the future.

yelp:train:37615.orig: I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place yet. I work nearby and frequent Jolta Java at least 4 times a week. Mostly for just Iced Tea (which is delicious!). I love supporting locally owned places and the staff at Jolta Java is why. They always remember who you are and what you like. When I eat lunch there they always ask how it is and for any feedback. \n\nMy only suggestion would be more veggie friendly menu options! Even their caprese salad has buffalo chicken on it?? Their soups however, are FANTASTIC. I wish they served them on more of a regular schedule because I love the Jalapeno creamed corn soup but never know when it is being offered.
yelp:train:37615.para: I'm astonished I haven't given my opinion on this spot yet. I live close by and visit Jolta Java frequently, about four times a week, mostly for their scrumptious Iced Tea. I'm a big fan of supporting local businesses and the friendly staff at Jolta Java is a major reason for that. They remember your preferences and inquire about your dining experience. \n\nMy sole recommendation would be to introduce more vegetarian-friendly dishes! For instance, their caprese salad includes buffalo chicken. However, their soups are incredibly delightful. I'd like them to be available more often, especially the Jalapeno creamed corn soup, which I enjoy but can't always predict when it's served.

yelp:train:38318.orig: Food not that good overpriced. My Calmari was very tough must have been old. Sauce was good\nSkimpy salad.  Service not that good. Will not go back, very dissapointing, and the place was empty.
yelp:train:38318.para: The cuisine was subpar and overpriced. My Calmari dish was excessively tough, likely due to age. The sauce was enjoyable, but the salad was lacking. The service was underwhelming. I'm displeased and won't return, especially since the venue was notably vacant.

yelp:train:38386.orig: Got bagels and coffee to go this morning and was very disappointed. For a breakfast place their coffee is awful and they don't even have real half and half out or the right cups for iced coffee. They also do not have stevia or raw sugar.. They need to get an update on this bandwagon. I'll give it to them that their bagels are fresh but our bagel sandwich was half heartily put together. It was dry and they did not get either orders right I asked for a jalape\u00f1o bagel and got plain and I asked for pepper jack cheese and got cheddar.. Needless to say I will find a different place to get bagels and coffee.
yelp:train:38386.para: This morning, I picked up my bagels and coffee to go, but I was quite disheartened. The coffee quality at this breakfast spot is subpar, and they lack authentic half and half, suitable cups for iced coffee, and sweeteners like stevia or raw sugar. Even though the bagels appear fresh, the bagel sandwich I received was half-heartedly assembled, dry, and my specific requests were ignored - I was given a plain bagel instead of a jalapeño one and cheddar cheese instead of pepper jack. Consequently, I'll seek out another establishment for my bagel and coffee needs.

yelp:train:38555.orig:
I would not eat here because I don't care for extra mucus with my meal.

The parent company, Darden, is threatening to turn full-time employees into part-time employees in order to dodge the requirements of the Affordable Care Act.

Do you want your food handled by people who can't afford a doctor's visit because they are uninsured part-timers, AND they can't afford to miss a day of work if they are sick, because they are part-timers?
yelp:train:38555.para:
I wouldn't dine at this place due to my aversion to mucus-laden food.

Darden, the parent company, is considering converting full-time staff to part-time roles to circumvent the Affordable Care Act's stipulations.

Would you prefer your meals prepared by individuals who can't afford healthcare due to their part-time, uninsured status, and who are unable to take sick leave because of their part-time employment?

yelp:train:40045.orig: I always remark to myself about the professional demeanor of the people who work here.\nWalt runs a tight ship.
yelp:train:40045.para: I frequently remind myself of the professional conduct displayed by the staff in this place.\nWalt maintains a disciplined and orderly environment.

yelp:train:40145.orig: Seems like every time i come here lately, a side order of bad attitude that i didn't order, is served up!  Won't be coming back after the particularly snotty attitude I got from a Ms. Elizabeth tonight though. What a shame, the sweet potato fries were actually decent here...
yelp:train:40145.para: It appears that each visit recently has been accompanied by an unwelcome side of negative vibes, which I didn't request. I've decided not to return after the particularly rude demeanor I encountered from Ms. Elizabeth tonight. It's unfortunate, but the sweet potato fries here were quite enjoyable.

yelp:train:41150.orig:
Slightly touristy in that there's a lot of memorabilia scattered around the place, not to mention a tank with rattlesnakes right when you enter and an old west town made up of prop store fronts and a stage for live music out back, but other than that, it's all history.  The restaurant has been around since 1957 according to the website, and the history is pretty evident upon first glance.  The cieling is covered in snipped neckties and business cards dating back decades - just look for the dustiest ties and the yellowest cards, you'll see what I mean.  Along many of the interior walls there are hundreds of beer related trinkets, tap handles, old label artwork, bottle caps, old photos of the first breweries, and unique bottle openers.  It's a pretty interesting place to just walk around (and, of course, there's a gift shop for all your last minute christmas gifts).  

There's also a local brewery attached to it, Sonoran Brewing Company, and all of their beers are served at the restaurant.  I recommend trying their Inebriator Stout and the Victorian IPA if you like craft beer or your tastebuds could use a wake-up call.  

The food isn't oh-my-gawd amazing, but it's good.  The ste
yelp:train:41150.para:
