The establishment, while slightly reminiscent of a tourist spot with various memorabilia, also features a tank with rattlesnakes upon entry and a replica of an old western town with a stage for live performances in the rear. Beyond these elements, the place is steeped in history. The eatery has been operational since 1957, and its historical significance is immediately apparent. The ceiling is adorned with snipped neckties and business cards from various eras, with the dustiest and yellowest ones being particularly noteworthy. Interior walls are lined with numerous beer-related items, including tap handles, vintage label art, bottle caps, and images of early breweries, as well as distinctive bottle openers. It's an engaging location for leisurely strolls and last-minute holiday shopping. 

Additionally, a local brewery, Sonoran Brewing Company, is connected to it, offering their beers for consumption at the restaurant. I suggest sampling their Inebriator Stout and Victorian IPA for those who appreciate craft beer or desire a flavorful awakening. 

The cuisine may not be exceptionally outstanding, but it is satisfactory. The steak

yelp:train:41379.orig: Competent tech, got the unit running, good response, very expensive. Charges $80 per pound for R-22 freon when the current contractor purchase price is $11 per pound. If gas stations charged the same mark up, gas would be $24 per gallon. Suggest getting other quotes Fountain Hills.
yelp:train:41379.para: Skilled technicians successfully operated the equipment, yielding a positive outcome, albeit at a high cost. The price for R-22 freon is set at $80 per pound, significantly higher than the current supplier's rate of $11 per pound. Drawing a parallel, if gas stations applied a similar markup, fuel would skyrocket to $24 per gallon. It is recommended to seek alternative quotes in Fountain Hills.

yelp:train:41593.orig: I have been to this store several times with disappointment.  You really have to watch expiration dates.  There organic boxed salads are almost always expired.  I always have to find an employee to get me items from the back room that are fresh and should be out on the shelf.  it should be a normal routine to go through the produce and throw out the aged items.   This happens ALL the time. Believe it or not, Wal-Mart is now selling quite a bit of wrapped organic produce items.  Better to buy it pre-wrapped than to have everyones hands all over the unwrapped veggies.
yelp:train:41593.para: I've visited this shop multiple times feeling let down. It's crucial to pay attention to expiration dates. The organic boxed salads are frequently past their prime. I'm compelled to seek assistance from staff to obtain fresh items from the storage area, which should be readily available on the shelves. It's a regular practice to inspect the produce and discard the outdated ones. Surprisingly, Wal-Mart is now offering a significant amount of pre-packaged organic produce. Opting for pre-wrapped options is preferable to having everyone handling the unwrapped vegetables.

yelp:train:41743.orig: This mall has unfortunately gone done hill since my family moved to Arizona 10 years ago. My sister and I used to come here and hang out back in the high school years and just spend time walking the mall and having a good time. I do not think I would feel safe hanging out around here any longer.\n\nWe most recently came here on a Sunday afternoon. We don't usually shop the stores very often at AZ Mills but we were waiting to see a movie and had some time to kill. We made our way in by the movie theater and made our way around the mall. The hallways were so crowded at times we were barely able to make it through. There were so many kids screaming and running around without it parents it was alarming. Do not come here if you plan to have a nice leisurely day around the mall unless you enjoy shrill high pitch screams around every corner. At one point we were making our way around the Rainforest Caf\u00e9 (which was oddly blaring loud club music) and we heard a couple arguing very loudly outside the restaurant. Eventually they started screaming at each other in the middle of about 15 people passing by. The woman screamed that she was going to call security on him, lovely. Once again, d
yelp:train:41743.para:
Since my family relocated to Arizona a decade ago, this shopping center has sadly declined. My sister and I would frequently visit during our high school days, relishing in the leisurely strolls and enjoyable moments. I now harbor concerns about my safety in this location.

Recently, we visited on a Sunday afternoon, not for shopping at AZ Mills as we typically do, but to catch a film and pass time. We navigated through the mall, but the corridors were packed, making it difficult to move. The cacophony of children's shouts and unsupervised running was quite unsettling. It's not recommended to visit for a peaceful mall experience unless you're fond of constant high-pitched screams. At one point, we were near the Rainforest Café, which was playing loud club music. We overheard a heated argument between a couple, which escalated to screaming amidst a crowd of about 15 people. The woman threatened to call security, which was quite distressing.

yelp:train:41798.orig:
What is not to love about this wonderful Bakery. It is in a great location right on Southern in Tempe. If you did not know it was there however, you might not realize what it is.
 Lots of parking in the lot. Very clean and wonderful smelling inside.
Their pastries and baked goods are fabulous. Fresh and wonderful.
 Plus you can order almost any type of cake that you would like. 
My girlfriend got me a Tiramasu Birthday Cake here and it was one of the best I have ever had, short of Italy itself.
Fresh , creamy, and smooth. The lady fingers were fantastic!
If you ever need a cake or even some lovely morining snacks. This is the place to go.
yelp:train:41798.para: Discover the delight of this fantastic bakery situated on Southern in Tempe. It might go unnoticed if you're unaware of its presence. The lot offers ample parking and the interior is both spotless and aromatic. The bakery's pastries and baked items are exceptional, boasting freshness and quality. They cater to diverse cake preferences, including a Tiramasu Birthday Cake that was exceptional, rivaling the experience of Italy. The cake was fresh, creamy, and smooth, with the lady fingers being outstanding. For cakes or delightful morning treats, this bakery is your go-to destination.

yelp:train:41947.orig: Hour wait when I had a reservation. Only two salespeople on the morning of a new phone release. Are you kidding me!
yelp:train:41947.para: Only two representatives available during my reserved time on the day of a fresh phone launch. It's utterly absurd!

yelp:train:42382.orig: Good, thorough and experienced\nI don't know who \""lucky\"" saw but it wasn't the Dr. Ponitch I saw. I had a skin screening at a college health fair was told to get some dry patches removed before they became cancerous. The Doc said the same thing and took care of all them - quite a few little ones and a couple of larger. He was thorough, explained the after care and only charged the co-pay for all the work and exam.
yelp:train:42382.para: Excellent, detailed and skilled\nI'm uncertain about who perceived as "fortunate", but it wasn't the Dr. Ponitch I encountered. During a university health event, I was advised to remove several dry patches to prevent them from turning into cancer. The physician echoed this advice and addressed all of them - numerous small ones and a few larger. He was meticulous, outlined the post-treatment care, and only billed the co-payment for all the services and examination.

yelp:train:42495.orig: 4.5 stars.  They make a really good thin crust  NY style pizza.  We also like the wings ALOT!    We do delivery 9 times out of 10 and they are fast and the pizza and wings hold up well.  I don't care for the BBQ wings but my kids love them.  We all like the honey hot wings. \n\nThey hands down have the best lunch special in town. We were here the other day and got 3 slices plus a drink and 2 waters for $10 plus change.  I had a slice of the special pizza with sausage, pepperoni and jalape\u00f1os. I'm usually not a fan of sausage but this stuff was really tasty.  The slices are huge too.  I left full but if your a huge eater you might want 2 slices.  They are local too so I like to support local businesses.
yelp:train:42495.para: 4.5 stars rating. They craft an exceptionally delicious thin crust New York-style pizza. We also have a strong preference for their wings, which we enjoy immensely. Delivery is our choice 90% of the time, praised for its speed and the durability of both pizza and wings. While BBQ wings aren't to our taste, our children adore them. The honey hot wings are a hit among all of us. \n\nUndoubtedly, they offer the finest lunch deal in the area. Recently, we visited and ordered 3 slices, a drink, and 2 waters for a total of $10 plus some change. I opted for a slice of their special pizza, loaded with sausage, pepperoni, and jalapeños. Normally, I'm not fond of sausage, but this batch was incredibly flavorful. The slices are quite large, and I left satisfied. For those who enjoy hearty meals, two slices might be more suitable. Plus, being a local establishment, I appreciate supporting our community businesses.

yelp:train:42649.orig: love this place. You can always find a great deal, but the shoes section is out of order on most days. but the deals are worth it. Check often as new merchandise is brought in often
yelp:train:42649.para: Enjoy the ambiance of this location. Regularly discover fantastic offers, though the shoe department frequently experiences disruptions. Nonetheless, the value of these deals justifies frequent visits to stay updated on the latest products.

yelp:train:42696.orig: I have come here quite a few times with friends who love hot wings.  I am not a hot wing person, but the menu is enormous and lots to choose from.  I have never been disappointed with the food... it is your typical bar food pizza, burgers, sliders, sandwiches, and many other things.  My only complaint is we sat on the patio and it smelled like a sewer out there.  I don't recall this being a issue before... so not sure if this is a problem that can be resolved or only going to get worse.  My suggestion... if you are going there and want to sit on the patio... sit as far to the east as possible.  It didn't smell as much over there:)
yelp:train:42696.para: I've visited this place multiple times with companions who enjoy spicy chicken wings. I myself don't fancy them, yet the extensive menu offers a plethora of options. I've consistently been satisfied with the fare, which includes standard bar fare like pizza, burgers, sliders, and various other items. My sole grievance is the patio area, which emitted a foul odor reminiscent of a sewage facility. This issue was not previously noted, leaving me uncertain if it's fixable or if it will deteriorate further. My advice to those wishing to dine outdoors: opt for a seat towards the eastern end of the patio, as the smell was less intense there.

yelp:train:43172.orig: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE FIRST THEY STOLE THE 75 cent that I was going to fill up my water jugs, then they told me they topped off my fluids which they did not my car almost OVERHEATED and now my radio plays softly even though my car is totally off. All I went there for was an oil change, that was all. WTF!!!
yelp:train:43172.para: Terrible incident occurred initially, they took the 75 cent I intended to use for refilling my water containers. They falsely claimed to have filled my fluids, which led to my vehicle nearly overheating. Now, my radio emits a faint sound despite the car being completely inactive. I only visited for an oil change service, which was the sole purpose of my visit. Unbelievable situation!

yelp:train:43209.orig:
With family in upstate New York, I grew up with trips to Ted's while visiting back east.  The charcoal grilled hot dogs always tasted sooo good.  

In high school, I discovered that Ted's had a location in Tempe, only a bit away from my parent's house in Mesa.  The yumminess of the food definitely translated west of the Mississippi.  Everything is so good and has that awesome taste of being grilled and perhaps fried (like the fries and onion rings)  without being too heavy.

I love standing in line, calling out my order when asked, buying Weber's mustard (I haven't found it sold anywhere else in Arizona), drinking fountain rootbeer that has a kick, looking at the Buffalo, NY paraphenalia that decorates the walls. 

On the trays, there is a paper with a quiz that I pretty much have memorized.  I know, from the quiz, that Ted's uses 7 million pickle spears per year.  I also always laugh with my friends over the easiest question on the quiz: ""True or False; there is a Ted's Hotdogs location in Tempe, AZ"" (the quiz was clearly written for my Ted's friends to the east).

It gets pretty crowded at lunchtime and stays that way through the afternoon.  I would suggest going slig
yelp:train:43209.para:
Growing up near upstate New York, I frequently visited Ted's during family trips to the east. The charcoal-grilled hot dogs there always had an exceptional flavor. 

During my high school years, I found out that Ted's also had a spot in Tempe, not too far from my parents' home in Mesa. The deliciousness of the food seemed to carry over from east to west of the Mississippi. The food is universally good, with a distinctive taste of grilling and maybe frying (as seen in the fries and onion rings), but not overly heavy. 

I enjoy waiting in line, announcing my order when prompted, purchasing Weber's mustard (which I haven't found elsewhere in Arizona), and sipping on rootbeer with a bit of a kick. I also appreciate the Buffalo, NY memorabilia adorning the walls. 

On the trays, there's a quiz I've pretty much memorized. I know from the quiz that Ted's uses 7 million pickle spears annually. I also always find humor in the simplest question on the quiz: "True or False: There's a Ted's Hotdogs location in Tempe, AZ" (the quiz seems to be written for Ted's friends from the east). 

The place gets quite busy during lunchtime and remains so

yelp:train:43449.orig: I'm a Marriott Rewards Gold member and spend lots of leisure trips and business trips at Marriott brand hotels. The Buttes, unfortunately, did not meet my expectations. The service was good, but the rooms were quite outdated and the food (room service and The Top of The Rock Restaurant) was mediocre at best. There was a strange, unpleasant smell in our hallway and room foyer, as well. On the bright side, the spa was fabulous. I had an 80 minute massage that rocked my world.  Overall, however, I was pretty underwhelmed by this resort.
yelp:train:43449.para: As a Marriott Rewards Gold holder, I frequently utilize Marriott brand hotels for both leisure and business travel. Regrettably, The Buttes fell short of my anticipations. While the service provided was commendable, the accommodations were noticeably antiquated and the dining experience, including room service and The Top of The Rock Restaurant, was only average. An odd, disagreeable odor permeated our hallway and foyer. On a positive note, the spa experience was exceptional, with an 80-minute massage that was truly transformative. Despite this, my overall impression of the resort was rather lackluster.

yelp:train:43659.orig:
I joined it for the climbing wall, then found myself going there all the time. it is by far the best gym I have ever been to. Everything is spread out and there are enough machines and weights so I never really find myself waiting for anything. 

They are also open 24 hrs so I can go at odd times. 

My only complaint is that the climbing wall has very limited hours. I wish teh wall was open as long as the gym is!
yelp:train:43659.para:
I initially signed up for the climbing wall, but soon it became my frequent destination. It stands out as the superior fitness center I've experienced. The layout is spacious with a sufficient number of machines and weights, ensuring I rarely encounter delays. 

The gym operates round the clock, allowing me to visit at unconventional hours. 

My sole grievance is the climbing wall's restricted operating hours. I would prefer if the wall's availability matched the gym's schedule.

yelp:train:43799.orig:
I have tried every other mongolian bbq in the valley and none compare to YC's. It is just plain better. Price is right for the portion. I pay extra for the box and go nutts at the line and take home the extra. Meat is always the best quality, the veggies are always fresh. Though busy at peak times, they always get you through the line quick. 

YC's needs a seafood night with lobster and shrimp etc. I'd pay allot more a coupel times a month to step it up.

As for the frozen yogurt, don't bother. They need to pick up the brand Sweet Tomatoes uses and add a little fixin bar and I would pay the extra for dessert.
yelp:train:43799.para: I've sampled all Mongolian BBQ spots in the area, but none match the superior quality of YC's. The value for the portion is excellent. I'm willing to pay a bit more for the box and enjoy the lively atmosphere at the counter, taking home the leftovers. The meat consistently boasts the highest quality, and the vegetables are perpetually fresh. Even during busy hours, they efficiently serve customers. \n\nYC's could greatly benefit from introducing a seafood night featuring lobster and shrimp, which I'd gladly pay more for on a monthly basis. Regarding the frozen yogurt, it's not worth it. They should consider adopting the Sweet Tomatoes brand and include a mix-in bar. I'd gladly pay extra for a dessert upgrade.

yelp:train:43854.orig: I went to Ana to have my nails done not even a week ago and the gel is peeling off of all my nails!!! Horrible job and I spent $45.00 which is a lot higher than most in the Valley.  Will not be back!!
yelp:train:43854.para: Just recently, I visited Ana for a nail treatment, and to my dismay, the gel is flaking off all my nails! The service was subpar, and I paid $45, which is significantly more than usual in the area. I'm definitely not returning.

yelp:train:44629.orig:
I walked over from gym in want of healthy chicken and rice and upon entering i was the only customer. The two employees were sitting down on their phones while there was trash on the table and customers wanting food! 

Upon getting my food for what I thought was gonna be a standard teriyaki chicken bowl , was a al le cart huge bin of chicken , then a huge been of rice . I thought wow im gonna have some left over. I began to eat and the chicken was full of gristle so long story short threw it away .. 

Not impressed
yelp:train:44629.para:
I strolled from the fitness center in search of nutritious chicken and rice, only to find myself alone. The two staff members were engrossed in their phones, amidst a messy table and patrons eager for a meal. 

When I received my meal, anticipating a typical teriyaki chicken bowl, I was greeted with a massive chicken container and a large serving of rice. I assumed I'd have some leftovers. However, as I started eating, I discovered the chicken was laden with gristle, leading me to discard it. 

Overall, I was left feeling unimpressed.

yelp:train:44966.orig:
I hate for my first official review to be a one star review but Macayo's really disappointed me last night. When I first pulled into the parking lot last night I was surprised to see how many empty parking spaces there were. I immediately got excited because normally any restaurant on Bell road any night of the week has a wait. However, when I walked inside I saw a slew of people waiting to be seated. I walked up to the hostess stand and put my name on the list and the hostess did not give me a time quote and when I asked how long it would be she quoted me, ""not too long."" We waited about 15 minutes before being shown to our table which is where the trouble really began. 

Once we were at our table we were quickly greeted by our server (yay) however, she told us she had another table's drink order to get and then she would be back for ours (boo). So we waited for her to take the other two tables drink orders before coming back to take ours. 

After about 10 minutes we got our fountain drinks and then 5 minutes later she came back to take our food order. Then it took about 50 minutes for our food to come out. Seriously, 50 minutes.... that's about how long I planned to spend
yelp:train:44966.para:
I detest the prospect of my inaugural formal critique being a solitary star rating, yet Macayo's left me underwhelmed last evening. Upon arriving at the parking area, I was taken aback by the abundance of vacant parking spots. This anomaly usually indicates a restaurant on Bell road is bustling any given night. However, upon entering, I observed a crowd eagerly awaiting their seats. I approached the hostess desk, added my name to the waiting list, but was met with no time estimate and a vague assurance of a brief wait. We endured a 15-minute wait before being directed to our table, marking the commencement of our dissatisfaction. 

Once seated, we were promptly attended to by our server, a positive development (yay). However, she informed us she was occupied with another table's beverage order and would return shortly (boo). We had to wait for her to complete the other tables' orders before she could attend to ours. 

After roughly 10 minutes, we received our fountain drinks, followed by a 5-minute interval before our server returned to take our food order. Subsequently, it took approximately 50 minutes for our meal to be served. In fact, that's the duration I had initially anticipated spending.

yelp:train:45139.orig: Been visiting Padre Murphy's for years! Always dependable for some good Irish food and definitely the fried fish. Love the fact you can eat drink and bet on races at the same time at the same place what more could you ask for?
yelp:train:45139.para: For years, I've frequented Padre Murphy's, consistently enjoying their excellent Irish cuisine and particularly the fried fish. The unique experience of dining, drinking, and placing bets on races concurrently in one location is something I couldn't ask for more of.

yelp:train:45863.orig: I was severely disappointed with my trip to Sakana. I remember coming to this restaurant and it being good quality, however I this trip changed my opinion. While I will say that the wait-staff was nice and the atmosphere was ok, the food quality was below average. I had a selection of nigiri and most of the pieces were dry and had a \""fishy\"" taste to them. Both attributes that I associate with low quality fish. I was disappointed with my visit.
yelp:train:45863.para: My journey to Sakana left me profoundly disheartened. Initially, the restaurant seemed to offer commendable quality, but this experience altered my perception. Although the service from the wait-staff was amiable and the ambiance was acceptable, the standard of the food was disappointingly subpar. I sampled various nigiri, and regrettably, most were desiccated with an undesirable "fishy" flavor, which I typically link to inferior fish quality. In essence, my visit did not meet my expectations.

yelp:train:45981.orig: for a place built not long ago,  it is sure falling apart. The rent is way to high for the size. since I have been here crime has went up,  couples having more then a good time in the hot tub and even at nine in the morning!  caught someone peeing on a bush by pool just yesterday .... ya buddy there are windows everywhere.  People throw garbage where ever as they walk by.  I moved in because I wanted a place where I felt secure but the gates are broken, people who don't live here pull big gates open and last week we had a creeper attempt to  break in our neighbors place and try to do same to mine.  had a set of neighbours that stayed three month,  had to call police five times for dometic violence... college students move in and bring the friends,  now there is no parking  and I live here!  let's not mention people are parking in my spot.  when I moved in I was told I can call towing well apt didn't give approval.  seems everyone with a dog does not know how to clean up behind their animals,  one day someone had their dog off leash and the dog crapped on my door step.  who does that?  thank goodness I am in the process of buying a house because this is an issue,  does no one see th
yelp:train:45981.para: Despite its recent construction, this location is rapidly deteriorating. The rent is excessively high considering its dimensions. Since my arrival, crime rates have escalated, with couples enjoying themselves in the hot tub and even at early hours. Yesterday, I witnessed someone urinating in a bush by the pool. Windows are abundant, and litter is frequently discarded as people pass by. I relocated here seeking a secure environment, but broken gates and unauthorized gate openings by non-residents have occurred, including a recent break-in attempt. A group of neighbors stayed for three months, leading to five police interventions for domestic violence. College students and their friends have caused parking issues, and I've had my parking spot occupied. I was informed I could request towing, but approval was not granted. Dog owners often neglect cleaning up after their pets, with one incident involving a dog relieving itself on my doorstep. I'm currently purchasing a home due to these ongoing problems, and it's clear that the situation is largely unnoticed.

yelp:train:46357.orig:
My girlfriend and I went here on Saturday night around 7:15 PM.  It was nearly full.  Here are my impressions.

1) Service : dreadful.  It took literally 20 minutes for someone to take our drink orders and another 20 minutes to receive them and bread.  There was only one server for the entire restaurant, including the outside patio.  Another 15 minutes later we received the caprese which was adequate.  Water glasses and drinks remained empty far too long.  Waitress was snippy at times, too.

2) Food: I had the chicken saporito which was marginal.  The chicken was a bit rubbery but the sauce was okay.  The pasta was done well, however.  My girlfriend had shrimp fra diablo which was bland and not spicy in the least.  The sauce was watery and lukewarm.

3) Ambience:  Tense, people all over the restaurant were annoyed at the wait for service.  It's in a strip mall.  It's a hole in the wall.

4) Overall:  Stay away.  Poor food, dreadful service, we wasted $50.
yelp:train:46357.para:
On a Saturday evening at approximately 7:15 PM, my partner and I found the place almost packed. Here's my take on the experience:

1) Service: Abysmal. It took a full 20 minutes to get our drink orders taken and another 20 minutes to receive them and bread. There was just one server for the whole restaurant, even the outdoor area. After another 15 minutes, we got our caprese, which was just passable. The water glasses and drinks were left empty for too long. The waitress was occasionally curt.

2) Food: I had the chicken saporito which was barely good. The chicken felt slightly chewy but the sauce was decent. The pasta was cooked perfectly. My girlfriend had shrimp fra diablo which was dull and lacked any spice. The sauce was watery and not warm enough.

3) Atmosphere: The place was tense, with everyone in the restaurant irritated by the long wait for service. It's located in a strip mall and feels like a small, hidden spot.

4) General: Don't go there. The food and service were both poor, and we ended up wasting $50.

yelp:train:46678.orig: Great community of people - love the outreach to the community!
yelp:train:46678.para: Fantastic group of individuals - admire the community engagement efforts!

yelp:train:46808.orig: While I do not disagree that the staff there is pleasant, I had the unfortunate need to use their services for a small wound that needed stitches and my regular Vet was closed.  I walked out with a bill for over $800.  This is completely ridiculous!  Buyer beware that in times when people are having to make cutbacks in their budgets, this office is contributing to people being forced to not seek proper care for their beloved pets.  Please seek reasonably priced care elsewhere.
yelp:train:46808.para: Although I acknowledge the staff's friendliness, I found myself compelled to utilize their services due to a minor injury requiring sutures when my usual veterinarian was unavailable. I left with a charge exceeding $800, which I deem utterly unreasonable. In situations where individuals are tightening their financial belts, this establishment is adding to the pressure on pet owners to forgo essential care for their cherished animals. I urge you to find more affordable care options.

yelp:train:46972.orig: I worked for this company for many months up front and as a groomer. They use the cheapest shampoo they can buy. They also have their groomers use the same toothbrush on many many dogs. They do not clean their kennels on a regular basis, only if a pet has soiled the kennel other than that out of all the months I worked there the kennels were never cleaned. The manager is a nice girl but way too young and inexperienced to handle the job properly. They Have groomers there that abuse the animals. The owners are never there. When I was injured on the job they told me I can't go to the Dr if I do I have to pay for it due to another employee getting hurt and going to the Dr using workmans comp.They told me if I go using it they will raise their cost. So I had to seek treatment and pay for it myself.
yelp:train:46972.para: During my extended tenure at this establishment, I served as both a groomer and an employee. The company opts for the most affordable shampoo available. Groomers are assigned a single toothbrush for use with numerous dogs. Regular kennel cleaning is neglected, with the exception of incidents where pets defecate. Despite the manager being a kind and youthful individual, her lack of experience hinders her ability to manage effectively. There are groomers who mistreat the animals. The proprietors are frequently absent. When I sustained an injury, I was informed that I must bear the cost of medical care if I choose to seek it, as another employee's previous visit to the doctor was covered by workman's compensation. They warned that my medical expenses would increase if I utilized workman's comp. Consequently, I had to self-fund my treatment.

yelp:train:47365.orig:
This little gem is located inside of Sun Villiage, a 55+ community. However, it is open to the public.  My in laws live there and my mom is looking for a place in there as well. We decided to try out the restaurant which I have heard is pretty good. Mom and I go in for lunch, and wow, Im kind of shocked at the decor. Somehow, it isnt at all what I pictured.. It was well, a little diner.. with blue booths and chairs and dated.. but ok. 

We sit, have great service and both order from the ""basket menu"".. for $5-6.00 you get a giant beverage, and a basket with fries, and your choice of a burger, fish (this is what I have heard is great here) and shrimp, and oh, something else but I cant recall it now). Anyway... just great. I ordered the burger with cheese (it was extra) but it was the perfect portion size and just delish. Moms fish & chips... wow, my favorite. While I am not a fish or seafood person, I am slowly venturing into it by means of fish frys. I know, not the healthy way.. but my way nonetheless. I loved it.  Its nice and crispy but not too heavy with coating.  

It was good enough in fact that since it was a Friday night, I was telling my husband about the place and
yelp:train:47365.para:
Nestled within Sun Village, a community catering to those aged 55 and above, this hidden treasure welcomes everyone. My parents reside there, and my mother is searching for a residence in the vicinity. We opted to dine at this eatery, which has garnered positive reviews. During lunch, I was taken aback by the decor, which diverged from my expectations, presenting a modest diner ambiance with blue seating and a vintage feel. Nevertheless, it was satisfactory. 

We were greeted with excellent service, and we both selected items from the "basket menu" priced between $5-6.00. The offerings included a large drink, a basket containing fries, and a choice of a burger, fish (which I've been told is a standout here), and shrimp, along with an unidentified additional item. Overall, it was a pleasant experience. I chose the burger with extra cheese, which was perfectly portioned and tasty. My mother's fish and chips were exceptional, even though I'm not typically fond of seafood. I'm gradually exploring this cuisine through fish frys. I found it to be nicely crispy without being overly coated. 

The quality of the food was commendable enough that, on a Friday night, I enthusiastically recommended the place to my spouse.

yelp:train:47435.orig: Just an amazing church. From Praise & Worship to the Message. My family has been looking for a church close to us and we found it.
yelp:train:47435.para: A truly remarkable place of worship. It offers a variety of services from uplifting Praise & Worship to meaningful Messages. My family has been searching for a nearby church and we've discovered this gem.

yelp:train:47442.orig: Pretty decent location for a nice target store.\nWhen I lived in the area I would frequent this target location and was happy with the service and product selection.\nLocated in the surprise town center shopping district alongside many great shops.
yelp:train:47442.para: The area offers a favorable spot for a well-regarded retail outlet.\nDuring my residency in this vicinity, I often visited this Target store and found the customer service and variety of goods satisfactory.\nThis establishment is situated in the bustling heart of the town's shopping district, neighboring numerous excellent establishments.

yelp:train:47549.orig: Worst service experience ever!!  I had Fletchers change the brakes on my truck.  They will not set up an appointment, rather they have you bring the vehicle in at 7am.  I did just that, and didnt receive my truck back until after 3pm and several calls inquiring about the status.  Doesnt end there.  I had to take my truck back 2 months later because the brakes were squealing worse than when I originally brought it in.  Same story, no appointment, truck dropped off before 9am, and didnt get back until 5pm.  On top of that, they try pushing several other items on you.  Last time I ever use this company for anything.
yelp:train:47549.para: I had the most frustrating encounter with Fletchers when they altered the brakes on my vehicle. They insisted on me dropping off the truck at 7am without scheduling an appointment. I complied and waited until after 3pm for its return, while making numerous calls to check on its status. The issue persisted, as I had to return the truck two months later due to the brakes squealing more than before. The same lack of appointment procedure was followed, with the truck being picked up before 9am and returned by 5pm. Additionally, they attempted to sell me extra services. I've decided never to use this company again.

yelp:train:47621.orig: Our first dining experience at Bucca was awful.  The service sucked and food  was awful.  A few months later decided to try again. Service was good and salad was good, however, the baked rigatoni we ordered took some time to be served to us  and when we did get it, it was lukewarm.  The  serving bowl was hot but the food was not which told us it was microwaved.  We shall not frequent this restaurant again. The manager did not find it necessary to come our table  to apologize but had the waitress tell us it would be taken off the bill. No further compensation offered. The waitress did suggest we take the food home  but we declined. Why would we take home what we didn't enjoy there.  No recommendations from us to visit this establishment. We could write a book from the other horrific experience  but why bother?
yelp:train:47621.para: Our initial meal at Bucca was disappointing, with subpar service and unsatisfactory food. After a few months, we revisited and found the service and salad to be satisfactory. However, the baked rigatoni we ordered was delayed and served lukewarm, indicating it was likely reheated. The manager didn't personally apologize but had the waitress remove it from the bill. No additional compensation was provided. The waitress suggested we could take the food home, but we chose not to. We have no intention of recommending this place, and we wouldn't waste time writing about another terrible experience.

yelp:train:47853.orig: We had the coupon special $14.00 Rib-eye the overall service was very good! very impressed by wait staff, but our steaks were not good at all, kinda tough, and not tasty at all, just taste like grilled cardboard, not flavor of beef, hummm! not sure why, I've been to other firebirds and never had this to happen. We paid over $50 for our meal celebrating our 32nd year anniversary, and I felt cheated. I took my steak home to see if I can revive it to taste better, too much money wasted on it.
yelp:train:47853.para: The $14.00 Rib-eye deal was quite enjoyable, and the service was commendable, leaving us impressed with the wait staff. However, our steaks fell short, being tough and lacking in flavor, resembling more of grilled cardboard than genuine beef. I'm puzzled as to why this happened, especially since I've dined at other Firebirds without such issues. Despite the celebratory nature of our 32nd anniversary dinner costing over $50, I felt deceived. I even tried to salvage the steak at home to recover some of the value, but it seemed like a significant waste of money.

yelp:train:47913.orig: Average to poor food. I've had orange chicken, a salad, and chicken enchiladas. They all sucked. They all cost more then they should have.
yelp:train:47913.para: The food quality was mediocre to subpar. I've tried orange chicken, a salad, and chicken enchiladas, and they all disappointed. They were pricier than expected.

yelp:train:48416.orig: Best karate center ever.Highly recommend attending. Teachers are firm but fair. Facility is good and students are friendly.
yelp:train:48416.para: Exceptional karate dojo, highly suggested for participation. Instructors are strict yet equitable. The premises are commendable and the pupils exhibit amiability.

yelp:train:48783.orig: Very slow service, over 55 minutes to check out . Lady did not know what she's doing.
yelp:train:48783.para: Extremely delayed checkout process, taking over 55 minutes, with the lady appearing clueless about her actions.

yelp:train:48933.orig:
Best Hawaiian food in Vegas by far!!!! The mochico chicken and fried rice is a must! 

The place is run by local ppl from Hawaii and not by Chinese ppl like L&L that's how you know food is done the right way.  

The prices are pretty reasonable considering the amount of food you get on your plate.  On average $6 you get meat of your choice 2 scoops of rice (or for me i get the fried rice), and macaroni salad.  

I highly recommend Ross J's to anyone from hawaii thats missing that island flavor and to everyone else willing to experience HAWAII'S VERSION OF ""SOUL FOOD""!
yelp:train:48933.para:
The finest Hawaiian cuisine in Las Vegas, undeniably! Mochiko chicken and fried rice are essential choices. 

Managed by native Hawaiians, not Chinese, ensuring authenticity in preparation, unlike L&L. 

Affordable prices for generous portions. Typically, $6 grants you a selection of meat, two servings of rice (I prefer fried rice), and macaroni salad. 

I wholeheartedly suggest Ross J's for those longing for Hawaiian essence and for anyone eager to savor the unique "Soul Food" of Hawaii!

yelp:train:48961.orig: Solid food for the price. One can easily get by with spending $6 for lunch. For a mixed special rice bowl with spicy chicken cost me that. What you get? A large bowl of rice is piled high with meat and doused with teriyaki sauce. I didn't know that there were no veggies, but they offer a side of them for an additional $1. \n\nThe service is warm and quick. It is no surprise that they have so many people stopping in to get lunch.
yelp:train:48961.para:
For a modest $6, you can enjoy a substantial mixed rice dish featuring spicy chicken. The dish comes with a generous portion of rice, abundant meat, and a generous drizzle of teriyaki sauce. It's worth noting that vegetables are not included, but they can be added for an extra dollar. The service is both friendly and efficient, which explains the high volume of lunchtime patrons.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is also roughly the same.)

yelp:train:49784.orig: Great service and yummilicious ice cream!!!  5 stars in my book
yelp:train:49784.para: Exceptional customer support and delectable ice cream! Rated 5 stars in my review.

yelp:train:51225.orig:
Hands down the best sandwich shop in town. Their signature sandwiches such as the Bobbie and Capastrami are second to none. If your ever in the mood for a sandwich, skip Subway and Quizno's and head to your local Capriotti's Sandwich shop!

**NOTE**

-Make sure to tip these guys out as they are all very appreciative for the beer money. :)
yelp:train:51225.para:
Undoubtedly, the top-rated sandwich establishment in the area. Their standout creations like the Bobbie and Capastrami surpass all others. When craving a sandwich, bypass Subway and Quizno's and visit your neighborhood Capriotti's Sandwich shop instead!

**NOTE**

-Don't forget to leave a generous tip; these workers genuinely value the beer money. :)

yelp:train:51590.orig: While the food was ok, they shorted me 2 soups, 2 egg rolls, and 2 crab rangoons.  I don't like getting ripped off, so that makes China A Go Go, a no no!  $28 for $20 worth of food.  No thanks!  It's like buying a 20 ounce coke, and only getting 16 ounces.
yelp:train:51590.para: The meal was satisfactory, but I was undercharged for 2 soups, 2 egg rolls, and 2 crab rangoons. I dislike being cheated, hence China A Go Go doesn't meet my standards. For $28, I only received the equivalent of $20 in food. I'm not interested, it's akin to purchasing a 20-ounce soda and only receiving 16 ounces.

yelp:train:51612.orig:
Shop here quite a bit, love the fresh produce selections,

Just want to compliment the fact the have cactus pears in which my mother in law loves to eat.

One of only a few stores in town that carry these.
yelp:train:51612.para: Enjoy shopping here frequently, appreciate the variety of fresh fruits and vegetables,\n\nI'd like to express my gratitude for the availability of cactus pears, a favorite of my mother-in-law, which is a unique offering among local stores.

yelp:train:51802.orig: Played Rio Secco yesterday and it was extremely slow due to the groups in front of us using the girl caddies ( that they paid $200 per girl)...so they were in no rush to play golf...it was mostly drinking and slow play by the groups in front of us....to top it off the staff encourages this kind of frat party environment...so if you are a real golfer skip this place as quick as you can...plus it is over priced and poor condition ( the traps are dirt and gravel )...Las Vegas and Henderson have numerous great courses...try them out and don't bother the hassle of Rio Secco and their poor customer service
yelp:train:51802.para: Yesterday's game at Rio Secco was notably lethargic because the groups ahead utilized costly girl caddies, resulting in a lack of urgency to proceed with the game. The atmosphere was dominated by excessive drinking and sluggish play from the leading groups. The staff's encouragement of a fraternity-like ambiance further detracted from the experience. For avid golfers, it's advisable to bypass this location swiftly due to its inflated prices and substandard maintenance, including the use of dirt and gravel for traps. In contrast, Las Vegas and Henderson boast a variety of superior golf courses worth exploring. Avoid the inconvenience and disappointment of Rio Secco's inadequate customer service.

yelp:train:51900.orig: Trying to figure out why they charged me $14 for two pairs of dress pants. They did offer me a 10% off coupon bringing the total down to $12.60. Still not good enough.
yelp:train:51900.para: Attempting to understand the rationale behind the $14 charge for two dress pants sets. They provided a 10% discount coupon, which reduced the amount to $12.60. However, I found this still unsatisfactory.

yelp:train:51914.orig: Yes the food is good. But the service?  Depends on who you get...Sheryl and Rhonda are great but the men???  The young guys are pretty good but the older men should really take some classes. We took 2 business associates out for dinner. The first bottle of wine was good except the waiter  forgot to give me some wine after I did the tasting. When the second bottle came he brought 1 new glass, let me taste out of the new glass then proceeded to refill everyone else's glass even though it still had wine in it!  Come on...for the price of the food you would think the waiters would at least know how to pour wine correctly!!!  The older men including the host (at least the night we were there) did not have a very professional attitude...when we arrived ahead of our guests and told the host this, he said, \""well, do you wanna sit down?\"".  Hmmm, I think the next time we will take our money to a more professional place.
yelp:train:51914.para: Indeed, the cuisine is commendable. However, the service quality varies depending on the server. Sheryl and Rhonda deliver excellent service, but the male servers leave room for improvement. The younger male servers are competent, yet the senior male staff could benefit from additional training. We had dinner with two business colleagues, and the initial wine selection was satisfactory, but the server neglected to offer me a second glass post-tasting. When the second bottle was served, a new glass was provided for tasting, followed by the server refilling others' glasses despite residual wine. It's surprising for the food's cost that the waitstaff lacks basic wine service skills. The senior male staff, including the evening's host, displayed a lack of professionalism, especially when we informed them of our early arrival and they responded dismissively. Moving forward, we'll consider dining at a more professional establishment.

yelp:train:51951.orig: Service at the bar was great, the wine was great, but the food wasn't that great! Your typical franchise Italian restaurant!!
yelp:train:51951.para: The bar service and wine quality were excellent, however, the food didn't quite meet expectations, typical of a standard franchise Italian eatery.

yelp:train:52085.para: Excellent customer support and delicious sushi!

yelp:train:53470.orig: The absolute worst nail experience I have ever had !!! I went for a gel manicure and a pedicure.  Mimi was not pleasant nor friendly, never smiled, no personality.  Then the tools were not sterilized ! And there was no cleaning of my feet with any nice abrasive scrub.  I actually have to go home and work on my feet with my own products and tools.  She finished with a very quick polish and then started my manicure .  I noticed there was polish all around the skin of my toes .  Very sloppy ! Of course I asked her to clean it up which she did .  Then the manicure .  I had a tear in my nail . Usually don't they just repair it . Not Mimi .  She was ready to polish right over it .  So I asked before she polishes if she would repair the nail .  She said if you want perfect nails get acrylics ! Miss personality ! I picked a color based on their selections .  Well another horrible experience ! The color looks nothing like the chart she shows you ! My nails are almost black.  She said the sample was only one coat ! Ha ! Even with one coat it was nothing like the color on my nails. Then she asked if I wanted to start over with a new color .  By this time all I wanted was this experience to be
yelp:train:53470.para:
The most dreadful nail service encounter I've ever endured! I opted for a gel nail and pedicure session. Mimi proved to be unpleasant and lacked warmth, never offering a smile or any distinct character. Furthermore, the tools were not properly sanitized, and my feet were not treated with a satisfying abrasive scrub. Consequently, I had to tend to my nails at home using my own products and tools. She hastily applied a quick polish before beginning the manicure. I observed polish residue on the skin of my toes, indicating a careless job. I requested her to clean it up, which she did. However, during the manicure, I noticed a tear in my nail. Typically, such issues are repaired, but Mimi was eager to polish over it. I insisted on her repairing the nail first. She suggested that for flawless nails, one should consider acrylics. I chose a color based on her recommendations, but the result was far from the expected shade. She claimed the sample was only one coat, but it was clearly not a match for my nails. She then offered to start over with a new color. By this point, I was only wishing for this experience to conclude.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the same length as the original text, with slight variations in sentence structure and word choice to convey the same meaning and sentiment.)

yelp:train:53510.orig: Fantastic coffee shop! It definitely has that cozy atmosphere that reminds me of coffee shops in my small college town. The staff was awesome and very friendly too! They were great about giving me reccommendations on the best food to eat. I also got a chai tea latte which was amazing! 5 stars for sure! Will definitely be back!
yelp:train:53510.para: This exceptional café exudes a warm, inviting vibe akin to the coffee houses in my quaint university area. The team was outstanding and exceedingly welcoming. They provided excellent suggestions for the finest dishes. I relished my chai tea latte, which was truly delightful! I wholeheartedly award it 5 stars and plan to return.

yelp:train:53800.orig: Service here is horrible!  They always seem to forget that were there. And there's always an Asian guy here who gives attitude as he's serving us.  Maybe because we always get all you can eat KBBQ and we can eat like bottomless pits.\n\nAs me and my friends quickly eat the first serving of brisket, we ask for another, we notice something different, turns out they gave us beef tongue instead.
yelp:train:53800.para: The service quality here is abysmal! It appears they consistently overlook us. There's a recurring presence of an Asian individual who exhibits a disrespectful demeanor while attending to us. This might be due to our frequent indulgence in all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ, leading us to consume voraciously. As I and my companions hastily finish our initial brisket portion, we request more, only to discover they've mistakenly provided us with beef tongue.

yelp:train:55525.orig: The steak was good... Very cool old gangster atmosphere. This place has some old roots... Cool restaurant.
yelp:train:55525.para: The steak was delicious... A refreshing vibe of classic crime lore. This establishment boasts a rich heritage... A trendy dining spot.

yelp:train:55873.orig: This place really doesn't have much selection.  At all.  I guess I expected a store this large that carries JUST home goods to have, well, more home goods.  There is just a lot of empty space.  Maybe I got my hopes up to see something unique or different.  But really, when I visited, it was the same stuff you can find at my local Macy's... just more of each particular item.  \n\nBoo.  I wanted to like this.
yelp:train:55873.para: This location offers a limited variety. In fact, I anticipated a larger store specializing in home goods to provide a broader range of products. However, I found it to be filled with empty space. Perhaps I was hoping for something distinctive or unique. Regrettably, upon my visit, it resembled the offerings at my neighborhood Macy's, merely with increased quantities of each specific item. \n\nDisappointing. I had hoped to appreciate this place.

yelp:train:56069.orig: Horrible! It must be under new management, the last time I came here it was way better. This time I had to wait for 2 people that came after me before I even got started. I had to walk out I was so upset. NEVER COME HERE.
yelp:train:56069.para: It's dreadful! The change in leadership seems to have negatively impacted the experience. I had to wait for two additional customers before I could begin, which left me extremely frustrated. I will never return.

yelp:train:56813.orig:
This was my second attempt at getting a deal here which is elusive at best. Even with insurance, 2 pairs of glasses cost us over $200. This is the first pair of glasses I've bought since age 14 that did NOT fit properly at all! I'm trying to calm down before I go back to fix this fiasco. The glasses in 1 hour does not exist. You can ask and get your hand slapped. Go ahead. You're a big girl. 

Last time I was there, I made the mistake of getting my exam at Red Rock Eye Care. I had a $10 copay for an exam and they tried to charge me $150 for me and my son, NOT including contact Rx! We were the only people there and forced to wait with an antsy 3 year old for over an hour. Then they didn't want to give me the Rx's until we cam back for another visit to check contact fitting! Total BS scam! 

Then we exited eye doctor room into store where eyeglass world employees-all dudes-were hypnotized by twerk videos on YouTube. Classy.
yelp:train:56813.para:
This marks my second try to secure a deal that's notoriously hard to come by. Despite having insurance, purchasing two pairs of glasses set us back more than $200. It's the first time since I was 14 that I've acquired glasses that didn't fit correctly at all. I'm attempting to maintain my composure before addressing this debacle. The notion that glasses could be ready in just an hour is laughable. You can inquire, but expect to be met with a dismissive response. You're old enough to understand. 

Previously, I chose Red Rock Eye Care for my exam, which included a $10 copay. They attempted to bill us $150 for myself and my son, excluding contact lens prescriptions! We were the only ones present and had to endure an hour of waiting with a restless 3-year-old. They insisted on not providing the prescriptions until we returned for a follow-up to verify contact lens fitting! It was a blatant scam. 

We left the eye doctor's office and found ourselves in a store where employees, all men, were captivated by twerk videos on YouTube. It was quite unrefined.

yelp:train:57160.orig:
I usually come here a lot and never complain about anything. When I came here this time I  ordered their icy strawberry jelly drink with squid balls and wings. 

When I got my drink and took one sip....OMG I seriously thought I drank pure
Strawberry syrup with crushed ice. It was so sweet I had to ask for water and pour half it in there to dilute it. I didn't bother complaining because I fixed it with water. 

Other than that the wings were slightly over cooked and I loved the squid balls.
yelp:train:57160.para:
I frequently visit this place and always express my satisfaction. This time, I chose their frozen strawberry jelly beverage with squid and wings. 

Upon receiving my beverage and tasting it, I was astonished, as it seemed like I had consumed straight strawberry syrup with shaved ice. The intense sweetness compelled me to request water and mix half of it to lessen the sweetness. I didn't voice any complaints since I managed to adjust it with water. 

Apart from that, the wings were marginally overdone, but I greatly appreciated the squid balls.

yelp:train:57315.orig: The room was okay. Nothing was gross or anything. Everything in the room seemed like it was from the 70-80s.. no renovated anything. \n\nThe hotel seemed to be full of crackheads and gangsters. If you have little kids this is probably not the best place to say. My friends and I got woken up at 6:00am by the loud thumping of a cars stereo system. It lasted at least and hour. I think it took so long to have someone tell them to turn it down out of fear of getting shot or something.
yelp:train:57315.para: The room was satisfactory, with no offensive elements. It appeared to be a typical setup from the 70s-80s, lacking any modern updates. \n\nThe hotel had an atmosphere reminiscent of a haven for drug users and criminals. It's not recommended for families with children. My companions and I were rudely awakened at 6:00am by the persistent noise of a car's loud music system. The disturbance persisted for over an hour. It seemed that the staff was hesitant to address the issue due to potential violence.

yelp:train:57818.orig: I had perhaps the worst business/merchant experience in my life here. I was charged for $700 worth of entertainment and actually only received about $300 worth. Which itself was outrageously over priced. Then they continued to try and charge another $330 on my credit card which they said wouldn't go through. That was for other fees that I did not agree to , nor did I receive services for! \nI complained to management twice but they wouldn't do anything for me. I urge you not to visit this establishment. If you do, certainly do not, under no circumstance agree to go to VIP room. That is where the ripoff begins! The same thing happened to a friend of mine this same night, only on a smaller scale. I am going to try to take this to a higher level. Checking legal sources first!
yelp:train:57818.para:
I endured what might be the most disappointing commercial encounter of my existence at this location. I was billed $700 for amusement, but in reality, I only got about $300 worth, which was exorbitantly expensive. They attempted to add another $330 for unacknowledged charges on my card, claiming it would be declined. This was for services I neither consented to nor were provided. Despite voicing my grievances to the management twice, no action was taken on my behalf. I strongly advise against visiting this venue. If you do, absolutely avoid the VIP room, as that's where the deception starts. A similar incident occurred to a friend of mine that same evening, albeit on a lesser scale. I plan to escalate this issue and will initially consult legal resources.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, sentiment, and intent while changing the wording and sentence structure. The length is approximately the same as the original text.)

yelp:train:58144.orig: I don't understand all the glowing reviews of this place.  The mashed potatoes and gravy were INSTANT and kraut came from a can.  I cannot say enough that for 12.50, someone had better have at least BOILED the potatoes.  Over priced, it deserves to be on Kitchen Nightmares.  Unless we just happed to be there on the one day in their history to have used instant and prepackaged things, I would pass it on by.  Their kitchen has at least 3 microwaves visible from the dining area, and they charge for lunch avg $15 a plate?  No thank you.
yelp:train:58144.para: I'm perplexed by the numerous positive comments about this establishment. The instant mashed potatoes and canned kraut left much to be desired. For a mere $12.50, I expect the potatoes to be properly boiled. It's overpriced and seems ripe for a feature on Kitchen Nightmares. If it's just a one-time occurrence of using instant and prepackaged ingredients, I'd skip it entirely. The presence of three microwaves in plain sight from the dining area, coupled with an average lunch charge of $15 per plate, is unacceptable to me. I decline.

yelp:train:58339.para:

yelp:train:58759.orig: Store puts labels incorrectly and do not stand by the label price.
yelp:train:58759.para: The retailer misplaces labels and fails to uphold the stated price on them.

yelp:train:58943.para: I visited due to persistent hiccups, and the process was swift. Soon after, a PA provided care. However, the situation escalated rapidly. They drew blood and the PA concluded I was experiencing a cardiac event. I was advised to seek treatment at either Valley or UMC, but I had no preference. The loss of choice was disheartening. I vow never to allow a PA to conduct a physical examination again. This individual seemed inadequately trained. (apologies for my harsh critique, as it reflects the reality of insufficient experience and training). It's quite disconcerting.

yelp:train:59211.orig: Horrible customer service. Had to talk to 3 different employees to locate a portable iPhone charger. Not because the employees didn't know the answer, but because no one was willing to help. Just short answers and \""it's over there\"" type of responses.
yelp:train:59211.para: Terrible service from customers. I was forced to communicate with three separate staff members to find a portable iPhone charger. The issue wasn't their lack of knowledge, but their unwillingness to assist. I received brief replies and vague directions like "it's over there".

yelp:train:60759.orig: DO NOT GO HERE. I went to her as a child for orthodontics and it was such a horrible experience that my dad made her remove them. Then 8 years later i've had to have another set of braces due to her poor treatment! DO NOT GO HERE!!!!
yelp:train:60759.para: Avoid this place. I visited her for dental braces as a youngster, and the experience was dreadful, leading my father to insist she take them off. Eight years on, I've had to undergo another round of braces because of her substandard care! Stay away!

yelp:train:60833.orig: I played this course today and have played in the past as well. Today the course was in excellent condition, the grass on the tee boxes was a little long and some is the sand traps were not taken care of ( hard and wet ), but the fairways were in great condition as well as the greens. Now I know everyone says 4 to 4 1/2 hours is an acceptable time to play a round of golf but I don't agree with that, anyone can easily shave off an hour at least if they just played the game and acted like they were pros. It took our group 4 1/2 hours to play 18 holes today and on a few tee boxes there were two to three groups backed up all because one group ahead of us had no time management or common courtesy to move along at a quicker pace, they would wait until the group ahead of them cleared the green before teeing off and from the way I saw them hitting the ball, there was no need for them to wait, there was also no marshal on the course to help move along play, I know my group can and has played a round in about three and a half hours and we are not rushing at all. It's just a sad state that someone, somewhere said it should take that long to play a round and so people make it take that long an
yelp:train:60833.para: Today, I experienced this course, which I've played before, and found it to be well-maintained, despite some tee boxes having slightly overgrown grass and sand traps in poor condition. However, the fairways and greens were impeccable. While the general consensus suggests a 4 to 4 1/2 hours duration for a full 18-hole game, I disagree, believing that a more professional approach could reduce this time by at least an hour. Our group spent 4 1/2 hours on the course today, with delays at certain tee boxes due to a lack of time management and courtesy from a preceding group, who unnecessarily waited for others to clear the green before starting. My group has demonstrated the capability to complete a round in approximately three and a half hours without rushing. It's disheartening that this extended duration has become a standard expectation for playing a round of golf.

yelp:train:60970.orig:
I don't think this is a 1 star place by any means. I've been here twice now. They have been consistent, which is all I need from a haircut.

I haven't had to wait either time. The first was a true weekday morning, and the second was today, Memorial Day. They were actually open, which is nice. The first time, the lady (I think Valerie was her name) was patient enough to explain why they needed my name and phone # (it's for keeping track of when I go and who my hair is) and to work through my uncertainty with the size of the clipper attachments.

The haircuts each seemed to take no more than 10 minutes - surprising since I think it used to take longer at my last barber shop - and the ladies are nice enough not to try to chat with you much if you're quiet (I'm not a very chatty person).

I will gladly continue to return, especially if they keep providing Valpak coupons online. I wanted to help the rating with 5 stars, but I'm keeping it at 4 stars since there's nothing mindblowingly awesome about it.
yelp:train:60970.para: I don't consider this establishment to be of the lowest rating. Having visited twice, I've found their consistency satisfactory for my haircuts. No waiting was necessary on either occasion, which was convenient. The first visit was on a regular weekday morning, and the second was on Memorial Day, with the salon being open as usual. The attendant, whom I believe was Valerie, took the time to clarify the need for my contact details and to address my concerns about the clipper attachment sizes. Each haircut took approximately 10 minutes, a noticeable improvement from my previous barber shop experience. The staff refrained from engaging in conversation if I was not inclined to talk, which suited my quiet nature. I am inclined to keep coming back, particularly if they maintain the practice of offering Valpak coupons online. Although I would have preferred a 5-star rating, I've settled for a 4-star rating as the experience wasn't exceptionally outstanding.

yelp:train:61096.orig: I really feel comfortable and pampered here. I've never enjoyed mani's and pedi's before because no one really explained what I was supposed to do. Linda, who first helped me, was very patient and explained everything. Only lost one star because sometimes they take too many walk-ins.
yelp:train:61096.para: I genuinely feel at ease and indulged in this place. I've never been fond of manicures and pedicures prior as there was no clear guidance on the process. Linda, my initial guide, was incredibly understanding and elucidated every detail. I've rated it almost perfect, with a slight deduction for occasional overcrowding due to walk-ins.

yelp:train:62509.orig:
I should've known better than to come here, but I was out running errands, was starving and saw this place as I drove out of the nearby CVS. The restaurant looks like an older run down place serving up Americanized Chinese food. The whole time I was sitting inside and reading the menu I felt unsure if I really wanted to eat here but I told myself I should at least try it since I was there. I ordered a beef chow fun to go since it's kind of hard to mess that dish up so I figured I was safe.
 
When my order was ready it was handed to be in a bag where I noticed they didn't provide utensils or chopsticks but I was too lazy to go back in since I was already in the car. Strike 1. When I opened the box I noticed that the portions were way smaller than most other Chinese places while they are charging a full entree price ($8.50-10.00)  for everything including the beef chow fun. Strike 2. The beef was fully cooked but had a weird taste to it and the dish overall just seemed bland. Strike 3. 

I would not recommend this place at all and even Panda Express would be a better choice since their food has more flavor. This place also has a $20 card minimum so bring cash if you're not going
yelp:train:62509.para:
I should've avoided this location, but I was on errands and felt famished, spotting it as I exited the adjacent CVS. The eatery appeared to be an aged, dilapidated establishment serving Americanized Chinese cuisine. While perusing the menu from within, I was hesitant about dining there, convincing myself to give it a shot as I was already present. I opted for a takeout beef chow fun, considering its difficulty to ruin, assuming it would be a safe choice. 

Upon receiving my order, it was handed out in a bag without any utensils or chopsticks, prompting me to not return for them. This was my first setback. Upon opening the box, I found the portions significantly smaller compared to other Chinese restaurants, yet they charged a full-priced entree ($8.50-10.00) for everything, including the beef chow fun. This was my second setback. The beef was thoroughly cooked but had an unusual flavor, and the entire dish lacked taste. This was my third setback. 

I strongly advise against this place, as even Panda Express would offer a tastier option. Additionally, this establishment requires a $20 minimum payment, so it's wise to carry cash if you're not planning to dine in.

yelp:train:62528.orig:
Good deeds? Great deals? I don't know...

I have a disability, EM (Erythromelalgia). Store manager, Ben Niebauer, rudely discriminated against me by requiring me leave the Savers located at 3121 N. Rancho Dr. in Las Vegas, NV. I had spent quite a bit of time & effort picking out cloths to try  on. He would not let me try them on. He threatened to call the police to have me removed, even though I explained my handi-capped condition & showed him a letter from my doctor. I said I would sign a letter relieving Savers of all responsibility for my safety. He continued to threaten to call the police, but he didn't. All he did was get louder & more aggressive. So I told him I would call the police. I went outside with my mother to wait for the police. When they arrived, the police were told he had left.
I have never encountered this kind of treatment for being disabled.

(For more info on EM: http://www.erythromelalgia.org/WhatisEM.aspx). 

Did I see good deeds or great deals? No, but I would have liked to.
yelp:train:62528.para:
I'm uncertain about acts of kindness or beneficial offers...

As someone with Erythromelalgia, I faced discrimination from Ben Niebauer, the store manager, when I was asked to vacate the Savers at 3121 N. Rancho Dr., Las Vegas, NV. I had invested considerable time and effort selecting clothes to try on. Despite my handicap and a doctor's note, he refused to allow me to try them on. He menacingly suggested involving the police to remove me, but he didn't follow through. He only grew more aggressive. I decided to involve the police. With my mother, we waited outside for their arrival. However, they informed us that Ben had already left. 

This level of treatment for disabled individuals is unprecedented to me.

(For additional information on Erythromelalgia, visit http://www.erythromelalgia.org/WhatisEM.aspx).

Was I witnessing acts of kindness or beneficial offers? No, but I would have preferred that.

yelp:train:62958.orig:
I have had 2 experiences at Summerlin Hospital.

I will say the place is very neat and clean. The water fountains were so polished and clean you actually didn't mind drinking from them.

The first experience I had was when my Nephew was born in October 2011..
I felt that the Maternity Ward was a bit difficult to find and there weren't enough signs to point you in the right direction.
When we did find it and ask for my Sister-in Laws room the Nurses acted like we were bothering them which made us a bit uncomfortable.

The second time was when my man extreme pain and was bleeding from the mouth. Even though he was bleeding and rolling around on the floor in pain (there were only 3 others waiting and all so sick they were vomiting on the floor) they would not see him right away and said it would be a 3 hour wait. 
We chose to go to another Hospital and he only waited 15 minutes to be seen.
yelp:train:62958.para:
I've encountered two instances at Summerlin Medical Center.

The facility maintains an immaculate appearance, with water fountains that are exceptionally well-maintained, making them a pleasant choice for hydration.

During my first visit in October 2011, when my nephew was born, I found the Maternity Section somewhat elusive, with insufficient directional signage. Upon locating it and inquiring about my sister-in-law's room, the staff seemed to perceive us as an inconvenience, causing some discomfort.

In a subsequent situation, my partner was in severe pain and bleeding from his mouth. Despite his distress and the presence of three other patients who were vomiting, the staff delayed immediate attention, promising a 3-hour wait. Consequently, we opted for a different hospital, where he received prompt care, waiting only 15 minutes to be seen.

yelp:train:63274.orig:
Food is decent. Service needs help. Walked in 8pm, place not even 1/3 full and immediately told I'll be right with you. No hi welcome or nicety. More like what you would expect from flos diner. 
Seated and waited WAY too long for menus and drinks to order. 
Maybe I am too critical but I expect my water to be refilled without asking, to be asked - when my beer is empty - if I would like another, be checked on during appetizers and the meal as to if we are enjoying the meal and is everything good. 
With all that being said and the food being adequate there are many other choices with better pizza and service - which may be why the place was 2/3 empty. I will move onto other places - good luck
yelp:train:63274.para: The dining experience was satisfactory, but the service requires improvement. Upon arrival at 8pm, the establishment was notably underpopulated, and the staff's response was lacking in warmth. The wait for menus and beverages was excessively long. Despite the food meeting basic standards, I hold high expectations for attentive service, such as proactively refilling water and engaging with patrons during the meal. Considering these factors, I will explore other dining options with superior pizza and service, which may explain the establishment's 2/3 occupancy rate. I wish you the best in your search for a better dining experience.

yelp:train:63653.orig:
