yelp:train:79177.orig: Everything was great until I opened up the strawberry jam from the cheesecake to find mold.\n\nPretty disappointing they would let that go out of the kitchen
yelp:train:79177.para: The situation was enjoyable until I discovered mold in the strawberry jam from the cheesecake.\n\nQuite disheartening it was that they allowed such a product to leave the kitchen.

yelp:train:79266.orig:
Auto mechanics you can trust!

I would like to thank Dave, Keith, and the rest of the crew at Back to Basic Automative. I have used Back to Basic Automative on numerous occasions from oil changes to alignment work and everything in between. The guys at Basic to Basic are honest, trustworthy, and always explain what needs to be done, and my vehicles are always repaired in a timely matter.

Honesty, experience, and expertise are just a few of the attributes at Back to Basic Automative. You can't beat the  great customer service, thorough work, and more than fair pricing. Back to Basic can't be beat! (I've been a customer for a very long time and will remain a customer for good.)
yelp:train:79266.para:
Trustworthy auto mechanics at Back to Basic Automative are highly appreciated!

I extend my gratitude to Dave, Keith, and the entire team at Back to Basic Automative. I've availed their services for various automotive needs, including oil changes and alignment, and have always been satisfied with their honesty, expertise, and prompt repairs. The exceptional customer service, meticulous work, and reasonable pricing at Back to Basic Automative are unmatched. As a long-standing customer, I vow to continue my patronage.

Expertise, integrity, and superior customer service are hallmarks of Back to Basic Automative. Their unbeatable service, diligent work, and fair pricing make them unrivaled. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and will remain so.

yelp:train:79971.orig: My cousin lives across the street from Los Compadres. I was starving and decided to give it a shot. I called and placed my order to go. A red chile burrito with a side of cheese and sour cream. I got there and was shocked my burrito was only $5! Usually restuarants charge an arm and a leg for side items. I asked the girl for an iced tea to go and she gave it to me for free! I thought that was really sweet of her so I gave her a nice tip. I was very pleased with my food and I would't hesitate to come back. The restaurant isn't fancy just a good solid place to get cheap tasty Mexican food.
yelp:train:79971.para: Across the road from Los Compadres resides my relative. Hungry, I opted to try it out. I dialed up and ordered a takeout red chile burrito, accompanied by cheese and sour cream. Upon arrival, I was amazed to find the burrito cost just $5! Typically, eateries inflate prices for extras. I requested an iced tea to go, which the attendant provided without charge. I found her gesture incredibly kind, so I rewarded her with a generous tip. I was thoroughly satisfied with my meal and would certainly return. The establishment isn't high-end but offers affordable, delicious Mexican cuisine.

yelp:train:80076.orig: I came here with high hopes-perhaps I'd found my next dive bar. But there's something about this place that didn't quite gel with me, and I can't put my finger on it. The drinks are cheap, and they serve a righteously cold beer. But I guess it's the big, vast feel of the place with the off-putting fluorescent lighting. It gives the place a very bowling alley feel. I don't see this as a place where you and your crew would want to hang for very long. However, if you've been out drinking all night, are short on cash and just need to knock back another one or two before calling it a night while sitting in shameful silence already starting to regret how awful you're going to feel in the morning, this place would be perfect.
yelp:train:80076.para: I arrived here full of optimism, thinking it might be my next go-to dive spot. However, there's an element here that didn't resonate with me, and I'm struggling to identify it. The beverages are affordable, and they offer a chilled beer. But the expansive ambiance coupled with the unsettling neon lighting gives it a distinctly bowling alley vibe. It's not the ideal spot for a group to linger for extended periods. Nevertheless, if you're weary from a night of drinking, financially constrained, and in need of a few more drinks in a quiet, self-reflective state, this place would be ideal.

yelp:train:80136.orig:
I had decent expectations for this place because of the reviews that it has, but I was sorely disappointed. I went there and ordered from the lunch special menu, which is very limited. 

My coworker got the sweet and sour chicken, she said that it was good, but the sauce was thick.

I got the crispy house chicken, and the wor wonton soup. First, the wor wonton soup only comes in large, but I was willing to give it a chance. I shouldn't have. The soup lacked salt, and had barely anything in it. Canton Dragon still has the best wor wonton soup I have ever had. 

The chicken was far from crispy, as it was completely overwhelmed in sauce and soggy by the time I got it back to work to eat. The fried rice was mushy, and the egg roll was overcooked. 

Maybe this was just a bad day, but I won't be returning to the prime, as I've had much better Chinese food, at a much better price.
yelp:train:80136.para:
Despite positive reviews, my anticipation for this establishment was not met, leading to significant dissatisfaction. I opted for the lunch special menu, which offered limited choices. 

My colleague enjoyed the sweet and sour chicken, praising its taste, though noting the sauce's thickness. I chose the crispy house chicken and wor wonton soup, which was served in a large portion. However, I regret my decision as the soup was underseasoned and lacked substance. In my experience, Canton Dragon still reigns supreme in serving the best wor wonton soup. 

The chicken failed to live up to its name, becoming soggy due to excessive sauce. The accompanying fried rice was too soft, and the egg roll was burnt. 

It could have been an off day, but I won't be revisiting this prime spot, as I've encountered superior Chinese cuisine at a more reasonable cost.

yelp:train:80152.orig:
There is nothing more frustrating than taking your pet to the vet because you think something is wrong with him, and having the vet completely ignore everything you tell her. This is why I do not take my dogs to Alta Vista anymore. 

I took my older dog to Alta Vista after we adopted him because it was close, and I had a free exam certificate from the shelter. The vet seemed nice enough, and I'll give her a pass on the fact that she clearly had no idea what breeds he might be (she told us he'd get 50 pounds, max, when full grown today, he's 70). 

So, figuring that they were ok from the first visit, I took him in when he started having issues. Vet #1 ""thought"" he might have bladder crystals, and sent him home with expensive prescription food and an order to come back in 4 weeks. 

Vet #2, on the return visit, completely disregarded everything that had been written in my dog's chart as well as everything I told her, and wanted to run a bunch of expensive tests. Vet #1 had told me he'd just need a retest for the crystals, Vet #2 wanted to send him through the ringer. No thanks. 

We got the hell out of there as fast as we could manage. I don't do doctors who don't listen.
yelp:train:80152.para:
I find it utterly exasperating to bring my animal companion to the clinic, suspecting an issue, only to have the vet dismiss my observations entirely. Consequently, I've stopped visiting Alta Vista for my canine companions. 

After adopting my senior dog, I chose Alta Vista due to its proximity and a complimentary exam certificate from the adoption center. The vet appeared amiable, but she was clueless about the breed's potential weight, predicting a maximum of 50 pounds, whereas he currently weighs 70. 

Assuming he was fine from the initial consultation, I brought him back when he started showing symptoms. The first vet speculated bladder crystals and advised a costly diet and a follow-up in four weeks. 

The second vet, however, ignored the notes from my dog's file and my explanations, insisting on conducting numerous costly tests. The first vet had suggested a retest for the crystals, but the second vet wanted to subject him to extensive procedures. I decided to leave immediately. I refuse to work with doctors who don't value my input.

yelp:train:80331.orig: I love this place but I've actually never tried the pizza. The salads are awesome!! The caprese is one of the best I've ever had, and I love the insalata italiana with gorgonzola. The penne primavera is so good too! P.S. They DO accept credit cards, just not American Express, which sucks because that is the credit card I have for my work so we don't come here nearly as often as I would like to. Also, I've only done take-out orders so I don't know about the service at lunchtime, however the parking situation is really bad!
yelp:train:80331.para: I adore this location, yet I haven't sampled their pizza. The salads impress me greatly, especially the caprese which ranks among the finest I've tasted, and I'm fond of the insalata italiana with gorgonzola. The penne primavera is also delightful! Note: They do accept credit cards, but not American Express, which is unfortunate as that's the card I use for work, leading to less frequent visits than I desire. Additionally, my experience is limited to take-out, so I'm unaware of their lunchtime service, but I must mention the challenging parking conditions.

yelp:train:80808.orig: I have been very disappointed in this KFC. The service is lousy, the employees do not have a good customer service standard. My orders are consistently wrong. After my last bad experience I wrote them an email and they didn't even respond.
yelp:train:80808.para: I've been extremely disheartened with this KFC. The level of service is subpar, and the staff lacks a commendable standard in customer service. My orders are frequently inaccurate. Following my recent unsatisfactory encounter, I sent them an email, but they failed to reply.

yelp:train:80918.orig: Convenient but can be significant waits. Staff is pleasant enough. Now they get your co-pay in advance. Fair enough I suppose but hold onto your receipt because weeks later I got a bill from them for that very same co-pay. When I called about it, they could find no record of me having paid at my visit so I had to go to the trouble of faxing them my receipt. Over a month later and I've heard nothing back.
yelp:train:80918.para: The service is handy but may involve considerable delays. The staff is amiable to a degree. It's acceptable that they provide your co-pay ahead of time. However, retain your receipt as I encountered a situation where, after several weeks, I received a bill for the same co-pay. When I inquired, they couldn't locate any payment records from my visit, necessitating the effort to fax them my receipt. Despite over a month passing without a response, I'm still awaiting a resolution.

yelp:train:81489.orig: A lot of $$$ and not a lot of quality!  My partner and I came for dinner tonight after being told it was the worlds greatest hamburger. With high anticipation we ordered the 1/2 lb burger combos and shared a sampler platter...we had an appetite tonight!  Unfortunately the quality did not meet the anticipation. The burgers wet just okay...nothing special. The \""fries\"" or as I know them wedges were not good. My partner ordered the chili cheese fries and received wedges with a little chili and some sprinkled cheese. The chili had an odd flavor. \n\nNeedless to say out bill was around $36 and we could have went to a Five Guys Burgers and Fries and had a better experience for about half the price.
yelp:train:81489.para: We spent a significant amount of money on dinner tonight, expecting a top-notch burger experience. We ordered half-pound burger combos and a variety platter, fueled by our hunger. Regrettably, the quality fell short of our expectations. The burgers were merely satisfactory, lacking any exceptional qualities. The fries, which I recognize as wedges, were subpar. My companion's chili cheese fries came with a modest amount of chili and a sprinkle of cheese, but the chili had an unusual taste. \n\nIn conclusion, our $36 bill left us considering a more cost-effective option like Five Guys Burgers and Fries for a superior dining experience at roughly half the cost.

yelp:train:82148.orig: The food is good that's why we come here but we will be finding a new one to go to every time we come the staff is unprofessional messing around  yelling across the store to one another 2 different visits they were cursing one time they were complaining about another guest and they always have the same Spanish soap opera on the tv I thought this was a family friendly place
yelp:train:82148.para: The cuisine is enjoyable, which is why we frequent this establishment, yet we're on the lookout for a new spot each visit. yelp:train:82161.orig: I had to mail my books back to school and the service was amazing. They got my shipping label printed and all I had to buy was a $2 package. I've come here on several occasions for copies, printing, etc. and enjoy the well kept facility. Right off the access road and easy parking. Great place to get all my shipping and printing needs taken care.
yelp:train:82161.para: The service for returning my textbooks to the educational institution was exceptional. They efficiently produced my shipping label for a nominal $2 charge. I've visited this location multiple times for various printing and copying services and appreciate the meticulously maintained environment. The facility is conveniently situated off the main road with straightforward parking. It's an excellent venue for fulfilling all my shipping and printing requirements.

yelp:train:82546.orig: Their food is GREAT! Actually, I love their gigantic antipasto salad. The small is enough for two. \n\nTheir lunch specials are great deals as well.
yelp:train:82546.para: Their cuisine is fantastic! I particularly enjoy their large antipasto salad, which serves two people adequately. Moreover, their lunch specials offer excellent value for money.

yelp:train:82870.orig:
20 years ago as a kid a friend's mom took us here. I remembered it being good, in fact it is excellent.  My kids and I are total snobs when it comes to Chinese food. I hate paying and they hate eating things inferior to our own escapades in the kitchen. 

We ordered beef skewers, crab puffs and soup for appetizers.  The beef was tender and marinated/seasoned well, crab puffs had homemade as opposed to commercial grade wrappers which was a nice treat. The sizzling Rice Soup was delicious and the the meat was not tough. 

The main course was Orange Chicken and Chicken Chow Mein listed as Mandarin style on the menu (meaning soft not crispy noodles). The chicken had a perfect light breading, nice and crisp upon biting and the chicken was a quality cut, no gristle, very juicy and tender.....the sauce involved no artificial orange colors or flavors, cavities from high fructose sugars.... just a perfect balance of salt, citrus and garlic. Chow Mein was equally delightful with fresh veggies, seasoned well, noodles were cooked to perfection.

 We didn't order any egg rolls but I saw a few walk buy and they were the size of small footballs. Next time we will get those....as for this ti
yelp:train:82870.para:
20 years back, as a youngster, a friend's mother introduced us to this place. I recall it being enjoyable, and now it's exceptional. Our family and I consider ourselves connoisseurs of Chinese cuisine. We dislike spending money on subpar food, and our children are equally picky, preferring our own culinary adventures. 

We opted for beef skewers, crab puffs, and soup as starters. The beef was succulent and well-seasoned, while the crab puffs boasted homemade wrappers, a welcome change from mass-produced ones. The sizzling Rice Soup was mouthwatering, and the meat was tender, not chewy. 

The main dishes were Orange Chicken and Chicken Chow Mein, described as Mandarin style on the menu, indicating soft noodles rather than crispy ones. The chicken had a perfect light breading, crisp when bitten, and the cut was of high quality, free from gristle, and extremely juicy and tender. The sauce was a harmonious blend of salt, citrus, and garlic, without any artificial orange hues or flavors, or cavities from high fructose sugars. The Chow Mein was equally pleasing, with fresh vegetables, well-seasoned, and noodles cooked to perfection.

yelp:train:82912.orig: I heard alot about this place through Yelp so when I came across it I decided to give it a try. I didnt know that they were more of a luncheonette type place. I ordered a medium hot coffee and try a glaxed donut. The coffee tasted like it was burnt and the donut wassoft but just didnt taste right. It almost seemed like the glaze was bad or something. Either way I was not impressed with Rainbow Donuts and will continue to go to Dunkin Donuts since no one can seem to match their amazing coffee! (and donuts too!)
yelp:train:82912.para: Through Yelp reviews, I discovered this establishment and opted to experience it. Unaware that it functioned as a luncheonette, I ordered a medium-hot coffee and a glazed donut. The coffee had a burnt flavor, and the donut was soft but overall unappetizing. It appeared the glaze might have been subpar. Disappointed with Rainbow Donuts, I'll keep patronizing Dunkin Donuts, as they consistently deliver exceptional coffee and donuts.

yelp:train:83634.orig: Awesome service! In home repair and service of our grandfather clock was easily arranged with a simple email and phone call. He arrived right on time and fixed everything up good as new with no added surprise charges. This place is the BEST!
yelp:train:83634.para: Exceptional customer support! Our grandfather clock's in-home repair and service was efficiently coordinated through a straightforward email and phone communication. The technician arrived punctually and restored the clock to its original condition without any unexpected fees. This establishment is truly outstanding!

yelp:train:84258.orig:
I'm not a big fan of beef chinese dishes, but their Beef with broccoli is truly awesome! I liked it so much, that I had it 3 days in  row for lunch. Even better than going to the Chinese Cultural Center restaurants, more affordable and tastier! Lunch specials are affordable as are the dinner combos.

My personal list:
Beef with broccoli - AWESOME!
Lemon chicken - yum!
Moo Shu pork - another of my personal faves
Sesame Chicken
BBQ Pork  
Fried Shrimp - mmm, try mixing ketchup into soy sauce for dip.
Crab puffs
Pork fried rice
Honey Garlic Chicken
Sweet n sour pork

I don't care for the egg rolls (however, my son LOVES them) or pot stickers (deep fried rather than steamed with oil). I wasn't impressed with the egg flower or hot and sour soup.
 
I work close by and their delivery service has been primo. On time and food is hot! Their staff is friendly and very helpful. Everyone I have introduced to this restaurant has been very pleased. I sincerely recommend this place.
yelp:train:84258.para:
I don't particularly enjoy beef-based Chinese meals, but their Beef with broccoli dish is exceptionally delightful! I was so fond of it that I consumed it consecutively for lunch over three days. It surpasses the experience at Chinese Cultural Center eateries, offering both cost-effectiveness and superior flavor. Lunch deals and dinner combos are also reasonably priced.

My preferred selections include:
Beef with broccoli - absolutely fantastic!
Lemon chicken - delicious!
Moo Shu pork - another favorite of mine
Sesame Chicken
BBQ Pork  
Fried Shrimp - try combining ketchup with soy sauce for a tasty dip.
Crab puffs
Pork fried rice
Honey Garlic Chicken
Sweet n sour pork

I'm not a fan of the egg rolls (though my son adores them) or pot stickers (which I find too fried). I was also unimpressed with the egg flower and hot and sour soup. 

Working nearby, I've found their delivery service to be top-notch. It's consistently punctual and the food arrives hot. The staff is amiable and incredibly supportive. Everyone I've introduced to this restaurant has expressed great satisfaction. I wholeheartedly

yelp:train:84422.orig: when i first moved here I thought this pizza place was the bomb but apparently I came on a good day. I have ordered pizza twice since my last post and have been disgusted. I asked the girl on the phone for a bbq chicken pizza, and she says they can make it. So when I came to pick up my order, the pizza literally had hot wings on top... HOT WINGS!  i have never seen a bbq CHICKEN pizza with hot wings on top, however despite the disapointment in my pizza and the rude service, I figured I'd \""try\"" it. I was repulsed, tossed the pizza and called papa johns. NEVER AGAIN.
yelp:train:84422.para: Upon my initial arrival, I was convinced this pizzeria was fantastic, but it turns out I was fortunate with my timing. I've placed two pizza orders since my previous update and both left me utterly unimpressed. I requested a barbecue chicken pizza over the phone, and they assured me it was possible. However, upon arrival to collect my order, I was met with a shocking sight: the pizza was topped with hot wings. I've never encountered a barbecue chicken pizza with hot wings on top, and although the service was unpleasant and the pizza failed to meet my expectations, I decided to give it a chance. Disgusted, I discarded the pizza and opted for Papa John's from that point forward.

yelp:train:84838.orig: Unique take on New Mexican, especially their lasagna-like stacked enchiladas. Good atmosphere, and friendly service. The owner is a good Nebraska guy, and very personable with the patrons.
yelp:train:84838.para: Distinctive approach to New Mexican cuisine, particularly their layered enchiladas akin to lasagna. The ambiance is pleasant, and the staff is amiable and welcoming. The proprietor hails from Nebraska and exhibits a warm and engaging demeanor towards customers.

yelp:train:84964.orig: I've visited several times for both breakfast and lunch.  They strive to have a homey feel, but the fake wood floors just make the place overly noisey.  The staff is very nice.  The food always reminds me of what I make myself when I'm in a hurry, rushing out the door.  Overall, I don't enjoy the place very much.
yelp:train:84964.para: I've dined there multiple times for morning and midday meals. They aim for a cozy atmosphere, yet the synthetic wooden flooring contributes to an excessive level of noise. The team is exceptionally friendly. The cuisine consistently evokes the hurried, on-the-go dishes I prepare myself. In summary, I find the establishment less than satisfying.

yelp:train:85083.para: Poor service pace, chilled dishes, and an absent manager... A disappointing visit. Typically, this establishment excels!

yelp:train:85113.orig:
just moved around the corner from Flor De Michoacan. On a referral went into check it out. WOW! The owner Floyd happened to be there and let my wife and I sample all kinds of ice cream. It was amazing! We now go almost every single day. Stephanie and Gabriella are the nicest ladies and represent well. You can see the pride in their Hispanic heritage in their service levels. yelp:train:85113.para:
Recently relocated just next to Flor De Michoacan. Following a recommendation, I decided to visit and was blown away. The proprietor, Floyd, was present and graciously allowed my spouse and me to taste various ice cream flavors. It was absolutely fantastic! We've become regulars, visiting almost daily. Stephanie and Gabriella are delightful women who embody the establishment's high standards. Their Hispanic background is evident in their exceptional service. The strawberry and cream combination is unparalleled. This place is a must-visit. I'm motivated to exercise more now! A lifelong patron,
Don D.

yelp:train:85255.orig:
How do you like your service???

yelp:train:85255.para:

yelp:train:85488.orig: Other than the long wait to be seated, the restaurant is great. The food was delicious.
yelp:train:85488.para: Except for the extended period before being served a table, the dining establishment impresses with its excellent cuisine.

yelp:train:85571.orig: Love this place , they have the best breakfast burritos ( about 5 bucks)  I have ate here at all hours and the food is always good.  Plus it is open 24 hours a day!
yelp:train:85571.para: I adore this location, their breakfast burritos are top-notch and cost around $5. I've enjoyed meals here at any time, and the quality of food remains consistently excellent. Moreover, it's accessible round the clock, 24/7.

yelp:train:85593.orig: Food was good but the bakery was the best. Please try the Lemon Merigne pie. To die for!\n\nThe yelp app was a life saver since we had no idea where to eat.
yelp:train:85593.para: The cuisine was enjoyable, but the bakery stood out as the top choice. Give the Lemon Marigold pie a shot. The Yelp app proved invaluable as we were uncertain about where to dine.

yelp:train:86765.orig: Wednesday: walk into the kitchen and flip on the lights... and nothing.  I check a few things, flip the breakers, even pulled off the plates on the switch and a dead outlet to check for lose wires, no such luck.  I called Dodge Electric on Friday afternoon and scheduled an appointment for 9 AM Monday morning.  9:01 AM Monday morning I meet the electrician and describe the problem to him and he gets to work.  9:40 AM, he finds a loose neutral wire in a smoke detector on a wall that's in no apparent way connected to the room without power.  9:41 AM I have lights in my kitchen and a slightly dumbfounded look my face.\n\nSummary: The electrician from Dodge Electric was punctual, friendly, knowledgeable, quick and efficient.  The price for the repair was also very reasonable.
yelp:train:86765.para:
On Monday morning, the punctual and amiable electrician from Dodge Electric arrived at 9:01 AM. After I explained the issue, he immediately began his work. By 9:40 AM, he discovered a loose neutral wire in a smoke detector, which was not visibly linked to the unlit room. At 9:41 AM, the kitchen was illuminated, leaving me slightly astonished. The repair cost was also quite affordable.

Summary: The Dodge Electric electrician was timely, pleasant, skilled, swift, and proficient. The repair fee was notably economical.

yelp:train:87749.orig:
Went in this morning for breakfast with my husband and daughter. Glad we arrive before 10 am because the restaurant filled up pretty quickly after that time. 

I had the green flannel hash -- Amazing. A terrific portion and super tasty. The dollop of sour cream is perfect to cool the spice of the jalapenos.  I don't generally order a more savory meal for breakfast, generally preferring french toast or pancakes, but the green flannel hash is a must have at Orange Table.

My daughter enjoyed her pancake, scrambled eggs and a slice of bacon.  Just the right size for a hungry nine-year-old. She ate her entire meal.  I snagged a bit of her bacon and it was awesome! Thick cut and cooked to perfection.  She also had a hot chocolate.  No thin, out-of-a-machine beverage-- the real deal with chocolate and whole milk.  An indulgence!

My husband loved his garlic and mushroom omelet. He asked to have spinach added to which our waiter replied, ""Sure. No problem!"" His omelet arrived with a really nice helping of spinach included.  My husband replied that he's not always a fan of omelets but he wanted to give this one a try.  It was cooked to perfection-- not too thick and eggy but a ni
yelp:train:87749.para:
This morning, I joined my spouse and child for breakfast at Orange Table. We were pleased to arrive before 10 am as the place gets crowded soon after. I opted for the green flannel hash, which was exceptional in both portion and flavor. The sour cream dollop effectively balanced the heat from the jalapenos. Although I usually prefer lighter breakfast options like french toast or pancakes, the green flannel hash is a compulsory choice here.

My child enjoyed her pancake, scrambled eggs, and a slice of bacon, which was just the right portion for a hungry nine-year-old. She finished her entire meal, and I tasted her bacon, which was thick and perfectly cooked. She also had a genuine hot chocolate, not the usual machine-made version, but a rich blend of chocolate and whole milk. It was a treat!

My spouse savored his garlic and mushroom omelet, and requested spinach to be added, which our waiter readily agreed to. The omelet was cooked to perfection, not overly thick or eggy, but just right. He admitted that he's not always fond of omelets, but he wanted to try this one. It was indeed a delightful experience.

yelp:train:87876.orig: Good place to pick up a nice essential piece to build outfits around. The sale rack is your friend, it's worth taking five minutes to flip through it. Employees are attentive but not pushy, which frankly, I'd rather be ignored until I'm ready to purchase something, but as long as they're not breathing down my neck, I'm good.
yelp:train:87876.para: A great spot to find a key item to complement your wardrobe. The sale section is beneficial, it's advantageous to spend a few minutes browsing through it. Staff members are considerate without being intrusive, which is actually preferable for me to be left undisturbed until I decide to buy something, but as long as they don't pressure me, I'm satisfied.

yelp:train:87997.orig: Always busy for HH! They have great patio seating (not in the sun). Food is fast and fabulous. A great place for out of towners to go see the Scottsdale scene and not be disappointed!
yelp:train:87997.para: HH is perpetually occupied, yet they boast impressive shaded patio seating. Their culinary offerings are swift and exquisite. An ideal spot for visitors from afar to explore the Scottsdale vibe without any letdowns.

yelp:train:88318.orig: I went to Grazie with my family, visiting from out of town. It was cold out that eve so I requested the front door be closed. The waitress told me, \""We are supposed to keep it open.\"" Not a very accommodating voice or comment. I looked around and the only reason I could see for this was that the woodfired oven is in the direct path of the air from the front door. GOD FORBID THE COOK GET HOT while he is making our pizza. We, and the other patrons ate pizza with our COATS ON. Really? The pizza isn't as good as it used to be. And the service BLOWS.
yelp:train:88318.para: When my family and I arrived at Grazie from elsewhere, it was chilly outside, prompting me to ask for the front door to be shut. The waitress responded, "We're supposed to keep it open." Her tone was unhelpful. I noticed the woodfired oven's location, directly exposed to the front door's airflow, which could potentially scorch the cook. Consequently, we all dined on our coats. It seemed the pizza quality had declined, and the service was disappointing.

yelp:train:88794.orig: Extremely disappointed with this place.....was looking forward to \""Beat the Heat -- Arizona Winterfest\"" at The Venue Scottsdale last Saturday, but as other reviewers have mentioned...it was quite simply a disaster.  No A/C. No A/C. No A/C.  Enough said.\n\nI did at least get my money back.
yelp:train:88794.para: Very dissatisfied with this establishment...anticipated the "Beat the Heat -- Arizona Winterfest" event at The Venue Scottsdale on the previous Saturday, but as others have pointed out, it turned out to be a complete failure. The absence of air conditioning was glaringly obvious. Sufficiently stated.\n\nOn a positive note, I managed to receive a refund for my expenditure.

yelp:train:88926.orig: Very family-friendly; one area of the restaurant is kid-oriented. Service was fast and friendly and the prices reasonable. Delicious ice cream.
yelp:train:88926.para: The restaurant offers a welcoming atmosphere for families, with a section specifically designed for children. The service was prompt and amiable, and the cost-effective pricing. The ice cream served was exceptionally tasty.

yelp:train:89554.orig: I would recommend Arizona Academy of Real Estate INSTEAD.  Arizona School of Real Estate & Business is overkill if you ask me.  You need to take your test and pass before you can take the state test.  Well if you fail the school test they won't show you your test scores to help in any way.  In fact you get sent home to find out if you pass online.  Funny because even the state test is graded immediately, and breaks down the test in sections so you know what to study when you retake the test.  My friend went to Arizona Academy of Real Estate and said they scan your test right in front of you when you turn it in, and it breaks down each section to let you know what you got wrong so you know what to study.  Same format as the state test. Oh, and their study guide was so small.  Well if you go to ASREB you definitely won't be able to say the same.  Arizona School of Real Estate gives you 3 different study guides.  The National Study guide has two study guides they tell you to memorize.  One study guide for this has 522 questions, study guide 2 has 320 questions, and the state study guide has 279 questions. That is 1,121 questions they send you home with for a school test that only has
yelp:train:89554.para: I suggest opting for the Arizona Academy of Real Estate rather than the Arizona School of Real Estate & Business. The latter seems excessive based on my perspective. To proceed, you must pass their examination before attempting the state test. Unfortunately, if you don't succeed at the school's test, they won't provide your scores for assistance. Interestingly, the state test results are immediately graded and sectioned, offering insight into areas for improvement. My acquaintance experienced this at the Arizona Academy of Real Estate, where they scan your test in real-time upon submission, highlighting incorrect answers for targeted study. This mirrors the state test's structure. However, the study material provided by ASREB is notably limited. In contrast, the Arizona School of Real Estate offers three study guides: a National Study guide with two memorization-focused guides, one with 522 questions and another with 320, plus a state-specific guide with 279 questions, totaling 1,121 questions for a school test that only requires

yelp:train:89560.orig:
This was not a very good experience for me, my husband, or my daughter.  Made a visit to the Scottsdale mall store and an incredibly rude younger dark haired woman helped us. 

 I guess she wasn't happy that we were asking the prices.  Maybe she felt our $500 purchase was a waste of her precious bitch time, not sure.  I came over to the counter to help my daughter pick something that she really wanted and not to go for the cheaper closure because she was probably worried she was taking advantage of us.  I was pointing her to something of more quality and of course more expensive because I would prefer she gets something nice that will last a very long time and that she would be happy with.  The bitch actually told me to go take a seat in the man chair because they were close to a decision.  I actually made that bitch more money but I think she may have been too stupid and too impatient to even realize nor do I think she cares about our piddly little purchase.  Normally I would educate a dumb bitch like that but I just didnt need the drama so I walked away. 

When I first walked into that store nobody knew that I was there with anyone else because I went in a couple minutes afte
yelp:train:89560.para:
My visit to the Scottsdale mall store turned out to be a disappointing one for my family and me. We encountered a young, dark-haired woman who appeared to be quite unpleasant in assisting us. It seemed she was displeased with our inquiries about the prices, possibly perceiving our $500 transaction as a misuse of her valuable time. I approached the counter to aid my daughter in selecting a high-quality item she desired, rather than opting for a less expensive alternative due to concerns of exploitation. I suggested a more premium option, emphasizing its durability and potential for long-term satisfaction. The woman, whom I referred to as 'bitch', instructed me to sit in a man's chair as they were nearing a decision. Although I inadvertently increased her earnings, I doubted her intelligence and patience, nor did I believe she valued our modest purchase. Normally, I would have taken the opportunity to educate her, but I chose to avoid further conflict and left the store.

When I first entered the store, no one seemed to recognize my presence with others, as I had arrived shortly after.

yelp:train:89743.orig: Incredibly knowledgeable staff. Great book signings.
yelp:train:89743.para: Exceptionally well-informed personnel. Enjoyable author events.

yelp:train:89926.orig: Malee's was very good.  My mom was here visiting from Washington State.  She had never had Thai food before but I knew she would love it.  We had the fresh spring rolls to start with, this is a meal here but in most places might have been an app.  We liked these so much that I am going to try to recreate these for dinner at home one night.  We also had the chow Mein, which was very good!  There could have been more meat but it was still good.  I would go back to Malee's for sure!
yelp:train:89926.para: Malee's provided an excellent dining experience. My mother, visiting from Washington State, had not tried Thai cuisine before, but I was confident she would enjoy it. We began with the fresh spring rolls, typically an appetizer, but here it was a main course. We were so fond of them that I plan to make a similar dish at home. Additionally, we savored the chow Mein, which was delicious, despite the meat quantity. I would certainly return to Malee's.

yelp:train:90582.orig: Ordered the nachos and the veggie enchiladas, and 2 margaritas.  The beans on the nachos were incredibly salty - could not eat without drowning them in sour cream.  The dinner plate was loaded with so much cheese you could choke from it... unhealthy and fattening meal, and unfortunately the taste, quality of food, or flavor did not justify the calories.   The atmosphere is very nice, unfortunately the food made it such that I'll never return.  Service was good overall.  The manager walked over to ask us how we were doing, but didn't stay long enough to hear the answer.  Enjoyed the 80's alternative music.
yelp:train:90582.para:
Purchased nachos with beans and veggie enchiladas, along with two margaritas. The saltiness of the nacho beans was overwhelming, necessitating a sour cream dip to make them palatable. The cheesy dinner plate was excessive, leading to a potentially choking hazard, and the meal was deemed unhealthy and calorie-dense. Despite the pleasant ambiance, the food quality was subpar, making it unlikely for a return visit. The service was commendable, though the manager's brief interaction was brief. The enjoyment of 80's alternative tunes added a positive note.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, sentiment, emotion, and intent while altering the wording and sentence structure. The length is approximately the same as the original text.)

yelp:train:90686.orig:
Yeah Im a BIG FAN.  

This place is great for getting a bite to eat like a burger or ribs.  I have gone to this place for many years and I always leave satisfied.  The wait staff is great and they bring out a complimentary chopped liver platter that is so good, and don't knock it till you try it. 

I would bring family here or if your a sports fan and with a couple buddies thats good.

Sign up for there rewards program and you will get emails giving deals.  During Suns games and other sports events burgers at the bar for like 8 bucks and for you birthday they give you a 25 dollars off for spending 50.

Recommendation:  To anyone that likes good stakes and burgers, and has a craving for awesome fries, copped liver, and good service.
yelp:train:90686.para:
Absolutely, I am an enthusiastic patron.  

This establishment excels in serving delicious meals such as burgers and ribs. I have frequented this place for years and consistently depart with a sense of fulfillment. The service team is commendable and they offer a complimentary chopped liver platter that is exceptionally delightful, and I encourage you to give it a try. 

This place is perfect for family outings or for sports enthusiasts with friends. 

Join their rewards program to receive promotional emails with special offers. During Suns games and other sporting events, you can enjoy burgers at the bar for approximately $8, and on your birthday, you can avail a 25% discount for spending $50. 

Suggestion: For anyone who appreciates quality dining and burgers, and has a desire for excellent fries, copped liver, and superior service.

yelp:train:90980.orig: News Flash!  Pepins is a far cry from traditional Spanish cuisine and somehow, someone thought that they would classify it as \""Basque Cuisine\"" also.  I guess it sounds good to throw that in.  Me thinks not!  The cuisine has nothing to do with Basque cuisine.  The Spanish cuisine is very much Americanized.  Since most people on this planet have not traveled to Pais Basco (Basque Country, located in the most northern, central region of Spain and partly in France) the owners of Pepins must think that the consumer will take their word for it.  Pepins food is not \""terrible\"", but it's not Spanish, and it's definitely not Basque!  The service was atrocious when we went.  The Paella, was hardly a paella.  The garlic shrimp was pretty good though.  And what's up with the Salsa dancing in a \""Spanish\"" restaurant.  Weird.\n\ni'm giving it an extra star because I'm nice guy.  If I told actually thought, Yelp would have to come up with a separate rating scale.
yelp:train:90980.para: Urgent Update! Pepins deviates significantly from authentic Spanish dishes and someone has erroneously labeled it as "Basque Cuisine." I believe this misclassification is misleading. The culinary style here has no connection to Basque gastronomy. Spanish cuisine has been heavily influenced by American flavors. Given that most individuals haven't visited the Basque Country (Basque Region, situated in Spain's northern central area and partially in France), the Pepins' proprietors may assume consumers will accept their claims. While the food isn't dreadful, it's not genuinely Spanish or Basque. The service quality was disappointing during our visit. The Paella didn't meet expectations, but the garlic shrimp was commendable. The sight of Salsa dancing in a "Spanish" eatery is quite unusual. Despite this, I'm awarding it an additional star out of courtesy. If I were to be honest, Yelp would need a new rating system.

yelp:train:91589.orig: Beware gift cards expire. Who does that anymore?  If I pay you $100. Why should it expire?  Stupid!
yelp:train:91589.para: Exercise caution with expiring gift cards. Is this still a common practice? If I provide you with $100, why should it have an expiration date? It seems illogical!

yelp:train:92246.orig:
Great place with great wine.  I am a regular and always look forward to coming here for a Red Zin.   

They always have one by the glass and it's always a treat to see which one they picked to pour!   

As soon as the weather is a bit better, the patio is great.
yelp:train:92246.para:
This fantastic establishment offers exceptional wine. I am a frequent visitor and eagerly anticipate my visits for a glass of Red Zin. 

They consistently provide a selection by the glass, and it's delightful to observe their choice of pour each time. 

Once the weather improves, the outdoor patio becomes an enjoyable spot.

yelp:train:92792.orig: I love our timeshare where we have been calling home for the past week. The staff is super friendly, the gym although small has recently been renovated/upgraded, and everything is within a 15 minute drive which is nice. Our studio has the basics (which is perfect since we are minimalists) and a nice patio to relax and enjoy the sunrise. There are 2 jacuzzis (one is for adults only) and the pool is decently sized and has a nice waterfall overhang.  CVS/Pharmacy, coffee, groceries and places to get things you forgot/ need for your stay is located along the way to this place. You can walk to the Fairmont (ten minutes or less) to meet up for drinks or friends. My only gripe\nis the wall are thin... either that or the two older women have naturally loud voices... I guess it is perk because they are our alarm clocks... and I am sure since we go to bed 2 hours later than them they hear us blaring the Olympics.
yelp:train:92792.para: I adore our timeshare that has been our residence for the previous seven days. The team is incredibly welcoming, the gym, though compact, has been recently refurbished/enhanced, and it's conveniently situated just a 15-minute drive away, which is convenient. Our studio comes equipped with the essentials, ideal for our minimalist lifestyle, and features a charming patio for unwinding and basking in the dawn's light. There are two jacuzzis (one adults-only) and a sufficiently spacious pool with a delightful waterfall overhang. Nearby amenities like CVS/Pharmacy, coffee, and groceries, as well as places to pick up forgotten or needed items for your stay, are easily accessible on the way to this location. You can stroll to the Fairmont in under ten minutes for socializing or catching up with friends. My sole complaint is the thin walls... or perhaps the two elderly ladies' naturally boisterous voices, which ironically serve as our wake-up call, especially since we tend to sleep two hours later than them, resulting in us being the ones to blast the Olympics.

yelp:train:92862.orig: We had went to rawhide Aug 30 and to celebrate my 10 year anniversary and to try the rattlesnake. First of all it started ok until the new waiter spilled water all over my Dad's back. I understand he was training but the only comp we got from them was \""oh sorry he was a trainer\"" and we got 2 baskets of  cornbread. What kind of comp  is that?  They did not even offer to get his clothes dry cleaned or even dried off. \nNext the food ... Rattlesnake was no different from popcorn chicken. It was not what I expected. The steak and prime rib was dry and the sides were not good. And I got sick the next day with diarrhea and vomiting. \nI  spent a lot of money and was disappointed with the entertainment. Overall my experience was 1 one star. Not a happy customer
yelp:train:92862.para: On August 30, we attended rawhide to commemorate my 10-year milestone and sample rattlesnake. Initially, things seemed fine until a new server accidentally drenched my father's back. The only apology we received was that he was a trainee, and we were given two baskets of cornbread as compensation. This response left us questioning the quality of their customer service. Furthermore, the rattlesnake dish was underwhelming, akin to popcorn chicken, and the steak and prime rib were dry with subpar sides. The following day, I suffered from diarrhea and vomiting. Despite the expenditure, I was disheartened with the entertainment and overall experience, rating it a solitary star. I am undoubtedly a dissatisfied patron.

yelp:train:92973.orig: Food was delicious. I had the meatloaf and the brown tomato gravy on top was fantastic. Hubby had the Catfish and said it was great. Large portions...we didn't finish. Server was very attentive.
yelp:train:92973.para: The meal was scrumptious. I savored the meatloaf with the delectable brown tomato sauce. My partner enjoyed the Catfish and praised its excellence. Despite the generous servings, we didn't manage to consume it all. The attentive server contributed to our dining experience.

yelp:train:93028.orig: It's always the first place I eat at when returning to Scottsdale.
yelp:train:93028.para: Every time I come back to Scottsdale, that's the restaurant I head to initially.

yelp:train:93389.orig: Went into Denny's to get my all you can eat pancakes once out of the year for Veterans Day and got denied.  Apparently they already have deeply discounted menu options like there value slam, so they disregard there promise of all you can eat pancakes on Veterans Day(only Denny's near me)
yelp:train:93389.para: Visited Denny's to enjoy their unlimited pancakes on Veterans Day, but was turned down. It seems they already offer heavily reduced choices such as their value slam, hence they overlook their commitment to providing unlimited pancakes on Veterans Day, specifically at the Denny's location near me.

yelp:train:93528.orig:
It's Friday...strike that, Saturday morning.  I have one mud covered high heel.  I have had a few vodkas, so have my friends.  We took a cab, but that doesn't stop us from getting a burrito.  I buy one for the cab driver too since he was nice enough to turn off the meter and didn't mind that my shoe was extremely dirty.  

The pastor taco is delicious.  The chorizo burrito is delicious.  The bean and cheese burrito is delicious, not that you can mess up something that simple.  The guy behind the counter is super and puts up with my drunken food requests (basically, that means adding sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallo to everything).  It also helps that my best friend speaks fluent Spanish and that the counter guy has a crush on me.

Super burrito is not only great for drunk binge eating, but also for awkward heart to hearts with your friends.  If you can't say it over burritos on the patio, when can you say it?  It reminds me of those 'chew it over with Twix' commercials, only you shove a burrito in your mouth instead of candy bars.
yelp:train:93528.para:
Saturday morning has arrived, and I'm sporting a single muddy high heel. I've indulged in a few vodkas, and so have my companions. We hailed a cab, yet we're still inclined to grab a burrito. I treat the cabbie to one as well, appreciating his kindness in deactivating the meter and tolerating my filthy footwear. 

The taco from the pastor is scrumptious, as is the chorizo burrito. Even the basic bean and cheese burrito is delectable, as there's no room for error in its simplicity. The counter staff is exceptional, accommodating my inebriated food demands (essentially, I'm asking for sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallo to be added to everything). Their patience is aided by my best friend's fluency in Spanish and the counter staff's affection for me. 

The burrito is not only perfect for drunken overeating but also for awkward yet intimate conversations with friends. If you can't express yourself over burritos on the patio, when else can you? It brings to mind those 'chew it over with Twix' ads, but instead of candy bars, we're munching on burritos.

yelp:train:93888.orig: I've been going here since I was a kid.....um a while ago. They are the lease expensive place to go for glasses by far, they take there time with you and their selection is always great.  You sometimes have to wait since they are very popular, but they are popular for great reasons. I don't go anywhere else.....its the very best bang for your buck for something noone wants to have to have.
yelp:train:93888.para: I've frequented this location from my childhood days, and it's been the most cost-effective choice for eyewear. They invest time in customer service and consistently offer an impressive range of options. Although there can be delays due to their popularity, it's well-deserved. I never consider other places; it provides the utmost value for an unwanted necessity.

yelp:train:94030.orig:
Based on the Szechwan Chicken and the Spicy Chicken dishes two stars seems about right.

The menu here states that the spicy chicken would be in a bean sauce but we received it in approximately eighty percent sriracha sauce and the rest was mostly oil. This was the better dish.

The Szechwan Chicken I couldn't eat because it was extremely sweet and could have passed for a dessert sauce.

Both meals were made with nicely cooked white meat chicken. The vegetables in both dishes were bell peppers, onions and mushrooms that were a good ratio. They gave us two plates of white rice that were approximately three cups each.

Maybe other dishes on the menu are better I don't know.

This place is very casual you order at the counter and seat yourself.

I do note this place is very clean and spotless.
yelp:train:94030.para:
According to the Szechwan Chicken and Spicy Chicken offerings, a rating of two stars is fitting.

The menu indicates that the spicy chicken should be served with a bean sauce, but we were presented with roughly eighty percent sriracha sauce and the remainder was predominantly oil. This dish was superior.

The Szechwan Chicken was too sweet for me to consume, almost resembling a dessert sauce.

Both meals featured well-prepared white meat chicken. The dishes included bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms in a satisfactory proportion. We were provided with two plates of white rice, each about three cups in size.

It's possible that other dishes on the menu might be superior, but I'm uncertain.

This establishment has a laid-back atmosphere where you place your order at the counter and choose your seat.

I would like to mention that this place maintains a high level of cleanliness and is immaculate.

yelp:train:94722.orig: Good beer. Terrible food. Bland, bland, bland. First off it took 15 minutes for anyone to realize we were in the place. Secondly the food was as if the cook just took the food out of the package threw it on the grill and then served it. I never thought of salt as a spice but seeing as it was the only thing to make the food have any taste guess it will have to do. The one upside our server was very nice.
yelp:train:94722.para: Excellent brew, disappointing cuisine. Dull, dull, dull. Initially, it took a quarter of an hour for anyone to acknowledge our location. Moreover, the meal seemed like it was merely heated from the package and then presented. I hadn't considered salt as a flavor enhancer, but given it was the sole element to impart any taste, it's our only option. The positive aspect was our attentive server.

yelp:train:95315.orig: Great room for the price. Paid 70 and we were expecting a shitty hotel.  Rooms looked newly remodeled, beds were comfortable and the place was clean.
yelp:train:95315.para: Paid 70 and we anticipated a subpar accommodation. However, the rooms appeared recently refurbished, the beds were cozy, and the establishment maintained a spotless condition.

yelp:train:95496.orig: My problem is with their undergraduate admissions dept. I had sent $2 for a transcript request to my high school, not to mention rude service from them, to get me off this financial hold. Today, I had spoken with a rep from ASU undergraduate, and she was rude. I have asked her to speak with the person that deals with the actual PO Box that receives the transcripts, and she asked me, \""why?\"" I had told her that My school had sent the paperwork, she had told me that there's nothing they could do. I think that this college want me to pay out of pocket instead of receiving financial aid. Im tired of playing these games. I had thought that ASU had a good reputation.
yelp:train:95496.para:
I'm frustrated with the undergraduate admissions department. I previously paid $2 to my high school for a transcript request, which was accompanied by unpleasant customer service, in an attempt to resolve a financial hold. After discussing with a representative from ASU undergraduate, I encountered rudeness. I requested that she connect with the individual handling the PO Box for transcripts, but she questioned my motives. I explained that my school had submitted the necessary documents, but she responded that there was nothing they could do. I suspect that ASU intends for me to cover costs personally rather than providing financial aid. I'm exhausted from navigating these obstacles. I had previously believed ASU to be reputable.

(Paraphrase length: approximately 100 words)

yelp:train:95855.orig: The pizza is good ,but not great, the service is almost always slow and the place is generally a dump, yet for some reason I can't stop going back.  Maybe it's the fact that it's on my way to campus.  Maybe it's because it's the only place i've found near campus where I can get 2 slices and a drink for $5.  Maybe I just get a kick out of the fact that the middle aged balding guy (manager?) is almost always yelling at one of the mexican dudes in the back.  For whatever unknown, illlogical reason I just like this place!
yelp:train:95855.para: The pizza here isn't outstanding, but it's decent. The service tends to be sluggish, and the ambiance could be better, yet I find myself returning. Perhaps it's the convenience of its location on my campus route. Or it could be that it's the sole establishment near campus offering two slices and a beverage for $5. Maybe I enjoy the sight of the middle-aged, balding individual (presumed manager) frequently scolding a Mexican employee in the kitchen. For some inexplicable, illogical reason, I have a fondness for this place.

yelp:train:95987.orig: Spring rolls, egg rolls and Pho are just as good or even better than the best Vietnamese in other cities (San Jose, NYC and Denver, to name a few)...but the building, service and drink offerings are lacking. yelp:train:95987.para: Pho, spring rolls, and egg rolls at this place are comparable or superior to the finest Vietnamese eateries in cities like San Jose, NYC, and Denver, but the establishment's architecture, customer service, and beverage selections are subpar. It's disappointing to ruin a special Date Night attire in this uninspiring setting. Hence, it's not worth the visit. Casual wear like T-shirts and sandals are prevalent here. Although the Lemongrass Chicken doesn't match the fiery taste my husband recalled from the past, he still found it enjoyable.

yelp:train:96235.orig: Excellent pizza marguerite and guacamole appetizer was big and excellent and as always the cookie dessert was fabulous!
yelp:train:96235.para: The large and delicious pizza margherita and guacamole starter, along with the consistently fabulous cookie dessert, was truly outstanding!

yelp:train:96268.orig: Always the best.  Been going to Oregano's for over 20 years.  Great place.
yelp:train:96268.para: For more than two decades, I've frequented Oregano's, consistently regarded as an exceptional venue.

yelp:train:96333.orig:
I have tried this location twice for custom print work. My two star goes to the terribly unhappy woman that works behind the counter. And this locations lack of attention to detail.

Team, small things, like cutting a straight line along the edge of a print job. It goes a long way. They were invitations to a party, not some cheap flyer! Couldn't you have paid closer attention to detail so that it didn't look like a five year old cut them out with hand scissors?
yelp:train:96333.para:

yelp:train:96372.orig:
This place is a nice little surprise next to the gym I recently started working out at. It's . . . quaint, but the people there are friendly enough and the drinks and smoothies are surprisingly tasty. 

I am sipping back on a protein berry something or other right now that is on point. 

They do things a little differently over here than at your local Jamba Juice. They allow you to choose a base (soy, yogurt, etc.), a flavor, and then a boost to mix in, making it sort of a do-it-yourself version of its counterpart. 

There is also a wide selection of protein blends and pills to use as supplements for workouts, but, frankly I don't trust those things all that much. Anything that engineered can't be that healthy for you, regardless of their claims of being naturally occurring or whatever. I bet that's what they told Barry over at Balco, too. 

There is a tanning salon attached that I also skip by. For pretty much the same reasons as I skip the supplements. Engineered sunlight can't be a good thing in heavy doses, no matter how you spin it. 

All in all, a good place to stop in and use their internet (did I mention it also doubles as an internet cafe?) and sip on something b
yelp:train:96372.para:
This spot is a pleasant unexpected find near the fitness center I've recently begun frequenting. It's charming, and the staff are amiable, with their beverages and smoothies offering unexpectedly delightful flavors. 

I'm currently enjoying a protein-packed concoction that's hitting the mark. 

Here, they offer a unique approach compared to your typical Jamba Juice. Customers can select a base (like soy or yogurt), a taste, and an additional mix-in, creating a customized version of the standard. 

They also provide a variety of protein powders and pills for workout supplementation, but I'm skeptical about these engineered products. No matter what they claim, artificially created substances can't be entirely beneficial to your health. I imagine Barry at Balco would share this viewpoint. 

There's also a tanning salon connected, which I avoid for similar reasons as I do with the supplements. Artificially produced UV light can't be healthy in large quantities, regardless of any supposed natural benefits. 

In summary, it's a great spot to relax, use their Wi-Fi (which also serves as a computer cafe), and enjoy a refreshing drink.

yelp:train:96990.orig:
I spent half my life at Coney Island and wanted a NY hot dog. It wasn't here. Try Nathan's at the AZ Mills Mall...and even that ain't a Coney Island dog.

I seem to remember the very sweet and helpful waitress saying Jim wasn't from Coney Island, so I gave her a good tip before shootin' her.

Don't be fooled by the name. Looked like it was out of business last time I drove by. Maybe somethin' happened to Jim. You know what I'm talkin' about!?
yelp:train:96990.para: I dedicated half my existence in Coney Island and craved a New York hot dog. Unfortunately, it wasn't available here. Attempted Nathan's at the AZ Mills Mall, but it didn't resemble a Coney Island hot dog. \n\nI recall a particularly kind and attentive server informing me that Jim wasn't from Coney Island, leading me to leave a generous tip before parting ways. Don't be misled by the name. It appeared to be closed during my last visit. Perhaps something occurred to Jim. I'm referring to the situation!?

yelp:train:97026.orig: Service was slow but the food was awesome! Fun atmosphere! Pool table, lots of tvs, games... Great time! And a bar!
yelp:train:97026.para: The dining experience was a bit leisurely, yet the cuisine was exceptional! The vibe was lively with a pool table, numerous screens, and entertainment options. It was a fantastic evening, complete with a bar!

yelp:train:97269.orig: My ritual every morning is to get their columbian coffee with chocolate and nature valley's salty and sweet peanuts snack bar from this place. They have the fastest service ever as they kept the line going and nobody has to wait more than 5 minutes to pay. The friendliest customer service! Woh!
yelp:train:97269.para: Every day, I start with Columbian coffee mixed with chocolate and a Nature Valley snack bar, which is a blend of salty and sweet peanuts, from this establishment. They boast the quickest service, maintaining a steady flow without causing any customer to wait over five minutes for payment. The level of friendliness in their customer service is truly impressive!

yelp:train:97445.orig: I am so glad I found this place because I no longer have to make baklava when ever I get the craving. Yes I know there are places to get baklava around Phx but they were either too soggy, too sweet, too sugary, too stale, etc. Something was always wrong. But this place is definitely a diamond in the rough. They have a basic selection of middle eastern food like the sherwarma and the kabobs, which are all very tasty and well prepared and much cheaper than the Persian Room (I'm not the biggest fan of the Persian Room bc its just not worth the drive and money unless you are on a date and trying to impress someone). They also have a great selection of baklava like almond, pistachio, cashew, walnut, and the princess which is think is a combination of all the nuts. Regardless of what you get, you will be happy (both mouth and wallet). \n\nThe downside is that since it is in a grocery store, its a bit crowded and sometimes the wait can be a bit long, but I don't really mind the wait bc I know everything is fresh and prepared when ordered.
yelp:train:97445.para: I'm thrilled to have discovered this location as it eliminates the need for me to bake baklava whenever I desire it. While there are baklava options in Phoenix, they often fall short with issues like excessive moisture, overwhelming sweetness, or staleness. However, this establishment stands out as a hidden gem. It offers a range of modest Middle Eastern dishes, including shawarma and kabobs, all of which are delicious and reasonably priced compared to the Persian Room, which I don't favor due to its high cost and inconvenient location unless it's for a special occasion. Additionally, they boast an excellent array of baklava varieties such as almond, pistachio, cashew, walnut, and the unique princess blend. No matter your choice, satisfaction is guaranteed for both your palate and your budget. The only drawback is the occasional crowdedness and wait times, as it's situated in a grocery store, but I'm fine with the wait knowing the food is fresh and ready upon request.

yelp:train:97490.orig: The food is great, the shawarma plate, hummus, mixed grill, it could've been better tho. The staff and service is ok.\n\n4-star mostly is for the garlic souce
yelp:train:97490.para: The cuisine is excellent, with dishes like shawarma, hummus, and mixed grill, although there's room for improvement. The service and staff are satisfactory. The establishment earns a 4-star rating predominantly due to the delicious garlic sauce.

yelp:train:97813.orig:
Time will tell.  My son had his oil changed there on Thursday, Feb 9th and then came home later that evening and parked in the driveway in Sahuarita.  On Saturday, I was looking at the tires because the service rep indicated they needed to be replaced (they have at least 20k) more miles when I depth checked them.  I noticed a significant oil leak. 

I crawled under the vehicle and found that the oil plug was loose and I was able to turn with my fingers.  When I hand tightened the plug, I found that the hole had been stripped when they did the oil change.  Nothing was ever said and thankfully I found the issue before he seized the engine.  I've called American 5 Star and left a message as they close at 1 Saturday.  I'll update the review with their response.

*************
Owner took in car and fixed the oil leak.  He was really good to work with, listened to my concerns and took care of my son.  Thank you!!
yelp:train:97813.para:
The passage of time will reveal the outcome. My son had his oil changed at a location on Thursday, February 9th, and returned home that night, parking in the driveway in Sahuarita. On Saturday, I inspected the tires as the service technician had suggested they required replacement after I measured their depth. I observed a considerable oil leak. 

I examined the underside of the vehicle and discovered that the oil plug was not securely fastened and could be manipulated with my fingers. Upon tightening the plug by hand, I noticed that the hole had been worn down during the oil change. No communication occurred, but fortunately, I identified the problem before the engine could fail. I've left a message with American 5 Star, as they are closing on Saturday, and I will update the review with their reply. 

*************
The car owner addressed the oil leak issue and provided excellent service. He attentively listened to my worries and ensured my son's needs were met. I am grateful for his assistance.

yelp:train:97918.orig: By far for me, this is the best Pizza around. I love the sweet sauce, for some it might be to much but for me it is perfect. I would recommend sticking with the thin crust as the tradition is a little to much dough. I have had salads, spaghetti and meatballs, pretty much everything on the menu and not once was anything bad. the only complaint I have is there is not one by me.
yelp:train:97918.para: For me, this pizza stands out as the top choice in the area. I adore the sweet sauce, which some may find excessive, but it suits my taste just right. I suggest opting for the thin crust, as the traditional thick dough might be overwhelming. I've sampled all the dishes on the menu, and none have disappointed me. The sole issue I have is the lack of seating for me personally.

yelp:train:98108.orig: small uncomfortable beds, have to pay for Internet, have to pay for breakfast, and let's just say my bath towel was not clean. didn't get to go to the pool or gym but they looked really nice and modern. rather not stay here again tho.
yelp:train:98108.para: Compact and slightly unpleasant sleeping arrangements, along with the necessity to cover costs for Wi-Fi and morning meals, were part of the experience. The absence of a clean towel and inability to use the pool or fitness center were notable. Despite the facilities appearing sleek and contemporary, I'd prefer not to return.

yelp:train:98235.orig: Good food, really cool, old restaurant. Had a history lesson from the waiter before ordering. Definitely recommend this place!
yelp:train:98235.para: Enjoyed a delightful meal in a vintage eatery. The waiter provided an insightful history lesson prior to placing our order. This establishment is highly recommended!

yelp:train:98675.orig: I have not known a person who spoke of this place in anything but glowing terms. This was over many years. I have had their food a few times and felt the fish was like cardboard and nothing to speak well of.
yelp:train:98675.para: Over numerous years, I've encountered individuals who consistently praised this location. However, after sampling their cuisine on a few occasions, I found the fish to be as uninspiring as cardboard, far from commendable.

yelp:train:98684.orig:
I have never bought a car sight unseen before, and if it wasn't for the confidence I had after talking with Kris Le Suer on the phone, I would not have gotten on a plane. yelp:train:98684.para:

Previously, my visits to new VW dealerships in CA resulted in frustration, but discovering this family-owned business filled me with joy.

yelp:train:98796.orig: Minimal selection of food but  tasty. The reason why I'm writing this review is because of the drinks. Hopefully you go in on a night when Matthew is bartending. yelp:train:98796.para: The food options are limited, yet the flavors are delightful. I'm penning this review primarily due to the exceptional beverages. After expressing a preference for a sweet yet balanced drink with a bit of zing, Matthew delivered a flawless beverage. The subsequent drink I sampled surpassed the first. Should I return, it will be for the drinks, and I'll prioritize checking if Matthew is on duty.

yelp:train:99502.orig: I've been going here since I was little. Hands down, the best BBQ in AZ (in my opinion.) \n\nI've had just about everything on their menu and they've never disappointed me. The service is great as well. :)
yelp:train:99502.para: I've frequented this place from my childhood days. Without a doubt, it's the top-notch BBQ in AZ, according to my perspective. \n\nI've sampled nearly all their dishes and they've consistently met my expectations. The service quality is also commendable. :)

yelp:train:99696.orig: The last time I visited Burke Veterinary hospital was a few years ago. But since I was reviewing Vets I thought I would include this place. yelp:train:99696.para: My most recent visit to Burke Animal Clinic was several years back. While perusing veterinary services, I decided to mention this facility. The vet's demeanor, which appeared distant and somewhat haughty, left a strong impression and ultimately deterred me from returning.

yelp:train:99971.orig:
The food here is delicious! I am mostly impressed with the competent, helpful and friendly staff.  I go there often and see the manager always working hard and nice to her employees and customers.  All of the food I have gotten here has been good.  The helpful friendly staff will guide you in making food choices which is nice with so many options.  The Togo menu has the nutrition which is up front and helpful.

Love this place! 
Thank you for being a reliable, consistent place to get a bite to eat, or enjoy a beer on the patio.
yelp:train:99971.para: The cuisine offered here is scrumptious! I am mostly taken by the skilled, supportive and amiable team. yelp:train:100275.orig: A Touch of European Cafe is a well kept little secret of Glendale Arizona. If you enjoy Eastern European fare, or just want to try something new, visit this small, picturesque cafe, which is located on a charming and quiet side street within the historic square of Glendale. Weather permitting, dine at the outdoor patio under mature shade trees, where you may feel as if you are no longer in the desert Southwest. This is a place where you can casually relax with some quality authentic food in a quaint, possibly romantic setting. Tip: Call ahead about their Sour Pickle Soup... you do not have to be pregnant to develop cravings for this unusual yet appetizing soup recipe!
yelp:train:100275.para: Glendale, Arizona harbors a hidden gem known as A Touch of European Cafe, perfect for those who relish Eastern European dishes or seek novel culinary experiences. Nestled on a serene, tree-lined street within the city's historic heart, this cozy eatery offers a tranquil retreat from the arid Southwest. Here, you can unwind and savor genuine, traditional cuisine in a charming, potentially romantic ambiance. Note: It's wise to inquire about their Sour Pickle Soup in advance, as cravings for this distinctive, yet delicious soup are not limited to expectant mothers.

yelp:train:100758.orig:
First we have been getting pizza and wings from here for years. Always good and good service. 
Tonight we ordered a large supreme and after getting it home and eating over half with the family we discovered a cricket on the pizza. 
We called them and returned the evidence. Very apologetic and returned our money. 
Hopefully this does not happen to anyone else and they clean the place up. 
Will be looking elsewhere for our pizza.
yelp:train:100758.para: For many years, we've consistently enjoyed pizza and wings from this place, with excellent quality and service. This evening, we ordered a large supreme, which we shared with our family before noticing a cricket on it. Moving forward, we'll seek pizza elsewhere.

yelp:train:100791.orig: This is the first tanning salon I ever went to and that was about nine years ago. Throughout management and staff change  I've continued to come here on and off (whenever I'm in Arizona)\nAnyways, I signed up again in April (I hadn't tanned here in about a year and a half, if not longer) a few weeks later my mom signed up and the girl who took my moms info told me I would get a free month. Score! How awesome is that? Well my paid month recently expired and when I went in I was told my membership was up. I explained everything to the lady working and with a puzzled look on her face she allowed me to tan. This happened about two more times and each time I had to explain to the worker about the free month. I figured no one ever entered it or saved this info. Today I went in and Jill was working. I explained everything to her & to my surprise that free month does NOT exist. If you sign someone up you get a free upgrade for the month. I never knew this, or else I would have. yelp:train:100791.para: Nine years back, I visited my initial tanning salon, which I've frequented intermittently since, especially during my stays in Arizona. I re-enrolled in April after a break of over a year and a half, during which my mother also joined. The employee handling my mother's details promised a complimentary month, which I found delightful. However, when my paid membership concluded, I was informed that my membership had lapsed. I clarified the situation with the staff member, who, after some contemplation, permitted me to use the facility. This occurred twice more, each time necessitating a repeat explanation about the supposed free month. I assumed the free month was never recorded or saved. Today, I encountered Jill, who was accommodating and amiable. It turned out that the free month was a misconception; instead, signing someone up grants a free upgrade for the month. Jill and the rest of the staff were exceptionally pleasant, with one person standing out as less than cordial, though not overtly rude.

yelp:train:100919.orig: Found this place on my Yelp app and we ate here after the Gladiator Rock n Run.  BEST mexican food I've had in a long time!  Service was a tad slow, but they didn't anticipate the large groups coming in from the event.
yelp:train:100919.para: Discovered this eatery through my Yelp app and dined here post-Gladiator Rock n Run. The Mexican cuisine here was exceptional, the best I've experienced in quite some time. Although the service was slightly delayed, it was understandable given the influx of attendees from the event.

yelp:train:101896.orig: Ehhh. It just serves its niche clientele. if you are older and are accustomed to that style of food and service go and enjoy. Do not expect too much
yelp:train:101896.para: Ah, it caters specifically to its targeted audience. If you're seasoned in that culinary taste and service approach, indulge yourself. Don't anticipate excessive standards.

yelp:train:101948.orig: Oh wow ! I hear about this place a lot.... I went to get some burgers and shrimp. Well , what can I say ... yelp:train:101948.para: I've heard numerous mentions of this location... I decided to grab some burgers and shrimp. However, I was searching for a positive dining experience, but this place fell short of my expectations. Upon placing my order, they informed me that only cash is accepted, so I had to drive to a bank for some money. Afterward, I placed my order and observed kids playing near the kitchen area. yelp:train:101977.orig: Glamis Status parties every other SAT. They have anything you ever want to do with playing in the dirt. BMX, MOTORCROSS, MUD BOG, SAND DRAGS, FREE STYLE TRACK, RC CAR TRACK, LEGIT STREET QTR MILES DRAGS.

yelp:train:102003.orig:

They have the community table in one side for the daily locale customers, as well as ample booths and table.
