yelp:train:203351.para: Regularly explore this shop without making significant purchases. Today, they hosted a tasting event for Moscato wine. We acquired some EVOO and a new wine glass as our old one was damaged.

yelp:train:203543.orig:
First ride on the light rail and nowhere to go.  I have absolutely no need for this thing, but I wanted to try it anyway.  So, one evening in downtown my friend and I decided to see what kinda shenanigans we could find.  

Positive #1.  Crazy people.  God do I love crazy people.  A lovely lady sang Marvin Gay's ""Let's Get it On"" word for word to another passenger.  She even reached out and touched him as she belted ""lovin' you could never be wrong.""  I'm not sure if he liked it because he wasn't smiling on the outside, but I sure loved it.

Positive #2.  While riding I spotted some fun looking lights.  I ended up on the grass looking up at Sky Bloom in some downtown Phoenix park.  It was a nice little surprise.  

Positive#3.  Super clean and air conditioned.  It's nothing special, but it's not gross or smelly. 

Negative #1.  I have a dream, a dream where I can stumble out of the bar at 2am and ride the light rail all the way home.  In my dream the light rail actually takes me places, places I want or need to be.  

For now it's just a novelty- like, hey look at me!  I'm a big city, I have a light rail, wawawewoo, king of castle, bla bla bla.  Someday I will not
yelp:train:203543.para:
On my initial journey on the light rail, I found myself with no destination in mind. Despite not requiring it, I was eager to experience it. One evening in the city center, my companion and I embarked on a quest to uncover any unusual occurrences. 

Positive #1.  I adore encountering eccentric individuals. A delightful woman performed Marvin Gay's "Let's Get It On" from memory to a fellow passenger, even touching him while singing. I'm uncertain if he appreciated it due to his lack of a smile, but I thoroughly enjoyed it. 

Positive #2.  During the ride, I noticed some entertaining lights. I paused on the grass to admire Sky Bloom in a downtown Phoenix park, which was a pleasant surprise. 

Positive #3.  The light rail was immaculately clean and well-ventilated. It may not be extraordinary, but it certainly wasn't unpleasant or stinky. 

Negative #1.  I envision a future where I can exit a bar at 2am and utilize the light rail to reach my home. In this dream, the light rail would transport me to desired or necessary locations. 

Presently, it serves as a mere novelty, akin to boasting about my urban lifestyle and possession of a light rail. Someday, I hope to experience its practicality.

yelp:train:204017.orig:
D'lish doesn't need another review, but I love it so much that I couldn't resist.  

If I can help you out with anything, the key is to drench their sandwiches/wraps/flat breads in their chipotle aioli - game changer.  Makes their super delicious food even better.  

While it's 'fast food,' be prepared to wait as everything is made to order.  Totally worth it, and you will be occupied by reading the rest of the menu items, plotting your next order a week later.
yelp:train:204017.para:
D'lish doesn't require further critique, yet my affection for it compels me to share.  

Assistance I can offer involves immersing their sandwiches, wraps, or flatbreads in their chipotle aioli - a transformative move. It elevates their already mouthwatering cuisine.  

Despite being categorized as 'fast food,' anticipate a bit of patience as each item is crafted individually. The experience is entirely rewarding, and you'll find yourself engrossed in perusing the menu, planning your subsequent visit a week ahead.

yelp:train:204132.orig: Nick's is a great little neighborhood Italian place. Of which there are not many in Phoenix.  It's small and intimate, the food is consistently good; my husband is always impressed with how fresh the fish and seafood is - we do live in the desert. He grew up on the east coast, lots of good Italian and fresh seafood so the fact that they make him happy says something.  Service is always good, Orlando always knows who we are and takes good care of us. There was a time in the past where service was lacking, and it was something they were aware of which is why they had a \""now hiring servers\"" sign up. Shortly after, they had some new people about the place and service was back on point.  I've never had a dish I didn't like here, and I'm the kind of person who likes to try all the menu has to offer; sometimes seafood, sometimes chicken, sometimes veggie - ravioli, linguini etc... It's all good. A favorite of mine is the farfalle salmon, it's a repeat on occasion.  Check out Nick's!
yelp:train:204132.para: Nick's offers a delightful, cozy Italian dining experience in Phoenix, a rarity in the area. The ambiance is quaint and personal, with the cuisine consistently excellent. My spouse is frequently amazed by the freshness of their seafood, despite living in arid conditions. Having been raised on the east coast with a penchant for Italian and fresh seafood, the fact that Nick's satisfies him speaks volumes. The service is consistently commendable, with Orlando being familiar and attentive to our needs. There was a period when service was subpar, but they were conscious of this issue, which led to a "now hiring servers" notice. This prompted the introduction of new staff, and service quality has since improved. I've never encountered a dish I didn't enjoy at Nick's, and I'm an adventurous eater who enjoys sampling the entire menu, including seafood, chicken, and vegetarian options like ravioli and linguini. The farfalle salmon is a standout dish that I often return to. Don't miss out on Nick's!

I endured discomfort and it wasn't due to an allergy. My first attempt at two-week lash extensions seemed like a bargain, so I decided to try it out. 

-The extensions should be placed above your natural lashes, not beneath.
-The salon's manager incorrectly positioned my lashes under my natural ones, near the waterline.
-I expressed my discomfort and the sensation of foreign objects in my eyes. She dismissed my concerns, claiming the lashes were merely "stiff" and would adjust over time.
-I suffered for several days, even using a warm cloth to soak them repeatedly.
-Some lashes began to fall out within a week, along with my natural lashes.
-I was left with lashes that were thinner and damaged.

After voicing my complaint to the salon manager, I spoke with the owner. The manager, a young woman with long hair, insisted I might have had a reaction and ignored her incorrect application. She offered a refund, but it didn't satisfy me. The owner called me, was courteous, and offered to remove the extensions and process a refund. I accepted the offer and went for the refund and removal. The solution...

yelp:train:204873.orig:
This is a terrific homewares store!  Great selections of many categories of merchandise.  It ain't cheap, but it's all *quality* stuff. 

Most of the people are knowledgeable & happily helpful.

Almost everything I've bought here is completely satisfying.  On a rare occasion I've taken something back -- they simply replaced it or refunded my money.  No big deal about it.

Whenever I need something along their line, BB&B is where I go first.   Then I don't have to go anywhere else second.
yelp:train:204873.para:
This home goods shop is exceptional!  It offers a wide array of products across various categories, though it comes with a higher price tag. However, the items are all top-notch. 

The majority of customers are well-informed and cheerfully assistive. 

I've found that nearly all my purchases here have been thoroughly gratifying. On the off chance I've returned an item, they've either provided a replacement or issued a refund without any hassle. 

Whenever I require items similar to theirs, BB&B is my go-to place. This means I don't need to search elsewhere.

yelp:train:205171.orig: Overpriced items both in the store and on the menu compared to other kosher places in the area.
yelp:train:205171.para: Items with inflated prices are found both in the shop and on the dining menu, standing out as more costly than similar kosher establishments nearby.

yelp:train:205207.orig: I have been a customer of Wells Fargo for a year and have deposited a good amount of money.  Since now the economy sucks and I dont have a job my account overdrafted.  I will be getting money on the 1st to pay off my overdraft.  The overdraft department has called me non stop and been very rude, treating me like I am lower than dirt.  Im sorry  but I thought I was still a customer.  Today Briane from that department hung up on me and was very rude.  I cannot stand a business that treats their customers like best friends as long as you are giving them money but then are complete ass holes because of circumstance.  I DO NOT RECOMEND THIS BANK TO ANYONE!!!  I hate banks period but this one needs to be gone.  This actual location has some of the nicest tellers but overall I HATE WELLS FARGO! I hope they all know they could be me tomorrow with no job.
yelp:train:205207.para: As a patron of Wells Fargo for the past year, I've accumulated a significant sum in my account. However, due to the current economic downturn and unemployment, my account has gone into overdraft. I'm expecting funds on the 1st to settle this debt. The overdraft team has been persistently contacting me in a disrespectful manner, making me feel devalued. I apologize for my reaction, but I assumed I was still a valued customer. Today, Briane from that team abruptly ended the call rudely. I am appalled by a company that appears friendly and supportive as long as they're profiting, but turns hostile when faced with unfortunate situations. I strongly advise against choosing this bank for anyone. While I generally dislike banks, I believe Wells Fargo deserves to be replaced. I hope they understand that anyone could be in my position tomorrow.

yelp:train:205251.orig: Just got home from a private event at Polar Ice and it went great! Leanne, the event coordinator, was great to work with and she made the process of getting everything together very painless, especially since we're a student organization at ASU. I came in a little early before our event to make sure everything was in the clear, and it went off without a hitch. This was just my second time being here, but it's very clean, tons of space in the lobby area, and our group had a really good time.
yelp:train:205251.para: Returning from a confidential gathering at Polar Ice, I found it to be a success! Leanne, the organizer, was exceptionally helpful and streamlined the preparation process, particularly as a student group at ASU. I arrived ahead of time to confirm all was set, and everything proceeded smoothly. This was my second visit, and I was impressed by the cleanliness, ample lobby space, and the enjoyable experience for our group.

yelp:train:205463.orig: its not the best mexican food, buts its good..  the homemade tortillas are very good..
yelp:train:205463.para: While not the top-tier Mexican cuisine, it still delivers a satisfying taste, particularly praising the quality of the homemade tortillas.

yelp:train:205563.orig:
This place rocks. I chose it as payment from a buddy at work whom I had picked up a couple of pounds of chorizo from Bill's Market over the weekend for.  Man am I glad that we went here. I had read the reviews on yelp and even reached out to my fb network.  Most of the pre-meal feedback I had received was positive and I was confident that I was going to get a good meal.  

I drove up there (the place is at Via Linda and 90th next to Teakwoods) after viewing the menu on-line and had already narrowed down my sandwich choices to a couple.  Walking up to the restaurant I noticed seating for about a dozen or so folks outside. Walking inside I was immediately hit by the aromas of warm bread, baked goods, and other goodness. 

After double checking the menu and seeing that the soup of the day was chili (sounded good but not enough to deter me from ordering a sandwich today), I was ready to order one of their signature  sandwiches, the Long Trail. However I will have to wait for another day to get properly introduced to a sandwich that is constructed by their own roasted beef with crumbled bacon on sourdough with peppered horse radish mayo, muenster cheese, lettuce, tomato, red onion,
yelp:train:205563.para:
This spot is fantastic. I selected it as a reward from a colleague I had assisted in acquiring some chorizo from Bill's Market during the weekend. I'm extremely pleased that we decided to dine here. I had perused the Yelp reviews and even contacted my Facebook connections for insights. The pre-dining feedback I had gathered was largely favorable, which bolstered my confidence in enjoying a satisfying meal. 

I arrived at the location (located at Via Linda and 90th, adjacent to Teakwoods) after browsing the menu online and had already pinned down my sandwich options to a few. Upon approaching the eatery, I observed seating for approximately a dozen people outside. Upon entering, I was immediately enveloped by the scents of fresh bread, baked treats, and other delightful aromas. 

After verifying the menu and noting that the soup of the day was chili (which I found appealing but not enough to prevent me from ordering a sandwich for the day), I was prepared to order one of their trademark sandwiches, the Long Trail. However, I'll have to postpone my introduction to a sandwich that is meticulously crafted by their own roasted beef, crumbled bacon, sourdough, peppered horse radish mayo, muenster cheese, lettuce, tomato, and red onion.

yelp:train:205865.orig: When I moved into my place a year ago, I was talked into \""locking in my rate\"" for 5 yrs. OK, it was a little higher than the standard rate, but they assured me in the long run, it would be worth it since the rates will never go up. OK, I fell for it, I signed up- at the higher rate. 7 months later, I got a price increase.....what??? So I called COX. Customer service reps says I'm not on the plan where rates are locked in, and supposedly had no idea what I was talking about and could find no notes relating to the conversation I had less than a year ago. I worked in a call center- I KNOW conversations are captured.  I promptly cancelled and called Dish. Service has been great and price is way cheaper. And the techs that come out actually WORK for Dish...not the shady contractors that COX hires that don't even have the right equipment for the job (the idiot they sent to me didn't even have a ladder!). Not a big fan of Century Link for my internet, but I wont give COX another dime.
yelp:train:205865.para: Upon relocating a year back, I was persuaded to commit to a 5-year fixed rate with a slightly elevated cost, under the belief that it would be beneficial in the long term as rates are expected to remain stable. Regrettably, I was misled and agreed to the higher rate. After 7 months, I was surprised to receive a rate hike. I reached out to COX, and their customer service representatives informed me that I was not enrolled in the fixed rate plan and had apparently misunderstood the previous discussion. Given my experience in a call center, I am aware that conversations are recorded. Consequently, I immediately terminated the service and switched to Dish. The service quality at Dish has been excellent, and the cost is significantly lower. Moreover, the Dish technicians genuinely work for the company, unlike the unreliable contractors employed by COX, who lacked the necessary tools, as evidenced by the technician who arrived without a ladder. I am not pleased with Century Link for my internet service, and I will not consider COX for future payments.

yelp:train:206032.orig: I thought Canada was bad with communication companies, but COX in Phx AZ. is the worst , at least in Canada you have three choices and they are more technological advanced, then COX. everything in these previous reviews have also happened to us. no need to repeat the same lousy customer service, reliability issues and tech product offering.\nWhy worry about ISIS when you have Cox.
yelp:train:206032.para: I previously believed Canada had issues with telecom providers, but COX in Phoenix, AZ. stands out as particularly disappointing, especially when compared to the three more technologically sophisticated options available in Canada. The negative experiences highlighted in past reviews also resonate with our own, making it clear that there's no need to endure the same poor customer service, unreliability, and subpar technology offerings again. Instead of fretting over ISIS, it's better to consider the superior alternatives available in Canada.

yelp:train:206242.orig: Great food at a great price and always with a smile. The atmosphere is bright and friendly. I have been going to AZ Bread since it opened and there isn't a better breakfast or lunch place in the Valley. It just doesn't get any better.
yelp:train:206242.para: Delicious cuisine offered at affordable rates, accompanied by a cheerful demeanor. The ambiance exudes warmth and friendliness. I've frequented AZ Bread from its inception and it remains unrivaled as the top spot for breakfast or lunch in the region. It consistently surpasses expectations.

yelp:train:206364.orig:
This is one of the dirtiest gas stations I have ever encountered.  A little power-washing would go a long way.  Or, if that is too difficult, perhaps try simply emptying the overflowing trash cans periodically?  

At any given time, a minimum of 3 of the 12 pumps are out of order.  The ones that do work are covered with scratched-in graffiti markings.  Classy.

The only redeeming quality is that the gas is usually a few cents cheaper than nearby competitors.  The only reason I keep coming back.

I guess you really do get what you pay for...
yelp:train:206364.para:
This gas station is among the most unclean I've seen. A bit of cleaning could significantly improve the situation. Alternatively, if that's not feasible, consider regularly disposing of the trash cans that are overflowing. 

Typically, at least 3 out of 12 pumps are non-functional. The operational pumps are marred with graffiti etchings. It's far from elegant. 

The sole positive aspect is that the fuel price is often lower than that of nearby rivals. This is the sole reason for my repeated visits. 

It seems that you indeed receive what you pay for.

yelp:train:206745.orig: Been doing business with bookman's for years but I guess the economy finally caught up to them. The store credit offer on collectables or music related items is really low ball nowadays. It is not even worth the time and gas to be honest. I suggest doing some checking as what the value of your items are so you are not scammed at trade in OR purchase. Some of the items for sale are overpriced and going more than new retail. If the tag says rare that means you can find it on the internet in abundance. Heck sell your stuff on the internet or give it to goodwill. I hope things improve but for now I'm moving on.
yelp:train:206745.para: I've been a loyal customer of bookman's for quite some time, but it seems the economic downturn has impacted them. The current store credit deals for collectibles or music merchandise are disappointingly low. In my view, it's not worth the effort and expense to visit. I recommend evaluating the worth of your possessions to avoid being cheated at trade-ins or buying. Some items listed are excessively priced, even surpassing new retail costs. If an item is labeled as rare, it's likely easily available online. Consider selling your items online or donating them to charity. I'm optimistic about a turnaround, but I'm currently shifting my focus.

yelp:train:206784.orig:
I rented here on 4/26-4/27 and can fully agree with the other reviewers.

60 minute wait to get a car and 30 minute wait just to return it.

The place seems understaffed with no processes in place.

STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS!
yelp:train:206784.para:
From 4/26-4/27, I stayed and concur with the sentiments expressed by other reviewers.

A 60-minute delay was experienced in securing a vehicle and a 30-minute hold-up occurred during the return process.

The establishment appears to be understaffed with a lack of established procedures.

It is strongly advised to avoid this location under any circumstances.

yelp:train:207006.orig: Chinese food in buffet.  Not planning on visiting here again.  I am not a fan of employees cleaning windows right next to the table I am eating at.  Spraying window cleaner by my plate is not a good idea. :)  \nThe food was so-so and service OK.  What else to say?  Wish I could like the place, its close to home.
yelp:train:207006.para:
Buffet featuring Chinese cuisine. I won't be returning to this establishment. Displeasure with staff wiping windows adjacent to my dining area. The act of window cleaning near my plate is undesirable. 😊 

The food quality was average and the service was satisfactory. Beyond that, I'd like to express a desire to appreciate this venue, given its proximity to my residence.

yelp:train:207109.orig:
Ok, so this ISN'T new.  It is actually a correction.  I didn't realize until I dropped off my car this morning that there's another place with a VERY similar name--SORRY!  

I kept getting coupons in the mail for this place, so I decided to check it out.  I recently had an auto repair shop tell me I needed to replace both front & rear brakes and wanted a second quote before forking over cash I didn't really want to part with.  

They did a full inspection and not only negated what the first auto place told me but provided a report showing how much 'brake' life I had left before I needed to bring it in for replacement.  They could've just taken my money but this demonstrated they wanted to keep me as a customer and that's exactly what they got.

I now take my car there for routine oil changes and other work (e.g., engine flush, etc) when necessary.

7/1/08  Just dropped off my car for routine service.  They've now added free wifi for customers who want to wait @ the shop.  I luv me some free wifi.
yelp:train:207109.para:
This isn't a fresh revelation; it's actually a rectification. I didn't become aware until I handed in my vehicle today that there's another location with an extremely similar name--my apologies! 

I had been receiving discount vouchers for this establishment, prompting me to investigate. Recently, an automotive repair facility advised me to replace both front and rear brakes and requested a second estimate before spending money I was hesitant to part with. 

They conducted a comprehensive examination and not only contradicted the initial advice but also presented a document indicating the remaining lifespan of my brakes before requiring replacement. They could have simply accepted my payment, but this showed their desire to retain my patronage, which they successfully achieved. 

I now prefer to bring my car to this place for regular oil changes and other necessary services (such as engine flushing, etc.) when needed. 

7/1/08 - I just dropped off my car for routine maintenance. They've now included complimentary internet access for customers who wish to wait at the shop. I appreciate free internet access.

yelp:train:207464.orig: If you're looking for a dining experience at Fry's deli area you're better off going to an actual sit down restaurant.  Fry's \""dining style\"" food in the deli area is very substandard at the best.
yelp:train:207464.para: For a superior dining experience, it's advisable to choose a sit-down restaurant over Fry's deli area, where the quality of their food is notably lacking.

yelp:train:207763.orig: This is a busy BofA location. There are plenty of tellers though being near a light rail location and mall may be why this location stays pretty active. There are in house representatives to assist with all your banking needs including personal loans, business banking, finical and other banking services. This location has plenty of bilingual Spanish speaking tellers to meet the needs of those whom may need to speak Spanish. \n\nThe teller who helped me with both my personal and business needs was friendly. She also thanked me for coming in.
yelp:train:207763.para: This bank branch is bustling, likely due to its proximity to a light rail station and shopping center. It offers a range of banking services, including personal and business loans, finance, and other banking services, with a team of in-house representatives ready to assist. The branch is equipped with Spanish-speaking tellers to cater to Spanish-speaking customers. The teller who attended to my personal and business banking requirements was amiable and expressed gratitude for my visit.

yelp:train:208101.orig:
Studio 3-26 is legit!  I get my haircut by Luis and haven't been disappointed once!  I was nervous, just having moved to Phx to try someone new, but Peter, the owner, recommended him and he lived up to his billing!
Every stylist there is talented and friendly....you can tell they all enjoy what they do and where they're at.  Peter has done an awesome job at finding the right group of stylists that genuinely care about the quality of their work.

Highly, highly recommend.  Any guy looking for a good cut, go see Luis!
yelp:train:208101.para: Studio 3-26 is genuinely excellent! I've been getting my hair styled by Luis and have been consistently satisfied. Initially, I was apprehensive after relocating to Phoenix and trying a new stylist, but Peter, the proprietor, suggested him and he has indeed met his expectations! All the stylists in the studio are not only skilled but also amiable. It's evident that they take pleasure in their profession and their location. Peter has successfully assembled a team of stylists who are truly invested in delivering high-quality work. \n\nI wholeheartedly endorse this place. If you're in search of a top-notch haircut, I wholeheartedly suggest visiting Luis!

yelp:train:208142.orig: Typical Chipotle flavor but the service staff always seems annoyed and they're light on that guac we all pay to have added.
yelp:train:208142.para: The usual Chipotle taste is present, yet the service team consistently appears irritated, and they often skimp on the generous guacamole that customers expect to be included.

yelp:train:208458.orig: First I am not a sushi expert. I do know when I like something. I have been trying places close to where I live. There are many places close to me in Peoria. Until you start looking you don't realize just how many places there are. This is one place I had not been. So far this is the best place I have tried. Remember this was just the first visit so until I get in several visits and try more of the menu will I really know how much I like them. The star rating could go up or down. The service was great. The meal was about $2.00 more than I have been paying for something similar. It was better tasting. Fresh distinct tastes. I am looking forward to a repeat visit.
yelp:train:208458.para: I'm not a connoisseur of sushi, but I can discern my preferences. I've been sampling nearby eateries in Peoria. Initially, the abundance of options was not apparent. This particular spot was new to me, and it has so far proven to be my top choice. It's important to note that this is my first experience, and I'll need to sample more dishes to fully gauge my enjoyment. The establishment's rating is subject to change. The service impressed me, and although the price was slightly higher than usual, the superior flavors and freshness have made it worthwhile. I'm eager to return.

yelp:train:208459.orig: I've been here many times picking up sushi for my mother but I have never tried any. I'm a recent fan of sushi (yeah....I know, something's wrong with me) and have been trying different types at various places. This place is one of the good ones!\nI tried the crunch roll and the teriyaki beef roll. Both were amazing! I got it special ordered since I do not like avocado (not my fault, it's my brothers!) and they were very accommodating. Both were perfect and the portions were huge! I have leftovers (who would guess?) for tomorrow. Can't wait. :)\nWill recommend this place to others and I will be back again.
yelp:train:208459.para: I've frequented this spot numerous times to procure sushi for my mom, yet I've never sampled it myself. I've recently developed a liking for sushi (odd, I admit) and have been sampling various kinds at different locations. This establishment stands out as one of the excellent ones! I sampled the crunch roll and the teriyaki beef roll, both of which were fantastic! I requested a special order due to my dislike for avocado (blame it on my siblings), and they were incredibly understanding. Both dishes were spot-on and the servings were generous! I have leftovers (unexpectedly) for tomorrow. I'm eagerly anticipating it. I'll definitely suggest this place to others and plan to revisit.

yelp:train:208743.orig: Meh! it's just OK. The fries were over cooked and the burger was just another burger. Nothing to write home about.
yelp:train:208743.para: The experience was mediocre. The fries were excessively fried and the burger was unremarkable, lacking any noteworthy qualities. It wasn't particularly impressive.

yelp:train:209573.orig: Some of the best service of any Starbucks - reasonably fast with an upbeat smile to help start my day on the right foot.  Has some of the \""local\"" coffee shop vibe to it, even though it is a chain.
yelp:train:209573.para: At certain Starbucks locations, one can experience top-notch service that's prompt and accompanied by a cheerful demeanor, setting a positive tone for the day. Despite being part of a larger network, these spots maintain a cozy, neighborhood coffee shop atmosphere.

yelp:train:210207.orig:
Co-workers and I decided to order take-out from Pei Wei for dinner, last Friday night. This location seemed like it would be the closest to work, but still ended up being quite a drive. With the construction going on near ASU, it took us nearly an hour to get there and back.

When I went to eat my food, was rather amazed to find a staple lying on top of my rice underneath the lid! Also found what appeared to be some facial hair in our chicken lettuce wraps as did my manager in his entree. Aside from all that, the food seemed subpar to the many other Pei Wei locations I have visited. 

Tossed the food and didn't even bother to call and complain.
Definitely will not be going back.
yelp:train:210207.para:
Last Friday, my colleagues and I opted for take-out from Pei Wei for our meal. We thought this spot would be near our workplace, but it turned out to be a lengthy drive due to nearby construction at ASU. It took us almost an hour to reach and return from the place.

Upon eating, I was surprised to see a common item placed on my rice under the lid. I also noticed facial hair in our chicken lettuce wraps, which my manager found in his dish. The overall quality of the food was disappointing compared to other Pei Wei outlets I've experienced. 

We didn't make a fuss and simply discarded the food. I'm certain I won't be returning to this place.

yelp:train:210309.orig: The meat here tastes nasty-so nasty I had to send it back.  I tried a curry chicken dish and the beef with eggplant.  The curry was good if it was without the chicken. When I sent it back the lady got so mad and started yelling in her language =/  I felt so weird.  What horrible customer service!  And then she said to me, \""that is the last eggplant today-NO MORE.\"" I was like oooookaaayyy whatever that meant lol  I would never ever come back.  The restaurant looks dirty and there is no health grade rating posted anywhere (and we all know why).  I wonder what they are trying to hide.  Anyways, do yourself a favor and go to Thai Chili.
yelp:train:210309.para: The flavor of the meat served was extremely unpleasant, prompting me to return it. I sampled a chicken curry and a beef with eggplant dish, but the curry was enjoyable sans chicken. Upon returning the dish, the server became extremely upset and began shouting in her native tongue, which made me feel uneasy. I found the customer service to be appalling. She then informed me, "That's the last eggplant dish for today - no more." I couldn't grasp the significance of her statement. I would not consider revisiting this establishment. The place appeared unclean, and there was no visible health inspection rating displayed. I speculated on the possible reasons for this omission. In conclusion, I advise you to choose Thai Chili instead.

yelp:train:210319.orig:
We get most of our food at Fry's when we do our Big grocery shopping. For the most part their prices are good.
 My family drinks almond milk and we have been buying it at Fry's for years and it is always next to the cow's milk. A few weeks ago they moved it and nobody in the store knew where it was. It literally took me an extra half hour to finally find the almond milk. The manager had to wheel a big crate out, full of almond milk.

They had it in the back the whole time, nobody had ever designated a spot for it! Now you can find your cold almond milk on isle 6 with the cheese!!!
yelp:train:210319.para:
When we conduct our major shopping at Fry's, we typically purchase our food there. Generally, their pricing is quite reasonable.
 My family prefers almond milk, and we've been purchasing it from Fry's for a long time. Recently, they relocated it, and no one in the store was aware of its new location. It took me an additional half-hour to locate the almond milk. The manager had to bring out a large carton filled with almond milk.

It was actually in the back all along, and no specific spot had been assigned for it! Now you can easily locate your chilled almond milk on isle 6, alongside the cheese!

yelp:train:210493.orig: Conveniently inside Collision center of Peoria. Staff is nice. Got my rental was on a quarter tank. Return with a quarter tank. Nothing else to say. I had my company account which made process super easy.
yelp:train:210493.para: Located within the Peoria Collision center, the staff's friendliness was evident. I managed to return my rental vehicle with a quarter tank, as instructed. The process was seamless due to my company account. No further comments.

yelp:train:210829.orig: Great, authentic Mexican just outside of downtown. Very friendly, attentive staff. Great menu advice. Chili rellenos were absolutely deee-lish.
yelp:train:210829.para: Fantastic, genuine Mexican cuisine located near the city center. The team is incredibly welcoming and helpful. Excellent guidance on the menu. The chili rellenos were truly mouthwatering.

yelp:train:211382.orig: Another night of ordering pizza 1 and a half hours ago, and it's still not here. I'm not sure if I should get delivery from here anymore. I ordered at 18:30 (6:30PM) right after my sons soccer practice. Now it's after 20:00(8PM) past his bedtime and we are still waiting. Can the delivery service at this location get it together!?
yelp:train:211382.para: I've just placed a pizza order for tonight, which was done around 6:30 PM following my boys' soccer session, and it's already past 8 PM with no sign of the delivery. I'm contemplating whether to continue using this delivery service here due to their apparent inefficiency. It seems they're struggling to deliver on time!

yelp:train:211445.orig: I enjoyed Julia Baker's chocolates. I am more of a dark chocolate kind of person, so those are the only ones that I tried. I don't remember the names of all of the chocolates I had, but they were all pretty good. There was one with nuts on the outside and a salted caramel on the inside that was really good, and even the passion fruit one (which I was very suspicious of) turned out to be pretty good.\n\nI would definitely come back while visiting Phoenix.
yelp:train:211445.para: I found pleasure in tasting the chocolates made by Julia Baker. As someone who prefers dark chocolate, I sampled only those varieties. I can't recall the specific names of all the chocolates I tried, but they were all enjoyable. Among them, a nut-covered chocolate with salted caramel inside stood out as particularly delicious, and surprisingly, the passion fruit chocolate, which initially seemed dubious, was also quite pleasing. I would certainly consider returning during my time in Phoenix.

yelp:train:212940.orig:
It's unfortunate that I have to write a bad review- but I believe it's important to get this out there. This is especially for those that are non-locals. 

Thursday night, my friend and I needed a ride back to our hotel. It was already late and we could not take the light rail back because it had already made its last round.

Strike 1: Driver did not know where he was going & he was on his cell phone asking for directions.
Strike 2: I knew that he knew a more direct way to get to our hotel; instead he chose to take a scenic route through a residential area. Therefore, making the drive longer than it should have been. 
Strike 3: THE METER WAS NOT RUNNING. So he basically just said a random price when we got to our hotel.

We were picked up in the US AIRWAYS CENTER and our hotel was on Central & Osborn. We paid $12 for the fare; I guess I should assume that is a decent price. However, the service was unacceptable from my perspective. The meter should have been on.

PS. they also DBA as Elite Taxi Cab.
yelp:train:212940.para:
Regrettably, I find myself compelled to pen a negative critique, yet I consider it crucial to share this feedback. This is particularly relevant for visitors unfamiliar with the area. 

On a Thursday evening, my companion and I required transportation back to our lodging. It was past the usual hours and the light rail was no longer operational. 

First off, the driver seemed lost and was distracted by his phone, seeking guidance. Secondly, I was aware that he could have taken a more direct path to our hotel, but he opted for a leisurely route through a neighborhood, unnecessarily extending our journey. Thirdly, the meter was inoperative, leading to an arbitrary fare upon arrival at our hotel. 

We were collected at the US Airways Center, with our accommodation located on Central & Osborn. The fare was $12, which I would typically regard as reasonable. However, from my viewpoint, the level of service was unsatisfactory. The meter should have been functioning. 

Note: The service was also marketed as Elite Taxi Cab.

yelp:train:213352.orig: I love Costa Vida. Their salads are delicious, it must be the fresh tortillas that are layered on the bottom.Customer service is great and the food is consistently good. My only issue with this restaurant is when you are nickel and dimed for things like sour cream, extra dressing, etc...I'm not a fan of that. But the pros outweigh the cons and I will continue to eat here.
yelp:train:213352.para: Costa Vida is a favorite of mine, particularly for their scrumptious salads, likely due to the fresh tortillas at the base. The customer support is outstanding and the food quality remains high. However, I do have reservations about being charged for small additions like sour cream and extra dressing. cant say much about the product!!! used them 2 times not too picky about car washes because anyone can do a better job by themselves. I was just being lazy and it cost me!! 

I'm writing this review because they offered me a deal that cost 20 bucks for 1 month and i could take my car there as many times as i wanted ... this was true but i realized after the 3rd month these guys were charging me $31.95 every month after and i didnt sign up for that.

So a quick call to the bank got back the 5 months of fraud charges back into my account no problem.
yelp:train:215972.para:
I'm unable to express much about the item; I utilized it twice without being overly particular about car wash services, as anyone could potentially outperform them. I was just being lazy, and it ended up costing me. 

I'm penning this review due to the offer I received, which was $20 for a monthly subscription, allowing me to use the service as often as I liked. However, I discovered after three months that they started charging me $31.95 monthly, a price I hadn't agreed to. 

I contacted my banker, Bud, who informed me that they were manually entering transactions each month. This implies that the arrangement wasn't set up for direct payment, and my credit card details were being circulated. Consequently, they were engaging in fraudulent activities. 

A swift call to the bank resulted in the recovery of the five months' worth of fraudulent charges, which were seamlessly restored to my account.

I was thoroughly unimpressed! I'd choose In N Out over this any day! Luckily, I was in costume and got 15% off my purchase during the Halloween period. Although my burger didn't appear charred, it certainly had a burnt flavor. The cheese quantity was subpar (just one slice) for $0.99, and it was rather bland. The pickle/ relish mix was downright disgusting, and the fries tasted like those from Burger King. I had hoped for Onion Rings, but they were unavailable. 

While I know you can customize your order, as my first visit (and likely my last), I opted to try the sandwich as it should be. 

Sierra, the sole employee, was the highlight of the entire establishment! She was exceptional! She delivered our food and inquired if we needed anything, like Ketchup. Instead of merely pointing out its location since it's self-serve, she fetched it for us. She didn't have to go that extra mile. She exceeded her duties to enhance our dining experience. Her constant smile throughout was a pleasant contrast to the other staff members. I believe she deserves a raise and promotion! 

Additionally, aside from the 10-minute wait in line,

yelp:train:220618.orig: Dismissively unhelpful. I popped in to grab a birthday card and couldn't find the corresponding envelope. When I asked the girl that was working if she had any more, I was told that they were mixed up, but on the rack (they were not). She never made any attempt to help me look or even bothered to look at me while she spoke. I replied, \""So that's it?\"" and received no response. As I stood there flabbergasted, the gentleman working the counter walked over, silently pulled out a box of miscellaneous envelopes, placed them on the counter, and walked away without acknowledgement.
yelp:train:220618.para: Indifferently unsupportive. I entered to pick up a birthday card and couldn't locate the matching envelope. When I inquired the employee if there were more, she informed me of a mix-up, yet they were displayed on the shelf (they weren't). She showed no effort to assist me in searching or to pay attention to me during our conversation. I questioned, "So, that's the end?" and got no reply. As I stood there astonished, the man operating the counter approached, silently retrieved a box of various envelopes, set them on the counter, and left without any recognition.

yelp:train:221182.orig: The worst cleaner ever.  When I arrived to pick up my jacket, it was still in their dirty laundry basket.  I will never go back.  This place is unorganized & messy!
yelp:train:221182.para:
Upon retrieving my coat, I discovered it was still languishing in their filthy laundry pile. I've decided this establishment is chaotic and disorderly, and I'm not returning.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original sentiment of dissatisfaction and the intention to never return to the place due to its untidiness. The length is roughly the same, and the topic of a negative experience at a laundry service is preserved.)

yelp:train:221316.orig: Very bad experience with couples romance pkg which included 80 minute massage and the partner mud. We started with the mud which was horrible. We were put into a small   Pitch black room and told we had 4 minutes to put mudd on each other. We were told to sit in the most uncomfortable plastic seats which were ice cold until the light came on approx 40 minutes later. \""Torture\"" would be a better description. We exited the cell after about 10 minutes which felt like an hour. \nThe entire spa is very brightly lit and the employees are very loud so loud many couples were complaining. Both of us thought our massages were just average certainly not worth $500.00. We tried to express our dissatisfaction when we left but there was nobody left at the front desk. We were asked to pay in advance of our services which struck me as odd since we were staying at the Palazzo. There are so many great spas in Vegas including the MGM grand, Wynn, Red Rocks etc. Go somewhere else this spa sucks. Worst spa experience ever and $700.00. Bad bad bad! Not even worth one star.
yelp:train:221316.para: Terrible experience at the couples romance package, featuring an 80-minute massage and partner mud. The mud was dreadful, and we were confined to a pitch-dark, uncomfortable plastic chair for about 4 minutes. The chilling seats remained cold until the lighting was restored after roughly 40 minutes. The situation could be aptly described as "torture." After roughly 10 minutes, we felt as if time had stretched to an hour. The spa's bright lighting and boisterous staff were distracting, with many couples voicing their complaints. Our massages were mediocre and not justified by the $500 price tag. Attempts to convey our dissatisfaction were futile as the front desk was empty. The requirement to prepay for services seemed peculiar, especially since we were lodged at the Palazzo. With numerous excellent spas in Vegas like the MGM Grand, Wynn, and Red Rocks, we advise others to avoid this establishment. It was the worst spa experience we've ever had, and the $700 fee was utterly unjustified. A mere one-star rating would be a generous assessment.

yelp:train:221421.orig: This place is a hidden little gem in Henderson.  When I lived on this side of town we would go here exclusively for the Gyro's.  The sauce they put on it is amazing.  Also, the fries with the garlic sauce is a favorite of my boyfriends.  This is a mom and pop kind of place and you are served by their family.  As for the other food on the menu....I've never tried any of it.  Whenever we go to another greek place we always talk about the greek bistro and how we wish we lived closer to it.
yelp:train:221421.para: In Henderson, this establishment remains a well-kept secret treasure. During my residency on this part of town, we would always head here solely for the Gyros, praising the exceptional sauce they use. The garlic-infused fries are also a hit with my boyfriend. It's a family-run business, with the family personally serving the customers. I haven't sampled the other menu items, but whenever we visit another Greek restaurant, we invariably reminisce about this place and lament our distance from it.

yelp:train:221813.orig: So its been an hour and 30mins and just got a phone call trying to verify my address, im guessing the drivers lost. yelp:train:221813.para:
After an hour and 30 minutes, I received a call to confirm my address, likely indicating the delivery personnel were misplaced. It's perplexing to encounter delivery staff who are unable to reach your location. I'm truly disheartened, especially since my previous experience with this service. To add to the frustration, the food arrived 1 hour and 40 minutes later and was served cold. I appreciate the monetary compensation of $25 for this inconvenience.

UPDATE: The food arrived at the 1 hour and 40 minutes mark, but it was unfortunately cold. I'm grateful for the $25 compensation for this unfortunate situation.

yelp:train:221993.orig: When in Vegas and you like cigars, everyone should come spend some time at Casa! (as we refer to it as) LOL Great Mojitos, cigars are Vegas prices but the selection is good and always try the Casa Fuente house selection! Still haven't had a cuban coffee here yet but I will!!! yelp:train:221993.para: If you're in Las Vegas and enjoy cigars, it's a must to visit Casa (our nickname)! Haha, it's definitely a trip worth taking, and then head over to the Mirage's patio next door for a Rhumbar to cap off your experience! Haha.

yelp:train:222123.orig: aaah love coming here!  The Pimp Juice and Peach Bellini are my fave.  Get an extra shot with your concoction, it's def worth it!\n\nAlso, you can bring back your refill cups and get refills at a discount.  But make sure they give you the discount cos I've gotten jipped at another location before.
yelp:train:222123.para: The delight of visiting this place is undeniable! I adore The Pimp Juice and Peach Bellini. It's definitely worth the extra shot you can add to your mix. Plus, you can return your reusable cups for discounted refills. Just ensure you receive the discount, as I've previously been shortchanged at a different spot.

yelp:train:222838.orig: Had to wait while they tried to fill up the shuttle departing the airport but it gets better.  On the return leg they no showed our 5:20pm pick up and we had to call to be put on the next shuttle which was in one hour getting us very close to missing the flight.  The driver told dispatch that he stopped but no-one was there.  Gray line was everywhere, they are the shuttle to take while in Vegas, Showtime sucked.
yelp:train:222838.para:
Faced a delay as they attempted to load the airport-bound shuttle, but the situation improved. The driver informed dispatch of a halted stop with no one present. The Gray line, serving as the Vegas shuttle, provided a less than satisfactory experience.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent, while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept roughly the same.)

yelp:train:223167.para: My second visit to California Pizza in LV Mirage was equally unsatisfactory as my initial experience. It was my friend's persuasion that led me here, and I must admit, the pizza didn't meet my standards. I might be more critical of pizza quality than others, but this didn't pass my criteria for a good pizza. Additionally, the cost for two pizzas and a soda exceeded $40, which seemed steep.

yelp:train:223321.para: This is my initial attempt at composing a critique. I urge you to steer clear of enrolling in this establishment! It's the most disappointing one I've encountered. yelp:train:223434.orig:
Maybe I'm the outlier here but I have no idea how or why this place exists. Do they even get enough business to turn a profit? Mad props to the owner for being able to create a business out of a personal passion, it just isn't an interest we share.

Store is small and exterior decor and signage is a bit tacky, IMO, but at least its distinctive? Inside you'll find everything you can possibly purchase that is related to Zombies, hence the name.

There's shirts and stickers and action figures and statues and movies and posters and various art, too. I may not understand it, but selection is large and everyone seems friendly.
yelp:train:223434.para: Possibly I'm the exception in this scenario, but I'm clueless about the purpose or the rationale behind its establishment. Is the business generating sufficient revenue to be profitable? Kudos to the proprietor for transforming a personal hobby into a commercial venture, though it doesn't align with our interests. The store's size is modest, and the exterior design and signage might be considered garish in my opinion, yet it stands out. Inside, you'll discover a vast array of items connected to Zombies, which justifies its moniker. The inventory includes shirts, stickers, action figures, statues, films, posters, and diverse artwork. yelp:train:224136.orig: As a local I have seen MANY Comedians. Carrot Top was hands down the best show, period. A solid \""10\"" no question about it. A must see for anyone regardless of where you live. Put this guys show on your bucket list.
yelp:train:224136.para: Being a resident, I've witnessed numerous stand-up performers. Carrot Top's act was unrivaled, undeniably earning a perfect score. It's essential viewing for everyone, irrespective of your location. Include this comedian's performance on your list of must-see events.

yelp:train:224140.orig:
Surprise, surprise. I did not think I was going to like this show. I don't think of myself as a Carrot Top type of person. Yes. And the comedienne who was Carrot Top's warm up act was not very good. Sorry. 

But then Carrot Top came on and almost immediately I was laughing. He was very funny! The prop comedy is okay, but I actually liked him better when he was doing straight stand up. It was a last minute decision to get tix and we were toward the back of the theater. But we could see well.

yelp:train:224140.para:

yelp:train:224322.para: For me, Golf Galaxy embodies \"The Joyful Haven,\" thanks to the amiable and supportive team, a vast array of fresh club sets, simulators, and retail options. They were really good, the meat was sweet but I do recommend only getting them as an appetizer unless you want a cold entree. My boyfriend of course got the filet mignon and lobster and the filet was cooked perfect and as well as the lobster. yelp:train:225051.para: I intended to take my partner out for a memorable birthday dinner, suggesting a new place instead of their usual spot, Mastro's. He was pleased with this decision, which was all I desired as it was his special day and I aimed to make it unique. However, I left feeling disappointed due to my own mistake of not selecting my preferred dish. We chose to skip the appetizer, as we typically don't finish our main courses. My original plan was to enjoy the stone crab appetizer and scallops, but with the decision against appetizers, I settled for the medium stone crab. Given the positive feedback on the stone crab, I thought it was essential to try it. It was delicious, with a sweet taste, but I advise it to be enjoyed as an appetizer to avoid a cold main course. My partner opted for the filet mignon and lobster, which were cooked to perfection, and he graciously shared some with me, understanding my dissatisfaction. The service was commendable, with the host welcoming us upon arrival and providing our names.

yelp:train:225280.orig: Called for a car to go to rent a car. Driver was nice and we felt safe unlike another car service which almost got us killed. Took us the route we expected and it came to the price we expected. Very satisfied and will call them when I go to Vegas again!
yelp:train:225280.para: Requested a vehicle for hire and were pleased with the driver's friendliness and our sense of security, especially in contrast to a different car rental service that nearly endangered us. The driver navigated the anticipated path and charged the expected fee. Our satisfaction is high, and we plan to use their service again during our next trip to Las Vegas.

yelp:train:225635.orig:
We have been to Sunset and Vines multiple times, and have always left satisfied, full, and happy.  The wine selection is superb, and if you're not sure what to get, just ask Max and he will definitely steer you right.  

As for the wait issues - if you come on an event night (concert, wine walk, holiday) - you will definitely wait for food, and if you don't have a reservation, you will wait for a table as well.  We have made reservations every time we came, with no issues in terms of wait.  that being said, the food is FANTASTIC!  We have never been disappointed with our food, and have ordered half the menu.  Sometimes they are out of certain cheeses or one or two appetizers, but they will substitute or make a recommendation, one just has to ask.

I have had the crab cakes, fried spinach, differet cheese selections, truffled Mac n cheese, vegetarian penne, and chicken piccata.  My husband has had various steaks, caesar salads, and some of my cheese :).  We have both enjoyed chocolate and fruit desserts - the poached pear is a must - save room!
yelp:train:225635.para:
We've frequented Sunset and Vines several times, each visit leaving us content, satiated, and joyful. The wine assortment is exceptional, and if you're uncertain about your choice, Max will undoubtedly guide you correctly. 

Regarding wait times - on event nights like concerts or wine tours, you can expect to wait for your meal. Without a reservation, you'll also face table waiting. However, we've always managed to secure reservations without any wait-related problems. The food quality is outstanding, and we've never been let down by our meals, often sampling half the menu. Occasionally, certain cheeses or appetizers may be unavailable, but they'll offer a substitute or suggest an alternative, provided you inquire.

I've savored dishes like crab cakes, fried spinach, various cheese options, truffled Mac n cheese, vegetarian penne, and chicken piccata. My partner has relished different steaks, Caesar salads, and some of my cheese selections. We both appreciate chocolate and fruit desserts, with the poached pear being a must-try - remember to save room!

yelp:train:225791.orig: This is a GREAT place to come to for passport photos, shipping, printing needs or copying. yelp:train:225791.para: Step into Aru & Sue, a fantastic spot for passport photos, shipping, printing, and copying services, conveniently situated within Smith's premises near the bank. They offer comprehensive, swift, and amiable service at unbeatable rates - just $6 for two passport photos. I'm eager to return and champion a modest, local enterprise that matches their exceptional friendliness and professionalism. They also provide notary services, faxing, shredding, and logo design expertise - truly impressive!

yelp:train:226113.orig: I went here on a Sunday evening. There were 4 of us in our party. We waited about 3 minutes at the front before one of the servers noticed us and said they would be right back. It was probably another 5 minutes before we could sit down and keep in mind there were only 4 or 5 other tables currently being used so it was pretty dead. When we received our food we were pretty disappointed. I ordered the filet medallions and so did my mom. I wanted mine medium and she wanted hers medium well. Mine was completely brown all the way through and hers had a slight pink in the middle so we switched. The mashed potatoes tasted like there was no seasoning and no milk or butter was used to make them. I mean who messes up mashed potatoes? I never got refills on my drinks and the server had to be hunted down to get a new steak knife that had fallen on the floor. The server came back with a fork and butter knife... I ended up just giving up my steak knife as the filet was not the best.\n\nI love steak houses but I left there wishing we had gone to outback. That's just sad. This might have been a fluke and they might have great food but I'm not willing to give it another chance.
yelp:train:226113.para: On a Sunday evening, a group of four of us visited this place. We had to wait for about three minutes at the entrance before a server acknowledged us and promised to return shortly. It took another five minutes before we could find a seat, and we observed that there were only a few other tables occupied, making the atmosphere quite quiet. When our meals arrived, we were quite disheartened. I had ordered the filet medallions, and my mother had the same, but I preferred mine medium while she wanted hers medium well. Unfortunately, my filet was entirely brown, and hers had a hint of pink in the center, leading us to exchange dishes. The mashed potatoes lacked seasoning and had no milk or butter, which was surprising. I also struggled to get refills on my drinks and had to search for a new steak knife that had dropped on the floor. The server brought back a fork and butter knife instead. In the end, I gave up my steak knife as the filet didn't meet my expectations. Despite my love for steak houses, I left feeling that we should have chosen Outback instead. This experience might have been an isolated incident, but I'm hesitant to give this place another try.

How to strip it, load it, clean it, oil it. In the 7 + years I've lived back out here, this is the first place I've gone that I felt genuinely welcomed. Thank you !
yelp:train:227306.para: I am overjoyed. \nThe team was incredibly supportive, clear, and made me feel at ease as if I belonged. Will made sure to cover every detail about safety, posture, and proper handling of the firearm, including stripping, loading, cleaning, and oiling. In the seven plus years I've resided here, this is the first location where I experienced true acceptance. I am deeply grateful!

yelp:train:227592.para: Scheduled a transmission fluid replacement appointment through their website for the New Year's Day. I was taken aback by their operational hours. The lack of quality service has solidified my decision not to utilize their services in the future. \n\nThis location has proven to be a letdown for one of my preferred car brands.

yelp:train:228012.orig: I have got to say they impressed me did not taste at all vegetarian great service friendly staff fresh food and drinks are awesome I love the food here a must try if you are in town..
yelp:train:228012.para: They left a positive impression on me, with no hint of vegetarian flavors, yet the service was commendable, staff was amiable, and the freshness of the food and drinks was exceptional. I highly recommend this place if you're visiting the area.

yelp:train:228104.orig:

yelp:train:228173.para: During my initial experience at a Sonic, it was satisfactory. The service was extremely sluggish, as we observed multiple vehicles ahead of us being attended to prior to us. yelp:train:228909.orig: Rented a car from Bugdet. A week later they bill me on top of my original bill $256.62. My original bill was less than $60. When my credit card statement came in I was pretty surprised to see the second charge. I knew they had a hold of $200 when that drops off after you return the car. I called to try and get an answer of why I was billed a second time and no one including the manager had an answer. I opened a dispute claim and they said they would contact me in 4 days. 4days passed and I heard nothing. I called back to find out the status and they told me that they had no idea why I was charged and that they would call me back about my claim. Do to their \""I could give a care less\"" attitude on the phone, I called my credit card company and reported it as a fraudulent charge. With several rental places to choose from, if Budget is the only one with a car left, take the bus.
yelp:train:228909.para:
After renting a vehicle from Budget, I was astonished to receive a bill a week later totaling $256.62, significantly higher than my initial charge of under $60. Upon reviewing my credit card statement, I noticed the unexpected additional charge. I attempted to clarify the situation by contacting them, but neither the staff nor the manager could provide a satisfactory explanation. I initiated a dispute claim, but after four days without any communication, I reached out again and was informed they were clueless about the extra charge and would get back to me regarding my claim. Frustrated by their indifferent response, I escalated the issue to my credit card company, marking the charge as fraudulent. Considering the availability of other rental options, I advised others to opt for public transportation if Budget was the sole provider.

yelp:train:229066.para: This spot is my buddy's favorite for chicken and grilled beef. I tried it before and was impressed by its deliciousness. yelp:train:229090.para: Avoid purchasing roundtrip tickets. The airport transfer was satisfactory. I arranged my return journey and they demanded to collect me 90 minutes ahead of their requirement. I called once more at 1:30 and they falsely claimed I was next in line. I endured being out in the cold rain for an hour after my scheduled pickup, while six other airport transports passed by, offering a much quicker route to the airport.

yelp:train:229422.orig:
When I don't know what to eat, I ask myself if it's Tuesday.
No? Think of a place to eat.
Yes? GO TO BUFFALO WILD WINGS

People here think my friends and I are crazy because it is not uncommon for us to order well over 100 wings to share.

I absolutely love their parmesan garlic sauce on traditional wings. Desert heat, honey bbq, and chipotle bbq are all solid choices as well. The servers are very friendly and attentive. I've come here with small and large parties and have usually gotten great service.

It may just be me, but I HATE their boneless wings, which is what is holding back the last star. They are overly breaded, dry, and have very little sauce on them. I honestly only come here on Tuesdays for their traditional special.
yelp:train:229422.para:

It may be my personal preference, but I dislike their boneless wings, which prevents them from achieving a perfect rating. They are excessively breaded, dry, and lack sufficient sauce coverage. I typically visit only on Tuesdays to savor their traditional specialty.

yelp:train:230631.para:

Nevertheless, if you're in the mood for a late-night or morning pho fix, feel free to indulge.
