The service is not so good and that makes 6 people never going there again, it's ok by me cuz I hate chain's. Will people ever learn chai's suck!?!? This place should not even get 1 star the best thing is the bucket's of peanut's. My daughter loved throwing the shells on the ground, I mean where else can your kid's do that on purpose?
yelp:train:267239.para:
Tried this eatery as it was suggested by Sarah (appreciation in tone). Initially, our takeout experience was disappointing, resembling a mess with items scattered on the floor. My child's meal, supposedly 'roadies' or sliders, was incomplete with two missing meat portions. We reached out to clarify, and the manager offered a voucher for the unsatisfactory meal. Despite weeks passing, we contacted her again, receiving an apology and a generous replacement, three times the original order.

We invited friends along since it was complimentary. Regrettably, the food quality remained subpar, with only a couple of people enjoying their filets, which were unfortunately overcooked. The manager's response was unsatisfactory, implying that the quality would remain the same regardless of the time of day. The service was lacking, leading six of us to vow never to return. I'm content with this decision, as I have a distaste for chain restaurants. It's disheartening to see such places struggle to deliver quality. The only redeeming aspect is the generous servings of peanuts, which my daughter enjoyed tossing around. It's a unique experience for kids to engage in such playful behavior.

yelp:train:267469.orig: Interesting & informative tour. We enjoyed it, as well as the various flavor samples of specialty olive oils and other goodies! The atmosphere is pleasant & everything we tried was delicious!! Enjoy a glass of sangria (or share a carafe)
yelp:train:267469.para: An engaging and educational excursion was delightful for us, including the sampling of unique olive oil flavors and other delectable treats. The ambiance was inviting, and all the tastes we experienced were scrumptious! Relish a glass of sangria (or partake in a carafe) with us.

yelp:train:267889.orig:
Hell yeah! What is it? The Wednesday after? And I'm still recovering!
The parade was glittery gorgeous fun. Fun crowd, good groups at the festival. Plus, I won a big tube of fancy German lube!

I had a really good time, but it was mostly because of the people I was with, and that the last time I went was about 3 years ago. Three year intervals seem to work best for me, in order to prevent a bad case of been-there-done-that.
yelp:train:267889.para:
Absolutely thrilled! Is it Wednesday already? And I'm still on the mend!
The celebration was sparkling delightful and enjoyable. A lively audience, excellent groups at the event. Plus, I secured a large, luxurious German lubricant!

I thoroughly enjoyed myself, but it was largely due to the company I kept and the fact that my previous visit was approximately three years prior. Three-year gaps appear to be ideal for me to avoid the monotony of having experienced it all before.

yelp:train:268093.orig: Super friendly customer service, clean atmosphere and AWESOME MILITARY DISCOUNT!  We will be regulars:)
yelp:train:268093.para: Warm and welcoming customer support, a spotless environment, and an exceptional discount for military personnel! We're looking forward to becoming regulars:)

yelp:train:268146.orig: great pizza, apparently the pepperoni is in \""the top twenty\""
yelp:train:268146.para: Apparently, the pepperoni on this pizza ranks within the "top twenty," indicating it's quite exceptional.

yelp:train:268212.orig: For one thing when you ask for medium rear it should not be medium well and the shoe string fries tasted like crap the service was not great it is the worst 120 I spent for two never again
yelp:train:268212.para: When requesting a medium rear, it should not imply a medium-well quality, and the shoe string fries were disappointingly poor in taste. The service did not meet expectations, making it the least satisfactory 120 spent for two, and I will not repeat this experience.

yelp:train:268302.orig:
I have been to the Herb box for lunch  twice and have loved it each time. Located in the very chic DC ranch at Pima, the restaurant is best enjoyed if seated outside in the patio on a lovely March afternoon. 
The mango lemonade is very soothing and the refills keep coming. Had the salmon with tsatziki and a side if the sweet potato chips . The salmon here is one of the best i have eaten and the chips are really addictive. 
I didnt have dessert this time around but have tried their graham cracker chocolate mousee before and its delicious. 
Would love to go back whenever the weather permits patio seating.
yelp:train:268302.para: I've visited the Herb box for lunch twice, and each visit was delightful. Situated in the stylish DC ranch at Pima, the eatery shines when dining on the patio during a charming March day. \nThe mango lemonade is incredibly calming, and the continuous refills are a pleasure. I savored the salmon with tsatziki and complemented it with sweet potato chips. The salmon here is exceptional, and the chips are irresistibly tempting. \nI skipped dessert this time, but I've previously relished their graham cracker chocolate mouse. I'm eager to return whenever the weather allows for outdoor dining.

yelp:train:268409.orig:
This rating is not about the cupcakes...because I didn't get to have any. 

Aside from seeing my fabulous friends, this place was what I was most looking forward to on my trip to the area. I've heard about the yummy treats for a while now, and was SO excited to get to go.

So, post dinner and hockey game on Saturday night, we waltzed down Walnut...just in time to see the shop being locked up. Whaaaa? I(well,  we ALL) were expecting late night goodies at a place known for late night hours. Evidently, Cakes on Walnut has recently changed their hours, and alas, are now not the ""post bar"" go-to. No biggie, we'll just stop back tomorrow. Errr, wait.  Closed on Sundays. Hmmm...Monday, before we leave??? No dice. They don't open 'till Noon. 

Boo Hiss. 

Perhaps if I'm ever in town and get to taste these cakes, I can actually rate them. 

*I'm giving them two stars, because only  Funky-McNasty places with bad service get one star in my book(which I don't think would describe this place)...but my bummed out sweet tooth thinks I'm a softie.
yelp:train:268409.para:
This score isn't about the cupcakes since I didn't sample any. 

Besides meeting my amazing pals, this spot was the highlight of my visit to the vicinity. The delectable desserts had been on my radar for some time, and I was thrilled to experience them. 

So, after our dinner and hockey match on Saturday evening, we strolled down Walnut just in time to witness the store closing. Surprise! We anticipated nighttime delights at a well-known late-night spot. Unfortunately, Cakes on Walnut has recently altered their operating hours, and it seems they're no longer the go-to place for post-bar treats. No problem, we'll revisit tomorrow. Oh, wait. They're closed on Sundays. Monday, before we depart? That's not going to work. They don't open until noon. 

Disappointment. 

Maybe if I'm in town in the future and get a chance to try these cakes, I can give them a fair review. 

I'm awarding them two stars, as only places with poor service and questionable quality get one star in my rating system (which I don't believe would apply to this establishment). However, my disappointed sweet tooth feels I'm being overly sensitive.

yelp:train:268615.orig:
Ethel M and the Chocolate factory?? Just call me Veruca since I wanted milk chocolate covered strawberries only and I WANTED IT NOW! They didn't have enough available,  but the person named Sharon on the other end said, ""Sure thing! I'll make them and have them ready for you when you get here.""  Sweet!!

We arrived 20 minutes later and killed a little time checking out the cactus garden and going down the  long hallway on a self guided tour.  I spotted the Oompa Loopmas in the blue and green hard hats making the sweet treats! ..wink wink .. other than that the tour really ain't anything special. My visit is based as a customer for the Ethel M Store within the chocolate factory mainly. 
 
The store itself was where I thought was chocolate heaven! It's divided into different sections. The showcases of truffles and chocolate candies, another section dedicated to liqueur filled ones (those are my fave), a section of novelties like hot coco, cups, signs, and a section of hand dipped pretzels, and varieties of chocolate and pecan bars.  

A lady named Sharon was behind the counter with a tray of chocolate covered strawberries.  I told her I was the one that called.  She showed
yelp:train:268615.para:
Veruca, who craved milk chocolate-coated strawberries, was assured by Sharon that they would be prepared upon arrival. Arriving 20 minutes later, we spent some time exploring the cactus garden and a lengthy corridor on a self-guided tour, where we saw the Oompa Loompas crafting confections. Although the tour wasn't particularly remarkable, my visit was primarily as a customer for the Ethel M Store within the chocolate factory. 

The store was a paradise for chocolate lovers, with various sections showcasing truffles, chocolate candies, liqueur-filled ones (my favorites), novelties like hot cocoa, cups, signs, and hand-dipped pretzels, along with different chocolate and pecan bars. A lady named Sharon, behind the counter, presented a tray of chocolate-covered strawberries, confirming my earlier call. 

(Paraphrase length: approximately 170 words)

yelp:train:268620.orig: The garden during the holiday season is very relaxing and enjoyable.  There was a section of lights that were completely out and that was a little disappointing.  \n  Strolling amongst the lights you feel like you have completely left the city.  At the end of our exploration of the lights we went into the chocolate factory and had some hot chocolate.  They were so busy and making the hot chocolate so fast that it was a little on the cool side.\n  Their chocolate products are delicious and we enjoy going there every year.
yelp:train:268620.para: The holiday season garden offers a serene and pleasurable atmosphere.  A part of the lights was not functioning, which slightly dampened our spirits.  \n  Walking through the illuminated area, one can feel a sense of escape from urban life.  After our tour of the lights, we entered the chocolate factory and indulged in some swiftly prepared hot chocolate.  Despite the rapid service, the drink was slightly cool.  \n  The chocolate treats from this place are scrumptious, and we make it a point to visit annually.

yelp:train:268926.orig: Beautiful church that you can tell the members take care of. I recently moved here and was looking for some place warm and I have to say when I walked in I was  a bit intimidated by the size and the amount of people but by the end of mass I was in love. The music is so beautiful, the singers are passionate, you can hear it in their voices. That's a big part for me, I like to sing along at mass. The mass was wonderful and the community was so welcoming. They have greeters at the door which is a nice touch, makes you feel that one on one connection. The priest stays after to chat with members and all in all it is just amazing. I look forward to mass.
yelp:train:268926.para: This stunning church, evident by its well-maintained appearance, became my new home. Upon my arrival, the vastness and the crowd initially made me feel overwhelmed. However, by the conclusion of the service, my heart was captivated by the enchanting melodies and the fervent voices of the choir. Singing along during the mass is a cherished aspect for me. The service was exceptional, and the sense of community was incredibly inviting. The presence of door greeters added a personal touch, fostering a sense of individual connection. The priest's willingness to engage in post-service conversations further enhanced the experience. I eagerly anticipate future masses.

yelp:train:269463.orig: New to the Tattoo world I went here due to a referral. I spent over $700 dollars and got the worst tattoo...the artist ? can't remember his name colored in my whole chest with green...like paint by numbers-no outline of florals....had to go to another shop since they refused to fix or even take my calls. I am now $1500 into a tattoo that still has bizarre green back ground. If you have a picture they probably do fine...for me I was trusting the artistic ability and they don't have it.
yelp:train:269463.para: As a novice in the realm of tattoos, I was directed here by a recommendation. I invested more than $700 and received a subpar tattoo, with the artist's identity eluding me, as they've inked my entire chest in green, resembling a simplistic paint-by-numbers style without any floral designs. They declined to rectify or respond to my communications, leading me to seek services elsewhere. I've now expended an additional $1500 on a tattoo that still features an odd green backdrop. While they might be competent if you have a visual reference, I placed my faith in their artistic skill, which unfortunately fell short.

yelp:train:269594.orig:
Pro: drunks singing, public insults, friendly atmosphere 

Con: upstairs

Came here late hour wondering Phoenix solo on a business trip, stumbled upon this gem by chance. I already know the Shout House well from the SD location... and wouldn't you know it, one of the player on the piano was on loan from SD. 

So, drinking and singing, I managed to get a song in (part of the your world)... too bad it was a weeknite and the place closed early. 

Next time I am in Phoenix, I would be coming back for more.
yelp:train:269594.para:
Pro: lively singing, public taunts, welcoming vibe 

Con: located on the upper floor

Discovered this hidden treasure during a late evening while in Phoenix for a work trip. I'm familiar with the Shout House from its downtown spot... and it turns out, a musician from there was temporarily performing here. 

So, I indulged in some libations and joined in the melody (as part of the collective experience)... regrettably, it was a weekend and the venue shut down early. 

On my return to Phoenix, I plan to revisit.

yelp:train:270104.orig: I rented a car on 12/9-12/14 upon turning it in left my Garmin in the drivers seat.  Got to the airport called them and let them know.  Got home to a message that they had the Garmin in lost and found and to call Rosa.  Called them every 3 days trying to reach Rosa who was never at work, she was always on vacation.  Well today, still unable to speak with Rosa, I spoke with someone who called lost ad found (they were unwilling to that til today) and guess what?  Yep, Rosa must have needed a gps for her vacation because it's not there.  I'd been looking for a corporate number to call, but every one is disconnected.  Finally got in touch with someone at their call center.  The fella was nice enough...but the company is a bunch of thieves.  If I could give them no stars I would.  One star is too good for them.
yelp:train:270104.para: From 12/9 to 12/14, I leased a vehicle and accidentally left my Garmin in the driver's area. I informed the airport and they kept it in their lost and found, directing me to Rosa. Despite my repeated calls every three days, Rosa was unreachable as she was on holiday. Today, I finally spoke with a representative from lost and found, who confirmed that Rosa likely required the Garmin for her trip since it's still missing. I've been unable to reach a corporate line, but I managed to speak with a call center agent. While the agent was courteous, my impression of the company remains negative. They're untrustworthy, and I'd rate them one star if possible. One star is generous for them.

yelp:train:271310.orig:
It is a good eat. They use all white meat chicken and give you plenty to eat. My wife always gets sweet and sour chicken. It is enough to feed to boys from one plate. They all love it. 

The orange chicken is is just too sweet for me. If it wasnt so syrupy and had more spice, it would be better. I like white meat chicken with some spice. Good, but just too sweet.

Mongolian beef is very tasty. Thats usually what I get. Again, not quite the kick I like. I usually add some sriracha hot sauce. Mmmmmm.
yelp:train:271310.para:
The dining experience is excellent, featuring all-white chicken and ample portions. My spouse consistently orders sweet and sour chicken, which is sufficient for feeding boys from a single plate, and they enjoy it.

The orange chicken is excessively sweet for my taste. It would be more enjoyable with less sweetness and a bit more spice. I prefer white chicken with a hint of spice. It's delicious but overly sweet.

Mongolian beef is quite flavorful, which is typically my choice. However, it lacks the desired level of spiciness. I often enhance it with a dash of sriracha hot sauce, which I find quite satisfying.

yelp:train:271704.orig: On my way back from vegas, i thought of having a quick lunch at this burger king located within airport premises. I ordered a burger. First it around 20 minutes for them to serve it, ridiculously long for a fast food joint located at airport, with around 8 people staffsize, but to add to a misery, the burger served was with burned buns and yes!..the buns were charred black from inside!! Didnt get a chance to raise my concern with the outlet manager since i was running late to board my flight. But overall it was the worst possible burger experience i had till date. Would NOT recommend this place to anyone..
yelp:train:271704.para: While returning from Las Vegas, I contemplated grabbing a speedy meal at the Burger King situated inside the airport. I placed an order for a burger. Initially, it took about 20 minutes for the service, which seemed excessively long for a quick-service restaurant in the airport, especially with a staff of roughly eight. To compound the frustration, the burger arrived with toasted buns that were blackened on the inside. Unfortunately, I couldn't address my complaint with the store manager due to time constraints, as I was rushing to catch my flight. In summary, it was the most disappointing burger experience I've encountered to this point. I would strongly advise against recommending this establishment to others.

yelp:train:272064.orig: This is the best LVAC in town! I never have to wait for equipment, the staff is decent and I do not feel like I am in a roid-raged meat locker. Use caution in the parking lot because the crazies who are there to work out, don't believe in walking far to get to their work out. I have also seen several cars broken into so BE CAREFUL not to leave your valuables in the car.  Aside from that, there's something for everyone and the classes are kick %$@!
yelp:train:272064.para:
This local LVAC stands out as the top choice! I've never experienced delays with machinery, the team is satisfactory, and I don't feel trapped in a rage-filled gym. Exercise caution in the parking area as the dedicated fitness enthusiasts there prefer not to walk long distances to their workouts. I've noticed multiple instances of car break-ins, so be vigilant and don't leave valuables in your vehicle. Besides that, it caters to a wide range of interests and offers dynamic classes.

(Note: The phrase "%$@!" was not paraphrased due to its inappropriate nature. It was replaced with "dynamic classes" to maintain the original sentiment of enthusiasm and energy.)

yelp:train:272389.orig: We dined last night. When we entered we asked the hostess for a table on the patio by a heat lamp. She said that would be no problem. We get out to the patio and all the heat lamps are bundled together and off. I see her tinker with one and then walk away. A few minutes later our server approached our table and took our drink orders. We mentioned the heat lamps and he said the owner was probably fixing them for us. (We had two kids with us who were freezing). Just as our drinks arrived another table was sat. The hostess/owner came back out to the patio and started to fix the heat lamps by the NEW table. We ordered our food and said if we could not get a heat lamp we would like to move inside. For the next 15 minutes the owner set up and got working two heat lamps for the new table. Once our food arrived she came over and started on ours. I felt like a second rate citizen. We mentioned that it was cold and she said it was because we were drinking margarita's. I said the kids were not drinking margaritas and their hands were freezing she said they should have gotten up and warmed them by the fire pit. With this kind of hospitality from the OWNER I won't need to ever dine here again.
yelp:train:272389.para: Last evening, we requested a table under a heat lamp upon arrival, which the hostess assured us would be no issue. However, when we reached the patio, all the lamps were unlit, and she began adjusting one before departing. Our server, upon taking our drink orders, informed us that the owner was likely repairing the lamps for us, especially since we had two children who were shivering. As our beverages arrived, another group was seated, prompting the hostess/owner to return and commence the repair on the lamps near the new seating area. We expressed our discomfort due to the cold and requested a move indoors if the lamps remained unavailable. Over the next quarter-hour, the owner successfully installed two lamps for the new guests. When our meal was served, she addressed our concerns, which left us feeling undervalued. The owner's response to our complaints about the cold, attributing it to our choice of drinks, and suggesting the children should have warmed their hands by the fire pit, was unacceptable. This experience has led us to decide against dining at this establishment in the future.

yelp:train:272571.orig: I usually come here every morning on my way to work. The staff is friendly and when I go into the store it's always clean. The drive thru is 80% of the time very slow. I've waited 15 minutes for coffee stuck in the drive thru with a moderate/shorter line. I don't know what they do behind the scenes after you order, but they need to pick up the pace.
yelp:train:272571.para: Every morning, I make it a point to visit this place en route to my job. The team is amiable, and the store maintains a spotless appearance. The drive-thru service is often sluggish, with instances of me waiting for 15 minutes in line for coffee. I'm uncertain about the operations post-order, but there's a clear need for them to expedite the process.

yelp:train:272658.orig:
I go on a 3 day horseback riding trip twice a year.  When I do, I always stop by REI to pick up supplies for the trip.  On my last visit, I found a 10 degree sleeping bag for $70, not bad!  It's kept me very warm and comfortable.

The employees at this REI are always helpful and answer all of my stupid questions. Since I'm a novice outdoors guy, I ask a lot of basic questions.  They're always willing to help me.

Return Factor - 93%
yelp:train:272658.para:
Twice annually, I embark on a 3-day equestrian adventure. During these excursions, I make it a point to visit REI to gather necessary gear. In my most recent trip, I discovered a 10-degree sleeping bag priced at $70, which I found quite reasonable. It has provided me with ample warmth and comfort.

The staff at this REI are consistently supportive and respond to all my naive inquiries. As a beginner in outdoor activities, I frequently ask fundamental questions. They are always ready to assist me.

Return Factor - 93%

yelp:train:273149.orig:
I completely forgot about my experience 2 years ago and went back to eat  again...
This time, they didn't list the auto-grat in bill. Instead, they just added to the credit card bill after wards!!
My bill was $26.04, I put $28.00 in total, my statement says $30.04. They didn't like what I wrote for tip, so they gave themselves a little more. I left little for a reason. They didn't do anything to serve us! All they did was took the order, brought the food (not even at the same time. 3 meals came in 3 different times.) And the bill. No refill, no checking on how we're doing, or how the food tasted, or need anything else! 
Keep your receipt and check your account to make sure they don't add more amount than you wrote in.
I'm not concerned about $2 they added more, it's the principle of the fact that they did it. Very bad way to do business. A scam.
yelp:train:273149.para: I had completely overlooked my previous visit from two years back and decided to dine there once more...\nThis time, the auto-gratuity wasn't mentioned in the initial bill, but was added later on, resulting in a total of $30.04 on my statement. They were unhappy with my tipping note, so they increased the amount. I left a small tip for a specific reason. The service was subpar; they merely took the order, delivered the food at staggered times, and presented the bill without any additional service like refills or food quality checks. \nHold onto your receipt and verify your account to ensure they don't inflate the amount beyond what you've written. Although the extra $2 might seem trivial, it's the underlying principle that bothers me. It's a poor business practice and appears to be a scam.

yelp:train:273298.orig: They actually open at 11:00 am , not 9:00. Also, the address listed is wrong. It is actually 2630 rio solado parkway. Other than that, the facility is okay. Staff isn't very tentative.
yelp:train:273298.para:
The establishment commences operations at 11:00 am instead of 9:00. Additionally, the provided address is incorrect; the correct location is 2630 Rio Solado Parkway. Aside from this, the facility itself is satisfactory, and the staff displays a lack of hesitation.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept relatively the same.)

yelp:train:274127.orig:
I haven't been to this Red Robin in a while, and I came back with a friend of mine this afternoon to meet up for some food.  What a good time!  It was busy for a Sunday afternoon, but fortunately we didn't have to wait.

We were seated in the bar area and our server greeted us promptly.  We already had the menu's at our table, and after scouring it, I went with the fries.  My friend went with a chicken salad, and I her sister went with the fish and chips.  Overall, our food was tasty, and I really had a good time.

While we were busy gabbing, our server always refilled our drinks, and after I bill came we had our bill split.  She was friendly and nice, and I really enjoyed our time here.  I will say, the handicapped bathroom was out of service when I was there, and it was a bit messy and needed attention overall.  Nothing horrendous, but could have used someone to go in there and clean up the towels on the floor and mop some.

Overall a positive experience and I had a good time. Will be back when I'm in the area again!  Oh, and happy hour all Sunday long!
yelp:train:274127.para:
After a break from visiting this Red Robin, I returned with a companion today for a meal. It was a delightful experience! Despite the Sunday afternoon crowd, we didn't face any waiting. 

We were accommodated in the bar section, and our attendant welcomed us without delay. We had already perused the menu, and I opted for the fries. My companion chose a chicken salad, while my sister selected the fish and chips. The food was delicious, and I thoroughly enjoyed myself.

Our server was attentive, refilling our drinks and splitting the bill once it was time. She was amiable and pleasant, enhancing our visit. However, the handicapped restroom was not operational during our visit, appearing untidy and requiring maintenance. It wasn't catastrophic, but it would have been beneficial if someone had tidied up the towels on the floor and mopped the area.

In summary, it was a positive experience and I had a great time. I plan to revisit when I'm nearby. Plus, there was a happy hour all Sunday!

yelp:train:275213.orig:
I went to this salon and had a great time! The place is beautifully decorated and they played a lot of fun music. The people are very friendly. They gave me free champagne as I got my hair done.  
Campbell did my hair and gave great advice as I was unsure what I wanted to do. The haircut was better than i could have pictured it! 
After my hair was done, Gina did my make-up. She made me look like a completely different person! I especially loved my eyes. The way she made them stand out was so impressive. 
I would recommend this salon to everyone.
yelp:train:275213.para:
I visited this salon and thoroughly enjoyed myself! The ambiance is elegantly adorned and they played a variety of entertaining tunes. The staff are incredibly welcoming. They offered me complimentary champagne as I received my hair treatment. 
Campbell styled my hair and provided excellent guidance since I was uncertain about my desired look. The final hairstyle surpassed my expectations! 
Post hair styling, Gina enhanced my appearance with makeup. She transformed me into an entirely new individual, particularly enhancing my eyes. The way she accentuated them was truly remarkable. 
I highly suggest this salon to all individuals.

yelp:train:275445.orig: I want to love Amelie's I really, really do. On the whole they are trying very hard but when you consider the $ they just fall so short. Let's consider- 24.00 for a soda, cup of soup, brownie, tart, sandwich and lemonade. Boylan soda out of a bottle, 2.15 so no big deal. The soup was Spicy Thai, easy on both points but more meh for 3.99. Salted caramel brownie was ok.  Turkey and brie the merest of both drowned in 'seasonal fruit compote' which was raspberry so sour it was all you could taste, the bread IS delicious. French Lavender Soda- mmmnope, just carbonated water with a splash of lemonade, again very sour and definately no lavender and 3.49. Meh. My final complaint is that even though the counter lady was nice she did not have a clue what 'apricot' is and pulled tart after tart after tart out- No, that's apple, No that's pear, No that's almond...I finally gave up. Apple tart it was. Again, just ok but a king's ransom at 4.59!!!! I certainly hope the owner reads these reviews and takes them to heart because she seemed on the ball as she served in the dining room very aware of customers reactions. She seems sweet and earnest and is just so close to being on target. Honestly, I
yelp:train:275445.para: I genuinely adore Amelie's efforts, yet their pricing leaves much to be desired. Let's break it down: 24 bucks for a soda, soup, dessert, sandwich, and lemonade. Boylan soda, a mere 2.15, hardly a concern. The Spicy Thai soup was mild and acceptable, but at 3.99, it left me indifferent. The salted caramel brownie was passable. The turkey and brie, unfortunately, were overshadowed by a sour raspberry fruit compote, despite the bread's quality. The French Lavender Soda was disappointingly just carbonated water with a hint of lemonade, sour and lacking in flavor, priced at 3.49. My final grievance is the counter lady's confusion about 'apricot,' leading to a series of misidentified tarts. I eventually settled for an apple tart, which, while acceptable, was exorbitantly priced at 4.59. I hope the owner considers these reviews seriously, as she was attentive and responsive to customer feedback. She appears kind and sincere, nearly hitting the mark. Truly, I

yelp:train:275666.orig: We went there on Wednesday night for dinner.  It's a very typical asian buffet set-up. The selection was below average. We were looking for the fresh oyster everybody talked about, and they were a no-show. We felt gypped. The check for 2 including tip was $30 which I can get some good chinese food from a nearby restaurant seem a little high.
yelp:train:275666.para:
On Wednesday evening, we dined at a standard Asian buffet. The variety of options was somewhat lacking. We were eager to try the fresh oysters that were highly praised, but they were absent. We felt cheated. The total bill of $30, inclusive of the tip, for two people seemed steep when compared to the cost of quality Chinese cuisine at a local eatery.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent, while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept roughly the same.)

yelp:train:275710.orig: I have been there for both lunch (at only $8.75), and dinner (at only $12.75). I actually liked some of the sushi selections, but hate that they put ham in their fried rice (kinda gross), they do have other food selections that are pretty decent though. For dinner, which starts at 4pm, they add crab legs & oysters... Just be sure to bring your patience with you because some of the servers dont understand english, are kinda rude, and it gets so packed with people who bring their little kids, and let them run around unattended while yelling and screaming, as if the buffet was a personal playground. Other than that, yeah, the place is okay.
yelp:train:275710.para: I've dined at this establishment for both lunch (priced at $8.75) and dinner (costing $12.75). I found some of their sushi dishes enjoyable, but I'm not fond of the ham in their fried rice (which I find unappealing). However, they offer other food options that are quite satisfactory. For dinner, beginning at 4pm, they serve crab legs and oysters. Just remember to have patience as some of the staff struggle with English, display a bit of rudeness, and the venue can become quite crowded with families allowing their children to roam freely, causing a noisy environment. Excluding these issues, the restaurant is generally acceptable.

yelp:train:276904.orig: Place was dirty and did not serve vegetarians. They guy said over the phone they did. Otherwise nice people.
yelp:train:276904.para: The location was unclean and unsuitable for vegetarians, as per the individual's phone conversation. However, the people involved were quite pleasant.

yelp:train:277230.orig: My husband and I went to this restaurant last week after going to the Beatles show. My husband ordered the I-80 burger; he ordered his burger well done but it came burned and couldn't really get our server to replace it because he hardly ever showed up to see how the food was and how we were doing. I ordered the California chicken and it was nothing amazing, in fact I couldn't finished it because the sun dried tomatoes were so salty it made it hard to enjoy. We also ordered the sweet potato fries but can't tell you if they were good because we never got them , our server gave us the wrong kind.The only thing that we did enjoy was their buffalo chicken wings, they were really good.As I mentioned before our server never checked on us except for when we were done and ready to pay. I would definitely not recommend it to anyone, unless you want to pay a lot for mediocre food.
yelp:train:277230.para: Last week, my spouse and I visited a dining establishment following a Beatles concert. He chose the I-80 burger, requesting it well-done, but it arrived charred, and our server was unresponsive to our request for a replacement due to their infrequent check-ins. I opted for the California chicken, which was underwhelming, particularly the overly salty sun-dried tomatoes that made it difficult to savor. We also ordered sweet potato fries, but we can't assess their quality as we never received them, receiving the incorrect variety instead. The only dish we genuinely appreciated was the buffalo chicken wings, which were exceptionally tasty. Our server's attention was minimal, only checking in when we were finished and ready to settle the bill. I would not suggest this place to anyone, barring those willing to pay a premium for subpar cuisine.

yelp:train:277379.orig: I gave birth to my baby here in August 2011. The nurse that checked me in was rude and unfriendly. The nurse that I had from the time I got into my room until an hour after giving birth was fantastic! My baby needed to go to the NICU, but we weren't really told the reason for taking her there. Our baby was in the NICU for 7 days, so we met almost all of the nurses up there. About 2/3 were rude and not friendly (IN THE NICU). The other 1/3 was friendly and wanted to answer our questions. I was there every 3 hours to feed my baby while she was staying at San Martin so I met everyone that came in. We didn't meet the doctor caring for my baby until day 5 after I demanded to talk to him. They were very vague about why she was staying there and treated us as if we were stupid! For my next baby I will not be delivering at San Martin Campus.
yelp:train:277379.para: In August 2011, I welcomed my child into the world at this location. The initial nurse I encountered was impolite and distant. However, the nurse who cared for me from admission to an hour post-delivery was exceptional. Our infant required admission to the NICU, but the rationale was not clearly communicated to us. Our baby remained in the NICU for a week, during which we interacted with nearly all the nurses. Approximately two-thirds of them were unfriendly, especially within the NICU. The remaining third were amiable and eager to address our inquiries. I was present every three hours to nourish my baby while she was in San Martin's NICU, thus meeting all incoming staff. It was only on the fifth day, after I insisted on speaking with the doctor, that we finally met the one responsible for my baby's care. They were evasive about the reasons for her NICU stay and seemed to regard us as uninformed. For my forthcoming childbirth, I will not choose San Martin Campus as my delivery location.

yelp:train:277500.orig: This pub is my favorite place for beer and food.  I think I would stop by this place everyday if I could.
yelp:train:277500.para: I hold this bar in high regard as my preferred spot for enjoying beer and cuisine. Had the opportunity, I would frequent this establishment daily.

yelp:train:277712.orig: After watching my favorite TV chef  Daisy Martinez prepare ropa vieja in her PBS cooking program last night, I had an overwhelming craving for that dish, so today I headed to Sabor Cubano where this was my fave dish when I came for buffet. As one of the recent reviewers mentioned, this establishment is NO LONGER A BUFFET, but is now a full-service restaurant. But that was OK, I came here for the ropa vieja. It was as delicious as I remembered it to be from my previous trips here, and came with a tasty side of moros (black beans and rice), a simple fresh salad, and toasted buns. A great satisfying meal, which would have been perfect if they lowered the volume of the music on their sound system.
yelp:train:277712.para: Following my viewing of Daisy Martinez's beloved cooking show on PBS, where she made ropa vieja, I found myself longing for that meal, prompting me to visit Sabor Cubano, my preferred choice when I previously enjoyed buffets. Recent feedback indicates a shift from buffet to full-service restaurant, which I found acceptable as I was there for the ropa vieja. The dish was as delightful as I recalled from my past visits, accompanied by a flavorful combination of black beans and rice, a straightforward fresh salad, and toasted buns. It provided a fulfilling dining experience, which would have been ideal with a quieter music volume on their sound system.

yelp:train:277964.orig:

yelp:train:277964.para:
I thoroughly enjoyed myself at Mullen's, engaging in activities like partying, dancing, consuming beverages, reconnecting with old pals, and making new acquaintances for a few hours. However, I can't shake off the feeling that this venue is subpar. The enjoyable experience I had is largely due to the efforts of the party planners (an external team) and my companions.

yelp:train:278343.orig: I eat here regularly with my co-workers for lunch.  We go for one of two reasons.  Reason number 1: we are in the mood for Indian food.  It is the best Indian restaurant near the office.  Reason number 2: we can't think of any other places to eat and we haven't been to the Taj Mahal in three days.  The food is always great.   The lunch special is a good deal.  There is a rotation with three options.  You select your preferred spiciness level, one through ten, and naan or garlic naan.  Lunch also comes with lentil soup and yogurt sauce.
yelp:train:278343.para: I frequently dine with my colleagues at this spot for our midday meal. Our motivations are twofold. Firstly, we crave Indian cuisine, and this establishment is renowned as the nearest Indian restaurant to our workplace. Secondly, we lack alternative dining options and haven't visited the Taj Mahal in a span of three days. The quality of the food consistently impresses us. Additionally, the lunch special offers a reasonable price. There's a choice of three different meals. You can pick your desired spice intensity on a scale of one to ten, and either naan or garlic naan. The meal is complemented with lentil soup and yogurt sauce.

yelp:test:1.orig: Last summer I had an appointment to get new tires and had to wait a super long time. I also went in this week for them to fix a minor problem with a tire they put on. They \""fixed\"" it for free, and the very next morning I had the same issue. I called to complain, and the \""manager\"" didn't even apologize!!! So frustrated. Never going back.  They seem overpriced, too.
yelp:test:1.para:
During the previous summer, I scheduled a tire replacement and endured an excessively long wait. This week, I returned for a tire issue they had previously installed, which they resolved without charge. However, the problem reoccurred the very next day. I voiced my complaint, but the manager showed no remorse. Extremely dissatisfied and unwilling to return. Additionally, I perceive their pricing as excessive.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, sentiment, and intent while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept relatively the same.)

yelp:test:3.orig: The food is good. Unfortunately the service is very hit or miss. The main issue seems to be with the kitchen, the waiters and waitresses are often very apologetic for the long waits and it's pretty obvious that some of them avoid the tables after taking the initial order to avoid hearing complaints.
yelp:test:3.para: The cuisine is enjoyable. Regrettably, the service quality fluctuates significantly. The primary problem appears to be rooted in the kitchen, with staff members frequently apologetic for extended waiting periods and it's quite apparent that some prefer to steer clear of tables post-order to evade customer grievances.

yelp:test:34.orig: I'm a creature of habit--I've been getting a savory and sweet item each time I'm around the neighborhood. White lily cake is divine! Quiches always tasty. Macarons are alittle too sweet. I wish the cake slices weren't $4/pop. Otherwise, would be a regular here.
yelp:test:34.para: As someone who thrives on routine, I consistently indulge in a savory and sweet treat whenever I pass by. The white lily cake is utterly delightful! Quiches are invariably delicious. However, I find macarons to be slightly overly sweet. I'd prefer if the cake slices were more affordable at $4 each, but otherwise, I'd consider this place a frequent stop.

yelp:test:40.orig:
My girlfriend and I went to Casbah for the first time recently and we both enjoyed our experience.

The atmosphere is dressy, but the restaurant isn't so formal that it feels stuffy or uncomfortable, which is a welcome change compared to most classy restaurants.  The environment was relaxed, and it was easy to have a quiet conversation throughout the meal.  As for the meal itself, we had a reservation and were promptly seated when we showed up.

Our waiter was courteous and provided good, fast service without being overbearing or constantly hovering, which was quite nice.  For an appetizer, we ordered the cheese tray which was tasty as well as fun and unique.

Following the cheese tray, I dined on the cioppino while my girlfriend had the casereccia.  Both dishes were tasty and our seafood was skillfully cooked, particularly the sea bass in my dish which was delicious.

I'd recommend this restaurant for anyone looking to celebrate an occasion or have some good, out of the ordinary food.
yelp:test:40.para:
Recently, my partner and I visited Casbah for the initial time and both of us had a delightful time.

The ambiance is elegant yet not overly formal, making it a refreshing departure from the usual sophisticated dining spots. The setting was laid-back, allowing for uninterrupted, peaceful dialogue during our dining experience.

We had a reservation and were quickly seated upon arrival. Our server was polite and delivered efficient service without being intrusive or excessively attentive, which was appreciated. For starters, we chose the cheese platter, which was not only delicious but also entertaining and distinctive.

After the cheese platter, I enjoyed the cioppino while my partner opted for the casereccia. Both meals were flavorful, with the seafood, especially the sea bass in my dish, expertly prepared. I would suggest this establishment for anyone seeking to commemorate a special event or savor some exceptional cuisine.

The system just had a major overhaul (in spring 2010) but still travel many of the same routes.

yelp:test:90.para:
The Port Authority (previously PATransit or "PAT") manages a comprehensive array of buses and light rail in the South Hills. Rather than providing school buses, the school district distributed high school bus passes for students to attend classes, and I've utilized this service since 1997.

My experience with the bus in Pittsburgh has been positive. I didn't acquire a driver's license until I was nearly 19, and the bus ("Miss Pat"--an additional moniker) along with my bicycle enabled me to reach all my destinations. Delays and issues are typical of all transportation methods. The cost is reasonable, particularly with a "free" bus pass for students, as detailed below. If you reside and work in the city, it's advisable to use the bus as your primary mode of transportation.

Most of the system is rooted in the pre-World War II trolley line heritage, resulting in well-served neighborhoods established before 1950. However, newer developments can be more challenging to access by bus. The system underwent a significant upgrade in spring 2010 but continues to follow many of the same routes.

The route numbering system is intricate, with numerous exceptions, but generally, the routes are numbered according to a specific rule.

yelp:test:97.orig:
When there's this much hype about a place, it's hard to live up to, but they did a pretty damn good job. Maybe not the best sandwich I've ever had in my life, but if it was any random sandwich shop I'd happened to stumble into, it would definitely be five stars without a second thought.

The chili cheese fries were among the best I've ever had. I don't know what they do to them - it's not the chili that's particularly great, it's not the cheese that's particularly great, and it's not the fries that are particularly great. But somehow, putting them all together just turns it into unbeatable awesome.

The sandwich itself (I got the corned beef) was very good despite the fact that I hate coleslaw. But they don't mean the typical mayo-and-carrot-and-purple-onion coleslaw; they make it with vinegar and oil, so it's basically just like seasoned lettuce. They put a bit much of it on, which overwhelmed the rest of the ingredients at first, but just pull about half of the slaw off and you have a kick-ass sandwich. The hot sauce goes really well on it too. And for a pretty reasonable price, I might add. Normally, I'd expect it to be about twice as much with that kind of reputation and do
yelp:test:97.para:
When the buzz surrounding a location is so intense, it's challenging to meet expectations, yet they managed to achieve an impressive level of excellence. Although it might not be the supreme sandwich in my entirety of experiences, if it were just any ordinary sandwich joint, it would unquestionably merit a perfect score.

The chili cheese fries were among the superior I've ever tasted. The secret to their excellence isn't in any single component - the chili, cheese, or fries - but in the magical combination of all three. It's a blend that creates an unbeatable delight.

Despite my personal dislike for coleslaw, the sandwich (specifically the corned beef one I chose) was exceptional. They've innovated the traditional coleslaw recipe, using vinegar and oil instead of mayo, carrot, and purple onion, making it more akin to seasoned lettuce. Initially, the slaw seemed to overpower the other ingredients, but removing about half of it transformed it into an outstanding sandwich. The hot sauce also complemented it well. Plus, considering the price, it was quite reasonable. Normally, I'd anticipate a cost about twice as much given its renown.

yelp:test:110.orig:
Last weekend my mother and I headed down to the strip to get some weekly goods - lunch meat and cheese from Penn Mac - veggies at Stans - needed some new spices from Penzeys for a chili I was going to make that day....we were both a little hungry and knew we wanted to have a snack before shopping.

We parked in front of Roland's and see the sign: Famous for Lobster Rolls and Bloody Mary's!

Perfect. 

My mother got the Lobster Roll, which she said was 'good'. The bread, from Mancini's, was of course tasty - toasted and buttery - delicious mostly because it was Mancini's bread. I had the Lobster Roll minus the carbs on a salad - and the lobster was tasty, no doubt , I mean, lobster is just - good. For the price though, not sure that I got enough bang for my buck. The salad was something I could have picked up at Get-Go in the pre-made section. I just didn't feel satisfied at the end of my meal. I couldn't even drink my Bloody Mary (this is a rare affair), way too much horseradish, and I often like horseradish in my Bloodies!

And it was cold - didn't even take my winter coat off. So, needless to say, not the best experience.

Talk about false advertisement...
yelp:test:110.para:
During the previous weekend, my mother and I made a trip to the strip to pick up our weekly provisions - lunch meat and cheese from Penn Mac, vegetables from Stans, and new spices from Penzeys for a chili I planned to cook that day. We were both slightly famished and decided to snack before our shopping trip.

We parked in front of Roland's and noticed the sign advertising their Lobster Rolls and Bloody Marys. It seemed like a great choice.

My mother enjoyed her Lobster Roll, praising the taste of the Mancini's bread, which was toasted and buttery. I opted for a Lobster Roll without the carbs on a salad, and the lobster was undeniably delicious. However, considering the price, I wasn't convinced I received good value for my money. The salad could have been easily found at Get-Go's pre-made section. I didn't feel completely fulfilled after my meal. I also couldn't finish my Bloody Mary due to the excessive horseradish, which I usually enjoy in my Bloodies.

Additionally, the place was chilly, so I kept my winter coat on. In conclusion, it was a disappointing experience.

The experience felt like misleading advertising.

yelp:test:123.orig: Worst Brazilian wax I have ever gotten. Extremely Painful and inefficient, still had a red welt 3 days later. She also used the same stick the entire time which is not sanitary. Eyebrow waxing is significantly overpriced at $18. Do not go here for waxing!
yelp:test:123.para: I experienced the most agonizing and ineffective Brazilian wax session ever. The aftermath included a persistent red mark for three days, and the use of a single stick throughout the procedure raised hygiene concerns. Additionally, the cost of eyebrow waxing at $18 is exorbitantly high. I strongly advise against choosing this place for waxing services.

yelp:test:158.orig:
My boyfriend and I stayed here for a long weekend because we both had interviews in the North Shore area, which was a short car ride away. We got a very good rate on Hotwire--otherwise I don't think we would have been able to stay here. Although the hotel was very comfortable and in a good location, we could hear every noise from the hallway and adjacent rooms (including the bathroom). I was sitting up in bed reading, and every time the people next door closed a drawer in their bureau the whole headboard would shake.

Parking was also expensive. We needed to use the car several times during our stay, so we had to valet park, which was over $20/day (plus tips each time we picked up or dropped off the car).

The coffee shop attached to the hotel is just OK. The breakfast/lunch place was not very good. You will probably have to venture a bit to find affordable and good quality food (other than the hotel restaurant, which I can't comment on because we did not eat there given the high prices).

One perk--the hotel does offer free internet, but it is a low bandwidth version. We didn't need the internet for work or anything so it was hard to justify paying for the high speed, so we
yelp:test:158.para:
We opted to spend a weekend at this location as my partner and I had job interviews nearby, just a brief drive away. We managed to secure a favorable deal on Hotwire, which made it feasible for us to stay. Despite the hotel's comfort and prime positioning, we were constantly disturbed by sounds from the hallway and adjoining rooms, even the bathroom. I was engrossed in a book in bed, and every time the neighbors shut a drawer, the entire headboard would tremble.

The cost of parking was steep. We had to use our car multiple times, necessitating valet parking, which amounted to over $20 per day (plus additional tips for each car retrieval).

The on-site coffee shop was mediocre. The breakfast and lunch spot was subpar. To find reasonably priced and high-quality food, you'd likely have to explore beyond the hotel's dining area, as we didn't dine there due to the exorbitant costs.

A positive aspect was the complimentary internet service provided by the hotel, albeit with limited bandwidth. Since we didn't require it for professional tasks, the expense of premium speed didn't seem justifiable for us.

yelp:test:160.orig: I had great expectations that were sadly not met. For the price of the room, I was expecting a LOT more for my buck, maybe I was just too optimistic. I will say the whole hotel was clean and didn't have any unsanitary conditions. But it just seemed outdate for the top price paid, it could use a spruce up. Our room was ready before posted check-in time and when we got to the room there were no problems. The wi-fi was free and the tv channel selections were pretty good. I would say this is an average hotel for amenities with a high price tag.\n Usually when you pay top tier rates, I usually expect the service staff to be very friendly, didn't get that here, I think I had one of the service staff actually talk to me unsolicited. I would not revisit The Westin Convention Center.\n My wife would probably give it 4 star just for the shower head, it was pretty amazing, but when that is the highlight, I don't think there is value here.
yelp:test:160.para: I held high hopes that unfortunately fell short. The cost of the accommodation didn't justify the value I anticipated, perhaps my optimism was too high. The hotel maintained cleanliness without any unhealthy conditions. However, it appeared outdated considering the high cost, suggesting a need for refurbishment. Our room was prepared ahead of the scheduled check-in time, and upon arrival, we found no issues. The complimentary wi-fi and satisfactory TV channel options were noted. I'd categorize this as a mid-range hotel in terms of amenities, despite its steep price. Typically, when paying premium rates, I expect exceptional service from the staff, which was not the case here. I had a single interaction with a staff member who approached me without being asked. I would not consider returning to The Westin Convention Center. My wife might rate it 4 stars solely for the exceptional shower head, but with that as the sole highlight, I don't see much worth in it.

yelp:test:166.orig: Great spot for weird or obscure parts, general maintenance items, and to  borrow a wrench or two.  Gerry is like a wise eccentric uncle.   I remember going there for my first time in the early 90's and it hasn't changed in almost 20 years.
yelp:test:166.para: An excellent location for unconventional or rare components, common repair tools, and occasional borrowing of wrenches. Gerry embodies the wisdom of a quirky elder relative. I recall my initial visit in the early '90s, and the place remains largely unchanged for nearly two decades.

yelp:test:173.orig: I just moved to the area and went here for the first time the other day. Tomaso did a great job! I high recommend this place.
yelp:test:173.para: Recently relocated and decided to check this location out for the initial occasion. Tomaso's performance was outstanding! I wholeheartedly suggest this venue.

yelp:test:200.orig: My favorite pizza in the city. Hoagies are also pretty good but the pizza takes the spotlight. One of the best places to shoot pool in the south hills next door, what more do you need?
yelp:test:200.para: The city's top pizza spot is mine, though Hoagies are commendable, pizza reigns supreme. Adjacent to the south hills, an excellent pool hall awaits, essentially fulfilling all requirements.

yelp:test:207.orig: This place has the best pizza I've ever had besides Keste and Paulie Gs in NYC.  Wood fired greatness.  Expect to wait on weekends in a crowded wine bar.  FANTASTIC red sauce and olive oil.  Not extensive on the wine list but good by the glass selection. A gem in Pittsburgh.
yelp:test:207.para: This establishment boasts the finest pizza I've experienced, surpassing only Keste and Paulie Gs in New York City. The wood-fired excellence is unparalleled. On weekends, anticipate a wait amidst a bustling wine bar. The red sauce and olive oil are exceptional. While the wine list isn't vast, the glass offerings are commendable. It's a treasure in Pittsburgh.

yelp:test:251.orig: Two words: grossly overrated. If I am going to wait an hour for breakfast/brunch, it needs to not only be good, but also unique. Unfortunately, Pamela's is neither of these things. Then again, the hour-long wait does provide you will ample time to find a ATM because they only take cash. If you want to wait in line for an hour for food that is both good and unique, try Coca Cafe.
yelp:test:251.para: If I'm going to spend an hour for a morning meal, it should be not only delectable but also distinctive. Regrettably, Pamela's fails to meet these criteria. On the other hand, the one-hour wait affords you enough time to locate an ATM, as they only accept cash. For a one-hour wait for a meal that is both exceptional and distinctive, consider Coca Cafe.

yelp:test:256.orig: This restaurant is in a great location and has nice ambiance. That is where the positive ends. The food is LOUSY. I paid $9 for a stainless steel mixing bowl of iceberg lettuce with a little frozen (OK, it was thawed, but had previously been frozen) corn, about 4 tablespoons of black beans and the same amount of feta. As a vegetarian, this salad was one of two that had some sort of substance to make one think of a meal. What a disappointment - I won't be back.
yelp:test:256.para: The eatery's prime position and inviting atmosphere are its only redeeming qualities. However, the culinary experience falls short. I spent $9 on a salad comprising mainly iceberg lettuce, a small portion of previously frozen corn, a few tablespoons of black beans, and an equal measure of feta cheese. As a veggie, this dish was among the few with a hint of substance. Regrettably, it was a letdown, and I won't be returning.

yelp:test:282.orig: I have been a long time fan but after having a issue with an item I purchased online this Christmas I will not be shopping here again. I tried to take a item back with the packing slip that came on the item, the associate told me I was unable to do the return with the packing slip but she could do it if I had the email confirmation.. I didn't have it on my phone so I went.. I found the email sent it back to my phone and tried the return again.. todays associate told me I could not do the return with the confirmation email but needed the packing slip.. which I could not find at the time. I asked to speak with the manager on duty which the associate called.. Valencia the manager on duty would not come up to speak with me but told the associate that they couldn't do the return.. I still have this 100.00 worth of stuff I don't need.. I would not recommend anyone from purchasing from Kmart!
yelp:test:282.para: As a dedicated supporter for years, my recent experience with an online purchase during the festive season has led me to decide against shopping with them in the future. When I attempted to return an item using the packing slip provided, the employee informed me that it wasn't sufficient, but they could process the return with an email confirmation. Unfortunately, I didn't have the email on my device, so I retrieved it and tried the return process again. However, today's employee insisted that the confirmation email was not enough and I needed the packing slip, which I couldn't locate at that moment. I requested to speak with the manager present, but Valencia, the manager, declined to converse with me and relayed that the return could not be completed. I'm left with unwanted merchandise valued at $100, and I strongly advise against buying from Kmart.

yelp:test:289.orig:
On Yelp, a 500th review is a milestone.  It's a big deal and for those of us that have written hundreds of reviews, it's a place to talk about a business that has had an impact on our lives  Fairpoint Communications is such a business.  Fairpoint took over Verizon's local phone service in this area recently and this is a review of their ability to deliver.  In a nutshell, it has been a disaster.

Fairpoint took over my land line at home and billing was screwed up.  They got the new business when my office moved to Portsmouth.  One day the landlines stopped working and our customers got a message that the number was no longer in service.  When that was fixed, the lines didn't roll over properly.  The billing was never correct.  The internet connection required rebooting the DSL modem up to 15 times a day.  Calls about all of these issues rarely went well.  People were apologetic but problems remained.  Calling about the same problem twice usually resulted in two different answers.  Two different people in my office were reduced to tears.  Most people and companies I know with Fairpoint in New Hampshire and Maine are having similar troubles..

My company switched carriers recentl
yelp:test:289.para: On Yelp, reaching the 500th review signifies a significant achievement. It's a noteworthy event for those who have contributed numerous reviews, providing a platform to discuss a company that has left a mark on our existence. Fairpoint Communications exemplifies such a company. They recently assumed control of Verizon's local phone service in this region, prompting this critique of their service delivery. To summarize, it has been a series of unfortunate events.\n\nFairpoint Communications assumed responsibility for my home phone line, leading to billing complications. This change occurred when my workplace relocated to Portsmouth. On one occasion, the landlines ceased functioning, leaving our clients with a message stating the number was out of service. Once resolved, the lines failed to transition smoothly. The billing system consistently provided incorrect information. The DSL modem required rebooting up to 15 times daily for internet connectivity. Attempts to address these issues rarely resulted in satisfactory outcomes. Apologies were offered, but the problems persisted. Repeatedly contacting about the same issue often led to contradictory responses. Two individuals in my office were brought to tears by these recurring issues. Most people and businesses in New Hampshire and Maine with Fairpoint have reported experiencing similar difficulties.

yelp:test:306.orig: We just received the worst service ever I will never come back. Its shocking that on wing special night it was merly 6 tables. One person actually went to the back to fix their own drinks. We had To ask for everything numerous of times. Service was very slow ass and the management was not customer friendly. I personally was not thinking to take pictures of all the screw ups due to all of the complaints the whole table was making. I hated to make so many complaints but I've never experienced such horrible service. It was awful We couldn't find any positive in it. As a matter of fact the waitress didn't even come back to pick up all the checks. It Was 7 of us and 6 ppl got their checks. We told the management We needed to pay another check and that We didn't know why the waitress would leave one out, his response was unprofessional.  :(
yelp:test:306.para: We were recently subjected to the most disappointing service imaginable, and I'm certain I'll never return. It's astonishing that during the special night on wings, only six tables were occupied. A guest even had to go to the back to rectify their own beverage issue. We found ourselves repeatedly requesting for things. The service was excruciatingly sluggish and the management showed a lack of customer friendliness. I was inclined to document all the mishaps due to the complaints echoing throughout the table. Despite my reluctance, I felt compelled to voice my dissatisfaction as I've never encountered such dreadful service. There was nothing to commend about the experience. To add to the frustration, the waitress neglected to return for the collection of all the bills. Out of seven people, six had their checks left unattended. We communicated our need for an additional check to the management, questioning the waitress's oversight. Their response was markedly unprofessional. :(

yelp:test:327.orig:
There are much better choices in uptown Charlotte!  Let me start with the good...the front desk staff. The three people who assisted me at the front desk were extremely friendly and helpful. Great customer service!

Now the bad...stains. There is no other way to describe everything in my room. Multiple stains on the carpeting and the comforter. The bathrobe hanging on the back of the bathroom door had a huge brown stain on the sleeve that I kept telling myself was makeup from the last occupant. Every, yes every, bath towel had a stain (either black or yellow). There was stained grout behind the toilet like it had leaked sometime in the past. Even the shower curtain was stained. Then there was the hair dryer. It was sooooo sticky that I didn't even want to touch it. It appeared to be covered in about 15 years worth of cheap hairspray. 

I can appreciate that the hotel is getting older and may need a renovation soon, but come on people!  How about you splurge and replace your bath towels and hair dryers now!  

Let me be clear that I think the cleaning staff is doing the best they can with what they have been given. They just need a better starting product!
yelp:test:327.para:
In uptown Charlotte, superior options abound! I'll begin with the positive: the front desk team consisted of three individuals who were incredibly amiable and supportive, delivering exceptional customer service. 

However, the negative aspects were quite disappointing. My room was plagued with numerous stains on the carpet and comforter. The bathrobe's sleeve, hanging on the bathroom door, had a significant brown stain, which I suspected was makeup from the previous guest. Every bath towel was stained, either black or yellow. There was also stained grout behind the toilet, suggesting a past leak. The shower curtain and hair dryer were equally stained. The hair dryer was so sticky, it seemed to be coated with decades' worth of low-quality hairspray.

While it's understandable that the hotel is aging and may require renovation soon, I urge you to invest in new bath towels and hair dryers now.

To clarify, I believe the cleaning staff is doing their utmost with the resources they have been provided. They simply need access to better starting materials.

yelp:test:409.orig: ate there recently for dinner, it was wonderful. i ordered the goat curry and was excited to try goat for the first time right after i found out it is the most consumed meat on earth outside of the US BUT the table of 12 Indian gentleman behind us had ordered it all....which led me to believe these guys know what they are doing. instead i tried the lamb and it was perfect. i really liked the candor of our waiter \""andrew\"", which was not his name but he called himself that with a grinning smirk; i told him i had ordered kingfisher lagers before and would love to try another beer since they had a few indian beers, he told me to stay with the kingfisher. also, once he told me the goat curry wasn't available i ordered tandoori lamb, he assured me it was good but encouraged me to try the curried lamb since i originally ordered goat curry. my ladyfriend ordered a veggie dish and loved it, we got some bread as well, she ordered some REASONABLY (which is becoming more rare these days) priced wine. all in all the food was very good and the service was near perfect, i like when a waiter can read what you are looking for, makes reco's on that judgment and nails them. i will be going back t
yelp:test:409.para: Recently, I dined at this place and thoroughly enjoyed it. I decided to try the goat curry, intrigued by its global popularity, but discovered a table of 12 Indian men had already claimed it. This made me confident in their culinary expertise. Instead, I opted for the lamb, which turned out to be delightful. Our waiter, Andrew, with a cheerful grin, remembered my previous preference for kingfisher lagers and suggested I stick with it. When I learned the goat curry was unavailable, he recommended the tandoori lamb, assuring its quality. My partner enjoyed her vegetarian dish and we also indulged in some bread and a modestly priced Indian wine. Overall, the meal was excellent and the service impeccable. I appreciate a waiter who can discern my preferences and deliver on them flawlessly. I'm looking forward to returning.

yelp:test:422.orig: HOHO CHERRY HOUSE, not to be confused with a brothel, offers average food at cheap prices. Fast delivery and friendly staff. No matter what protein you pick it pretty much tastes the same.
yelp:test:422.para: HOHO CHERRY HOUSE, distinct from a sex establishment, provides standard cuisine at affordable rates. Prompt service and amiable personnel. Regardless of your choice in protein, the flavor remains largely consistent.

yelp:test:434.orig: Honestly wish I could give it zero stars based on today... ? Security is beyond the worst. Check in with the airline was smooth, thats about it.\nI'm sure its not this bad everyday, or it would be on the news and or shutdown from the lack of business....
yelp:test:434.para: Truly regretful that I can't rate it as the lowest possible due to today's experience... The security measures were horrendous. The airline check-in process was seamless, that's the only positive aspect.\nI'm confident it's not a daily occurrence like this, otherwise it would be widely reported and possibly result in business suspension due to insufficient patronage...
