I'm very happy with how they handled my dog. (Though, from experience, it helps to schedule the first appointment of the morning and call them en route to warn them that a big scared dog is on its way.) They also see my cat, which has also always been a positive experience. (But he's always well behaved at the vet. He's just glad he gets let out of the evil plastic box inside the evil metal box on wheels. He doesn't care what
yelp:test:1529.para: My canine companion weighs 86 pounds and is a rescue still prone to anxiety when encountering unfamiliar people (and objects like vacuums, doorbells, and hardwood surfaces). Despite her intimidating stature when frightened, she requires yearly health assessments and vaccinations, and Lookout Mountain has been fortunate to receive her care. The reception staff efficiently guided her directly to the examination area upon our arrival, preventing her from enduring the waiting room's intimidating atmosphere. The compassionate vet technician and veterinarian treated her with exceptional patience and kindness during her visit. She reacted positively to their gentle demeanor, displaying better behavior than with any other individual, including the mail carrier. I am extremely satisfied with their treatment of my dog. (Based on past experiences, it's beneficial to arrange the first appointment of the day and inform them in advance about an anxious, large dog's arrival.) They also provide care for my feline friend, who has consistently had positive vet visits. (He remains calm at the vet, appreciating the freedom from his confinement in the unpleasant enclosures.) He doesn't mind being in the metal container on wheels.

yelp:test:1570.orig: Used to come to this library often while I was in school.  Haven't come here many times after 2007.  But still come here once or twice just to vote for City of Phoenix elections.  Very good location right by PV Mall and near SR-51 and Loop-101.  I believe the city cut the library hours, so this location doesn't even open on Fridays anymore.  But I would agreed on the good librarians working in the library.
yelp:test:1570.para: Regularly frequented this library during my school years, but my visits have significantly decreased post-2007. I still make occasional trips, specifically to cast my vote for Phoenix City elections. The library's prime location, adjacent to PV Mall and close to SR-51 and Loop-101, is noteworthy. I'm aware that the city has reduced library operating hours, resulting in the library being closed on Fridays. Nonetheless, I acknowledge the exceptional service provided by the library staff.

yelp:test:1596.orig:
Perhaps certain places don't deserve the lowest rating because the person doing the reviewing is not a good fit for that particular kind of place, and so, cannot review it accurately. Because of this, I gave this place an extra star just in case I am biased against these types of places.

Now I will paint humanity with a wide brush and put us all into two camps: 

1) Those who would rather play with a dog outside on the lawn on a nice warm afternoon.

2) Those of us who would rather slip outside the backdoor of a rock club in Berlin to snort a quick line.

Let me just say that in my camp we have no use for, nor desire to ever return to, this Outback Steakhouse type of establishment.

What I truly think about this place is not suitable for public utterance, but I will go so far as to say the food was dull, the drinks were mixed as if they were for a teething child and not a grown man, and the atmosphere looked as if the decorator was commissioned from the school of bathroom design.

If you died and went to this place, you would not be in hell, but you would not be very happy.
yelp:test:1596.para:
It's possible that some venues shouldn't receive the lowest score due to the reviewer's mismatched preferences, which could skew their evaluation. To account for this potential bias, I awarded this establishment an additional star.

In generalizing about humanity, I categorize people into two groups:

1) Individuals who prefer to engage with a dog in an open, sunny lawn setting.

2) Those who would rather discreetly enter a backdoor of a Berlin rock club for a quick drug fix.

I must clarify that my group has no interest in, nor inclination to revisit, establishments similar to Outback Steakhouse.

Regarding this specific place, I believe it's inappropriate to discuss openly. However, I can share that the food was uninspiring, the drinks seemed intended for a child rather than an adult, and the decor gave the impression of a bathroom design classroom.

If one were to perish and find themselves there, it wouldn't be a torment in hell, but it wouldn't be a joyous experience either.

yelp:test:1612.orig: I love this place, I come here allot all the food is amazing and well priced. Karaoke every night! and now comedy on Wednesday nights and I believe one other night and it is funny!!!\nService is good, most of the time and the people are all sorts from skaters to bikers to vocalists, if you wanna have a good time and not spend to much this is where you go!!!
yelp:test:1612.para: This location is my favorite, I frequently visit due to the delicious and affordable cuisine. Karaoke sessions occur nightly, and now there's comedy on Wednesdays and another night, all of which are enjoyable! The service is consistently good, and the crowd is diverse, ranging from skaters to bikers to singers. If you're looking for a fun experience without breaking the bank, this is the perfect spot!

yelp:test:1624.orig: i really hate to do this, but i have to. service was slower than slow. my bagel + cream cheese was super skimpy on the cream cheese. turkey chili was lukewarm and not as good as it should have been. the staff seemed gloomy and sad. it just wasn't a good experience. it really is too bad, i haven't had lunch at a einstein's in forever and i was hoping it would be as good as i remember it.
yelp:test:1624.para: It's unfortunate that I must express this, but I'm compelled to do so. The service was painfully slow. The bagel and cream cheese combination was disappointingly lacking in creaminess. The turkey chili was tepid and fell short of expectations. The atmosphere was draped in a somber mood. Overall, it was a regrettable dining experience. I've missed visiting Einstein's for lunch and had high hopes it would recapture the quality of my past memories.

yelp:test:1628.orig: The doctors and techs at this hospital bar none have been the most caring and compassionate vet I have ever experienced . My dog swallowed the end of a rawhide bone yesterday and I rushed her there hysterical of course. They gave her immediate attention and saved her life . That let me sit with her as she woke up from sedation and also stayed with us as she came to. Dr.Isom was right by our side and couldn't have been more comforting through my hysterical crying. After all was said and done I returned home so grateful with my girl Jazzy. Thank you Indian Bend
yelp:test:1628.para: The medical staff and technicians at this facility are unparalleled in their empathy and kindness, making them the most caring veterinarian I've ever encountered. When my dog ingested the tip of a rawhide bone the previous day, I was frantic and brought her in. They promptly attended to her, saving her life. I was able to comfort her as she recovered from sedation and remained with us during her recovery. Dr. Isom was a constant source of comfort, especially during my emotional outbursts. After everything was resolved, I returned home with my beloved Jazzy, deeply appreciative of the care provided at Indian Bend. Thank you.

yelp:test:1660.orig: Before I talk about the food I must say that this place is crazy expensive.  We tried this place because it was close and got tired of driving down to 7th Street for Pei Wei or Flamingo Palace. The pork fried rice was decent,  the house chicken was not at all good and the chicken lo mein was simply terrible  And for this less-than-mediocre food you pay more than Pei Wei and approaching P.F. Changs.  Next time I want typical chinese fair, I'll drive the extra few miles to Flamingo.
yelp:test:1660.para: Prior to discussing the cuisine, it's important to note that the establishment is quite pricey. We opted for this location due to its proximity, as we grew weary of the long drive to 7th Street for Pei Wei or Flamingo Palace. The pork fried rice was satisfactory, but the house chicken was disappointing and the chicken lo mein was downright awful. Considering the subpar food quality, the cost exceeds that of Pei Wei and nearly matches P.F. Changs. In the future, for authentic Chinese fare, I'll be willing to travel a bit further to Flamingo.

yelp:test:1667.orig: Very unaccomodating and expensive!  If your kids cannot make it to camp one day of the week, they will not allow a makeup day and the price stays the same.  They charge a \""late fee\"" if you want to come the same day, and don't seem to care whether they turn away new clients or customers because they are more interested in money.  Gold Metal Gymnastics in Chandler, although a bit further, is a better option.  They are friendly, kind, and know that with children and our lives, things don't always work out exactly as we want.  Save your money and go to another camp that cares about families and kids, and not about nickel and diming you.
yelp:test:1667.para: Extremely inflexible and costly! If children miss camp for a single day, no makeup day is permitted and the fee remains unchanged. A "late fee" is imposed for same-day attendance, and they prioritize profit over welcoming new families. Consider Gold Metal Gymnastics in Chandler, which is slightly farther away but offers a more accommodating and understanding environment. They are warm and considerate, recognizing that life with kids can be unpredictable. It's advisable to save funds and choose a camp that values family and child welfare over excessive charges.

yelp:test:1675.orig: I was using this cleaner for a few months, but not really sure why. The staff is rude and even worse, they jacked up my clothes. I asked for some repairs on two pairs of suit pants. Instead of fixing them, they sliced the butt of one of the pants and did not repair the other, while still charging me. Stupid me for not checking them before paying and going home. I don't trust them to fix it so I took them elsewhere. WILL NOT BE GOING BACK.
yelp:test:1675.para: For several months, I utilized this cleaning service, but my reasons for doing so were unclear. The employees were unpleasant and their actions were detrimental, as they damaged my suit pants. I requested repairs for two pairs, but they mutilated one and neglected the other, all while billing me. I regret not inspecting them prior to payment and leaving. Due to this lack of trust in their ability to mend, I decided to seek services elsewhere. I am firmly resolved not to return.

yelp:test:1717.orig: This is one of the better International airports in America.  The baggage unloading can be a slow process at times, but security lines, especially in the Delta terminal, go by in a flash!  My flights have always left on time, and I really, really appreciate the free WiFi!\n\nPHX is great!
yelp:test:1717.para:
This airport stands out as one of the superior International airports across America. Although the baggage unloading may occasionally drag, the security lines, particularly in the Delta terminal, swiftly proceed. My flights consistently depart punctually, and I am extremely grateful for the complimentary WiFi service!

PHX excels!

yelp:test:1726.orig: The airport is clean and looks like its been recently renovated. I'm not really fond that the rental car location is 10  minutes away though. Also, i dislike how you have to do a full body scan and get your fingers swiped for bomb stuff.. its like... really? out of all the airports ive been to, this is the only one that made me do it. lastly, the US airways employee at the airport booked me the wrong flight.!!! she gave me a ticket but when she put us in teh system, it was to a different place. we ended up staying in phoenix another night since there were no more flights back to so.cal.. NOT COOL! AND, they wouldnt even cover the cost of the hotel. They only offered a discount.. suppppppper lame!
yelp:test:1726.para: The airport exudes cleanliness and appears to have undergone recent upgrades. However, I'm not particularly pleased that the car rental area is a mere 10 minutes distant. Additionally, I find the requirement to undergo a comprehensive body scan and fingerprinting for security reasons quite excessive. It's peculiar that this airport is the sole one where I've been subjected to such measures. To add to the frustration, the US airways staff at the airport erroneously booked me on the incorrect flight. Despite being issued a ticket, the system indicated a different destination. Consequently, we had to extend our stay in Phoenix due to a lack of return flights to So.Cal. The airline's refusal to reimburse the hotel expenses, offering only a token discount, is utterly disappointing.

yelp:test:1729.orig: Very confusing airport.  For an International Airport, I would have expected a more luxury feel.  Definitely not the airport you would want to get stuck for hours in.  I flew southwest and Gate C and D did not have great restaurant choices or stores to look in.  You have to walk what feel likes miles to buy a water or grab a magazine, and food.
yelp:test:1729.para: The airport's layout was perplexing, especially for an international hub where one might anticipate a more opulent atmosphere. It's certainly not the ideal place to be stranded for extended periods. My journey southwest from here revealed that Gates C and D lacked appealing dining options or shopping venues. The distance one must traverse seems daunting to simply purchase essentials like water or magazines, not to mention food.

yelp:test:1737.orig: Awful place to have a layover. This airport is always overcrowded, hence, there is little seating and you'll likely find yourself squished between two strangers until your flight. To avoid the crowd, I recommend grabbing a book and finding a restaurant with bar seating to enjoy some quiet and a few drinks before boarding.
yelp:test:1737.para: This airport is not ideal for layovers due to its constant overcrowding, resulting in scarce seating and potential discomfort from being pressed against fellow passengers. To escape the bustle, consider taking a book and seeking out a dining area with bar seating to savor some tranquility and a couple of beverages prior to your flight.

yelp:test:1781.orig:
There were such mixed reviews that I had to find out for myself. I've been looking for a new neighborhood pizza joint and hoped that maybe this place could be it. no No NOOOO WAYYYYYY!!!
First: I ordered hot wings, all drummies and extra crispy. The rep said that I couldnt have my requested order because the wings come ""pre-made"", in ""oven-ready containers"". When someone orders wings, they take it out of the fridge and place the container in the oven to heat it up. Therefore, unable to take special requests.
The pizza arrived piping hot but I had asked for well done with the cheese brown and bubbly. The cheese was melted. I have to agree with the other reviews, there was an odd taste to the sauce and cheese. I'm from Wisconsin so I can taste real, quality cheese. This was very odd tasting ""cheese"". 
The wings were absolutely disgusting. Barely warm. I put them under the broiler after they were delivered and they still tasted rubbery. The skin was drenched in sauce but unable to get crispy, even after my broiler attempt. Very fatty.

yelp:test:1781.para:
I had to personally investigate due to the varied feedback. In search of a fresh pizza spot, I hoped this establishment might fulfill my expectations. Unfortunately, it was a definite NO!
Firstly, I requested hot wings, all drumsticks and extra crispy. The staff informed me that I couldn't have my specific order as the wings are "pre-made" and come in "oven-ready containers". When ordering wings, it's customary to remove them from the fridge and place them in the oven for heating, which means no special requests. 
The pizza was hot upon arrival, but I had requested it well done with a brown, bubbly cheese. The cheese was indeed melted, but I concurred with other reviews about the unusual taste of the sauce and cheese. Being from Wisconsin, I'm accustomed to authentic, high-quality cheese, and this was quite different. 
The wings were utterly revolting. They were barely warm, even after being put under the broiler. The skin was soaked in sauce but failed to crisp up, despite my broiling efforts. They were also very greasy. 
On a brighter note, the delivery was prompt. I would have appreciated if they had taken the additional time to at least try to please the customer.

yelp:test:1798.orig: This is my new place for sushi in the Valley.  Went for lunch on Tuesday and the place was busy but service was very prompt.  We ordered 3 different sushi rolls and a salad.  The portions were so large we took plenty home.  The ingredients were fresh and very flavorful.  Had the eel, spicy crab, and Mexican caliente rolls and all of them were absolutely DELISH!!!  If you're a sushi lover, you will not be disappointed!
yelp:test:1798.para: I've discovered a new sushi haven in the Valley. On a Tuesday, I dined there and it was bustling, yet the staff delivered service swiftly. We indulged in 3 unique sushi rolls and a side salad. The generous portions left us with leftovers. Fresh ingredients paired with robust flavors. I savored the eel, spicy crab, and Mexican caliente rolls, each a delightful treat. Sushi enthusiasts will find their expectations exceeded here.

yelp:test:1870.orig: they make smaller tables wait longer to be sat and the food is not that great you can get better food at mid level steakhouse
yelp:test:1870.para: The tables are smaller and experience delays in seating, and the quality of the cuisine pales in comparison to what you can find at a mid-range steakhouse.

yelp:test:1879.orig:
I am really impressed by this facility. Every machine you could want, Racquetball courts, The best spin bikes anywhere, large arobics room, free weights, TV's on the cardio some with ipod hookups, pool, spa and a steam room.

A small grip with the TV's on the cardio equipment is the channel selection. News stations spo
yelp:test:1879.para:
I find this establishment truly remarkable. It offers a wide array of equipment, including Racquetball courts, top-notch spin bikes, a spacious aerobics room, free weights, and TVs on cardio machines with iPod connections. There's also a pool, spa, and steam room. 

Despite potential issues with the staff's competence and the sales team's integrity, I'm fortunate to have been grandfathered in from PureFiness, so I rarely encounter these problems. 

The parking lot is a significant drawback for me, as it's filled with an excessive number of speed bumps per 100 feet, making it unsuitable for driving my convertible. Additionally, the smell in the free weight area back, reminiscent of a barn, is likely due to the floor's adhesive. I hope this issue resolves soon. 

The machines are well-maintained, with two to three of each type, including the latest Eclipse line, which are smooth and easily adjustable. The spin bikes are exceptional, offering a smooth ride and fully functional digital displays. 

The TVs on the cardio equipment have a small grip for channel selection, and I've had no issues with their functionality so far.

yelp:test:1897.orig: Saw Dr. Hetrick..I went to this office for Chronic headaches and neck pains. I felt like they did not care about my health condition and now I have Migraines. I told them I take medication that helps me a bit to get through the day but gets worse to the point where i'm out of it.What's their fix, a bag full of more medications (watch out liver) feels like they thought I was faking or something. Worst place to go really unhappy that I wasted my money and time
yelp:test:1897.para: Visited Dr. Hetrick's clinic for persistent headaches and neck discomfort. I felt neglected regarding my health issues, resulting in the onset of Migraines. I communicated that my current medication provides minimal relief, deteriorating to a point where I'm incapacitated. Their proposed solution, an excessive prescription of additional drugs (cautioning liver health), seemed to imply I was deceiving them. I am extremely dissatisfied, feeling like I've squandered both my finances and time.

yelp:test:1938.orig: I bought the voucher not knowing when I would use it. Then a carwash broke my windshield wipers on my brand new Q7 and the voucher came in very handy! I saved $25! Thanks YELP and Audi!
yelp:test:1938.para: I acquired a voucher without certainty of its future application. Subsequently, a car wash damaged the windshield wipers on my freshly acquired Q7, and the voucher proved extremely beneficial. I managed to save $25. Appreciation to YELP and Audi!

yelp:test:1949.orig: Checked out this place from the groupon last night. Friday night at 750 most tables were full ONE server. ordered our food, the the wings that were small and undercooked with generic sauce. got some garlic bread that we did enjoy. we had our drinks and all 3 cups were empty with some ice and I put them at the end of the table hoping the ONE server would notice, we had to call her over for refills, she said for which ones...... (I should have said only the EMPTY ones) ALL of our dishes from the garlic bread and wings sat on the table the ENTIRE time. we ordered the White pizza and realized when we got it there was no ricotta on it. I didnt want to complain I was tired of this place. The table behind us never had their pizza put in and they sat after us, and barely got their pizza as we were talking out the door. OIL everywhere on the pizza. That should not happen with white pizza. Here is the kicker, from about 820pm (FRIDAY NIGHT) they turned away 3 groups of people because \""they had NOTHING left in the kitchen\"" Really? you put out a groupon not preparing for the influx of customers?!?!??! Those people will NEVER come back when a pizza place is OUT OF FOOD at 845. such an embar
yelp:test:1949.para: Explored this establishment via a groupon deal last evening. At 7:30 PM, nearly all tables were occupied by a single waiter. We ordered our meal, including small, undercooked wings with a basic sauce, but found the garlic bread to be enjoyable. Our drinks were consumed, leaving three empty cups with ice, which I placed at the table's end, hoping the lone server would refill them. Unfortunately, she asked for specifics, and I should have specified only the empty ones. All our dishes, including the garlic bread and wings, remained untouched throughout. We also ordered White pizza but found it lacking in ricotta. Despite my fatigue with the place, I refrained from complaining. The table behind us experienced a similar issue with their pizza, which was barely served while we were engaged in conversation. The pizza was oily, which is unacceptable for white pizza. The situation escalated around 8:20 PM when three groups were turned away due to a complete lack of food, a consequence of not anticipating the groupon-induced customer surge. This incident will likely deter these customers from returning to a pizza place that ran out of food at 8:45 PM.

yelp:test:1968.orig: Chips, bean dip, and salsa was ok. Green burrito, rice and beans were below average. There was no green chili flavor at all - basically it was a brownish, dull flavor. The meat chunks were tough and not fit to eat. The rice and beans tasted a few days old. Margarita was ok, not much alcohol though. I usually go to Rositas which is right across the street - their green burrito (try it smothered in green sauce and cheese) is 100 x's better than Serranos - in fact every thing is better at Rositas. I will head over to the chandler Serranos and try that next time - hopefully they don't bring their food in from the same place as this one.  Honestly I can't believe this place is still in business. Try Rositas instead for some excellent mexican food.
yelp:test:1968.para: The chips, bean dip, and salsa were satisfactory. The green burrito, rice, and beans were subpar, lacking any green chili essence, resulting in a dull, brownish taste. The meat was chewy and unpalatable. The rice and beans had a stale flavor. The margarita was passable, though it had a low alcohol content. I typically prefer Rositas, just a block away, where their green burrito, smothered in green sauce and cheese, vastly outshines Serranos. I plan to visit Chandler Serranos next time, hoping they source their ingredients differently. In my opinion, this establishment should cease operations. I recommend Rositas for superior Mexican cuisine.

yelp:test:2000.orig: Wow this is a really nice place. I've never visited this cinema before, but I was surprised. The restrooms are clean and modern, the theatre is a great size and they have a great selection at the snack bar. I will go back to this theatre for sure.
yelp:test:2000.para: This location is truly impressive. I haven't been here to this cinema before, yet I was taken aback. The restrooms are spotless and contemporary, the auditorium is spacious and they offer an excellent variety at the concession stand. I am certain to return to this venue.

yelp:test:2015.orig: I had been going to them for years, but stopped a few years back feeling they lacked the attention to detail they once had. Well, they didn't tell me one popped into my engine and they did not try to retrieve it! A month ago the plug worked its way into my pump. Engine smoked, seized, and shredded my s-belt. Repair job costing me a few hundred dollars. I say lucky, because it could have been far worse, like the car is on the highway moving to another state and/or I completely lose the engine. Your better off doing the work yourself or taking it to AAA. The local AAA shop on E. Valle
yelp:test:2015.para: For years, I frequented them, but ceased a few years ago due to a perceived decline in their meticulousness. This perception was validated when problems emerged. I found incorrect components (such as an improperly sized fuel filter) and a freeze plug lodged in my engine—a stark contrast to the previous year when they replaced leaking freeze plugs. Unfortunately, they failed to inform me of a new one that had infiltrated my engine, nor did they attempt to remove it. A month prior, this plug caused my engine to smoke, seize, and damage my s-belt. Fortunately, the incident occurred on a side street, allowing me to safely stop, turn off the vehicle, and have AAA tow it to their facility. AAA identified the problem and extracted the damaged plug from my pump. The repair cost me several hundred dollars. I consider myself fortunate, as the situation could have been much worse, potentially involving a highway accident or a complete engine loss. I would be cautious about their work, particularly due to safety concerns. The meticulousness they once displayed has noticeably diminished and remains lacking. I would recommend either undertaking the repairs yourself or entrusting the task to AAA. The local AAA shop on E. Valle is a viable option.

yelp:test:2029.orig: Service was bad and food was subpar.
yelp:test:2029.para: The quality of service was unsatisfactory and the food did not meet expectations.

yelp:test:2041.orig:
I liked this place... because it's a local owned place with delicious greasy food. This place was written up in the East Valley Trib in one of their ""5 to try"" pieces, which is where I first heard about it. But, I actually think it's funnier that I have been in ""Hall of Fame"", a store located direclty next door several times and never given Giant Hamburgers a second glance. 

You walk into this place, past a grouping of tables and booths (only about 15 tables in the entire place)  to the cash register where you order your meal. We each got a burger and fries and they were both great, a real gut-bomb, but sometimes you're in the mood for something that fits just that description. We sat and ate, and they came to bus our table for us. 

On the way out, we noticed the ""Yelp"" sticker on the door. Bonus points.
yelp:test:2041.para:
I enjoyed this establishment due to its ownership by locals and its mouthwatering, indulgent cuisine. I discovered it in the East Valley Trib's "5 to try" segment, which led me to it. However, I find it amusing that I've frequented "Hall of Fame", a neighboring shop, numerous times without considering Giant Hamburgers. 

Entering this venue, you pass a small cluster of tables and booths (around 15 in total) before reaching the cashier to place your order. We each opted for a burger and fries, both satisfyingly filling, though sometimes you crave something that matches that exact profile. We dined and were attended to by staff who cleared our table. 

Noticing the "Yelp" sticker on the exit door, I appreciate the extra recognition.

yelp:test:2057.orig:
I was there this weekend, both Saturday and Sunday for a Youth Tournament for my son. Our ""home bowling alley"" is the Brunswick Zone on Southern and Dobson. This was my first time to this particular alley. This was the worst bowling alley I have ever been to in my entire 31 years of living. 

The location is hidden back behind some office buildings. The building is plain, late 60's decor. The interior, from what I was told, had not been updated in over a decade at least. The newest renovation was a strip of fluorescent carpeting and some fluorescent paint on the walls. (for neon bowling I presume) 

There is no real seating for the bowlers. There are tables and chairs randomly placed through out the building. Each table only gets 4 chairs, so if someone else steals a chair or you have more than 4 bowlers, someone is going to have to stand.  On a rack, in the corner, in the back, there are about 20 alley owned balls, so good luck getting one in the right weight. The bathrooms are tiny and dilapidated.  Whole chunks missing out of several spots in the tile. The handicapped stall has a baby changing station that does not fold up. It stays wide open, so you can't even get in th
yelp:test:2057.para:
This past weekend, I attended a Youth Bowling Tournament with my son at our local Brunswick Zone, located at Southern and Dobson. It was my first visit to this specific venue. Unfortunately, it was the most disappointing bowling alley I've ever experienced in my 31 years of residence. 

The venue is tucked away behind office complexes. The structure itself is unremarkable, with late 60's style decor. The interior, as per the information I received, hasn't seen any significant updates for at least a decade. The most recent renovation involved adding fluorescent carpeting and wall paint, likely for a neon bowling ambiance. 

There's a lack of proper seating for bowlers. Tables and chairs are scattered throughout the building. Each table accommodates only four chairs, meaning if someone else takes a chair or if there are more than four bowlers, someone will have to stand. In the corner, back of the building, there are roughly 20 alley-owned balls, making it quite challenging to find one of the right weight. The restrooms are small and in poor condition, with missing tiles and a handicapped stall that features a non-foldable baby changing station. It remains open, preventing easy access.

yelp:test:2059.orig: Oh my gosh:(  This morning I didn't get a breakfast so stopped at this BK for breakfast sandwich and coffee.  I told her no cheese on my sandwich. yelp:test:2059.para:
Oh no :( This morning I skipped breakfast and grabbed a breakfast sandwich and coffee from BK. I requested no cheese on my sandwich, and she confirmed twice, "yes, no cheese please." However, she misunderstood and my sandwich was loaded with cheese. I usually enjoy cheese, but I wasn't in the mood today. I had to remove the cheese-covered top and ham. I ended up eating just the egg and bottom biscuit. My morning started off poorly. I visited BK at 2024 E Southern Ave, Mesa. This was my last visit to this spot. I can't help but wonder how bad it would be during busy hours. This morning, at 9:50am, the place wasn't too crowded.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, sentiment, emotion, and intent while changing the wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept relatively the same.)

yelp:test:2072.orig: Ordered empanadas to go. Three orders and $28 later...I cut them open and 75 to 80% of them were EMPTY! yelp:test:2072.para: I placed an order for takeout empanadas, which cost me $28. Upon opening them, I discovered that 75-80% were hollow. I reached out to the manager, who explained that they are freshly prepared on-site, acknowledging this as a recurring problem. She promised to send me coupons for my wasted money, but this has not occurred. I'm now considering contacting my credit card company.

yelp:test:2078.orig: Having lived in Hawaii for over 5 years, I constantly have a craving for Hawaiian food. Moki's reminds me of little local restaurants in Hawaii. When I walk in I feel like I'm back in the islands. The atmosphere is very local style and the people are totally laid back. The decor has a do-it-yourself feel that IS local kine. \n\nI've tried every Hawaiian restaurant in the Valley and this is by far my favorite. I go back often and highly recommend Moki's to anyone looking for some great Hawaiian eats!
yelp:test:2078.para: Over half a decade in Hawaii has instilled in me a persistent desire for local Hawaiian cuisine. Moki's evokes memories of quaint island eateries. Upon entering, I am transported back to the islands. The ambiance exudes a genuine local charm, and the staff embody a relaxed demeanor. The decor's handcrafted vibe is distinctly local. \n\nAmong all the Hawaiian dining establishments in the area, Moki's stands out as my top pick. I frequently visit and wholeheartedly endorse Moki's to anyone seeking authentic Hawaiian dining experiences!

yelp:test:2092.orig: First off its a buffet , not a gourmet one you see at a high class vegas hotel or anything.. We moved here 8 mos ago from out of state and have been to another location but this particular location has been a great one! We usually go on Thurs nights because kids are only $1 to eat. Cant beat that! The food has been delicious both visits. The steak is Ranchers Reserve Sirloin and is always tasty and tender. The  hand carved roast beef is a perfect Med rare and is tasty and super tender as well. The servers stay busy so may not get plates off table super fast but its not that big of a deal.. We overall really are impressed with this location! They even have unlimited milk refills and and icee machine too with unlimited refills!!!!
yelp:test:2092.para: Initially, it's a casual buffet, not an upscale gourmet establishment like those found in luxurious Vegas hotels. We relocated here 8 months back from another state and have tried other places, but this specific spot has been exceptional! We typically visit on Thursday nights as children's meals are priced at just $1. It's an unbeatable deal! The cuisine has consistently been delightful on both occasions. The Ranchers Reserve Sirloin steak is always flavorful and soft, while the meticulously prepared roast beef is perfectly medium rare, equally delicious and extremely tender. The staff is often occupied, which might slow down the service, but it's not a significant issue. Overall, we are genuinely impressed with this venue! They also offer unlimited milk refills and an icee machine with unlimited refills!

yelp:test:2102.orig:

Understandable, considering the mix-up...only, he had ZERO interest or mo
yelp:test:2102.para:
This critique pertains to Delta Mechanical operations in both AZ and CO, where I reside and have also interacted with their AZ-based corporate office. Despite my attempt to be succinct, the essence of my experience reveals a significant disconnect within the company and a lack of commitment to client service. 

As a third-party installer for Home Depot, Delta Mechanical was hired to install a toilet for my household. I arranged the installation for a week later, between 8-10 AM, to avoid any potential disruptions or complications.

On the scheduled day, at 8:30 AM, I was informed by Delta Mechanical that they lacked the required details to proceed with the installation. I engaged with both the installer and the corporate office in an effort to rectify the situation.

During my initial conversation with the installer, I discovered that despite his proficiency in toilet installation, he was deficient in customer service abilities. When I inquired about the issue with my order and what assistance he might need from me, he responded, "I've already moved on to my next job. Nothing I can do."

While this explanation is understandable given the confusion, it's disappointing to note his complete lack of interest or initiative in resolving the issue.

yelp:test:2131.orig: I bought my wedding dress here and I was very impressed with pretty much everything here.  The staff was very kind and helpful and even shared in my excitement of choosing a wedding dress.  It felt like I was with friends.  The store is a decent size with a very wide variety of wedding dresses.  They have dude stuff too.  I was very impressed with the girls who helped me because I didn't have a picture of the dress I wanted with me, but they helped me narrow it down and we found \""The One.\""  They are also very good at finding dresses that may also fit your tastes.  Overall, it was just such a pleasant experience and I would recommend it to anyone.  Oh, they will also steam and press your dress right before the big day so it's all beautiful.
yelp:test:2131.para: I procured my nuptial gown from this establishment and was thoroughly satisfied with nearly all aspects. The personnel exhibited exceptional friendliness and assistance, even partaking in my joy during the selection process. It resembled a gathering with companions. The shop boasts a reasonable area with an extensive assortment of bridal attire, including unisex options. The assistance provided by the female staff was commendable, especially since I lacked a visual reference for my desired dress, yet they adeptly guided me to the perfect match, referred to as "The One." They also excel in tailoring choices to align with individual preferences. In summary, the encounter was delightful and I would endorse it to anyone. Additionally, they offer to steam and press your dress prior to the significant occasion, ensuring it looks impeccable.

yelp:test:2147.orig: yumm so good, hard to find though! But its the best breakfast place that I've found around here..but I'm still looking ;)
yelp:test:2147.para: This breakfast joint is absolutely delicious, though it's quite elusive! Nonetheless, it stands out as the top spot I've discovered in the vicinity. Still on the hunt, though!

yelp:test:2166.orig: Mediocre, corporately-bland Mexican food (as one would expect from a chain restaurant, even though Los Gringos apparently isn't). The perky waitress either didn't deliver my simple request to the kitchen or they ignored it: I asked for my Chimichanga extra crispy, it arrived soft and doughty. Good chips & salsa, but that should be a given. Wouldn't go back and can only assume the diners giving four or five stars to Los Gringos have never had top flight Mexican. It you think the Olive Garden is good Italian food, this might be the place you; otherwise steer clear.
yelp:test:2166.para: Mediocre, chain-style Mexican cuisine (as anticipated from a restaurant group, despite Los Gringos' reputation). The cheerful server either failed to pass my straightforward order to the kitchen or it was disregarded: I requested my Chimichanga to be extra crispy, but it came out soft and lackluster. The chips and salsa were decent, but that's expected. I won't return and presume that the patrons awarding four or five stars to Los Gringos have never experienced exceptional Mexican food. If you believe Olive Garden serves excellent Italian, this might be your place; otherwise, avoid it.

yelp:test:2243.orig: The salads here are absolutely delicious and there is so many choices to choose from! yelp:test:2248.orig: The staff here and the PTs are excellent! yelp:test:2254.orig:
I have frequented this place quite a few times, and its okay.  The things I like about it are the late hours, ""free"" internet as long as you buy a drink and the indoor and outdoor seating.

What I don't like is how they now regulate the internet.  When you purchase a drink, they give you a reciept for only 3 hours worth of internet service.  It's not that I personally need more then 3 hours of service at one time, but why regulate the Wifi?  Maybe its to stop people from camping out and hogging up space or something, I'm not sure.

yelp:test:2254.para: I've visited this location multiple times and found it satisfactory. The aspects I appreciate include the extended operating hours, complimentary internet access contingent upon purchasing a beverage, and the availability of both indoor and outdoor seating. However, I'm not fond of the new internet usage restrictions. When I buy a drink, I receive a limited internet access receipt valid for three hours. I don't require more than that duration of service at once, but I question the rationale behind regulating Wi-Fi access. It could be a measure to prevent individuals from monopolizing space, though I'm uncertain about the exact reason. The staff has consistently been courteous to me, though my visits are infrequent, averaging once a month, primarily to utilize their late-night hours.

yelp:test:2275.orig:
As Jesse J. said we went here last night for some sushi after i had looked here on Yelp and man was it worth it. So far this is probably the best sushi I have had in Arizona.

My favorite roll was the big and spicy roll. The flavor was just amazing with the seared salmon and yellowtail(?) on top with the pickled jaleneno. The sauce on it was amazing as well this is one where no soy sauce is needed.

Also ordered a spicy tuna but asked him to go a little on the spicy side and he obliged and it was a nice fiery roll but not so much that the taste of the tuna got lost. It but some burning on my tounge but was amazing.

The rest of the meal was jut as good especially the tsunami roll which I can best describe as a vegas roll minus the cream cheese(i am no a fan of cream cheese in sushi) with it's own special sauce. The sauce was a great mix of hot and sweet where you got a bit of a kick but it was cooled quickly. Even people who don't do spice will like this.

The only things preventing this from being a 5 star place was that i never got the water i ordered and some of my miso soup was cold, i think the tofu had not been in long enough. A return visit is planned soon and could
yelp:test:2275.para:
According to Jesse J., we visited this sushi spot last evening, having read positive reviews on Yelp. It's likely the finest sushi experience I've had in Arizona.

My preferred roll was the large, fiery one, with a delightful blend of seared salmon and yellowtail, topped with pickled jalapenos. The accompanying sauce was equally impressive, making soy sauce unnecessary.

I also tried a spicy tuna roll, requesting extra heat, which was well-balanced, not overpowering the tuna's flavor. It left a slight burn on my tongue, but the overall taste was fantastic.

The remainder of the meal was equally enjoyable, particularly the tsunami roll, which I'd liken to a Vegas roll minus the cream cheese, as I'm not a fan. It came with a unique sauce that offered a mix of heat and sweetness, providing a quick cooling sensation. Even those who don't typically enjoy spicy foods would likely appreciate it.

The only reasons this place didn't achieve a perfect 5-star rating were the unfulfilled water order and some lukewarm miso soup, possibly due to the tofu not being adequately heated. Despite these minor issues, I plan to revisit soon.

yelp:test:2310.orig: Having first oil change in this little car. Terrible service compare to the Honda and Toyota dealerships I been at.  Employees don't smile, no water for customers on the fridge, no snacks or news paper. Employees using the same restroom customers do.  The waiting area need to make lots of changes to make customers happy.
yelp:test:2310.para: Initial oil change experience in this compact vehicle was disappointing, especially when compared to the customer service at Honda and Toyota outlets. The staff lacked warmth, with no refreshments available on the fridge, and no snacks or newspapers in sight. Shared restroom facilities for both employees and customers were also noted. Significant improvements are needed in the waiting area to enhance customer satisfaction.

yelp:test:2320.orig: Bad day? I don't know. I've had better meals at other Red Lobster restaurants. The only good thing about tonight's experience was the waiter, Bryan. Fast, efficient, polite and funny, just how I like it. We had a Lobsterita (huge margarita) and shared it. Regretted it too, since it was way too sour and had a chemical taste to it. I couldn't take but two sips and then I switched to something else that I knew it'll taste much better, water. The salads were made with wilted lettuce and sore looking tomatoes. Croutons were ok. The all too familiar hot bread was good, as it is always. The main dish, a medium cooked steak and grilled shrimp was delivered on time. Steak was chewy at best, although the marinade's taste was ok. Shrimp were grilled well, not too much or too little. My wife's shrimp scampi was absolutely tasteless, overcooked shrimp in some sort of shrimp juice, with very little butter and no garlic. Pretty horrifying if you ask me.\n\nI think this is the last visit we're going to pay to this location. As I said before, I've had much better meals there and I cannot justify the bill when we are not satisfied with the quality of food. Too bad...
yelp:test:2320.para: I'm not sure if it was a bad day, but I've enjoyed better meals at other Red Lobster locations. The sole positive aspect of our visit tonight was the service provided by Bryan, who was quick, courteous, amusing, and just as I prefer. We indulged in a Lobsterita (large margarita), but I regret it now because it was excessively tart and had an artificial flavor. I managed only two sips before opting for water, which I knew would be more palatable. The salads were disappointing, featuring limp lettuce and unappealing tomatoes. The croutons were acceptable. The familiar hot bread was enjoyable, as it consistently is. The steak, cooked medium, was at best tough, but the marinade's flavor was acceptable. The shrimp were grilled to perfection, neither over nor underdone. However, my wife's shrimp scampi was utterly bland, consisting of overcooked shrimp in a shrimp-based sauce with minimal butter and no garlic. It was quite distressing. I believe this will be our final visit to this place. Despite having better experiences there in the past, I can't justify the expense when the food quality doesn't meet our expectations. It's unfortunate.

yelp:test:2354.para: The financial aspect is impressive, and we adore the spinach enchilada dish.

I recommend this hotel if you are not going to b
yelp:test:2532.para: If you're in Scottsdale, this is an excellent accommodation option, situated roughly a 15-20 minute stroll from Fashion Square and Old Town. We managed to secure substantial savings through hotels.com, and I've noticed similar discounts on Living Social, indicating alternative methods for further reductions. The hotel's free shuttle service to and from the airport, along with complimentary hot breakfast prepared to order, added to our savings. Our room boasted a living area, a kitchenette, dual televisions, and an extra sink in the bedroom, which proved particularly useful for simultaneous preparations for my aunt and me. Additionally, a Dollar Rent A Car service is conveniently located on-site, offering AMEX discounts. The concierge was exceptionally helpful, arranging our Sedona tour before we arrived. While some front desk employees were more amiable than others, the courtyard area's appearance didn't quite match the visuals in the pictures, and I concur with other Yelpers that a renovation is necessary. I still advise this hotel for those not requiring aesthetic perfection.

yelp:test:2615.para: Last week, I joined friends and took on the role of the designated driver for the evening. The entry fee was $5 to enjoy the house band's performance, which I found acceptable, and I also requested a diet coke for an additional $3, which I was willing to pay. After about half an hour of dancing, I headed to the bar for a refill of my diet coke, expecting it to be complimentary. However, the bartender informed me it would cost another $3. I pointed out that I was the responsible driver for a group of people consuming alcohol and that the purpose was to discourage drunk driving and promote responsible behavior. Unfortunately, this didn't change the situation, so I opted for a glass of water instead. The bartender explained that they had a policy of a two-drink minimum for water. Now in July in AZ, I had been dancing with a group, and despite being the designated driver, I found it peculiar that the bartender wouldn't provide me with water, even though I was not trying to be frugal but rather highlighting that most bars recognize and honor the designated driver's role. I was being responsible and they couldn't even offer me a simple glass of water.

yelp:test:2680.orig:
I've been here a few times. A couple of times with the husband to enjoy a Groupon and a special menu option. And twice for ladies night with the co-workers since they do a special ladies night menu the first Tuesday of every month - which has a good price for all you get!

We almost always call ahead and make reservations - on ladies night, a reservation is a MUST since it fills up quickly.  The staff is always really friendly and they are more than happy to walk you through the process if you are new here.  The drinks are strong and the food comes in stages so you can really make this an great date night.  

I'd be torn to choose between the cheese appetizer and the chocolate dessert for my favorite part of the meal, but since I'm more of a sweet than salty fan, I'll go with the dessert.  They always have special check-in offers and from time to time they offer Groupons, as well.  If you sign up online for their mailing list, you'll get some decent offers there, too!

Overall: A
A great spot for a date night experience, ladies night out, or special dinner for a loved one! Be sure to seek out specials since it can get a touch pricey.
yelp:test:2680.para:
I've visited this place multiple times. I've enjoyed a Groupon and a unique menu selection with my spouse, and also participated in ladies night with colleagues twice, as they offer a special menu on the first Tuesday of each month at a reasonable price. 

We typically call ahead and book a table, especially on ladies night as it gets booked up fast. The team is consistently welcoming and willing to guide newcomers through the experience. The beverages are potent and the meals are served in courses, making it an ideal setting for a memorable date night. 

Deciding between the cheese starter and the chocolate treat for my preferred meal part is tough, but I lean towards the dessert as I prefer sweet over savory. They often have special check-in deals and occasionally provide Groupons. Signing up for their email list can also yield some good offers.

In summary: A fantastic choice for a date night, ladies night, or a special meal for someone you care about. Don't forget to look out for deals as it can be a bit costly.

yelp:test:2913.orig:
My husband and I ate at the Siamese Cat for the first time last night. I am very disappointed in all the dishes we ordered.

When trying a new Thai restaurant for the first time, my husband I always get our favorite dishes. We ordered Laab Gai, chicken satay, phad kee Mao (drunken noodles) and phad bai kra prao. It's a lot of food but like most Asians, we like variety in our meal. 

The satay came out first and it was ok. Nothing memorable- you could taste a hint of the curry power but not much. The peanut sauce was super oily. 

Next was the Laab - I had high hopes for this because it usually is always good everywhere I go but this dish was much too salty.

The noodle dish was the worst dish. The noodles were really hard.  I could tell they did not warm up the noodles enough before cooking it. Also, there was no flavor to this dish at all. A big disappointment as phad kee Mao is always flavorful with the sauce and basil. 

Lastly the stirfry tasted nothing like what it should have tasted like. It was a typical stir fry and it was quite dry. 

Overall we phad 33 for everything so the food was cheap. The service is better than most Asian restaurants so we tipped our wait
yelp:test:2913.para:
Last night, my spouse and I dined at the Siamese Cat, an experience that left me quite disheartened with the meals we selected.

When exploring a new Thai eatery for the first time, my partner and I typically opt for our preferred dishes. We chose Laab Gai, chicken satay, phad kee Mao (drunken noodles), and phad bai kra prao. We enjoy a diverse array of flavors, a common preference among Asians. 

The chicken satay arrived first and was satisfactory, though it lacked a strong impression - a slight trace of curry was noticeable, but it was not prominent. The peanut sauce was excessively greasy. 

Next was the Laab, which I had anticipated to be excellent based on my previous experiences, but it was overly salty. 

The noodle dish, phad kee Mao, was the most disappointing. The noodles were excessively hard, indicating they were not adequately heated before cooking. There was also a complete absence of flavor, which was a significant letdown as this dish is usually rich in taste with its sauce and basil. 

Lastly, the stir-fry did not resemble what it should have tasted like. It was a standard stir-fry but was excessively dry. 

Des

yelp:test:2919.orig: When I was the young age of 3, my mom brought me to YC's. I have been going ever since. yelp:test:2919.para: As a 3-year-old, my mother introduced me to YC's. I've been visiting this unique spot ever since, offering a refreshing departure from conventional dining establishments where you're confined to a predetermined menu. Here, you're encouraged to craft your own Mongolian stir-fry, utilizing an extensive array of raw ingredients from the buffet. The result is always impeccably prepared, bursting with flavor, and tailored to your exact preferences, ensuring repeat visits. yelp:test:3000.orig:
There are several shared characteristics of a good dive bar:
1. Cash only for cheap, stiff drinks.
2. Pool tables (or alternately, shuffle board. darts must be combined with some other lure in order to count.)
3. Jukebox (classic rock required, the top 40 laughed out of the place.)
4. An air of disrepair (rips in the booth upholstery, musty smell of smoke on the air- because despite the ban, it's already been cured into the wood.)

This place has all those things in spades.

I hardly ever end up at the Time Out Lounge because I never carry cash, but the drinks are deliciously strong and don't strip your wallet of its greenery too quick. There's an ATM there too. The pitchers and half pitchers are also pretty cheap, but if you're drinking by yourself, you're required to get the half pitcher. Apparently they can't serve you a drink the size of your head in one sitting. What wacky laws.

There are several pool tables that take up the majority of the space, but if you're going during the rush, good luck securing one of them. I'm not that great at pool, but I really enjoy playing at this place (usually with a good partner I can coast off of and then gloat with after we win) be
yelp:test:3000.para:
Several key traits define an excellent dive bar:
1. Only cash transactions for affordable, potent beverages.
2. Presence of pool tables (or shuffleboard, with darts as an additional attraction).
3. A jukebox featuring classic rock, rejecting modern hits.
4. A sense of neglect (visible wear on booth cushions, pervasive scent of smoke due to its integration into the wood, despite a ban).

This establishment embodies all these elements to a great extent.

I seldom visit the Time Out Lounge as I rarely have cash on hand, but the strong drinks are satisfying and don't deplete my funds rapidly. There's an ATM available. The pitchers and half-pitchers are reasonably priced, but solo drinkers must opt for the half-pitcher. It seems they can't serve a drink as large as your head in one go. It's peculiar regulations.

Multiple pool tables occupy most of the area, but during peak times, finding a table can be challenging. Although I'm not skilled at pool, I find pleasure in playing here (typically with a competent partner, allowing us to bask in victory).

yelp:test:3246.orig:
This ""restaurant"" is, quite possibly, the worst place I have ever eaten - and I've traveled through Arkansas, so that's saying something.  

The waitress was only mildly interested in being there, and our dining experience only went downhill from there.  The food was among the most mediocre I have ever eaten.  The BBQ sliders (dry pork with a drop or two of sauce and some cole slaw) I got for an appetizer were barely appetizing.  My entree was an 8-oz sirloin (because, at 6:00 on a Tuesday, they were out of the only other cut of steak on the menu), which was completely without flavor.  Ordered with grilled onions, it arrived with mushrooms on it, and when I sent it back for grilled onions, it came out covered in raw onions that had been dropped on the grill for less than 10 seconds.  The accompanying beer-battered onion rings were uninspiring, as were the steak fries. 

And the atmosphere - it is very hard to describe.  The decor is ambitious and has some potential - but it needs people to liven it up.  It won't, however, get people with the lackluster food and service.  Generally, the place seemed like an old adult book store where someone decided to serve food.
yelp:test:3246.para:
This eatery might be the most disappointing dining spot I've encountered, especially considering my extensive travels across Arkansas.  

The server showed minimal enthusiasm, and our meal quickly deteriorated. The cuisine was notably average, with BBQ sliders (dry pork with a scant amount of sauce and some coleslaw) for a starter that barely whetted my appetite. My main course, an 8-oz sirloin (since they were out of other steak options at 6:00 on a Tuesday), was utterly devoid of taste. When I requested it with grilled onions, it was served with mushrooms instead, and upon returning it, it was topped with undercooked onions that had been briefly grilled. The beer-battered onion rings and steak fries were equally unremarkable. 

The ambiance is difficult to articulate. The decor is grand and holds promise, but it requires patrons to inject some life into it. However, it's unlikely to attract people due to the uninspired food and service. The place generally resembled an outdated adult bookstore that decided to offer food.

yelp:test:3259.para: I've spent my career focusing on animal behavior and biology, having worked at a zoo, which intensifies my scrutiny of each animal park I encounter. This is a privately owned zoo, and I'm aware of some individuals who have been employed there or have held positions there, and they share their concerns about the exhausting nature of the work, which is a separate issue. In this review, I aim to set aside my preconceptions, as my partner accompanied me, and I didn't want to spoil our experience. The zoo is well-structured, tidy, and offers a comprehensive experience in a single day. However, the downside is that the mammal exhibits are dull and compact, offering minimal stimulation for the animals. The reptile exhibits are also quite antiquated, despite featuring a diverse range of reptiles, which leaves me feeling disheartened for these creatures. It appears that once a section of the zoo is constructed, it's often neglected, with new developments being prioritized instead. On a positive note, the aquarium section is commendable, though it could benefit from a greater variety.

yelp:test:3278.para: While my spouse and I were completing our shopping tasks, time seemed to sprint by, and we found ourselves extremely hungry. yelp:test:3343.para:
The food is dreadful, with shells lacking crispiness, undercooked meat devoid of taste, and unappetizing combinations. People don't just consume Enchiladas! The Taco salad is a poor selection. Taquitos are the name for rolled tacos. Fajitas lack juiciness, and the prices are exorbitant. The re-fried beans are mashed, missing whole uncooked beans, which is revolting! The kid's menu ends at 10, leaving 11 and 12-year-olds puzzled. Adults? 

A comprehensive menu revamp is necessary. The bathrooms are compact and emit a musty odor. Waitstaff are slow to deliver drink refills, except for bar items. The building's limited space prevents comfortable seating for four. 

The outdated green wall color is uninviting. Consider an authentic Mexican restaurant's decor. Horse imagery is more suited to the old west than Mexico. This American/Mexican restaurant could use a modern makeover. Anita's Cocina is weary and requires urgent technological enhancements, like free wifi. Move your outdoor decorations indoors. yelp:test:3407.orig:
It really hurts me to update and down grade my review, but today, was so unacceptable.

I walked into BRUS today, because my husband and I have decided that it is time for our 8 month old to sleep in her own room, (her crib). I got the ""breathable"" mesh bumpers at my baby shower, almost a year ago, and they haven't really worked out for two reasons.

i believe the associate's name was Beth, and man, she was as mean as a snake.

yelp:test:3407.para:
It genuinely pains me to revise and lower my assessment, but today's experience was utterly disappointing.

My spouse and I concluded that our 8-month-old should sleep in her own crib, which came with mesh bumpers from our baby shower a year prior. These bumpers haven't proven effective for two reasons:

1. The crib features a solid wood back panel.
2. Our daughter forcefully pushes her head against the crib, preferring to sleep in corners.

As she's grown older and the risk of SIDS diminishes, I sought out regular (padded) bumpers.

I suspect the salesperson's name was Beth, and she was as unpleasant as a venomous snake.

She essentially warned me that I'd be endangering my child if I used bumpers on the crib. She also speculated that some regions might cease selling bumpers in the future. I should consult my physician before purchasing bumpers, as babies could potentially become entangled in them.

I struggle to comprehend how this could happen when bumpers are attached to the crib.

The irony lies in the fact that she has a bumper available for sale at $20.

S

yelp:test:3556.orig:

Every single one of them agree that it is not Mexican at all. 
Taco Bell would be more Mexican than this. I'm embarrassed of this place. 
I've eaten here 3 times and I hated everything. My parents hate it too and we couldn't even finish our meal. 
I have no idea how anyone could eat here. 
I eat almost anywhere and I hate making bad reviews but this place is just that bad.
If people like it then that's fine and all but I can't stand that it's called Mexican.
yelp:test:3556.para:
This location is unequivocally not Mexican, and it's imperative they reconsider its name or something similar, as it bears no resemblance to authentic Mexican cuisine. 
I passionately dislike this establishment, and it seems to have caused a similar aversion among all my relatives of Mexican descent. 
Every single one of them concurs that it fails to embody Mexican authenticity. 
In comparison, Taco Bell would offer a more genuine Mexican experience. I feel ashamed of this place. 
I've dined here on three separate occasions, and each time, I was left unsatisfied. My parents share this sentiment, and we struggled to complete our meals. 
I struggle to understand how anyone could find pleasure in this place. 
Despite my tendency to review dining experiences, I find myself compelled to highlight this place's poor quality. 
While I respect those who enjoy it, I personally cannot tolerate the misleading association with Mexican culture.

yelp:test:3579.orig: This burger joint operates in the Green Valley Ranch Casino and is a Fatburger franchise.  Now Fatburger is renowned in California for their juicy delicious burgers.  However their reputation does NOT translate to the Green Valley Ranch Casino location.  I went there about a month ago and asked for a medium large fatburger, hold the relish and mayo.  The mayo and relish were held however the burger came as a salty grossly overcooked piece of meat, more tasteless than the inexpensive major burger chains and cost $11.45.  I was shocked.  I recently returned and placed the same order for a large fatburger medium rare.  The waitress said fine.  Again to my surprise I received an overcooked burger loaded with salt. A piece of shoe leather would have been more appetizing!!  Again I paid $11.45.  Two times is enough for me.  This place is the WORST and does not come close to living up to the Fatburger standards. This franchise needs to be closed. You would do better and cheaper eating at any other burger joint in Las Vegas and there are many.
yelp:test:3579.para: This Fatburger outlet at Green Valley Ranch Casino, despite being a franchise known for its succulent burgers in California, fails to uphold its reputation at this location. About a month prior, I ordered a medium-sized fatburger without relish and mayo, but it arrived as an excessively salty, poorly cooked slab of meat, lacking flavor compared to cheaper burger chains, all for $11.45. I was taken aback. Upon my recent return, I placed a similar order for a medium-rare fatburger, which the waitress accepted. Yet again, I was served an overly seasoned, overcooked burger. A shoe leather piece would have been more appealing! I paid the same price of $11.45. Having experienced this twice, I've decided this place is the worst and doesn't meet Fatburger's standards. I believe this franchise should be shut down. There are numerous other affordable burger joints in Las Vegas.

I can understand if it was something like $5.00 or something but $14.95?? If it was still summer time when we can at least use their ugly pool, i can also at least understand that.  I mean, even the GOLD COAST which is much more decent than Palace Station has a surcharge of only $3.00!  Okay, live and learn i guess.  Well, at least whoever is reading this could use the heads up, right? :)
yelp:test:3769.para: The accommodation proves satisfactory for its older clientele, despite a minor issue with the room rates appearing deceptive. yelp:test:3781.para:
Excellent customer service and delicious cuisine. We indulged in a substantial amount of food and our total came to $60. The dishes we enjoyed, such as the Ramen with pork kakuni, Monk fish pate with cucumbers and seaweed, and Beef Tataki, are definitely worth ordering again.

The charashi roll was exceptional, especially with the shiso flavor that I absolutely adored!

--------------------------------------------------
After penning this review, I've revisited the establishment four times. I've revised my initial 5-star rating to a 4-star due to inconsistent service. Despite this, the place remains fantastic. However, the service can be unreliable. If you're there for drinks, order two more as they won't be returning to serve. Sake requests might be challenging. Visit with patience and a flask in hand.

yelp:test:3797.orig: Friendly staff and quick service for auto tinting, but wow quality was so bad. Film was wrinkled in a couple spots, bubbles galore, and don't expect them to tint to the window edge. I swear there is a 1/8\"" and close 3/16\"" on some edges. Of course, I didn't discover the edge issue for 4 days after the job was done (due to instruction not to open the windows until after a week).  Well, for $150, what can you expect?  On the other hand, I've seen $150 jobs that were flawless.  It's probably just an inexperienced tinter.  So, if you want your \""baby\"" tinted, I'd take it elsewhere.
yelp:test:3797.para: The team was amiable and prompt in their auto tinting service, yet the quality was disappointingly poor. The film exhibited wrinkles and numerous bubbles, and it failed to reach the window's perimeter. I only noticed the edge problem after four days, as I was advised not to open the windows for a week. Considering the $150 price tag, one might anticipate better results. However, I've encountered $150 jobs that were impeccable. It's likely the result of a novice tinter's work. If you're looking for a meticulous tint for your vehicle, I recommend seeking another provider.

yelp:test:3798.orig:
Please be warned! Do not patronize Home Fabrics online!!! They are not trustworthy.

I placed a large order online, received a confirmation the same day, and then the following day received a second confirmation that my order was being processed, would ship in 3-5 days and be received in 7-12 days. 

After receiving the confirmation, I ordered multiple custom items to coordinate with the purchased fabric. Imagine my surprise when I received a call a full 7 days later stating that they didn't have the fabric I ordered, hadn't had it for a long time, and weren't going to get any more of it. 

The customer service person I spoke to first accused me of yelling (I wasn't, she was), then of being disrespectful (well, ya, you got me there) and hung up on me. Well, she then yelled at me some more about disrespecting her and hung up a second time. I mean, really, they weren't sure if they could keep my money or if I wanted it back since I got a big fat nothing-burger from them? We'll see if I ever get my money back.

I've shopped Home Fabrics stores for year
yelp:test:3798.para:
Be cautioned! Avoid purchasing from Home Fabrics' website at all costs, as they lack credibility.

It's uncertain whether they can retain my money or if I want it back, given the disappointing experience I had with them. I'll see if I ever get my money back. 

I've shopped at Home Fabrics stores for a year.

yelp:test:3809.orig:
We went here over Memorial weekend for brunch after church. We wanted to go to Harbor Palace, because that's where we usually go...but it had a long wait. Sam Woo was our second stop. It was pretty crowded, as expected. When we walked in the hostess station was empty, so we made our way to the cashier and asked to be put on the waiting list. She rudely told us to go back to the hostess station and wait for her there. We were given a ticket with the number 1 on it, so I was pretty hopeful. After about 20 minutes of waiting, we noticed that people that arrived after us were being seated. We got even more suspicious when the hostess asked us again how many were in our party & gave us a ticket with the number 8 on it. Things were obviously very disorganized.

My mom then caught the hostess' attention and asked her exactly how their seating was conducted, because we had been waiting awhile, parties were being seated before us that arrived after, and she wasn't calling any numbers. Her reply was, and I kid you not ""You know, don't worry about it. They have the bigger party and their table became available first. You just have to wait for a smaller table, so don't worry about it.""
yelp:test:3809.para: During the Memorial weekend, we chose this location for brunch following our church service, as it's our regular spot. However, we encountered a lengthy wait. Our alternative, Sam Woo, was also bustling with patrons. Upon entering, the hostess counter was vacant, prompting us to approach the cashier and request a spot on the waiting list. The cashier dismissively instructed us to return to the hostess counter and wait. We received a number 1 ticket, which initially gave us hope. After roughly 20 minutes, we observed that later arrivals were being seated, raising our suspicions. The hostess then inquired about our group size and handed us a number 8 ticket. The situation seemed highly chaotic.\n\nMy mother then drew the hostess's focus and questioned the seating process, given our extended wait, the prior seating of parties arriving later, and the lack of number call-outs. The hostess's response was, quite surprisingly, "Don't worry, the larger party got their table first. You'll just have to wait for a smaller table. There's no need to stress over it."

yelp:test:3846.orig:
Review about this place were right, BIG portions! Off the strip but only about 10 minutes away from the end of the strip. We ordered the Corned Beef Hash breakfast, a pancake, and an omelette
The Corned Beef Hash came with potato crisps, very flavorful and tasted just baked, not soggy at all.
I ordered the banana bread instead of toast, was pretty tasty! The servers were nice and attentive, only when we paid was there a wait, but no biggie to me.
Overall, food was good and the price just as good.
yelp:test:3846.para: The review accurately reflects the establishment, highlighting substantial serving sizes. Located a brief 10-minute drive from the strip's conclusion, the reviewer recounts their order of Corned Beef Hash breakfast, pancakes, and omelettes. The Corned Beef Hash was accompanied by potato crisps, offering a rich and freshly baked flavor, devoid of any dampness. Opting for banana bread over toast, the reviewer found it quite enjoyable. The service was commendable, with a minor wait during payment, which the reviewer found acceptable. The reviewer concluded that both the food quality and pricing were satisfactory.

yelp:test:3935.orig: If you go to a Chinese restaurant to eat make sure you see at least 10 Chinese people eating not standing around watching TV.  If you don't see them run. One of Funniest things I ever heard in my life the owner or maybe not was talking to a couple next to our table saying I require my staff to speak English. Really?  I asked for a jack and coke what came to the table was regular coke. I asked the server what's up? He said we don't have that. I said take the coke away he gave to the couple sitting next to us.  Joyful house! Our shrimp in lobster sauce came out with canned mushrooms strange.  My wife Asian was laughing. She said check out your fork I think they used that one to fix the drain in the kitchen seems the forks and spoons have been there sense 1980's it wouldn't be so bad if the food was really fantastic. Costco has GREAT deals on quality table wear on MLK (TIP OF THE DAY) I asked the server what is in the dumplings he said chicken. I asked if they had shrimp of pork dumpling he said you can go up the street if you want that. OMG! I said we will try the dumplings how many do you get ?  He said 5 - I said r u sure the menu says 6. He said 5 only. Ok served 6.  Keep in mind
yelp:test:3935.para:
When dining at a Chinese eatery, ensure there are a minimum of 10 Chinese diners actively partaking in their meal rather than idly watching TV. An amusing incident I recall involved the proprietor insisting that his staff converse in English, which was met with disbelief. I requested a Jack and Coke, but received only regular Coke, and when questioned, the server explained they lacked it. The shrimp in lobster sauce was served with canned mushrooms, which seemed odd. My spouse found it amusing and suggested inspecting the fork, which appeared to have been repurposed for kitchen maintenance, as it had been since the 1980s. Despite the costco's excellent deals on tableware on MLK Day, the dumplings, which were supposed to contain chicken, were limited to five per order, contrary to the menu's six.

yelp:test:3938.orig:
I only like one drink here, but it's enough for me to come in occasionally.  I love their green milk tea, other than that I am not a fan of the drinks here.  The fruit drinks aren't made of real fruits and sometimes they taste powdery.

As for the food, there is only 2 things I like.  The taiwanese sausage ( I don't know where else to get this in Vegas) and the spiced pork chop plate is a pretty good price for lunch.

I don't like going at night though because that's when all the young teenagers come out...and I hate the smokers too.  I wish lung cancer on all of them.  :oP
yelp:test:3938.para: I enjoy just one beverage at this place, which is sufficient to make me visit from time to time. I have a particular fondness for their green milk tea, but I'm not particularly fond of the other drinks. The fruit beverages are not authentic and occasionally have a powdery flavor. When it comes to food, I appreciate two items: the Taiwanese sausage, which is hard to find in Vegas, and the spiced pork chop plate, which offers good value for lunch. I prefer not to dine here at night due to the influx of young teenagers and the presence of smokers, which I strongly dislike. I harbor a wish for lung cancer upon them. :oP

yelp:test:3969.orig:
Four on a good day, three on others.

It's a really nice custard, where it goes down to a three is day and time of day you show up.

This last visit, I was first in line when it opened, so, full selection of flavors for the day. And had flavors that were not vanilla or chocolate. The other flavors were very good. 

As others said, if stuck with vanilla, meh. Wrong day and or late in the day, the flavors they have left might not be inspiring.

So get there early in the day, and don't add extra stuff to it: order a plain cone or cup, and you should be happy.
yelp:test:3969.para: On a good day, you might have four options, but on average, you'll have three. The custard is delightful, especially when you arrive early and have a variety of flavors to choose from, excluding the usual vanilla and chocolate. The other tastes are highly praised. However, if you find yourself with only vanilla on a less-than-ideal day or late in the day, the remaining options might not be as exciting. To ensure satisfaction, arrive early and order a simple cone or cup without additional toppings.
