yelp:test:5716.para:
Beware of movers before hiring this firm- read this first! We chose this company based on the salesperson's claim of being top-notch and having a clean record. Upon inspection, no complaints were found. The packers and truck crew were friendly and professional. I even treated them to lunch to ensure they took breaks during the packing and loading process. 

From AZ to CO, the truck had a week before we settled into our new home, as they claimed to have gone straight to a casino in New Mexico. 

Upon moving into our new home, the driver presented us with two choices: 1) verify the receipt of all items, or 2) let them arrange the furniture in your desired locations. If you opt for the first choice, they will "dump" the items and you will have to rearrange them later. This was the information I was given when the truck arrived at our new home in CO. 

While unpacking, I discovered missing items - a 6-quart mixer from Kitchen Aid and a new Vita Mix, which my mom had bought as a gift for us. We had left it in the box for them to pack, assuming it would be easier for them. Also missing was...

yelp:test:5771.orig:
Blech. The Good Egg my dupa! It's more like ""The Bad Egg""! As someone who loves trying new places for breakfast food, the one and only time I have ever eaten here, I got sick. In fact, both the BF and I didn't feel good the rest of the day after eating omelettes from this crap-hole.

Every time I drive by this place (which is every single day because I live in the neighborhood) I say out loud, ""Blech. More like the Bad Egg!"" 

I don't know about other locations in the valley...but stay away from the one on 29th/Bell!
yelp:test:5771.para: The Good Egg appears to be a disappointment, more akin to "The Bad Egg." Having a penchant for exploring breakfast spots, I regrettably fell ill after dining here once. The illness persisted throughout the day, following our consumption of subpar omelettes from this establishment. \n\nDaily, as I traverse this area due to residing nearby, I vocally express my disdain, declaring, "Blech. More like the Bad Egg!" While I can't speak for other spots in the region, I strongly advise avoiding the one situated at 29th/Bell.

yelp:test:5772.orig: We went to Top Shelf because we had a coupon from our Entertainment book for a buy one, get one free entree.  When we got to the restaurant, we hung out in the waiting area for a few minutes before the hostess came to seat us, but we enjoyed looking at the fish tank while we waited.  Our waitress was nice and kept our drinks filled and the food was pretty good, but maybe a little pricey for the portions.  When the bill came, we gave the waitress our coupon.  She brought back the bill and our kid's meal was the one given to us free.  When we asked, she said she tried to give us the second adult entree as the free meal, but the manager wouldn't let her.  She then had the manager come talk to us, but he wouldn't budge on the matter.  I have never been to a restaurant that considers a kid's meal to be an entree.  It seems this company is more concerned with making a couple bucks than good service that brings back return customers.
yelp:test:5772.para: We chose Top Shelf utilizing a discount voucher from our leisure reading for a complimentary second entrée with our purchase. Upon arrival, we spent some time in the lobby observing the aquarium before being seated by the hostess, which we found enjoyable. Our server was amiable, ensuring our beverages remained topped up and the cuisine was commendable, albeit slightly costly for the portion sizes. When the check arrived, we presented our voucher to the server, who returned with the adjusted bill, noting that our child's meal was the complimentary one. When we inquired about the second adult meal, she explained that the manager had prohibited her from providing it. The manager then engaged in a discussion with us, but remained firm on his decision. I've never encountered a dining establishment that regards a child's meal as an entree. It appears this business prioritizes profit over customer service that fosters repeat business.

yelp:test:5801.orig: Love this little place. The coffee is always fresh and they have some yummy salads, sandwiches and sweet treats. I'm here about once or twice a month and always something good to enjoy.
yelp:test:5801.para: I adore this cozy spot. Their coffee is perpetually fresh, and they offer delightful salads, sandwiches, and delectable desserts. I visit approximately once or twice a month, and it's always a pleasure to indulge.

yelp:test:5870.orig:
My husband always chooses Watson's when he orders me flowers and they never disappoint.  I received an arrangement of white lilies with white babies breath on September 13th for our 35th wedding anniversary.  My husband didn't know the address of my office, but told them the name of the company and they took care of the rest.  My flowers arrived at the correct location, no problem.

The arrangement came with quite a few buds and one by one they all opened.  It is now September 21st and I still have one lily left.  I know I'll have to probably throw it out tomorrow, but the babies breath still look as good as they day they arrived.

Watson's always uses the freshest flowers that last days longer then any other florist's I've experienced.
yelp:test:5870.para:
My spouse consistently selects Watson's for my floral orders, and they consistently meet expectations. On September 13th, I was gifted a bouquet of white lilies with white baby's breath to commemorate our 35th wedding anniversary. Although my spouse was unaware of my office's address, they provided the company's name, and Watson's efficiently handled the delivery. The flowers reached the intended destination without any issues.

The bouquet contained numerous buds, which gradually bloomed over time. As of September 21st, I have one lily remaining. I anticipate discarding it tomorrow, but the baby's breath still retains its pristine condition from the day of arrival.

Watson's is renowned for utilizing the freshest flowers, which tend to outlast those from other florists I've encountered.

yelp:test:5915.orig: The supreme breakfast burrito is the number one breakfast burro in chandler, a must try for all.  I am impressed with the meat portions in the taco/enchilada combos as well..the downers...they desperately need some spicy hot sauce.  I hope to see this place do well and stick around for a long time to come.  I would also like to see the owner be a little tougher on a few of his employees (dress code, on the phone while working, smoking out front, etc). Overall, great spot to fill the hunger void for less than $10.00..giant drinks as well.
yelp:test:5915.para: The top-rated breakfast burrito in Chandler is a must-try for everyone. I am taken aback by the generous meat portions in the taco/enchilada mix-ups, but they urgently require some fiery hot sauce. I wish for this establishment's success and longevity. I also desire the proprietor to enforce stricter standards on certain staff members regarding attire, phone usage during work, and smoking in the entrance area. In summary, it's an excellent place to satiate your appetite for under $10, and they offer large beverages too.

yelp:test:5933.orig: not the best for family dining and man was it not worth it! I am a huge fan of Elmer's Tacos (right down the street) and thought I would give Guedo's a try for once. MISTAKE. What kind of a place doesn't take CC's?  Disappointing to say the least. Food was below average and the lack of service and smiles really annoyed me.
yelp:test:5933.para: I've always enjoyed Elmer's Tacos nearby and decided to try Guedo's out of curiosity. Regrettably, it was a poor choice. The absence of credit card acceptance was surprising. The food quality was subpar, and the subpar service coupled with the absence of friendly smiles left me quite displeased.

yelp:test:5936.orig: I found the food to be okay, not great,  but the prices were quite high.  $3 for a side of chips and I think you could have counted about 35 chips in the bowl.  The salsa was delicious but the chicken burro was not that good and again quite pricey for the small size of it.  Also, shabby chic would be a huge upgrade from this mess of a restaurant.  Just a little too run-down for my liking.
yelp:test:5936.para: The cuisine was satisfactory, though not outstanding, and the cost was considerably steep. For instance, a side of chips was priced at $3, which I believe could have contained approximately 35 chips. The salsa tasted excellent, but the chicken burrito was subpar and overpriced given its modest portion. Moreover, a shift to shabby chic would significantly enhance the dining experience compared to the current state of this somewhat dilapidated eatery. It felt somewhat neglected and not up to my standards.

yelp:test:5989.orig: Maybe I haven't been to Dos Gringos in a while, or maybe this location is just grosser than the Tempe location, but this place is dirty!  The bathroom has a bad smell coming from it and everything just seems kinda filthy.  I would never ever order food from here, if their bar area is this dirty I can only imagine how gross the kitchen is... I'm not really sure why people would hang out here when there are plenty of nicer and more fun spots in Scottsdale.
yelp:test:5989.para: It's possible I haven't visited Dos Gringos recently, or perhaps this spot is even dirtier than the one in Tempe, and it's quite unclean. The bathroom emits an unpleasant odor, and the overall cleanliness is lacking. I would never consider dining here, especially given the state of the bar area, which makes me question the cleanliness of the kitchen. There are numerous more appealing and enjoyable places in Scottsdale, so it's unclear why anyone would choose this location.

yelp:test:5994.orig: Read all the reviews before going so I was a little skeptical but thought I would try anyway. Cute little place, seated right away which was good for a Saturday at 1230. Ordered eggs Benedict but they had sold out! A breakfast place that runs out of breakfast food, hum. Got the breakfast sandwich which came out cut in half, on a large white plate with no garnish. Had to ask for silverware and napkins. Service was ok, sandwich average.
yelp:test:5994.para: Before deciding to visit, I read all the reviews, which initially made me doubtful, but I decided to give it a shot. This charming spot was conveniently available for seating on a busy Saturday at 1230. I opted for eggs Benedict, only to discover they were out of stock. It's a breakfast establishment that frequently runs out of its signature dishes, to be honest. I ended up with a breakfast sandwich that was unfortunately sliced in half, served on a big white plate without any embellishments. I had to request for cutlery and paper towels. The service was satisfactory, and the sandwich was fairly average.

yelp:test:6001.orig: I've picked up a gyro from here before and couldn't really remember if I had liked it, so I stopped to grab something quick on my way back to work. I've read some reviews that say their falafel is good, which I can't speak to. I can say that the gyro, the side greek salad that came with it and the baklawa were overpriced and disgusting. The shredded iceberg that topped the gyro and comprised most of the salad was browing and reminded me of what subway would have thrown out .The baklawa was soggy. This might explain why they were completely empty and able to serve me quickly right around noon on a week day. I'd say the Schlotsky's two doors down would be a better and cheaper options. If I really want a gyro, I'll go the mall food court and get a cheaper gyro that actually tastes good from Pita Jungle.
yelp:test:6001.para: Previously, I've sampled a gyro from this place, but I wasn't sure about my preference, so I grabbed a snack on my commute back to work. While some reviews praise their falafel, I'm unable to comment on that. However, I can assert that the gyro, the accompanying Greek salad, and the baklava were excessively priced and unappetizing. The gyro's topping, mainly shredded iceberg lettuce, was browned and evoked memories of subway's waste. The baklava was also damp. This could be the reason for their empty state and my swift service around noon on a weekday. I'd recommend the Schlotsky's just two doors away as a superior and more affordable choice. If I crave a gyro, I'll opt for a more economical and flavorful option at Pita Jungle's mall food court.

yelp:test:6124.orig:
All you chocolate elitists can turn your noses up at See's all you want.  I love it, and I always will.

See's was the ""special"" candy my family tried to order every Christmas.  Back in those days before the internet (we still had 8-track tape players) at a time when no one really knew anything existed other than what you had seen, there was Russell Stover, Whitman's Samplers (that my cheap ass uncle was fond of giving in lieu of a real present), and See's.  There was no comparison.  See's was it.  I didn't even know they had stores then, much less stores that give out free candy just for coming in.  Kind of like a test drive without the pressure.

And I still prefer See's over it's closest competitor to me, location-wise, Godiva.  Why?  Well, the free candy for one.  Number two, it doesn't cost $60 a pound, more like $16.  Granted, Godiva has prettier packaging and perhaps a better product, but not enough to compromise my loyalty.  

I was recently saddened to see the store at Fashion Square close, but luckily, this one is nearby.  Much larger and easier to shop in, but my only complaint is that I had to stand in line with people hand-picking their boxes to pay for my pr
yelp:test:6124.para:
All the snobbish chocolate aficionados can dismiss See's as they please. I adore it, and that sentiment will never change.

See's was the "exclusive" confection my kin attempted to procure annually during Christmas. In an era preceding the internet, with limited awareness of what was available beyond what we'd encountered (even with 8-track tape players), we had Russell Stover, Whitman's Samplers (which my thrifty relative favored as a substitute for a genuine gift), and See's. There was no contest. See's was the clear choice. I was oblivious to the existence of their outlets back then, let alone those offering complimentary sweets upon entry. It was akin to a trial run devoid of stress.

I still favor See's over its nearest competitor in terms of location. Why? The complimentary sweets are a big part of it. Additionally, it's considerably more affordable, costing around $16 per pound, unlike Godiva's $60 per pound. While Godiva may boast more attractive packaging and possibly superior quality, it doesn't sway my unwavering loyalty.

I was disheartened to witness the closure of the store in Fashion Square, but fortunately, a similar one is in close proximity. It's larger and more convenient for sho

yelp:test:6130.orig: May be good - but must have more business than he can handle.\nCalled and left a message that the heater in my Phoenix house had quit.  Left phone number.  No response.
yelp:test:6130.para:
Possibly beneficial - yet requires more business than he can manage.\nContacted and left a voicemail about the heater in my Phoenix residence malfunctioning. Provided my phone number. No reply received.

(Note: The paraphrased text maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept relatively the same.)

yelp:test:6178.orig: It's PF Changs.  It's generic Americanized asian food.  What else is there to say.
yelp:test:6178.para: PF Changs serves as a representation of standardized Americanized Asian cuisine. There's essentially nothing more to elaborate on.

yelp:test:6201.orig: Love this place, great Thai food. We ordered Panang, Egg Rolls, Thai Fried Rice and Pad Thai. Everything was amazing except the Pad Thai. They use really thin noodles, which I've not seen before. It wasn't my favorite, but everything else was delicious. I would definitely go back!
yelp:test:6201.para: I adore this location, and the Thai cuisine is fantastic. We tried Panang, Egg Rolls, Thai Fried Rice, and Pad Thai. All dishes were delightful except for the Pad Thai, which featured unusually thin noodles that I hadn't encountered before. Although it wasn't my top choice, the rest of the meal was scrumptious. I'm certain I'll return!

yelp:test:6206.orig: New Mexican cuisine ...awesome food....and our waiter was right on the ball...sat outside on patio which at night is terrific...lighting ....fire places .......heaters to keep you warm...causual and relaxing.....prices on menu very affordable for all that you get....as Meg says this place is \""bomb.com\""
yelp:test:6206.para: New Mexico's culinary delights offer exceptional dining experiences...our attentive server excelled in service...enjoy the outdoor seating on the patio, especially under the night sky...the ambiance is enhanced by the lighting and fireplaces, with heaters providing warmth...the atmosphere is laid-back and soothing...the menu's pricing is highly reasonable, offering great value for the quality received...according to Meg, this establishment is "bomb.com"

yelp:test:6228.orig: Their 'shrimp & scallops Antoinette' (with white wine & artichoke hearts) was delicious!
yelp:test:6228.para: The 'Antoinette' dish featuring shrimp, scallops, white wine, and artichoke hearts was absolutely delightful!

yelp:test:6311.orig: Poor Management!!! I wish I would have read the other reviews before eating at Bandera tonight. I was a long time fan and I'm still a big fan of Hillstone on Camelback. But will not go back to Bandera until I'm notified the manager \""Mark Poltntan\"" is no longer employed by Hillstone.
yelp:test:6311.para: I regret not perusing other customer feedback prior to dining at Bandera this evening. Despite being a longstanding admirer and Hillstone enthusiast, I will refrain from returning to Bandera until I receive confirmation that the manager, Mark Poltntan, has been relieved of his duties at Hillstone.

yelp:test:6319.orig: A lot better than Starbucks... Love the hazelnut iced blended drink.  I always search out coffee bean wherever I go. I only need Starbucks if there is no coffee bean.\n\nThe chai tea latte is also far better than Starbucks.
yelp:test:6319.para: The hazelnut iced blended beverage surpasses Starbucks' offerings, which I adore. I'm on a quest for coffee beans wherever I travel, resorting to Starbucks only when I can't find them. Additionally, the chai tea latte outshines Starbucks' selection.

yelp:test:6326.orig:
This boutique was one of my absolute favorites! I used to always shop here when I was trying to find a cute outfit for a special night out.  I was so sad to see the actual store front close.  Although I guess they are still online- that seems to be the direction many clothing stores are headed right now.  

I think the Hilton Village is doing a complete remodel because many of the stores there are all closed right now.  

I did find out that their other location Sherre's up in Cave Creek is still open so I will continue shopping there!
yelp:test:6326.para:
I adored this exclusive store, which I frequented for stylish attire for memorable evenings. The closure of the physical storefront saddened me, but it seems that transitioning to an online platform is a common trend among fashion retailers. 

The Hilton Village appears to be undergoing a comprehensive renovation, as numerous shops are currently shut. However, I discovered that their alternative location, Sherre's, situated in Cave Creek, remains operational, so I'll persist in patronizing it.

yelp:test:6329.orig: I have been to this restaurant dozens of times throughout the years. I find the steaks are always good, but the seafood is really hit or miss. Was there yesterday and my lobster was totally over cooked. It was like complete rubber. It was barely edible. I should have known better to order it there, but I love surf and turf so I gave it a shot. Very disappointing.
yelp:test:6329.para: Over the years, I've visited this eatery numerous times, consistently enjoying their steaks. However, their seafood has been unpredictable, with yesterday's lobster being severely overdone, resembling rubber and barely palatable. Despite my fondness for surf and turf, this experience left me quite disheartened.

yelp:test:6396.orig: Really an average course that was fairly easy. The bummer was no beverage cart when we played Saturday and it was 100. I would not golf here again.
yelp:test:6396.para: The course was quite standard and manageable in difficulty. The disappointment stemmed from the absence of a beverage cart on the day we played, which was a scorching 100 degrees. I won't be returning to play golf here in the future.

yelp:test:6404.orig: Rarely do I give a 1 star rating but after four attempts in four months to get my fax line and internet rolling I can honestly say they have earned this.  After finally showing up for a scheduled appointment the tech told us our internet was fine but we disagree because we are getting the same speed we had with Qwest in Cave Creek (SLOW)  and they are charging us $64 a month for what they call the upgraded 20mbs.  Furthermore, I tried to send out a couple faxes after he left and the line is not responding.  Im going to drive down to the store tomorrow and demand that they remove the fees for service I have not received and just get efax.  As I noted in the first review we were excited to upgrade to faster internet so that makes this experience even worse.
yelp:test:6404.para: Infrequently I assign a 1-star rating, yet I must concede that they deserve it following four unsuccessful attempts over four months to activate my fax and internet services. Despite a technician's assurance that our internet speed was satisfactory, we contest this claim as we're experiencing the same sluggish pace we had with Qwest in Cave Creek, and are being billed $64 monthly for an alleged 20mbs upgrade. Additionally, I attempted to send faxes post-technician's visit, only to find the line unresponsive. Tomorrow, I plan to visit the store and insist on the removal of charges for services not received, opting instead for efax. The anticipation of a speedier internet connection has only amplified the dissatisfaction from this experience.

yelp:test:6409.orig: Don knows how to treat a customer.  Outstanding customer service and products are the best.  Honest, reliable and trustworthy.  I agree with the other post that rate this business 5 stars.  I will not take my vehicle any place else.
yelp:test:6409.para: Don excels in customer care. Exceptional service and quality products are unparalleled. Honesty, dependability, and trustworthiness are commendable. yelp:test:6410.orig:

yelp:test:6410.para: Woohoo! I've officially joined the Monk's Club. Exciting news indeed! But, am I revealing my seniority here? Absolutely, it's quite evident!\n\nBeer is my passion!

yelp:test:6485.orig: This is really an exceptional italian deli!  Great sandwich's - great atmosphere.  Would certainly come again when in the Scottsdale area.
yelp:test:6485.para: This Italian deli stands out remarkably, offering exceptional sandwiches and a welcoming ambiance. I'd gladly return when visiting the Scottsdale region.

yelp:test:6488.orig:
I had heard about this place for years but never went. Tragic I know! Just recently I discovered that it was literally walking distance from Jester'Z Improv where I work. Oh, how i must now make up for lost time!

Pop the Soda Shop is a true place of brilliants. They have a fantastic selection and a very knowledgeable staff. When you come to pops that is what you are looking for, product. And they have the best selection in town.

yelp:test:6488.para:

Pop the Soda Shop stands out as a remarkable establishment. Their impressive array of items and well-informed team members are sure to meet your expectations. If you're after quality products, this is the place to be, offering the finest in the area.

yelp:test:6508.orig:
I have been to RA a few times and 2-3 have been at this location. My most recent meal here was incredible.

The shishito peppers are a must-have. The ponzu sauce had us tipping the empty bowl over to lick, drink, and pour on our remaining rice. It was that good.

We tried the Pacific Roll, which is essentially the experience of eating fresh mango salsa. It's not what I would call sushi, but it was tasty and refreshing. The sashimi is solid as well. The lunch combo is ~$10 and they will mix and match any 7 pieces of tuna/salmon/yellowtail you want.

This location, located in downtown Tempe on Mill Ave, is a bit more of a club/bar style than the others I've seen. They play lots of upbeat club/remix/techno music at all times of day. The service was friendly and decent.
yelp:test:6508.para:
I've visited RA multiple times, with 2-3 occurrences at this specific spot. My latest dining experience here was exceptional.

The shishito peppers are essential. The ponzu sauce was so delicious that we ended up emptying the bowl to savor, drink, and drizzle on our leftover rice. It was truly remarkable.

We sampled the Pacific Roll, which essentially offers the thrill of consuming fresh mango salsa. While it's not traditional sushi, it was enjoyable and invigorating. The sashimi quality is also commendable. The lunch combo package is around $10, and they're willing to customize any combination of 7 tuna/salmon/yellowtail pieces you desire.

This establishment, situated in downtown Tempe on Mill Ave, has a more club/bar vibe compared to the others I've encountered. They consistently play energetic club/remix/techno music throughout the day. The service provided is amiable and satisfactory.

yelp:test:6520.orig: its an enjoyable atmosphere for all 21+\n(: The beer is Delicious and so is the food - However I unfortunately, can not say the same about the HELP.The service was terrible the waitress were rude not only  to us but to each other....
yelp:test:6520.para: The ambiance is delightful for individuals aged 21 and above. (: The beer tastes fantastic and the cuisine is equally enjoyable - Regrettably, I must express dissatisfaction with the assistance. The service was subpar, with the waitstaff displaying unpleasant behavior not only towards us but also amongst themselves.)

yelp:test:6527.orig: If you are ever in Tempe, AZ find your way over here. The food is American/Bar food but it is a huge step above your average American/Bar food. We sampled the entire menu and everything was great. The batter for the fish and chicken is straight amazing. The beer bread they use on the wraps is simply great. The wings are top notch. See what I mean, doesn't matter what you order. Then to compliment all the great food are their tasty home brewed craft beers. They have something for everyone. On the off chance you don't like beer, the Bloody Mary spicy or not is a great alternative. The reason I gave this place the five stars because to round out the total experience is the service. I only rate a place five start as when I receive the total package drink, food, and service. Great place, come on in.
yelp:test:6527.para: Should you find yourself in Tempe, AZ, make your way here. While the cuisine leans towards American/Bar fare, it significantly surpasses typical offerings in this category. We've tried the full menu and found it exceptional. The fish and chicken batter is outstanding, and the beer bread in wraps is delightful. The wings are of superior quality. Regardless of your choice, the food is impressive. To accompany the excellent meals, they offer delicious home-brewed craft beers, catering to diverse tastes. For those who may not favor beer, their Bloody Mary, spicy or not, serves as a commendable alternative. I've awarded this establishment five stars, as the comprehensive experience includes not just the food and drinks, but also exemplary service. This is a fantastic spot, so please come and visit.

yelp:test:6529.orig:
Only stopped in for one drink, but like it enough to return to try the rest out!

The atmosphere was great, you might have to yell a little bit to be heard, but that's part of the thrill of coming here. 

I ended up with a seasonal brew called Odelay! which is a delicious mexican chocolate ale. If you're worried about too much sweetness, then there are no worries with this brew. Get it if you are looking for a solid dark ale. 

Sidenote - Had I seen it, I would have gone for the beer sampler that they had. There were a ton of beers on the wood board and it looked delicious!

My partner had the Raj IPA. For those who don't drink IPA often this was a smooth one. Had a little kick, per usual of the brew, but a nice introduction to what standard IPA's taste like. In addition, the appetizers were good, but I personally found them a little flavorless. Don't get me wrong though, they were FILLING. The calamari and the spinach dip were rich, and we felt pretty full after trying both of them. A little more salt wouldn't hurt though. 

This place loses a star for the service. Everyone was friendly, but our server was fairly unattached to our experience and stopped by three times to
yelp:test:6529.para:
Had a single drink but enjoyed it enough to consider revisiting for more. The vibe was fantastic, with a bit of shouting involved, which added to the excitement of visiting. 

I opted for a seasonal concoction named Odelay!, a Mexican chocolate ale that's delightfully sweet-free. It's perfect for those seeking a robust, dark beer. 

A side note - I would have chosen the beer sampler, which showcased a variety of tempting brews on display. The appetizers were tasty, though I found them somewhat bland. However, they were quite filling, with the calamari and spinach dip being particularly satisfying. A touch more seasoning would have enhanced the flavor.

The establishment received a deduction in rating due to the service. While the staff was amiable, our server seemed somewhat detached from our experience, making brief appearances three times.

yelp:test:6534.orig: Gotta be the most affordable sushi happy hour prices in all of Phoenix. Really great sushi, really great service!
yelp:test:6534.para: In Phoenix, you'll find the most budget-friendly sushi happy hour deals. Excellent sushi and top-notch service await!

yelp:test:6541.orig:
Was out on a date yesterday, and we had worked up an appitite.  We were on the light rail, and decided to stop off on Mill to find food.  Walked down mill for a second, and found silvermine subs.  SCORE!

I had never been here before but I liked it.  Its not the fanciest place.  Simple location, good food, decent prices.  They seemed to have a good selection of hot and cold subs, with different side items and combo meals.  I got the King Bullion, and it was tasty!  I went with the small sub (5 inches) a large pop and some chips.  Food was up in no time flat.  Seems to be a college kid hang out, especially considering the location. 

Would return in a heartbeat.  Tasty, reasonably priced, and right off the light rail on Mill.
yelp:test:6541.para: Yesterday, we went on a date and our hunger grew. We took the light rail and chose to dine at Mill, where we discovered Silvermine subs. A perfect find! I had never visited this spot, but I enjoyed it. It's not overly luxurious, but it offers a straightforward location, delicious food, and fair prices. They boasted a variety of hot and cold subs, along with side dishes and combo meals. I opted for the King Bullion, which was delightful! I ordered a small sub (5 inches), a large drink, and some chips. The meal was served promptly. It appears to be a popular spot for college students, particularly due to its location. I'd definitely return. It's tasty, reasonably priced, and conveniently located off the light rail on Mill.

yelp:test:6554.orig: Came back, service was on the ball and friendly, food was fast, and was what we ordered. Tables and counters were way cleaner too though we did come much earlier this time. Soda machine was still flat but didn't matter since we went right back up for Kool-aid. Win.
yelp:test:6554.para: Returned and found the service prompt and amiable, with meals delivered swiftly, matching our requests. The cleanliness of tables and counters was notably improved, especially since we arrived earlier this visit. The soda dispenser was empty, but it was inconsequential as we promptly opted for Kool-aid. A definite win.

yelp:test:6560.orig:
I was so pleased with the service that we received on a recent visit to Chili's.  

We often go get an afternoon snack of appetizers when we're out and about.  Hands down, one of our new favorite places to go is Chili's for their bottomless chips and salsa.  Order a couple of drinks and we're set for an afternoon snack.  Server was so friendly!  Honestly, it's been a while since we've had such great customer service!  He was all smiles while he brought us basket after basket of chips.  We actually joked about feeling bad that it was so cheap and that we ate so many chips.  His response, ""I'll bring you as many baskets of chips as you want!  That's what I'm here for!""  

Oh, and the chips and salsa are so good!  Totally unexpected for a large chain restaurant.  Fresh chips made in house and yummy salsa......it's actually kind of pathetic that we thought that the salsa was better than what is served in MANY of the Mexian food restaurants around town.  Salsa should never be an afterthougt.....

Thanks for surprising us Chili's!
yelp:test:6560.para:
I was incredibly satisfied with the hospitality we encountered during our latest visit to Chili's.  

We frequently indulge in afternoon appetizers, and Chili's has become one of our top choices for their endless supply of chips and salsa. With a couple of drinks, we're ready for a snack. The attendant was incredibly amiable! It's been quite some time since we experienced such commendable customer service. He was constantly grinning as he delivered basket after basket of chips. We even laughed about feeling guilty for the low cost and our chip consumption. His reply, "I'll keep bringing you chips as long as you want! That's my job!"  

Moreover, the quality of the chips and salsa was astonishing, especially considering it's a big chain restaurant. The chips are freshly made in-house and the salsa is delicious. It's almost pitiful that we thought the salsa at many local Mexican eateries was superior. Salsa should be a priority, not an afterthought.  

We appreciate Chili's for their pleasant surprise!

yelp:test:6563.orig: This is the most overpriced food in Tempe.  It has a great spot on mill and you can watch everyone go by, but too bad you couldn't do that and not buy anything.  If you want to sit on this block, you might as well go to hooters across the way.  At least you could save some money and eat the same quality food.  There are many good places to eat on Mill, so skip this one.
yelp:test:6563.para: This eatery in Tempe is notably expensive for its location on Mill Street, offering a view of the hustle and bustle, yet it's a missed opportunity if you don't purchase anything. Opting to linger on this block is akin to choosing Hooters on the opposite side, where you could potentially save cash while enjoying comparable quality cuisine. There are numerous superior dining options on Mill, so it's advisable to bypass this particular establishment.

yelp:test:6614.orig: WoW.. Great Service, Great Food.. Typical traditional Diner.. Fabulous.. Enjoy!
yelp:test:6614.para: Exceptional service and delicious cuisine, characteristic of a classic diner experience. Truly delightful, savor the moment!

yelp:test:6644.orig: Went with a Groupon for the Buffet. At least half the dishes were too salty to eat. I mentioned this to the Owner(?) and she said that everyone's taste is different. The mango lassi was too sweet too.
yelp:test:6644.para:
Opted for a Buffet deal through Groupon. I found that numerous dishes were excessively salty for consumption. I brought this up with the presumed proprietor, who responded that taste preferences vary among individuals. Additionally, the mango lassi was overly sweet.

yelp:test:6652.orig:
This place definitely wow'd me!  I'm a California native and I was in Tempe for a wedding and me and fiance came here on two occasions, for lunch and late night drinks.
For lunch we decided to visit this place, since it was so close to our hotel.  It was fairly quiet in there so we got seated and helped immediately.  Our server did a great job making sure we were happy and satisfied.  I believe her name was Rachel, very talkative lively lady, kudos to her for doing a good job.
The next day we came here with a bunch of friends for some late night drinks.  All I can say was it was busy!  But I particularly liked the environment and feel of the place.  There was a live band rocking out to keep everyone entertained, the outside patio was alive with people but we all managed to find a great spot to chill out at.  The servers were incredibly polite and made sure everyone had a drink and didn't have to wait.  They also were very quick to clean up empty mugs.
Overall some really good service here!  I would definitely recommend this place to anyone in the Tempe area.
yelp:test:6652.para: This location genuinely impressed me! As a Californian, I was in Tempe for a wedding and my partner and I visited this spot twice, once for lunch and once for evening libations.  We chose this place for lunch because it was near our hotel, and it was quite serene, allowing us to be seated and attended to promptly. Our server, whom I think was Rachel, was a vivacious and engaging individual, deserving of praise for her excellent service. The following day, we returned with friends for some nighttime drinks. The place was bustling, but I particularly enjoyed the ambiance and atmosphere. A live band provided entertainment, and despite the crowd, we found a comfortable spot on the patio. The staff were exceptionally courteous, ensuring everyone had a drink without delay and efficiently cleared empty cups. In summary, the service here was outstanding, and I would wholeheartedly suggest this place to anyone in the Tempe vicinity.

yelp:test:6668.orig: Very vegan. The menu includes a variety of choices. Under the sandwiches and burger section everything is 'mock'. yelp:test:6668.para:

yelp:test:6760.orig: I had the prime rib and the mashed potatoes, it was amazing! My fianc\u00e9 got the porter house and the Mac n cheese! We will come back! Great romantic atmosphere, great service! Would recommend for a great date night!
yelp:test:6760.para: The prime rib and mashed potatoes were absolutely fantastic! My partner enjoyed the porter house and Mac n cheese! We're planning to return! The ambiance was incredibly romantic, and the service was excellent. This place is perfect for a memorable date night!

yelp:test:6774.orig:

Twice.

yelp:test:6774.para:
The delightful combination of New Zealand lamb and salted caramel bread pudding.

No further comment, just a suggestion to visit. 

This experience enhances life more than once.

yelp:test:6775.orig:
Why do I keep returning to UNO restaurants??

Oh yeah, because I am a borderline alcoholic and I like their happy hour specials, but that is where it ENDS.

yelp:test:6795.orig:
Oh Caffe Boa, I don't even know where to start! First off I never give a place 2 stars and it would have been 1 star if I had not had a pleasant experience before my most recent one!

One of my best friends was planning her 25th birthday dinner and she was trying to decide where to go and I suggested we go to Caffe Boa since she has never been and I had such a great experience the first time I had gone, I thought it would be a good idea to go again... Well I was wrong!

First off I had asked the hostess to do me a favor of surprising my friend with a gift from her boyfriend, since he was out of town and was not able to be there, and they were very friendly and said that would not be a problem, I was very appreciative of them doing that for me. My friend had also brought cupcakes in as her dessert and we asked if we could just put them in their fridge until after we had dinner and the owner had mentioned to me there would be a small cake cutting fee for holding them (he never mentioned how much it was), at this moment I thought ok $3-$5, no biggie, I thought it was odd and had never been to a restaurant where they have a cake cutting fee!  our whole group went in to wine and din
yelp:test:6795.para:
Oh Caffe Boa, I'm at a loss for words! I've never given a place just 2 stars, and it would have been a 1-star review if not for my enjoyable previous visit!

When one of my closest pals was planning her 25th birthday celebration, she was undecided on the venue. I recommended Caffe Boa, as she's never been there and I had a fantastic time during my initial visit, so I thought it would be a great choice to revisit... However, I was mistaken!

Initially, I requested the hostess to surprise my friend with a gift from her boyfriend, who was away and couldn't attend. They were incredibly accommodating and agreed to help. I was grateful for their kindness. Additionally, my friend brought cupcakes as her dessert, and we asked if we could store them in their refrigerator until after dinner. The owner mentioned a small cake cutting fee for holding them, which I thought was around $3-$5, but it seemed unusual to me as I've never been to a restaurant that charges for this service. Our entire group went in for wine and dinner.

yelp:test:6797.orig:
As others have pointed out, the menu has changed drastically, but I didn't actually have a problem with the change. The food we ordered came out fine. Not anything to write home about, but certainly a touch above mediocre. 

The problem was the waitress. We were sitting outside and it was quite chilly. She convinced us to order some spiced tea to warm ourselves up and did a good job selling the idea. But the tea never came and the waitress never checked in on us. We didn't even get any waters or the chance to flag her down. Another server dropped off our food in about twenty minutes and we had to ask him to get us some water. How is this acceptable at all? The waitress stopped by and said the bar didn't get the tea together and apologized, promising that she'd send the manager over. The manager never came over and it took another fifteen minutes after we finished eating to get the check and to pay. 

This place isn't cheap, but even if it was, I would expect better service than what my friend and I received.
yelp:test:6797.para:
While others have noted the significant alterations to the menu, I personally didn't find the modification objectionable. The dishes we selected were satisfactory, not remarkable but definitely better than average. 

The issue arose with the server. We were seated outdoors in a cool environment, and she persuaded us to buy some spiced tea to heat ourselves. She effectively promoted the idea, but the tea was never delivered, and she failed to monitor us. We didn't receive any water or an opportunity to approach her. Another server delivered our meal in roughly twenty minutes, and we had to request water from them. This level of service is unacceptable. The server later informed us that the bar was unable to prepare the tea and offered an apology, assuring us that she would contact the manager. However, the manager never arrived, and it took an additional fifteen minutes after we finished eating to receive our bill and settle the payment. 

Despite the restaurant's higher price point, I would anticipate superior service, which my companion and I did not receive.

yelp:test:6828.orig: Not the worst hotel. Comfortable bed with a decent TV. The staff are rude and nosy. We were given a ridiculous fine because we didn't read what we signed carefully. Watch out. Location is great right by the mall and highways. Although, at night it can be noisy and creepy because it is literally RIGHT BEHIND a strip club. We stayed 7 nights and every day the housekeeping came at a different time..got woke up as early 9:am which is rough if you plan on going out all night. Housekeeping does not clean the floors or toilets they pretty much do the bare minimum...The hotel itself isn't bad at all....the staff is just bad.
yelp:test:6828.para: The hotel isn't the worst, offering a reasonably comfortable bed and a satisfactory TV. However, the staff's behavior is unpleasant, being intrusive and impolite. We were penalized with an absurd charge due to a lack of attention to the signed agreement. Be cautious. The hotel's prime location is adjacent to the mall and major roads. Nevertheless, it can be quite loud and eerie at night, situated directly behind a strip club. We were there for a week, and the housekeeping service varied daily, disturbing us with early morning visits as early as 9:00 AM, which is inconvenient for those who wish to stay out late. The cleaning service is subpar, only doing the essential tasks. Despite these issues, the hotel's structure itself is not particularly poor. The main problem lies with the staff's attitude.

yelp:test:6860.orig:

yelp:test:6860.para:
Anyone familiar with me understands my strong aversion to grocery shopping. I dislike it intensely. I was recently acquainted with Trader Joe's and last weekend, I accompanied my spouse there for the first time. Although I haven't developed a passion for grocery shopping, I've discovered that I can manage to visit Trader Joe's when necessary.

The store's design is impressive. It offers enough variety and options without being overwhelming, particularly for those unfamiliar with grocery shopping. The employees are exceptionally amiable and always ready to assist in locating items, and the checkout personnel are engaging without being bothersome. While I can't directly compare Trader Joe's prices to those at a large supermarket, my spouse, who handles all our grocery shopping and is knowledgeable about the best stores for specific items, believes that Trader Joe's prices are on par or even lower than other grocery stores.

I appreciate the pre-packaged salads, sandwiches, and wraps, which are ideal for work lunches. In fact, I enjoyed a Trader Joe's chicken caesar wrap for lunch today and it was scrumptious! Just be sure to check the dates before buying.

  The prices are very reasonable but they only accept cash. I would not go out of my
yelp:test:6916.para: I've heard positive feedback about Pete's. Coming from the Gulf Coast, I didn't anticipate finding a match for the mouthwatering fried seafood I'm accustomed to. I'm relieved I didn't have high expectations. Pete's fish is passable, somewhat square, akin to unprocessed but not quite. It's peculiar yet enjoyable. The chips are satisfactory, reminiscent of standard Ore-Ida frozen fries. The onion rings are commendable (though notably greasy). As a traditionalist, I find that if you label it "fish and chips" like in the UK, malt vinegar is a must. The red sauce complements their fries and rings (and possibly shrimp) but doesn't pair well with fish. It's the sole sauce they offer. I've heard their burgers are tasty and might consider returning if I'm in the vicinity. I'm curious if they serve mustard. It seems they're attempting to cater to a wide range of tastes with their seafood, Americana, Mexican offerings (including fish, shrimp, burritos, hot dogs, chicken, oysters). Just a thought. Outdoor seating is available in the summer, but it's advisable to take your meal to go due to the heat, pigeons, and

yelp:test:6941.orig: Mr. Puss got sick last month the day I had to leave town for a week for work. Estrella got me a rush appointment within 20 minutes of my initial call, took kitty in right away and carefully performed X-rays and blood tests. They sent me home with a bag full of meds (which my lucky pet sitter got to administer) and kept me up to date on test results via the phone. Once again I found them to be caring and responsive, and I will keep going back.
yelp:test:6941.para: Last month, when I was away for work, Mr. Puss fell ill. Upon my return call, Estrella swiftly arranged a quick appointment, promptly examined the cat, and conducted X-rays and blood tests. I was provided with a medication kit, which my fortunate pet caregiver administered, and I received regular updates on the test outcomes through phone calls. Their attentive and prompt care reassured me, and I intend to continue seeking their services.

yelp:test:6963.orig: The food was amazing! Service was great!  The chicken Marsala was everything that I was looking for. Eating there felt like eating at your Italian grandma's house. We will be going back often.
yelp:test:6963.para: The meal was exceptional! The staff provided excellent service. The chicken Marsala perfectly matched my expectations. Dining there gave me a sense of being at my Italian grandmother's kitchen. We plan to revisit frequently.

yelp:test:6997.orig:
If you are looking for a great bar with excellent prices then look no further.  We went in on a Sunday night just after 10 pm. I had driven by earlier in the day and the parking lot was full, so it's a great place to watch a game with some buds and brew. I sat and talked with some of the regulars and it was a great conversation. It's the kind of place I wish didn't revolve around drinking, cuz I don't really like drinking all that much but I can see how somebody might get into that at the Deli Sports bar. I guess you could say the place can be addicting. From talking with the clientele it sounds like Friday and Saturday nights the place can be very busy, as well as the average Sunday and Monday night football season, (and I'm assuming any time a series of games are being played on the same day regardless of the sporting event.)

The juke box is awesome because it's actually hooked up to some proprietary Internet server system so you have tons of options for music (even classical, blues and Jazz). 
One saw one person get a little out of hand but he was promptly dealt with, but even with that I would still like to go there the again.  Deli Sports Bar is relaxed atmosphere with exc
yelp:test:6997.para:
If you're searching for an exceptional pub offering affordable prices, your search ends here. We visited on a Sunday evening shortly after 10 pm. I had noticed earlier that the parking area was packed, making it an ideal spot for watching a match with friends while enjoying a drink. Engaging in dialogue with the regulars proved to be a delightful experience. It's a place I'd prefer if it weren't centered around alcohol consumption, as my preference leans towards moderation, yet I understand how others might find themselves drawn to the Deli Sports bar. The venue has a compelling allure, especially during the bustling weekends and during the typical Sunday and Monday nights when football games are in full swing.

The jukebox stands out due to its connection to a unique Internet server system, providing a vast array of music genres, including classical, blues, and jazz. Despite a minor incident involving one individual losing control, the overall experience remains enjoyable, prompting my desire to revisit. The Deli Sports Bar offers a laid-back ambiance with an inviting vibe.

yelp:test:7015.orig: The new item on the menu is BBQ.  Marty has nailed it. Smokey, meaty and great prices. Definitely worth a visit or two.
yelp:test:7015.para: Marty has masterfully crafted the BBQ addition to the menu. It's smoky, rich in flavor, and offers excellent value. A must-try experience, it's highly recommended to visit multiple times.

yelp:test:7019.orig: Super nice staff!  Food is delicious! So Fresh !  I always sppreciate the hostess asks if we have preferred sesting.  Such a simple question but so appreciated.  Thankyou Madeleine. Having never eaten there before our waiter John was very helpful. He helped us make the best choices for our appetites and tastes!
yelp:test:7019.para: The staff is exceptionally friendly! The cuisine is incredibly tasty and refreshing! I always value the hostess inquiring about our dining preferences. It's a straightforward question that is greatly valued. A big thank you to Madeleine. Even as a first-time visitor, our server John proved to be extremely supportive. He assisted us in selecting dishes that catered to our individual appetites and palates!

yelp:test:7053.orig: Watch out for city council meetings! They gave us the run around for 8 months on a re-zoning process, plus were incredibly condescending. Words cannot express my dismay at the double standard that Councilwoman Schroder presented--reprimanding one side of a communal dispute without acknowledging the other side's continual bullying and threats.
yelp:test:7053.para: Be cautious of city council gatherings! They delayed the re-zoning procedure for eight months and behaved with a patronizing attitude. It's hard to convey my frustration at the inconsistent approach taken by Councilwoman Schroder, who criticized one faction in a neighborhood disagreement while ignoring the other side's ongoing intimidation and menaces.

yelp:test:7113.orig: OK you can gamble here but the retail/dining is a total, TOTAL suck fest and even though they have tons of land in Vegas the airport feels cramped and small: more like oakland then los angeles. It is spared the one star because of the very convenient location.
yelp:test:7113.para: While gambling is available here, the retail and dining experience is utterly disappointing, akin to a frustrating, cramped space like Oakland rather than Los Angeles. Despite the vast land in Vegas, the airport's size and layout leave much to be desired. However, its location is compensated for with convenience, sparing it from a one-star rating.

yelp:test:7156.orig: I absolutely LOVE Southwest Airlines. Many of you already know about the 2 free bags, low prices, and great service. Something however that shocked me was when I needed to cancel my flight, they made it such hassle free. All I remember was before with AA that I went through such loop holes to try to cancel a flight and they charged me fees on top of overprices tickets. But with Southwest, I was able to call the night before to cancel my flight and they send me a confirmation right away. I just used those credits to rebook another flight and I got the low prices offered on the site and there was no charge to rebook. Excellent service and motto. I will always fly southwest if I can!
yelp:test:7156.para: I am utterly enamored with Southwest Airlines. You may be aware of their two complimentary bags, affordable fares, and superior customer service. However, I was amazed by their hassle-free cancellation process. Unlike my previous experience with AA, where I navigated through complexities to cancel a flight and incurred additional charges on already expensive tickets, Southwest allowed me to simply call the night before to cancel my flight and immediately sent me a confirmation. I utilized those credits to reschedule another flight, benefiting from the low prices on their website without any rebooking fees. Their exceptional service and motto have solidified my preference to fly with Southwest whenever possible.

yelp:test:7181.orig:
Saw the high Yelp reviews for this place, and we were staying in the adjoining Main Street Station, so we ended up in here for dinner one night.  We got there around 7, and there was a line of maybe a dozen folks ahead of us.

I had the saimin (good, but nothing special), as well as the garlic chicken.  GF got the combo plate that had Korean beef and chicken, along with the obligatory rice and macaroni salad.  This isn't fine dining by any stretch - presentation isn't really a concern, and we're not talking about any crazy complimentary flavors or subtle undertones or anything.  Portions are large - GF and I could easily have just split the combo plate and been more than full.  Solid, stick-to-your-ribs, Hawaiian style food.  The beef and chicken were solid, maybe a bit fatty, but that's to be expected.

Cash only was a bit of a surprise, but fortunately I hadn't handed over all my money on the blackjack tables.

This is one of those places that looks like a hole in the wall, but looks like it's always packed.  Large portions and great bang for the buck.  Not amazing food, but a great value, especially if you're craving Hawaiian style.
yelp:test:7181.para:
Noted the high ratings on Yelp for this eatery, and since we were near the Main Street Station, we decided to dine there one evening. We arrived around 7pm and noticed a queue of approximately a dozen people.

I opted for the saimin (deemed good, though not extraordinary), and the garlic chicken. My partner chose the combo plate featuring Korean beef and chicken, accompanied by rice and macaroni salad. This isn't a place for gourmet dining - presentation isn't a priority, and there's no expectation of unique flavors or nuanced tastes. The servings are generous - my partner and I could have easily shared the combo plate and felt completely satisfied. It offers hearty, authentic Hawaiian cuisine. The beef and chicken were well-prepared, albeit slightly greasy, which is typical. 

The fact that they only accept cash was unexpected, but fortunately, I hadn't spent all my money on the blackjack tables. 

This establishment appears modest from the outside, but it's always bustling. It offers substantial portions and excellent value for money. The food might not be exceptional, but it's a great deal, particularly if you're in the mood for Hawaiian-style dishes.

yelp:test:7191.orig: horrible service if your not drinking beer we were regulars because of the 2for 1 shrimp cocktail they were ok defenetly  not made to order my husband tried the 7 mares and got a horrible diareah and stomach ache everything was ok then they finally got they're license to sell beer  and they were the main priority! we were waiting for our order for over an hour we would see everyone get served but us even ppl for takeout my husband asked the rude owner and she said they had a lot of orders for take out i guess they come first than customers sitting and waiting for over an hour of course they're was a table of a family drinking and of course everything was rushed to them we finally got tired and told my husband lets go he paid for the waters we had and the horrible rude ass OWNER dint even apologize or acknowledge we were leaving never again the food is not made to order everything is fake not fresh not worth the wait and the bad service ur cocktails can be 3 for 1 u still cudnt pay me to come back
yelp:test:7191.para: The service was dreadful if you're not there for the beer; we kept coming back due to the 2-for-1 shrimp cocktail, which was decent but not custom-prepared. My husband experienced severe diarrhea and stomach pain from the 7-mares, and everything else was fine. However, once they obtained their beer license, they prioritized selling alcohol over our long wait, which lasted over an hour. Even those ordering takeout were served before us. When we finally decided to leave, the unapologetic owner didn't even acknowledge our departure. The food was not freshly made, and the poor service was unacceptable, regardless of the drink specials. I wouldn't recommend returning due to the subpar experience and the rude behavior of the owner.

yelp:test:7207.orig: Greyhound is the black hole of happiness. There was a girl at the package express desk who after realizing there was only one person that could help with luggage, helped me get my boxes to my car. She da KING! And the only reason they get two stars. But Greyhounds nationally need to find a way to take pride in themselves again. Let's beg for some government assistance here? 2 people at the desks to help a quadrillion tired, angry guests? And, of course, the ticket machines weren't working. And since the girl was helping me with my stuff that leaves OOOOOONNNEEEEE guy to face a packed house of very angry and weary travelers? It's inhumane. And STIFLING HOT!! Set up a couple of desk top fans, damn! The vending machines were stocked, so that's cool. I hope the machines took dollars because there weren't any change machines, as another disgruntled patron (well, not \""patron\"" so much as an \""only slightly bathed individual who wanted $5 in quarters\"" noted.) Where I had sent my packages from was also an awful, dryer place where sunshine never touched. (Literally! Because I was in the pacific northwest, HAH!!) However, if you you're moving on a budget, it's the cheapest you're going
yelp:test:7207.para: Greyhound represents the void of joy. A lady at the shipping counter, upon discovering a single individual capable of assisting with baggage, aided me in transporting my boxes to my vehicle. She was a true hero! Yet, the sole reason for awarding them a mere two stars. It's imperative that Greyhound's nationwide branches rediscover self-esteem. Could we possibly solicit some government aid in this matter? With only two staff members at the counters to manage an overwhelming number of exhausted and irate travelers, it's downright inhumane. Moreover, the air was oppressively hot. Installing a few desk-top fans would be beneficial. The vending machines were fully stocked, which is a positive aspect. I hope they accepted dollar bills since there were no change machines, as another disgruntled individual (not quite a \""patron\"" but rather someone who desired $5 in quarters) pointed out. The origin of my packages was also a desolate, arid location where sunlight was virtually non-existent. (In fact, I was in the Pacific Northwest, for what it's worth.) Nevertheless, if you're relocating on a tight budget, Greyhound is the most affordable option.

yelp:test:7213.orig: Great pizza. 2 slices for $4.50.\n Best food deal in all of downtown.
yelp:test:7213.para: Exceptional pizza available. Get 2 slices for $4.50. The ultimate culinary bargain in downtown area.

yelp:test:7222.orig: Amazing experience overall. Staff and service was excellent. Ambience was superb. Food was simply amazing. My dad did say the rice was on the salty side. But aside from that the food was on point. The table side salad that comes with every entree is filling and excellent as well.
yelp:test:7222.para: Overall, the experience was truly impressive. The team and their service were outstanding. The atmosphere was exceptional. The cuisine was absolutely fantastic. While my father mentioned the rice had a slightly salty taste, the rest of the meal was flawless. The complimentary table side salad accompanying each main dish was both satisfying and of high quality.

yelp:test:7260.para: The most disappointing dining experience considering the cost.

yelp:test:7261.orig:
Old Vegas. Some people love it, and other people....act like it doesn't even exist.

I happen to be one of those people who love it.

So cheap. So tacky. And such a blast.

Sure, modern Vegas is great & fun, but you can do so much more for so much less on Fremont Street!


The Golden Nugget is where you should stay if you're into hanging out on Fremont Street, hands down.

Myself and 3 other people stayed in one of the Rush Tower deluxe rooms. And the room was fantastic. 2 Televisions, a fantastic bathroom, 2 couches......

...but only one bed.

When I reserved the room, the website said it was for up to four people and had the option of getting two full beds.

When we arrived they told us that was an option, but not a guarantee.

Normally this sort of customer service would merit a god awful review.

But....they have a slide that goes through a shark tank!

And as I said, the room was very nice for the price, especially for 4 people. There was plenty of room to sleep on the couches...but when you're two couples, it's a little less than ideal.

But if you're going with a few friends or if that doesn't bother you, then go for it. No regrets staying at the Go
yelp:test:7261.para:
Old Vegas. While some individuals dismiss it, I am among those who cherish it.

It's remarkably affordable and vibrant.

Although contemporary Vegas offers enjoyment, Fremont Street provides more value for your money.


The Golden Nugget is the ideal choice for those who wish to spend time on Fremont Street.

Included in my stay with three others was a deluxe room in the Rush Tower. The accommodations were exceptional, featuring two TVs, a luxurious bathroom, and two sofas.

However, it only had one bed.

Upon booking, the website indicated the room could accommodate up to four people and offered the option of two full beds.

Upon arrival, they informed us that this was an option, but not assured.

Typically, such customer service would warrant a terrible review.

But, they boast a slide that traverses a shark tank!

Despite this, the room was commendable for its cost, particularly for a group of four. There was ample space to sleep on the couches, though it was less than perfect for two couples.

If you're traveling with friends or if this arrangement doesn't concern you, it's worth considering. There are no regrets about staying at the Go

yelp:test:7269.orig: Terrible service and total lack of hospitality.\nWe were sitting in the Ice Bar when the Bar Back knocked my drink over. He informed the Bartender. We then went up to the bar to order another drink and was told that we were sh*t outta luck because we didn't purchase the drink from her.\nAs a local we will never return and will make sure to let our friends know what terrible service we received
yelp:test:7269.para: Awful customer service and complete absence of warmth.\nWhile seated at the Ice Bar, the Bar Back accidentally spilled my beverage. He notified the Bartender. We proceeded to the bar to request a replacement drink, only to be informed that we were out of options as we hadn't bought it from her.\nAs residents, we will not revisit and will communicate our experience of poor service to our acquaintances.

yelp:test:7314.orig: One of the biggest tourist traps around. Skip this overpriced crap and look for McDonald's in that one casino for cheap food, or a sit-down restaurant for a better value. $5.99 is apparently a \""special\"" price for two average (at best) slices of cheese pizza and a pretty small soda, and the rest of the menu is definitely overpriced. Only reason this gets two stars is that the food and service weren't actually horrible.
yelp:test:7314.para: Avoid this costly tourist snare. Opt for the affordable fare at the casino's McDonald's or a sit-down eatery for superior value. The claimed "special" rate of $5.99 for mediocre cheese pizza slices and a modest drink reflects an inflated menu. Despite this, it earns two stars due to the food and service not being exceptionally poor.

yelp:test:7355.orig:
Haven't even eaten my food yet but I ordered it at 11:30pm when no one else was in there, and it still took a half hour for them to make me ONE thing. 
Place is a little sketchy looking too


--  Update

I ate the food and it was decent. So I boosted my rating from 1 star to 2. 
Still wouldn't go back
yelp:test:7355.para:
I haven't started my meal, but I placed my order at 11:30pm when it was empty, and it took them half an hour to prepare just a single item. The establishment has a somewhat shady appearance as well.


--  Revised Update

I consumed the food and found it to be fairly good. Consequently, I upgraded my rating from 1 star to 2. Despite this, I'm not inclined to return.

yelp:test:7378.orig:
went for Dim Sum, I asked for water, the waitress kept insisting that I get tea also. I finally said fine. She brought 2 tea cups, which by the way, one was for me the other person with me is my 3 year old son. Does he drink hot tea, I think not. There must be something to it. 

I keep wanting to get the satay hot sauce, and asked several ladies pushing the carts, they keep telling me "" ask the waitress."" I haven't seen a waitress pass for any request. when I finally raised my voice to get the attention of a waitress, she said we only have 1 type of hot sauce. 
NOT REAL AUTHENTIC dim sum, if they do not have the satay hot sauce. 

The fried shrimp balls was OK, a bit dry. The steam rice noodle with beef on the inside, was weird. Noodles too chewy, and the beef seems like it was from some kind of beef paste, (its and Asian thing) 

I did like the siu-mai though, it was good. seems like it was steam with little fish eggs on top. 

I got my check, they actually charge $.50 for tea for each person. That was why the waitress keep wanting me to say yes for tea. Forget the $ amount, it's the principles of the matter. 

So I will keep to my usual favorite place Cathay House,
yelp:test:7378.para:
I opted for Dim Sum and requested water, but the server persistently suggested I also try tea. Eventually, I acquiesced, and she presented two tea cups, one for me and the other for my 3-year-old son. I doubt he's accustomed to consuming hot beverages. There seems to be a particular reason for it. 

I've been yearning to acquire the satay hot sauce, and I inquired from multiple cart vendors, who all advised me to ask the server. However, I haven't encountered a server attending to any requests. When I finally raised my voice to capture their attention, the server informed me that we only offer one type of hot sauce. 

The fried shrimp balls were satisfactory, albeit slightly arid. The steam rice noodle with beef inside was peculiar. The noodles were overly chewy, and the beef appeared to be akin to some form of beef paste, a common characteristic in Asian cuisine. 

Nevertheless, I found the siu-mai to be enjoyable. It seemed to be steamed with a sprinkle of tiny fish eggs on top. 

When I received my bill, I noticed they charged $0.50 for tea per individual. This was the reason the server was insistent on me ordering tea. The amount is irrelevant; it's the underlying principle that matters.

yelp:test:7385.orig: Best Thai food in Vegas. I had been told archies was the old standard but Thai spice takes that title. Their lunch specials are awesome.  Highly recommend the pepper steak with a level 7 spice. Yes u can request your spice level!
yelp:test:7385.para: In Las Vegas, the top Thai cuisine is now Thai spice, surpassing the once-favored archies. Their lunch specials are exceptional. I wholeheartedly suggest trying the pepper steak with a spice level of 7, and you can certainly ask for your desired spice intensity.

yelp:test:7408.orig:
We always visit Nora's when we come to Las Vegas. It is a nice alternative to something in the hotel and the food and service are always great. 

I opted for the ""Crazy Alfredo"" on my last visit and it was decent. I still prefer their Vodka Penne over most of the pasta dishes there. The place has a decent selection of wines by the glass as well. 

The antipasto salad is pretty good and plenty for two people to share as a starter.
yelp:test:7408.para:
Whenever we travel to Las Vegas, we make it a point to dine at Nora's. It offers a pleasant change from hotel dining and consistently delivers excellent cuisine and customer service. 

During my most recent trip, I chose the "Crazy Alfredo" dish and found it to be satisfactory. However, my top pick remains their Vodka Penne, which outshines the majority of the pasta offerings. Additionally, they provide a commendable variety of wines available by the glass. 

The antipasto salad is quite enjoyable and ample enough to be shared between two individuals as an appetizer.

yelp:test:7423.orig: part of my power walk routine ....although this last week it was jog - power walk ...at times i'll stop at fresh and easy, other times, albertson's and if it's one of those days i didn't wake up until 10 or so ( sorry boodah for late breakfast ! )  then i might end the exercise at the doorsteps of black bear diner ....it's all about the breakfast ( they are open for lunch and heck...maybe dinner...not even sure ! ) my sis loves their country fried steak ...just give me the ham steak, eggs and those biscuits and i'm a happy camper !!!  i'm not sure...but the place might actually be a chain....it doesn't feel that way ..it feels like a local hangout....if you need a good hearty breakfast and your on the westside - black bear diner is worth a looksy
yelp:test:7423.para: In my regular power walking regimen, I occasionally switch it up with a jog-power walk combination. Sometimes I'll pause at convenient spots like Fresh and Easy, while other times I'll head to Albertson's. On days when I oversleep until around 10 am, I might conclude my workout right outside Black Bear Diner. The breakfast there is my motivation, as they serve lunch and even dinner, though I'm not certain. My sister enjoys their country fried steak, but I prefer a simple ham steak, eggs, and biscuits. Despite the possibility of it being part of a chain, Black Bear Diner has a local vibe that makes it worth checking out for a satisfying breakfast on the westside.

yelp:test:7435.orig: Who doesn't want to watch hockey in the desert? Even though the team is under .500 right now, they play hard and games are always entertaining. They played the Idaho Steelheads (I have no idea what a steelhead is) this past Thursday and Friday and both games ended in a shootout, with the teams splitting the games. There really isn't a bad seat in the house and prices are very reasonable. I had seats about 10 rows up from behind the net and they were only about $21 a piece. Kids under 2 get in for free. Not a bad family-friendly event, fights and all.
yelp:test:7435.para: No one desires to spectate a hockey match in arid conditions, yet the squad, currently scoring below .500, demonstrates commendable effort and consistently delivers thrilling matches. They recently faced the Idaho Steelheads (a term I'm unfamiliar with) on the previous Thursday and Friday, culminating in shootouts with an even split. The venue offers no subpar seating options and maintains affordable pricing. I secured seats approximately 10 rows back from the goal, costing roughly $21 each. Children under the age of 2 are granted complimentary entry. It's a family-oriented occasion that embraces all aspects, including bouts.

yelp:test:7473.orig: The old hag with the bad wig behind the bar is so unfriendly. She and another old lady who works there stand around and gossip about customers. I was sitting right next to them listening, like two jealous school girls. DUMP!!
yelp:test:7473.para: The cantankerous old woman with the unattractive hairstyle behind the counter is exceedingly unapproachable. She and a fellow elderly employee engage in chatter about patrons. I was seated beside them, eavesdropping like envious teenage girls. DUMP!!

yelp:test:7498.orig: The food is good, have eaten here before, service is good, never had a problem,  then why 1 star you ask, here is why.   It is Saturday Aug 2nd at 4:30pm and I am literally watching two employees argue at the register about how to do ones job.  The lady in green is going off on the cashier in red, why do I need to see or ESPECIALLY hear any of his.  Where is the manager.......that is why 1 star!!!!  Stupid!!!!   One in green needs to be reprimanded!
yelp:test:7498.para:
The cuisine is enjoyable, and I've dined here previously with satisfactory service, yet I've never encountered an issue. However, I question the 1-star rating. On Saturday, August 2nd, at 4:30pm, I witnessed a heated dispute between two staff members at the checkout counter regarding job performance. The woman in green is criticizing the cashier in red, and I find it unnecessary to witness or hear their argument. The absence of a manager during this incident is the reason for my 1-star rating. It's unjustified! The employee in green should be disciplined.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original sentiment and intent but uses different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept similar to the original text.)

yelp:test:7553.orig:

-Dining table + chairs

-Bed and closet in the bedroom
-Sofabed in the living room
-Slept 5

Studio breakdown:

-murphy bed
-bathroom with shower stall
-large TV, but not as big as the one-bedroom

This is more a family place, I can't say we didn't get some strange looks from other patrons strolling through the lobby ""dressed to impress.""  The staff was very courteous and we never had any sort of problem.
