yelp:test:13400.orig: Madhouse coffee is the local coffee shop I've been looking for all my life! My fave is the blended caramel mocha, way better than any other coffee places! Prices are reasonable and employees are great! I love the wannabe sandwich on focaccia. I never liked pesto but this one is the only pesto I would ever eat! The owner, Marco, is a great guy, he cares about his customers and he takes care of any concerns one might have. Andrea is my fave barista- thanks to her natural sincerity and jolliness! Every morning before work, this is where I'd be found. And on my days off, my system still asks for some madhouse! I'm so madly in love with this place. No one will understand my obsession...
yelp:test:13400.para: The local coffee haven I've been yearning for my entire existence is Madhouse coffee! My top pick is the caramel mocha blend, surpassing any other coffee joints! The cost is fair and the staff are commendable! I adore the focaccia-style sandwich. I've never been a fan of pesto, but this is the sole pesto I'd consider eating! The proprietor, Marco, is a wonderful individual, showing genuine care for his patrons and addressing any issues they might raise. Andrea, my preferred barista, is appreciated for her authentic warmth and cheerfulness! Every workday morning, I'm drawn to this spot. Even on my days off, I still crave Madhouse! I'm deeply enamored with this establishment, and my passion for it may be hard for others to comprehend.

yelp:test:13404.orig: Had a lovely lunch with my friend. The Scallop roll is to die for! sushiwa is one of my favorite places to lunch in Newer henderson....it is so relaxing and the staff is friendly. The Sushi chefs are absolutely adorable!
yelp:test:13404.para: Enjoyed a delightful midday meal with my companion. The Scallop roll is utterly delicious! Sushiwa stands out as my preferred spot for lunch in Newer Henderson. It offers a serene atmosphere and the team is incredibly welcoming. The Sushi chefs are genuinely endearing.

yelp:test:13409.orig: Pretty good market considering that most buy from the national grocery chains (Phoenix is a chained city!!). Maya Farms is one of my favs.. not only do they carry more exotic vegetables (romanesca) but they also added Save Our Farm raw milk! That's worth the trip alone! \n\nIf only the local bakers and such would join the scene.. where's Willo, Tammie Coe and MJ Bread? The market is only as strong as the people willing to participate in it.
yelp:test:13409.para: Considering the market's appeal, it's notable that a significant number of purchasers opt for national supermarket chains, with Phoenix being a prime example of such a city. Maya Farms stands out as a personal favorite, offering a wider selection of unique vegetables like romanesco, and introducing Save Our Farm's raw milk, which alone justifies the visit. \n\nThe market's vitality could be enhanced if local bakers and others were to become active participants. The absence of Willo, Tammie Coe, and MJ Bread is noticeable, highlighting the importance of community involvement in strengthening the market.

yelp:test:13448.orig: What a lovely restaurant. One of the best salad bars I've ever experienced. The Pot Roast was like mom used to make, the carrots were to die for. The Bread Pudding was over the top. Service was very good. \nI look forward to returning.
yelp:test:13448.para: This charming eatery left a delightful impression. Among the finest salad bars encountered, it stood out. The Pot Roast reminded me of my mother's cooking, and the carrots were exceptionally delicious. The Bread Pudding was truly extraordinary. The service was commendable. I eagerly anticipate my next visit.

yelp:test:13451.orig: When my mom worked in the area, we came here quite often, after picking her up from work. It's a busy location, so parking can be a pain. I don't like the store because there is a strong unpleasant smell in the produce section. I am used to ethnic markets and have been to so many of them in my life (childhood memories of visiting numerous ethnic markets) and I just couldn't stand it. I noticed that so many senior citizens shop here BTW. So when my mom no longer worked in the area, I did not miss coming here.
yelp:test:13451.para: When my mother was employed nearby, we frequently visited this place, following her work hours. The area is bustling, making parking challenging. I have an aversion to this store due to the intense, offensive odor in the fruit area. Having grown up visiting various ethnic markets, I found it unbearable. It's also worth noting that a significant number of elderly people frequent this place. Consequently, I didn't feel the need to visit this location once my mother stopped working in the vicinity.

yelp:test:13470.orig: Great food, great selection of craft beer and great service.  Love Chris and Bridget! Slainte!
yelp:test:13470.para: Exquisite cuisine, a wide array of artisanal beers, and exceptional hospitality. Chris and Bridget are adored! Cheers!

yelp:test:13481.orig: This is my second time visiting cuz I the first time was good. I took my friends here to have the same  nice experience as I had last time. We ordered the queen bbq combo. None of us can drink today so we change the soju into ordinary hot Tea pot. But we didn't get severed for any kind of tea. Not even iced water. So rude. We asked for it after paid the check and all we got was them saying you can get the soju. I mean what the hell we needed the hot tea when we were eating. That means they don't care about ur experience  or whatever. It's so unacceptable. Low score.  Don't come here ever ever again.
yelp:test:13481.para: During my second visit, I recall the initial experience being pleasant. I brought along friends to replicate that enjoyable moment. We opted for the queen bbq combo. Due to our inability to consume alcohol, we switched our soju for regular hot tea. However, we were disappointed to find no tea served, not even chilled water. This lack of consideration left us feeling disregarded. After settling the bill, we were simply told we could have the soju, which seemed insensitive given our dining situation. This negligence led to a poor rating. I strongly advise against visiting this place in the future.

yelp:test:13488.orig: Quite honestly, the reason that I am a fan is that they have a lot of pool tables, they offer free pool on certain nights, and the bartenders, male or female, are always awesome. PLUS, I get this humongous beer for 2.50 during happy hour with my PT card. Or free if playing 5 quarters. Can one really beat this? Okay, maybe, but I still love this location of the PTs. The food is okay, but what do you expect? It's a bar.
yelp:test:13488.para: Truly, my admiration stems from their abundance of pool tables, complimentary pool sessions on select evenings, and consistently excellent service from both male and female staff. Additionally, I enjoy a large beer for $2.50 during happy hour with my PT card, or it's complimentary when I play five quarters. While there might be better options, I still have a strong preference for this particular bar's location. The cuisine is satisfactory, considering it's primarily a drinking establishment.

yelp:test:13508.orig:
Always order a pizza from here when I am out at the pool...well...not ever again...had a simple order and didn't get it right..BUT the manager was very nice and gave it to me for free.

I ordered an appt. to eat while my pizza was cooking since I wanted to take the pizza to go...well the pizza came and no appt....oh well.. pizza was ok, had better from there...

yelp:test:13508.para:
Never will I place another pizza order from this spot during my pool visits, despite a courteous manager who offered a complimentary meal after a flawed order. It seems I should have exercised patience instead.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning and sentiment but uses different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept similar to the original text.)

yelp:test:13523.orig: Mediocre at best. Much better AYCE in the area.
yelp:test:13523.para: Subpar performance, yet superior all-you-can-eat options are available locally.

yelp:test:13544.orig: I change mind, this place is the BOMB BAY! The steak special is cheap and delicious!
yelp:test:13544.para: This location has transformed my view, it's a fantastic find! The steak dish here is both affordable and scrumptious!

yelp:test:13552.orig: I ate here twice.  The first time, I had a steak dinner, and found they forgot to season the meat, forgot to season the spinach, forgot to bring me any bread (I get just a little and look forward to it), and FORGOT I WAS THERE.\n\nTwo days later, 20 people for breakfast, they were OK, but JUST OK.
yelp:test:13552.para: I dined at this place twice. During my initial visit, I experienced a steak meal where the meat lacked seasoning, the spinach was similarly unseasoned, and they neglected to serve me bread, which I usually anticipate a small portion of. They also seemed to have overlooked my presence.\n\nTwo days after, during a breakfast for 20 people, the service was merely satisfactory, but not exceptional.

yelp:test:13578.orig: Honestly the worst customer service I have ever had. They got my wedding date wrong so they were going to give me back my altered dress three days before my wedding! I really wish there were more bridal stores because this one is just awful.
yelp:test:13578.para: Truly, the poorest customer service experience I've encountered. They mistakenly altered my wedding dress, intending to return it just three days before the ceremony. I earnestly hope for more bridal shops, as this particular one is dreadfully disappointing.

yelp:test:13592.orig:
I absolutely loved this restaurant. Amazing food, awesome ambience and great personalized service. 

I had the spicy bananna pepper appetizer stuffed with italian sausage and cheese. topped with sauce and served with a side of toasted italian bread. Very good. a little spicy but really good.

for dinner had the tortellini and loved it. best i've ever had. i'm going to try to recreate this dish . so good.

overall very good place and i'd recommend to anyone visiting vegas and willing to drive off the strip a bit.
yelp:test:13592.para:
This dining establishment was exceptionally delightful. The cuisine was exquisite, the atmosphere inviting, and the service tailored to individual needs. 

I indulged in the fiery banana pepper starter, filled with Italian sausage and cheese, drizzled with sauce, and accompanied by toasted Italian bread. It was delicious, albeit slightly spicy. 

For the main course, I savored the tortellini and it was the finest I've experienced. I'm eager to attempt to replicate this dish. It was truly scrumptious. 

In summary, it's a fantastic spot and I highly suggest it to anyone in Vegas who's open to a short drive away from the main strip.

Back to Chicago Dogs........Unfortunately, before I even bit into this burger it h
yelp:test:13602.para:
Hey, I partially accept responsibility for this critique...Lesson learned, when entering a hot dog establishment, opt for a hot dog.

I recently departed from Chicago Dogs after sampling one of their $8.00 burgers. Following the waiter/cashier's recommendation, I chose the burger, fries, and drink combo, which totaled around $11.50. Including a $1.00 tip in the jar, the final amount was approximately $12.50.

The speed of service from order to consumption was impressive; however, the quality might have been compromised for speed. Upon receiving the burger, I observed that the bun's top was cool (potentially room temperature, as I needed a jacket to dine there). Additionally, the pre-formed "Angus" patty (which I can purchase at Costco) was nestled between a commercially produced bun.

Here's my Burger Evaluation System for all burger vendors. Every burger starts with a "10" rating (10 being the highest). If a burger comes with a store-bought bun, it loses 2 points. If the meat is a pre-formed, previously frozen, store-bought patty, it loses 2 points. A cool or cool bun also results in a deduction of 2 points.

Now, regarding Chicago Dogs...

yelp:test:13689.orig:
Best Price in Las Vegas for lunch Buffet.

I love eating at an all you can eat buffet.

I think this place is very good. I just come here to eat and save some money on my trip to vegas.

They have a wide variety of food to choose from.

They even have mongolian grill.

Is just 1.5 miles off the strip.
yelp:test:13689.para:
Top-notch value for lunch buffets in Las Vegas.

I enjoy dining at a buffet where I can eat as much as I want.

I find this establishment to be excellent. My main reason for visiting is to enjoy a meal while economizing on my Vegas excursion.

A diverse selection of dishes is available.

They also offer Mongolian grill cuisine.

Located just 1.5 miles from the Strip.

yelp:test:13697.orig: Visited the Tied House on Superbowl Sunday, only to realize that our party were the only customers in the place who weren't friends of the owner.  As a result, a server came by perhaps three times, and we could never tell if the staff were working or were there to drink.\n\nFood-wise, standard but good brew-pub food, very good beers, including the amber ale and stout.  Warning: smoking is allowed in the restaurant.
yelp:test:13697.para: On Superbowl Sunday, we found ourselves the sole patrons at the Tied House who weren't acquainted with the proprietor. Consequently, the service was sporadic, with a server making an appearance maybe thrice, leaving us uncertain about the staff's engagement level or their presence for leisure.\n\nIn terms of cuisine, it was ordinary yet commendable, with an excellent selection of craft beers, notably the amber ale and stout. Note: smoking is permitted within the dining area.

yelp:test:13750.orig: Run of the mill cheap Chinese fast food and other poor quality fast food grade food.
yelp:test:13750.para: Ordinary low-cost Chinese fast food and other substandard fast food quality meals.

yelp:test:13751.orig: On the first day of my Vegas Vacation I realized somewhere during our travels to Vegas my camera had broke. Ugh. My mind was preoccupied by the thought of a vacation with no camera. I lamented the whole morning about my options, ruling out disposables because no self respecting photog would stoop that low. I even called all of the local camera repair shops with no luck for a place to get my broken baby repaired. I started to get frustrated as we walked to the Forum Shops at Caesar's Palace. I finally had a mini-meltdown where I burst into tears by the fountain at the shops. After wiping away my tears I looked up to see a beacon of light - no wait, it was just the Sony Style shop where I bit the bullet and bought a brand new Cybershot for $180 (totally compatible with the fully charged battery and 4GB memory card from my broken camera). The day was saved! I immediately started taking pictures and felt a million times happier.\n\nLong story short, thank god for this store. The staff was totally helpful (and sympathetic) and the price was right.
yelp:test:13751.para:
As soon as I arrived in Vegas for my getaway, I discovered my camera had malfunctioned during our journey. Disappointment washed over me, contemplating a trip without my camera. I spent the morning considering my choices, dismissing the idea of using disposable cameras as it didn't align with my professional standards. I reached out to nearby camera repair businesses but to no avail. My irritation grew as we strolled towards the Forum Shops at Caesar's Palace. I eventually had a breakdown, crying by the fountain. However, my spirits lifted when I noticed the Sony Style shop, where I reluctantly purchased a new Cybershot for $180, compatible with my broken camera's battery and memory card. The day was redeemed. I began snapping photos and my joy multiplied.

In summary, I'm grateful for this store. The staff were incredibly supportive and understanding, and the cost was fair.

yelp:test:13758.orig:
This review is for the Casino only.

A great place to play Black Jack.
Excellent dealers, professional staff and classy old school Vegas.

Check out the Egyptian ship at Cleopatra's; it's actually floating.
yelp:test:13758.para:
This comment specifically pertains to the Casino.

An ideal venue for enjoying Black Jack.
Notable for its skilled dealers, professional team and sophisticated old-school Vegas vibe.

Explore the floating Egyptian ship at Cleopatra's; it's genuinely afloat.

yelp:test:13769.orig: Wow this place has gone down hill. Old smelly rooms. Service is horrible
yelp:test:13769.para: This location has deteriorated significantly. The rooms are ancient and emit a foul odor. The level of service is abysmal.

yelp:test:13770.orig:
I was here on business over the weekend and just had a mediocre experience. The block rate we got for the business was between $132 and $152 a night. 

+ Attached to the Forum Shops
+ Registration staff was friendly
+ Bell man Federico helped us out a LOT
+ Cool fountains and decor
+ Comfy beds
+ Free Parking (as most hotels in Vegas have)

- Our first room smelled moldy/rank
- Got moved, but to a smaller room
- Reception/Front Desk takes a WHILE to pick up
- Housekeeping forgot to clean our room one day
- There was calcium buildup on one of the sinks
- Found out they only vacuum their floors (wear slippers because they're never formally cleaned!)
- There was a CD player in our room, but no ipod hookup (I know this is minor, but who brings CDs with them to a hotel in Vegas?!)
- Bell hop services charge $20 for a full cart, or $5 per box/piece for the convention center (a little steep for someone who is staying there)

Overall, I think this place needs a massive facelift considering all of their new competition around them. Not sure if I'd pay that much to stay here.
yelp:test:13770.para:
During a business trip over the weekend, my experience was average. The block rate for our company ranged from $132 to $152 per night. 

+ The Forum Shops are attached
+ The registration staff was amiable
+ Bell man Federico was incredibly helpful
+ The fountains and decor were appealing
+ The beds were comfortable
+ Free parking, similar to most Vegas hotels

- Our initial room had a musty odor
- We were relocated to a smaller room
- The reception/Front Desk was slow to respond
- Housekeeping neglected to clean our room on one occasion
- Calcium deposits were present on one of the sinks
- Floors were only vacuumed, with guests required to wear slippers due to lack of formal cleaning
- The room had a CD player but no iPod connection (a minor issue, but unusual for a Vegas hotel)
- Bell hop services charged $20 for a full cart, or $5 per box/piece for the convention center (a bit pricey for a stay)

In summary, I believe this establishment requires significant renovation in light of the new competition in the area. I'm uncertain if I would be willing to pay such a high price to stay there.

yelp:test:13826.orig:
Don't let the exterior set your expectations for the place! It's super cute on the inside with cupcakes that look more like pieces of art than food. 

I was hoping it would be more of a cafe where you could sit and hang out - to enjoy the ambiance but they only had a few stools and it didn't even seem to have a restroom. Majority of the patrons came, ordered to go, and left. Which is a bit of a shame because it's super cute and cozy in there. 

I did notice that they sell cold brewed Cartel coffee (awesome!) in addition to the bottled drinks in the cooler but no hot coffees. Also, I have to agree with the woman who posted about not having tap water available. Personally, I believe offering tap water is just a basic gesture of hospitality. 

Enough about what they *aren't* and into what they are - they are an awesome bakery to get some pretty amazing tasty cookies and cupcakes.  Seemed to have more cupcakes than cookies despite the name. Perfect for special occasions, gifts, or to really indulge your sweet tooth. 

They also change up flavors according to the season. They had pumpkin bread they were selling which seemed to be pretty popular.  Also had gluten-free options, 3
yelp:test:13826.para:
Avoid judging the place based on its outward appearance, as the interior is delightfully charming with artfully crafted cupcakes. 

I anticipated a cozy cafe atmosphere for relaxation, but found limited seating and no restroom facilities. It's a bit disappointing given its adorable and snug interior. 

I observed that they offer cold brewed Cartel coffee, alongside bottled beverages in the refrigerator, but no hot coffee options. I concur with the individual who mentioned the absence of tap water, as I believe providing tap water is a fundamental act of hospitality. 

Let's focus on what they excel at - they are an exceptional bakery, offering delectable cookies and cupcakes. Despite its name, there seem to be more cupcakes than cookies. Ideal for special events, gifts, or satisfying your sweet cravings. 

They also adapt their flavors with the seasons, with pumpkin bread being a popular choice. Additionally, they provide gluten-free options. 3

yelp:test:13902.orig: I had a great time here and the only complaint I got was the place being too small for the amount of people they let in. The music was great, a lot of attractive people and everyone seemed to be having a blast. We got bottle service which came with nice comfy seats that fits four in front of one of the pools. For the boos, we got blended redbull vodka which was bomb! Never had it blended before.. The strawberry vodka was also refreshing and tangy.\n\nIf you want to party daytime, this is one spot you want to hit up.
yelp:test:13902.para: I thoroughly enjoyed my time here, with the sole issue being the venue's limited capacity for the number of guests present. The music was fantastic, and the crowd was filled with appealing individuals, all seemingly enjoying themselves. We were provided with premium service that included comfortable seating for four in front of the pool area. The blended Red Bull vodka was explosive, a novelty for me. Additionally, the strawberry vodka offered a refreshing and tangy taste. If you're looking for a daytime party destination, this place is definitely worth checking out.

yelp:test:13903.orig: MEH MEH MEH. This place was just meh. \n\nThe only reason I didn't give this place one star was because my guy friend got in here for free so that's +1 for that. Venue wise....this place is SO SMALL! WHERE'S THE DANCEFLOOR?! COME ON!! Then, there are the creepers...my friends and I were people watching and saw a bunch of creepy old guys hitting and checking out these girls. Other than that, music was meh - they only started playing the good stuff when we decided to leave, venue - SMALL, pool - SMALL AND CROWDED...overall, DISAPPOINTING!
yelp:test:13903.para: This location was underwhelming. \n\nI refrained from rating it one star solely due to my companion receiving complimentary entry, which slightly offsets the overall experience. The venue's size was quite disappointing, lacking a dance floor. The presence of unsettling older men observing and interacting with women added a peculiar element, which was amusing. The music quality was mediocre, only improving as we prepared to depart. The pool area was also small and overly packed. In summary, the experience was quite unsatisfactory.

yelp:test:13904.orig: Came here with the BF last year with one of those VIP tickets.  TAO Beach itself is pretty small and packed.  There's nowhere to stand and trying to get drinks is horrendous. People pushing you as if they were giving out free drinks or something.\nWe actually enjoyed the other part of the pool area better. Plus, you can still hear the music from there, so why not?
yelp:test:13904.para: Brought along my partner the previous year with a premium ticket. TAO Beach itself is compact and densely populated. There's a lack of space to stand and obtaining beverages is extremely frustrating. Individuals seem to be shoving you as if they were distributing complimentary drinks or similar.\nWe actually preferred the alternative section of the pool area. Additionally, the music is still audible from that area, so it makes sense to appreciate it.

yelp:test:13906.orig: Went at 2pm on a Thursday and they were closed. Sign on the window says open daily 10am to 11pm.  Except 2pm on Thursdays apparently. \n\nBy the way, if you happen to go and they are actually open, they accept cash only (as evidenced by their huge sign on the window). I don't think I'll be giving them another shot.
yelp:test:13906.para: At 2pm on a Thursday, the establishment was shut. The window display indicated they are open from 10am to 11pm every day, except for 2pm on Thursdays. Additionally, it's worth noting that they only accept cash payments, as shown by the prominent sign on the window. Given this information, I'm not planning to try them out again.

yelp:test:14001.orig: I had a feeling it was gonna be bad but I didn't know it was gonna be this bad. Came in here looking for yarn, and I immediately didn't like any I liked or was worth looking at! The colors were a mix of 70's and late 80's ski suits or 90's glittering string for cats. Ugh, Anyhoo, saw a color and brand that was ok and when I saw the price I nearly hit the floor! $4 something for a ball of yarn not even enough for a mouse tea cozy. Your better off going to walmart for yarn, or any other place that specializes in arts and crafts, just not here.
yelp:test:14001.para: I sensed it would be disappointing, but I didn't anticipate it to be this underwhelming. Searching for yarn, I found none that appealed to me or seemed valuable. The hues reminded me of outdated ski attire from the '70s and '80s, or shiny cat-themed strings from the '90s. Disappointed, I stumbled upon a color and brand that was barely satisfactory. The cost, around $4, was shocking as it barely covered a single ball of yarn, let alone a mouse tea cozy. It's more prudent to purchase yarn from a store like Walmart or a specialized arts and crafts shop, rather than here.

yelp:test:14011.orig: Never enough employees working especially in the morning. Food is good and customer service is standard. Just wish they had more people working there to speed up the process.
yelp:test:14011.para: The workforce is insufficient, particularly during morning hours. The quality of food remains satisfactory, and customer service adheres to the norm. There's a desire for additional staff to expedite operations.

yelp:test:14021.orig: This place is very unique and healthy! Their wraps are amazing and the blended \""buzz\"" is very addicting. The only downside is the parking situation. I hate having to pull into this place because I feel like im either holding up traffic or about to get hit. A better idea - park at the Albertsons parking lot and WALK over. It'll be worth the few extra steps :)
yelp:test:14021.para: This location stands out for its distinctiveness and wellness! The wraps are exceptional, and the energizing "buzz" is highly compelling. The sole drawback is the parking arrangement. I dislike the necessity of arriving here, as it often disrupts traffic flow or poses a risk of collision. A superior suggestion would be to park at the Albertsons lot and stroll over. The minor inconvenience is offset by the benefits.

This Leslie said that she would email the 2 plans that I was interested in and follow up with a call. I got the email but didn't understand the abbreviations and scope of work and NO FOLLOW UP CALL. I left a couple of messages since I wasn't doing this for fun but I have dental issues that I want resolved. No call back other than a message next day saying that she was available until 2 pm. I called anyway (it was 4-4:30) and she was there. I asked her why she didn't call and she gave the worst possible answer any employee can give..I have too much work (going to 4 other offices and perhaps why those reviews stink as well) and don't have time to do what I said I would do, in essence. Also, even though she doesn't work in your mouth, she bites her nails which looked nasty and very unprofessional for a business where oral hygiene is critical. I suppose that she's too busy to scrub her nubs. Seeing these other reviews doesn't surprise me. I'm actually glad now that she didn't call, I may have really stepped in it.
yelp:test:14023.para: There's an employee named Leslie Ybarra who has been problematic. After two assessments and a strategy, I was prepared to proceed. Leslie assured me that she would send the two plans I was interested in and arrange a call. However, I received the email but was confused by the abbreviations and the extent of the work, and there was no follow-up call. I left several messages as I was not engaging in this for leisure but due to dental problems I wanted to address. I received a response the next day stating her availability until 2 pm, so I called at 4-4:30. She answered the call. When I inquired why she didn't call earlier, she provided a poor response, citing excessive workload and time constraints, as she was juggling tasks in four other locations, which might also explain the negative reviews. Additionally, her habit of biting her nails, which appeared unprofessional in a field where oral care is paramount, was noted. The other reviews didn't come as a surprise to me, and I'm relieved that she didn't call, as I might have gotten involved in a difficult situation.

yelp:test:14027.orig: Nick's is our favorite Italian restaurant in the valley.  The Baked Ziti is the best.  We frequent Nick's once a month.  Great happy hour specials and friendly staff.
yelp:test:14027.para: Our preferred Italian dining spot in the valley is Nick's. The Baked Ziti stands out as the top choice. We make it a point to visit Nick's monthly. Enjoyable happy hour deals and a welcoming team are what we appreciate.

yelp:test:14043.orig:
Good place to go for a mexican quick meal.  Ive never had anything that I dont like. The salsa bar is good with nice choices and fresh. 

Prices are fair and they even have the option for beer and margaritas. 

Ole!
yelp:test:14043.para:
A great spot for a swift Mexican dining experience. I've never encountered anything I didn't enjoy. The salsa bar offers excellent selections and freshness. 

The pricing is reasonable and they provide choices for beer and margaritas. 

Ole!

yelp:test:14058.orig: Very disappointing. A very unimaginative menu with fair at best food
yelp:test:14058.para: Extremely unsatisfactory. The menu lacks creativity, offering only mediocre culinary experiences at best.

yelp:test:14081.orig: Walked up to bar. order beer. fanned my money a five and 4-ones. bartender brings 2 bottles and scoops up all the money. I asked how much they were. she told me 2 for $4. uh... give me back my money..  she got all hurt that she didn't wasn't able to TAKE my money.  Also ordered a FIREBALL. poured me a cheap knock off.  Charged me and when i pointed out it wasn't Fireball, she argued with me, took ALL my change from a $20 and walked out to find a manager. He came in and argued with me, then admitted it was a different product.  Didn't offer to refund my money or make me another drink. I HAD TO ASK for a Washington Apple. Bartender didn't know how to make it.  Poured a lot of Crown, Pucker, and Cranberry in a shaker then filled a shot glass with about a third of what was in the shaker.  \n\nI won't go back!
yelp:test:14081.para:
Approached the bar and requested a beer. Presented a five-dollar bill and four-ones. The bartender served two bottles and collected all the cash. I inquired about the price, and she informed me it was $4 for both. I insisted on getting my money back, but she became upset and left to find a supervisor. The supervisor joined the dispute, acknowledging the product was not Fireball, but didn't offer a refund or another drink. I had to request a Washington Apple, but the bartender was clueless about its preparation. She mixed a significant amount of Crown, Pucker, and Cranberry in a shaker and filled a shot glass with roughly one-third of the mixture.

I will not return to this establishment.

yelp:test:14084.orig: This used to be my go to Chipotle, compared to the one at Alma cause their rice was always undercooked. But I might head back there now cause like stated before on other reviews, the portions SUCK! The amount of food they give: whether it's rice, meat, salsa, etc., its all VERY LITTLE. not to mention the workers there are never happy. Never. Again.
yelp:test:14084.para: Previously, my preferred Chipotle was in comparison to the one at Alma, due to their consistently undercooked rice. However, I might reconsider and return to it, as other reviews have highlighted the disappointingly small portion sizes for items like rice, meat, and salsa. Additionally, the staff's perpetual dissatisfaction is another deterrent. Never a cheerful sight.

yelp:test:14127.orig:
Never returning. Gave this place two shots. First time 30 minute wait for an unmemorable sandwich. 
Second time,  called ahead to avoid wait. Picked up food. My soup was forgotten. I called to have the charge removed. They ""cannot refund my money, only the owner can and she's at the other location."" I ask them to have her call me as I'm getting irritated at this nonsense. An hour passes, no call. 
I call other location, owner answers with HUGE attitude and I explain what happened. She says ""so you forgot your soup?"" Bc it's of course my fault.  She starts babbling/complaining about how they're short staffed and busy. I really don't give a crap about her excuses or staffing levels, I just want my money back. I interrupt her whining and just ask for my money back. She asks if she can call me back. I say ""no you've wasted far too much of my time.""
She finally refunds my money with attitude goes ""look I'm SORRY we forgot your soup, I'm SORRY were short staffed.""
I cannot possibly explain the owners terrible attitude in this review..comparable to Amy's baking co. 
Also, if owner does not trust staff to refund $2.75, why should I trust staff to make my sandwiches?
O
yelp:test:14127.para:
Never coming back. Tried this place twice. First visit, a 30-minute wait for an unremarkable sandwich. 
Second visit, I pre-ordered to skip the wait. My soup was overlooked. I requested a refund. They replied, "We can't refund your money, only the owner can, and she's at another location." I insisted they have the owner contact me due to growing frustration. An hour went by without a call. 
I reached out to the other location, the owner answered with a significant attitude. I recounted the incident. She questioned, "So you forgot your soup?" implying it was my mistake. She began to rant about staffing issues and busyness. I was indifferent to her justifications, solely focused on recovering my funds. I cut through her complaints and demanded my money back. She suggested a callback. I responded, "No more of your time wasted." 
The owner eventually refunded my money, but with a sour demeanor. She apologized for the soup mishap and staffing shortcomings. 
I find it impossible to describe the owners' poor attitude in this review, likening it to the service at Amy's Baking Co. 
Additionally, if the owner doesn't trust the staff to process a $2.75 refund, how can I trust them to prepare my sandwiches?

yelp:test:14151.orig: Just got my bill and my rate went from $55.99/month to $62.99/month.  Wake up Cox!  A price increase of over 10% in this economy will send me and others searching for our next provider.\n\nNetflix and Youtube videos stall and buffer at night during peak usage times so it's not like you have a superior product.  Grrrr!  Unjustified price increases really make me mad!
yelp:test:14151.para: I recently received my bill and noticed my monthly charge has risen from $55.99 to $62.99. This significant hike of more than 10% in our current economic climate will compel me and others to explore alternative service providers.\n\nThe buffering and stalling of Netflix and YouTube videos during high-demand periods at night indicate that the product isn't superior. This unjustified surge in costs is genuinely infuriating!

yelp:test:14158.orig: We had been their costumer over 6 years now and we're finally moving on, their poor costumers service had exceed anything I ever come across. The last two month we paid the bill with cash in the store but they seem to have lost the records of any bill being paid and they are charging us fees over fees. I personally try to go in and show them the payment that was made but they give me a hard time. with 30 minutes of arguing and explaining they finally removed one fee, \n\nI got to say I am disappointed how much they have changed in costumers service. I really hope they will turn around and give more happy costumers their time and services that they want and deserve.
yelp:test:14158.para:
Over the course of six years, we've served as their costumers, and we're ready to transition away. Their subpar costumers service has surpassed any experience I've had. Despite paying the last two months' bills in cash at the store, they've lost track of these payments and are imposing additional charges. I've attempted to present the proof of payment, but they've been uncooperative. After a half-hour of debate and clarification, they reluctantly waived one fee.

I must express my disappointment in the significant decline in their costumers service. I earnestly hope they will improve and provide more satisfied costumers with the time and services they rightfully deserve.

yelp:test:14176.orig: I made appointments for my daughter and I to have mani-pedicures.  We are from another state and I just moved here and she was visiting me and we thought it would be fun.  I checked Yelp and saw good reviews so I was thinking this would be a great treat for my daughter.  I had the man working on me and he did a passable job but the woman who worked on my daughter didn't speak any English and within hours her manicure was chipping off and she had to re-file her toenails because they were so jagged and sharp.  Our feet were so dry from the pedicures that we had to apply tons of lotion to them to make them stop hurting.  The manicures hurt for days from all nicks we had around our nails from the cuticle scissors they used.  We would not recommend this nail salon to anyone.  By the time my daughter left from her vacation, her nail polish had completely chipped off.  What a waste of $85.00!!
yelp:test:14176.para: I arranged for my child and myself to get manicure and pedicure services. We're relocating from another state and I'm settling in, and she was here for a visit. We thought it would be enjoyable. I browsed Yelp and found positive feedback, so I considered it a delightful surprise for my child. The manicure technician gave a satisfactory service to me, but the lady attending to my daughter struggled with English and her manicure started peeling off within a few hours. Her toenails were overly rough and needed re-filing. Our feet became extremely dry post-treatment, necessitating the application of a lotion to alleviate discomfort. The manicures caused discomfort due to minor cuts from the cuticle scissors used. We advise against recommending this nail salon. By the end of her trip, her nail polish had entirely worn off. It was a regrettable expenditure of $85.00.

yelp:test:14178.orig:
I enjoyed a Pastrami Sandwich here for a reasonable price. Their bread here is great  (it is AZ Bread Co for a reason) and they toasted this sandwich perfectly. Loved every bite of it! 

Could it have been piled a little higher for a traditional deli style sandwich, yes, but it was good anyway, and think of the calories I saved. 

My friend had their french toast which looked mouth watering good!  Thick toast cooked perfectly with plenty of warm syrup on the side.
yelp:test:14178.para:
I relished a Pastrami Sandwich at this place, which was quite affordable. The bread, sourced from AZ Bread Co, was excellent and the sandwich was expertly toasted. Every morsel was delightful! 

While it might have been stacked taller for a classic deli sandwich, it was still enjoyable and the calorie reduction was a bonus. 

My companion savored their French toast, which appeared delectable. The bread was cooked to perfection, complemented by a generous serving of warm syrup.

yelp:test:14203.orig: I've eaten here 3 times and I kick myself for going back the other 2 times. The first time it was terrible. It was fish and chips and there was nothing but heavy batter, you had a hard time finding the fish, it must have been thin as a sheet of paper. But I gave it a second chance, figuring it might have been a bad day for the cook. So this time a got adventurous and had a rib-eye steak. What a disaster, it was cooked dry, so overly done I couldn't cut it with a knife. I asked for medium-rare. So, convinced I would not ever go back, until my neighbor begged me to go with her and again, terrible food. This place I would never recommend to anyone and I made it very clear to my neighbor I would not be returning.
yelp:test:14203.para: I've dined here thrice, regretting my decision to return for the remaining two occasions. Initially, it was a disappointing experience with fish and chips, where the fish was almost invisible beneath a thick layer of batter. Opting for a second visit, I decided to try something different and ordered a rib-eye steak. Unfortunately, it was overcooked to the point of being inedible. I had requested it medium-rare, but it was far from it. Convinced I'd never return, I made it clear to my neighbor that I wouldn't be recommending this place to anyone.

yelp:test:14222.orig:
Our cheap rental is turning out to be $450 more because of the dent on the hood they insist was our responsibility. 

BIG TIP: Make a representative walk around the car with you and sign off on the no dents before you take the car off the lot or you could be the next one duped. 

I have never given a company a bad rating and I should have looked  here before renting at Fox since not many people had anything good to say.
yelp:test:14222.para:
The underpriced lease has unexpectedly increased by $450 due to the hood damage they claim we caused. 

HUGE ADVICE: Accompany a representative to inspect the vehicle and obtain a no-damage agreement before leaving the premises to avoid being deceived. 

Despite never rating a company negatively, I regret not researching Fox's reputation prior to renting, as customer feedback was predominantly unfavorable.

yelp:test:14223.orig: I live in Scottsdale and went out of town to Southern California for 4 days and booked this rental. The price was $116.00 total and I got there at 6 am on a Thursday so there was no line. The woman was nice and didn't try to up-sell me AT ALL. I didnt have a credit card so I had to put down a $400.00 deposit which was annoying but manageable. Brand new Chevy Malibu with 4900 miles which ran great. Brought it back at 3pm on Sunday with no line. Overall, I was pretty impressed. Last time we took a trip to Sedona and used Payless at the airport and it was horrid. I would rent again from Fox.
yelp:test:14223.para: I reside in Scottsdale and spent four days in Southern California, securing this rental. The total cost was $116.00, and I arrived at 6 am on a Thursday, avoiding any queues. The lady was pleasant and refrained from any attempts to upsell. Lacking a credit card, I had to deposit $400.00, which was slightly bothersome but feasible. I was provided with a brand-new Chevy Malibu with 4900 miles, which performed excellently. I returned it at 3pm on Sunday without any wait. In general, I was quite satisfied. Previously, we experienced a dreadful time at Sedona's airport using Payless for rentals, and I would certainly opt for Fox again.

yelp:test:14251.orig: Because of this NNY I will never eat at another one. I wish I could leave no stars. I got served a hamburger with Brillo pad cooked in it. Then they only gave me 1/2 off the cost of my bill. Worthless. They should have comped the meal because I didn't finish it and was grossed out. Do not go to this NNY
yelp:test:14251.para: Due to my experience here, I'll avoid dining at any other NNY. I regret not being able to award them zero stars. I was served a hamburger cooked with a Brillo pad, which was unacceptable. They only reduced my bill by half, which was insufficient. They should have covered the full cost as I couldn't finish my meal and found it repulsive. This NNY is not recommended.

yelp:test:14268.orig:
The layout of this store is great. My only complaint is that it takes just about as much time to check out as it does to shop. I'll admit....they have improved recently. ..however,  I would still like to see more cashiers. The store appears clean and organized. The clientele is less 'duck dynasty' inspired (code for white trash) than the Queen Creek store.

If you could reduce the checkout time, I'd give more stars.

Ok...now I'm extremely ANGRY! When I got home I scanned my receipt using the new Walmart app. When the app pulled up my receipt I reviewd the prices of the items I purchased, & I noticed a discrepancy. While I was at the store Pepsi was advertised that $2.24 a 12 pack. So, I bought eight. When I reviewed the receipt, I realized they charged me $3 a Pepsi. 
I called the customer service number and explain what happened to the lady over the phone. She put me on hold. After four and a half she came back on the line and ask me to explain explain what happened again. Then she told me I had to come to the store. I explained that now is going to have to spend gas money to go and resolve their mistake.  I told the lady to just pull my receipt up by the transaction number.
yelp:test:14268.para:
The store's design is commendable. My sole grievance is that the time spent at checkout is comparable to the duration of shopping. I acknowledge that there have been improvements lately, but I still desire to see an increase in the number of cashiers. The store exudes cleanliness and orderliness. The shoppers here are less influenced by 'duck dynasty' stereotypes (a euphemism for white trash) than those at the Queen Creek location. 

If checkout times were shorter, I would award more ratings. 

Now I'm extremely upset! Upon returning home, I used the new Walmart app to scan my receipt. I examined the item prices I had bought, and I discovered a pricing error. While in the store, Pepsi was priced at $2.24 per 12-pack. I purchased eight. However, the receipt showed a charge of $3 per Pepsi. 
I contacted customer service and narrated the issue to the representative over the phone. She transferred me to hold briefly. After nearly five minutes, she returned and asked me to repeat the incident. Then she insisted I visit the store to rectify their mistake. I suggested that she simply access my receipt by the transaction number.

yelp:test:14358.orig:
I used to LOVE Freddy's.  We started going when we were in Texas on vacation and then the opened this location and WOW...we had a favorite.

We have been to this location several times and the location in Gilbert twice.  It used to be that EVERY time we went it was AMAZING!!  Now, it is hit or miss.  Last visit to this location the fries were WAY overcooked...quality control would tell you not to send out burnt fries, but no they sent them right out to us.  I think the little burger has shrunk and it was small before.  

Ouch, why is it that when you start to really love a place it goes downhill?  Well, at least In & Out burger stays consistant and since I now live in SoCal I guess we won't be missing Freddy's anymore.
yelp:test:14358.para: I used to adore Freddy's. Our journey began during a Texas vacation when they inaugurated this spot, and it quickly became our preferred haunt. We've frequented this location multiple times and the Gilbert branch twice. Previously, every visit was extraordinary, but now it's unpredictable. Our most recent visit revealed that the fries were excessively burnt, a clear lapse in quality control. Additionally, the size of the burger seemed to have diminished since our last visit. It's disheartening when a beloved place starts to decline. However, In & Out burger maintains its consistency, and since I now reside in Southern California, I believe we won't miss Freddy's as much.

yelp:test:14360.orig: This is the place to go for an after work Happy Hour, family feast, birthday celebrations, etc.  We go there 8 times a year for only celebrating special birthdays.  Everyone loves the food and the service is great.  Take a table or a booth, either way, the atmosphere is very nice.  Try their special appetizer platters and if you like margarita's, try their on the rocks ones, really the best in town.
yelp:test:14360.para: This venue is ideal for post-work social gatherings, family dinners, and birthday parties. We visit it 8 times annually exclusively for honoring unique birthdays. The food is highly appreciated by all, and the service quality is outstanding. Choose between a table or booth, the ambiance remains consistently pleasant. Don't miss out on their exclusive appetizer platters, and if you enjoy margaritas, their on-the-rocks versions are unparalleled in the area.

yelp:test:14375.orig: Great place for a dinner date or to woo a client or a propective hire. Great steak!! Went there for my anniversary and the valet puts a nice touch on the evening. Be prepared to walk out full.
yelp:test:14375.para: An excellent venue for a romantic dinner or to charm a potential client or job candidate. Enjoy their delicious steak! I celebrated my anniversary there, and the valet added a special flair to the night. Expect to leave satisfied and possibly full.

yelp:test:14377.orig:
Had dinner with five friends here. Four of us arrived and had a cocktail at the bar. We were seated after a 10 minute wait. Someone came by the table to greet us as soon as we were seated but we weren't sure if he was the waiter or not. He said bread was on the way (but we didn't see it till 20 minutes later) and gave us some menus.

We sat for nearly 10 minutes waiting for our waiter and no one showed up. I also want to note that the restaurant wasn't too busy on a Friday night (perhaps this review will explain why). One of my buddies asked another waiter for our server. The same guy who greeted us came back and said he was our waiter. I am not going to say his name as I don't want our country's unemployment rate to go up. The waiter made excuses on why he didn't come back. Whatever...

One of my buddies who's a wine connoisseur ordered a 2007 Syrah and the waiter brought out a 2008 instead. We politely sent it back. My buddy followed with another 2007 Cabernet and we again received the 2008 instead. How hard is it to update the wine menu? There's a huge difference in wine when it comes to the year. How can a ""famous"" steakhouse have such an oversight on the menus.

All
yelp:test:14377.para:

They informed us that bread would arrive shortly (which we didn't see until 20 minutes later) and provided us with menus.

The waiter offered excuses for not returning. Regardless,...

My wine-savvy friend then ordered a 2007 Cabernet, and once again, we received a 2008. It's surprising how difficult it is to keep the wine list updated. The difference in wine quality based on the year is significant. How can a renowned steakhouse overlook such details on the men

yelp:test:14381.orig: Went there last night for my first time and food was not that great, I have had better filet mignon. But that is not the reason why I am writing this review. We arrived and the hostess had asked my date to remove his hat which I could understand being a nice restaurant and all. After we had completed our dinner and waiting for the check to come, we see a large group seated and most of them were wearing hats, and t-shirts. Now, I am not one to complain about the food or service but if I am paying good $$$$ to eat at this so called nice place, I would accept the same rules apply to all customers. I had expressed my dissatisfaction to our lovely waitress but the manager came by and said sorry like it was no big deal. Regardless of why we were treated differently, If I am going to fork up $200 to eat at a nice restaurant I expect respect, great service and great food. I can say, I will never dine at Donovan's ever again and would give Hillstone my business. Way better service at Hillstone and better food.
yelp:test:14381.para: Visited the establishment for the first time last evening, and while the cuisine didn't quite meet my expectations, having sampled superior filet mignon elsewhere, it's not the crux of my review. Upon arrival, the hostess requested my companion to take off his hat, a gesture befitting a high-end dining venue. Post our meal and the wait for the bill, we noticed a sizable crowd donning hats and casual wear. Although I don't habitually voice grievances about dining experiences or service, as a patron investing a significant sum in this establishment, I expect uniformity in the application of rules to all guests. I voiced my discontent to our attentive waitress, but the manager dismissed it with a nonchalant apology. Despite the reasons for our unique treatment, as a patron spending $200 at a reputed restaurant, I anticipate courteous service, exceptional food, and equal treatment. Henceforth, I will not patronize Donovan's and will instead patronize Hillstone, which I found to offer superior service and cuisine.

yelp:test:14387.orig: I am an avid Black & White shopper, I love it! I just relocated to Scottsdale from Southern California and I have been SO disappointed with the service at the Kierland Commons location. Both my mom and I have been there several times and at first I thought it was just me, but confirming with my mom,  unfortunately we have both had the same experience. The ladies we have encountered have been so unfriendly and snobby which is so unlike the experience I have had in the past with other B&W locations. It makes me not want to shop there anymore! \nCome on ladies, it's not Chanel, please loosen up a little!
yelp:test:14387.para: I am passionate about Black & White shopping, and I genuinely enjoy it! I recently moved to Scottsdale from Southern California, and I've been quite disheartened with the service at the Kierland Commons branch. My mom and I have visited multiple times, and initially, I believed it was an isolated incident. However, after discussing with her, it's clear that we've both faced the same unsatisfactory experience. The staff we've interacted with have been overly aloof and pretentious, starkly contrasting with the welcoming atmosphere I've previously enjoyed at other Black & White stores. This has led me to reconsider shopping at this location. Ladies, please remember, it's not Chanel, and a bit more warmth and friendliness would be appreciated!

yelp:test:14397.orig: I have driven by the this place countless times and never even knew it was there. It's tucked into a tiny strip mall on the north side. The owners/employees are extremely friendly and very helpful. We ordered a Philly Mushroom Cheese Steak and a Turkey Hoagie. Although both were delicious, we agreed the Cheese Steak was amazing. It's a little bit of a drive for us but will continue to go back because it was that good. I highly recommend trying this hidden little gem. It's as close to the real thing as you're going to get without going to Philly.
yelp:test:14397.para: I've passed this location numerous times without realizing its existence, nestled within a small shopping center on the northern side. The proprietors and staff are incredibly amiable and supportive. We opted for a Philly Mushroom Cheese Steak and a Turkey Hoagie, both delectable but the Cheese Steak stood out as exceptional. Despite the extra travel effort, we're inclined to revisit due to its superior quality. I strongly suggest giving this concealed treasure a try, offering an authentic experience akin to being in Philly without the actual trip.

yelp:test:14410.orig:
This place is dead to me.  

I've been going here for years and used to be a regular for lunch.  The service went way town hill a couple of years ago so I stopped going as often but would occasionally go if I didn't have afternoon meetings.  Not anymore.  The service just isn't slow it's terrible.  I walked out after 20 minutes of no service today, the place was only half full and one of the waitresses was prioritizing bussing a table instead of taking care of guests.  

Too bad, the food is actually decent.
yelp:test:14410.para:
I feel disconnected from this location.  

I frequented this spot for years, often for lunch. The service declined a few years back, leading me to reduce my visits, though I'd still visit if my afternoons were free. That's changed now. The service is not just slow, it's abysmal. I left after 20 minutes of no service today, with the place barely half-occupied and a waitress more concerned with clearing tables than attending to customers.  

Regrettably, the food quality is commendable.

yelp:test:14448.orig: While I acknowledge I got there at 5:05 am - 5 minutes after they were set to close, the complete lack of compassion of the people I encountered was quite surprising.  Here I am, 5 months pregnant with a sick toddler still in his PJs, in an obvious rush to make it in the doors by 5 a.m.  The lobby is completely empty and the front door unlocked when I arrive.  I hear someone in the back say \""that's not someone new, is it?\""  and another voice responded \""no, probably just someone leaving.\""  Next thing I know I see the people who own the voices I heard - one looks like one of the doctors or nurses and the other like the person who runs the front desk area.  All I get is \""sorry, we're closed.\""  With the fact that I didn't make it in time sinking in, near tears (I blame the pregnancy hormones) I explain that I had a difficult time finding them in the strip mall where they are located and got stuck at a light.  This time I get one word - \""sorry.\""  I look up to see faces of stone.  Nothing.  Neither of the ladies offered any suggestion on where else I might be able to take my sick child to be seen by a doctor, which we were obviously in need of since we'd come to their urg
yelp:test:14448.para: Recognizing that I arrived at 5:05 am, just five minutes past their closing time, the utter absence of empathy from the individuals I met was unexpected. Here I am, pregnant for five months and carrying a sickly toddler still dressed in pajamas, frantically trying to reach the entrance by 5 a.m. The lobby is devoid of people, and the front door is ajar upon my arrival. I hear a comment in the back, "Isn't that someone new?" to which another voice replies, "No, probably just someone exiting." Shortly after, I encounter the owners of these voices - one appears to be akin to a doctor or nurse, while the other seems to be the front desk manager. All I receive is, "Sorry, we're closed." As I process the missed opportunity, tears well up due to pregnancy hormones, and I explain my challenges in locating them amidst the strip mall and being delayed by a traffic light. This time, I am met with a single word, "sorry." I notice the unyielding expressions on their faces. No further assistance or advice is offered on alternative medical facilities for my ailing child, which we desperately needed since we had come to their urgent care.

yelp:test:14454.orig: Arrived to sit down with a good crowd & ambiance. Soon a stinky bar tender assisted with our order.\nHis body oder was so offensive that it made me gag... We didn't want him to come near us. Couldn't even enjoy our meal. Came here on a Monday evening to watch a football game.
yelp:test:14454.para: Reached the venue and found a pleasant atmosphere with a large group of people. Shortly, a bar employee with a very unpleasant scent approached us to take our orders. The odor was so strong that it caused me to retch, and we wished he would keep his distance. We visited on a Monday night to watch a football match, but the smell ruined our dining experience.

yelp:test:14456.orig: Lost my health insurance application along with many others according to the health insurance exchange. Very poor customer service and zero accountability. I would stay away even though their prices are low.
yelp:test:14456.para: I misplaced my health insurance application, among others, as per the health insurance marketplace. The customer service was subpar and there was a complete lack of responsibility. Despite their affordable rates, I would avoid them due to these issues.
