yelp:test:14462.para:
One star rating is excessive for these individuals. Following my initial critique, I communicated with Aaron Pools via their "contact us" section. Here is the reply I got (names omitted):

Dear Becky,

We are unaware of your identity or your perceived judgment of our company, which has been operational for more than three decades...you are not our client.

Mr. A. is the person we have been interacting with as he is our client, and it might be beneficial for you to show this letter to him. He can reach out to us to address any issues mentioned in this communication.

Mr. A. had scheduled an appointment for us to replace the filter grids at 2939 E. Bonanza Road, Gilbert, AZ. However, he rescheduled the appointment to research the grid prices and secure a better deal for himself. He informed us that he would deliver the grids early in the week of May 7th but would call us to confirm the delivery. The only point of agreement between you and our office staff is that he delivered the grids in the afternoon of May 10th and expected an immediate appointment upon his call that day. We informed him that we could not guarantee an immediate appointment. 

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is roughly the same as the original text.)

yelp:test:14466.orig: took my scooter to get serviced here. worst experience ever,  I had read the bad reviews but still decided to try it out. My scooter has an oil leak, he told me it would be $55 for the first hour to find out where it was leaking from and call me to see how to proceed. He called me 2 days later and told me that there was a big leak, which I understood. But then he told me that the twist throttle was broken so they removed it. Something that had nothing to do with the leak.  Now I can't ride my scooter because the throttle is stuck.  He says they didnt break it, he blamed on me. I had half a tank when I took it to him, when I picked it up it was on empty. I don't recommend this place to anyone. They're just looking to make money off you.
yelp:test:14466.para: I opted to have my scooter serviced at this location despite the negative feedback I had encountered. Unfortunately, it turned out to be the most disappointing experience. The technician informed me that they would charge $55 for the initial hour to diagnose the oil leak source and discuss the next steps. After two days, I received a call stating there was a significant leak, which I acknowledged. However, they also mentioned that the twist throttle was malfunctioning and had been removed, an issue unrelated to the leak. Now, I'm unable to use my scooter as the throttle is jammed. They insisted it wasn't their fault, but I believe they were trying to profit from my situation. I strongly advise against recommending this place to others.

yelp:test:14507.orig: So, I really don't like complaining, but, only having two people run the joint in the early evening is definitely not enough. My husband and I first attempted to go through the drive though and after a few minutes, we weren't even sure if the place was open so we pulled around to try to go inside. By the time we parked, someone else was already in the drive through being helped. It was slightly annoying but still laughable at this point. When we went inside, we quietly waited for the guy in front of us to finish his order. However, as soon as he was done, they told us to wait and started helping all of the drive through customers. Either we have extremely bad luck or they definitely need to get their act together and hire more people. They made up for at least two stars by being friendly when they finally helped us and giving us fresh, hot fries. I don't think we'll ever have time to come to this location again.
yelp:test:14507.para: I generally avoid voicing grievances, but the fact that only two individuals manage the establishment during the early hours is insufficient. My spouse and I initially tried to navigate the drive-through, but after a short while, we doubted the place's operational status, prompting us to circle around for a chance to enter. Upon parking, we discovered another customer already receiving assistance. This situation was mildly irritating yet amusing by then. Inside, we silently observed the person ahead of us completing their purchase. However, as soon as he finished, they directed us to wait while attending to all drive-through patrons. It seems we either have a streak of unfortunate events or they urgently require additional staff. Nonetheless, their amiable demeanor and the provision of fresh, piping hot fries somewhat compensated for the inconvenience. I doubt we'll have the opportunity to visit this venue again.

yelp:test:14565.orig:
Ok, I have way better Chinese style Western food in Los Angeles.
I will say half of the dishes in its menu are soso or not good. Half of them meets my expectation.
The owner/chef is always proud of his cooking skill. He is too arrogant like a frog lives inside the well but has never been the outside world.
Actually for some of his dishes, I can make better than he does. 
I give it  2 stars.
yelp:test:14565.para: In Los Angeles, I've discovered superior Chinese-inspired Western cuisine. However, about half of the menu items are mediocre or subpar, only meeting my expectations. The proprietor/chef boasts excessively about his culinary abilities, akin to a frog confined to a well, oblivious to the outside world. Interestingly, I can outperform him in preparing some of his dishes. I rate this establishment 2 stars.

yelp:test:14571.orig: good boba milk tea!  wonderful food. had the Mongolian beef and chicken wings w/ fried rice. the beef was subtely spicy and very flavorful. I will be back.
yelp:test:14571.para: Excellent boba milk tea and delightful cuisine! Savored Mongolian beef and chicken wings with fried rice. The beef had a mildly spicy taste and was incredibly tasty. I plan to return.

yelp:test:14575.orig: I have had to change my review from 5 to 2 because the last few times I have gone my steak has not been cooked correctly. It is disappointing, but this place is still ok for the view.
yelp:test:14575.para: Due to recent visits where my steak was undercooked, I've adjusted my rating from 5 to 2. Although the culinary experience was unsatisfactory, the scenic location remains commendable.

yelp:test:14577.orig: Read reviews elsewhere to get the real picture.  This place is getting really, really bad.  Corporate management needs to change out the office staff and enforce posted policies before this whole complex goes to ruin.  It's so sad to see such a pretty location be handled so poorly.  It could be (and used to be) a great complex.  Now it's not worth the high rent they charge, the crime you'll be exposed to, and the noisy neighbors.
yelp:test:14577.para: Explore other reviews to understand the true situation. The condition of this establishment is deteriorating significantly. There's a pressing need for corporate leadership to replace the office personnel and implement the existing rules to prevent the complete downfall of the entire complex. It's disheartening to witness a beautiful location being mismanaged. It once had the potential to be an excellent complex, but now it fails to justify the high rental fees, the risk of crime, and the disturbance from nearby residents.

yelp:test:14602.orig: I love so many things about this place....the Bloody Mary is stellar, the fingerling potatoes are addictive, and I really like the \""window seat\"" for large groups. The parking guys are great and the location is right in my backyard.  Now for the \""requires improvement\""...I've talked with a specific employee, both on the phone and in person, and she is not customer-friendly, which has caused me to take this place off my list for special occasions (dinner club, monthly brunch).  Once the service improves, this place will double its business.  I'm also not a fan of the inside jazz on Sundays.  Once it moves outside during the winter, things will be better.\n\nThe bottom line: if you are very patient with inconsistent service and loud music, try it ASAP.  Otherwise, you have to take your chances!
yelp:test:14602.para: I adore numerous aspects of this location...the exceptional Bloody Mary, irresistible fingerling potatoes, and my preference for the "window seat" for gatherings. The parking attendants are commendable and the spot is conveniently situated in my own garden. However, there are areas that need enhancement...I've had discussions with a particular staff member both verbally and face-to-face, and their unfriendly demeanor has led me to exclude this venue from my list for special events like dinner clubs and monthly brunches. With improved service, the establishment's patronage is expected to significantly increase. I also dislike the indoor jazz on Sundays. The situation will improve when the music is taken outdoors during the colder months. \n\nIn summary: If you can tolerate erratic service and boisterous tunes, give it a try immediately. Otherwise, you're left to gamble.

yelp:test:14607.orig: Visited this place during happy hour on a Saturday.  Seated in outdoor dining area.  Even though it was cool outside, the heaters kept us warm.  Started with the baked goat cheese.  It was very good, but had a little too much tomato and not enough of the goat cheese.  I had the pork chile verde.  Not huge portions but it had great flavor and the meat was very tender.  Husband had the french onion burger and it was yummy.  The table next to us ordered the flatbread and it looked delicious.  I might have to try it next time around.  Our waiter was attentive.  I will be back in the future.
yelp:test:14607.para: Explored this venue on a cheerful Saturday evening.  We were seated in the al fresco dining section.  Despite the chilly weather, the heaters maintained our comfort.  Our meal began with the baked goat cheese dish.  It tasted excellent, though it was slightly overpowered by tomato and lacked sufficient goat cheese.  I opted for the pork chile verde.  The serving size was modest, but the taste was outstanding and the pork was exceptionally tender.  My spouse enjoyed the french onion burger and found it delightful.  The adjacent table ordered the flatbread, which appeared scrumptious.  I'm considering trying it on my next visit.  Our server was very attentive.  I plan to return in the future.

yelp:test:14628.orig: As someone who used to play the violin I really appreciate this place. I was most recently here at Christmas seeing The Nutcracker Ballet with my boyfriend. Thanks for coming with me baby! :) They usually feature a mixture of orchestra concerts, ballets, operas, and musical performances. Coming here is a great way to support the Arts in Arizona, and I have never been less than amazed by the performances they put on here. Located in the heart of downtown Phoenix, The Symphony would make a great cultured date or place to bring an out of towner. \n\nP.S The new Nutcracker was brilliant, check it out next Xmas you won't be disappointed!
yelp:test:14628.para: Having been a former violinist, I hold this venue in high regard. I recently attended The Nutcracker Ballet during Christmas with my partner, and I'm grateful for their company. The venue typically hosts a blend of orchestral concerts, ballets, operas, and musical shows. Visiting here is an excellent method to back the Arts in Arizona, and I've always been left in awe by the quality of their presentations. Situated at the core of downtown Phoenix, The Symphony is an ideal spot for a sophisticated date or to welcome a visitor. \n\nP.S. The latest rendition of The Nutcracker was outstanding, I recommend you see it next Christmas to ensure you're not let down!

yelp:test:14631.orig: When this place first opened they had some really good Mexican food and service. New management came in and really changed the feel of this place, trying to make it more of a restaurant then fast food Mexican. Unfortunately this place has really gone down hill and their food isn't that great anymore. I have given them more then one chance thinking they maybe having a bad day, but each time I have gone back it's been worse. I wouldn't recommend it.
yelp:test:14631.para: Initially, upon its opening, the establishment offered excellent Mexican cuisine and customer service. Subsequent changes in leadership aimed to transform it into a sit-down restaurant rather than a quick-service Mexican eatery. Regrettably, the quality of the food has significantly deteriorated, leading to a decline in its reputation. Despite multiple attempts to give them the benefit of the doubt, each visit has only worsened. I would advise against patronizing this establishment.

yelp:test:14654.orig: Good wings.  A person who worked there recommended the Gold Fever sauce.  I must say I was not disappointed.  It was spicy, yet tasty...  two things I like when I eat wings.  Too bad I don't live closer or else this would be a good place to go when I have a wing fix.
yelp:test:14654.para: Excellent wings. A colleague suggested trying the Gold Fever sauce. I found it to be pleasantly spicy and delicious, aligning with my wing preferences. Regrettably, I reside too far away to frequently visit this spot for my wing cravings.

yelp:test:14655.orig: Went to sardellas for the first time since, I was new to the area and was presently surprised. When I walked in I was greeted by a younger gentleman named Matt who gave me great descriptions of different types if pizza and even sold me on the wings which are my new favorite! Great customer service along with short waiting time for the food must go an try for your self!
yelp:test:14655.para: Upon my initial visit to the sardellas, having recently moved to the vicinity, I was pleasantly surprised. A younger man named Matt welcomed me and provided detailed explanations of various pizza varieties, convincing me to try their wings, which have now become my preferred choice. The excellent customer service and minimal wait time for the meal are worth experiencing firsthand!

yelp:test:14669.orig: This place is shit the workers lie about transfer fees and when they find out you dont have an AR or Glock they are dicks.
yelp:test:14669.para: This location is subpar, with employees deceiving about transfer costs and upon realizing you lack an AR or Glock, they behave unprofessionally.

yelp:test:14673.orig: beware of this dealership and avoid them at any cost. I was ready to buy a new Camry and had a quote from another dealership and they told me they'll match the price if i go there. After driving long distance, we went there and told them at the beginning the quote i had for LE model and they said they'll match. fast forward 2-3 hours later after showing us several cars and many \""manager\""s came and talk to us. a very rude, unprofessional and aggressive person came introduced himself as Tim. The written quote I had was $1k below their price on KBB and we were fine for paying whatever they advertised on KBB since they had the exact color we wanted. but **TIM** was so rude and aggressive that we decided to leave. Other staffs were good specially the boy who showed us the cars, but one terrible person is enough to make the whole experience disaster. They wasted our afternoon, save yours!
yelp:test:14673.para: Exercise caution with this car dealership and steer clear of them if possible. I intended to purchase a new Camry and had a quote from a different dealership, which they offered to match. After a long drive, we arrived and initially mentioned the quote I had for the LE model, and they agreed to match it. However, after a couple of hours, during which we viewed multiple cars and interacted with several managers, a particularly uncouth, unprofessional, and forceful individual named Tim emerged. The quote I possessed was $1,000 less than their price on KBB, and we were willing to pay the advertised KBB price since it matched the color we desired. Nevertheless, Tim's behavior was so offensive and pushy that we chose to depart. While other staff members were commendable, especially the boy who assisted us with the car selection, one negative encounter is sufficient to ruin the entire experience. They squandered our time, but you can save yours.

yelp:test:14679.orig:
I decided to walk in here on a whim, and kinda regret doing so. The food could have been pretty decent, but it was -extremely- oily. There was a visible puddle of oil left after I scooped the meat and veggies out of the plate they were delivered to, and onto the rice. Outside of that it was fine, it was pleasantly spicy, and would have otherwise been mediocre Chinese food (I prefer thai in any case).

This is definitely a place geared for delivery. The internal appearance was very dingy, and as another reviewer commented, there are boxes and things sitting around out in the main area. The service wasn't horrible; it's not exactly sit down service; you order from a counter, but I -did- have the food brought to my table. 

Had the food not been so greasy (seriously, they could have used 1/4th the oil they did, which still would have been a little much, but certainly within the realm of 'okay' for my standards), and had the internal decor been a bit better (remove the boxes, ensure everything is clean and a bit better lit), and I could see giving this place another star or two...but as it was, I regretted going in.
yelp:test:14679.para:
I opted to enter spontaneously, and now somewhat lament that choice. The cuisine had the potential to be quite acceptable, but it was excessively greasy. I noticed a substantial oil residue on the plate after transferring the meat and vegetables to the rice. Aside from that, it was enjoyably spicy and would have been average Chinese fare (I generally favor Thai cuisine).

This establishment seems tailored for takeout. The interior was noticeably grimy, with another reviewer noting the presence of boxes and clutter in the central space. The service was passable; it's more of a counter-order system, but I did receive my meal at the table. 

Had the dish not been so oily (they could have halved the oil usage, which would still be slightly excessive, but acceptable by my standards), and if the interior decor had been improved (eliminate the boxes, clean up, and enhance the lighting), I might consider awarding it an additional star or two. However, given its current state, I now wish I hadn't decided to visit.

yelp:test:14686.orig:
My sunglasses were stolen! 

Now, I'm an adult and a highly reasonable one.  I'm not prone to public whining sessions or making scenes.   I'm very aware that leaving a pair of NICE sunglasses in a rental car when you turn it in is not an advisable thing to do.  I would also expect to never see those sunglasses again if the car had not been thoroughly inspected or had been immediately rented out again to another customer.  

I rented a car from the San Diego location and drove to Scottsdale to attend a conference.   During that drive I made the mistake of taking off my sunglasses and instead of planting them firmly on top of my head, I put them in the dash compartment.  I made the drive on Sunday, the location to drop off wouldn't be open when I got there.  Ok, fine - not that big a deal.  The conference didn't start until 9am on Monday morning, plenty of time to get to the drop off point, turn in my car and catch a taxi back to the conference hotel.   The taxi was late and in my panic to get back to the conference in time, I was scrambling.    The taxi shows up, mad dash back to the hotel, run to the conference room and as soon as my butt hits the chair, I remember - the SUNGLA
yelp:test:14686.para:
As an adult, I maintain a level-headed demeanor and avoid public displays of distress. I understand that leaving valuable sunglasses in a rental vehicle upon return is ill-advised. I would anticipate their permanent loss if the vehicle wasn't properly checked or promptly rented to another party. 

I rented a car from the San Diego branch and traveled to Scottsdale for a conference. During the journey, I mistakenly placed my sunglasses in the dashboard compartment instead of securing them on my head. I made this error on a Sunday, and the drop-off location was closed upon my arrival. Although this was a minor inconvenience, I had ample time to rectify the situation before the conference began at 9am on Monday. The taxi I needed to return to the conference hotel was delayed, causing me to hasten my return. In my rush, I forgot about the sunglasses as soon as I sat down in the conference room.

yelp:test:14696.orig: I have been to crackers and company over 17 times. The service is always outstanding especially Byron. He knows the menu and he tells you exactly what you need to know to make sure your meal is fabulous. The food is always prepared perfectly and I'm very very picky about my breakfast. I would recommend crackers and company to everyone. Would I come back here, of course it's my favorite place to go in the Mesa area for breakfast or lunch
yelp:test:14696.para: I've frequented Crackers and Company no less than 17 times, and the service consistently impresses, particularly from Byron who is well-versed in the menu and ensures your meal is exceptional. The breakfasts are meticulously prepared, catering to my discerning tastes. I wholeheartedly endorse Crackers and Company to all, and it's undeniably my top choice in Mesa for either breakfast or lunch.

yelp:test:14714.orig: Tried a few more dishes, and was most impressed with the tofu soup which spicy, flavorful, and filled with a good amount of meat and tofu.  The bbq items were all too sweet (kalbi and beef bulgolgi), while the jap chae was decent and came in a gigantic bowl for everyone to share.
yelp:test:14714.para: Experimented with additional meals, and found the spicy tofu soup to be exceptionally tasty, rich in both meat and tofu. The barbecue dishes, including kalbi and beef bulgogi, were overly sweet. However, the jap chae was satisfactory and served in a large bowl suitable for communal sharing.

yelp:test:14743.orig: I have been to this location twice in the past month and each time they mess up our order. Either they put two pieces of nuts I. A whole large ice cream or completely don't put in any item at all! I won't be coming to this location anymore.
yelp:test:14743.para: Over the past month, I've visited this place twice, and both times they've made mistakes with our orders. They either include two nuts or fail to add any item entirely. Consequently, I've decided to stop visiting this establishment.

yelp:test:14762.orig: This is such a great little neighborhood spot! I've been here several times since we moved to Mesa and service is always great. Food is great! I haven't had a dish that I didn't like and I've had a variety from their menu. If they forget something or make an error they most definitely make up for it before you leave. That's really all you can ask for!
yelp:test:14762.para: This charming local eatery has become a favorite since we relocated to Mesa! The service consistently impresses, and the cuisine is delightful. Every dish I've tried has been enjoyable, offering a diverse selection from their menu. Should they overlook an item or commit a mistake, they promptly rectify it before departure. That's the ideal standard!

yelp:test:14772.orig: Dr. Heather & Megan are the best! They love the kitties and are so knowledgeable.We wouldnt go anywhere else.
yelp:test:14772.para: Dr. Heather and Megan are exceptional! Their affection for the felines and vast expertise are unmatched. We wouldn't consider any other place.

yelp:test:14783.orig:
I was very disappointed with the service or lack there of from benefit air. 

My A.C. unit wasn't working properly so I called Benefit heating and air. I was charged a $79 service for the tech to come out which seems to be standard with most of the companies. From the moment Chuck the tech came out he was only concerned with selling me a new unit. He spent almost all of his time taking measurements and giving me a quote on a $9000 new unit. When he finished I asked him if he repaired or replaced anything and he said no. When it was all said and done I paid $79 for a quote on a new unit. 

IN MY OPINION THEY SENT OUT A SALESMAN NOT A TECH.

After he left I called around for a second opinion. I found a company that didn't charge a service fee for coming out. The new tech arrived, determined the problem within 10 minutes and asked if I wanted it repaired for $149.00. What would you have done? $9000 or $149? That was a no brainer for me. 

Benefit heating and air was NO BENEFIT to me.

( In response to Michaels reply )

I did contact Michael who apologized for my negative experience and offered and sent out a refund of my $79.  

Thanks again Michael
yelp:test:14783.para:
I felt extremely let down by the service, or rather the absence of it, provided by Benefit air. 

When my A.C. unit malfunctioned, I reached out to Benefit heating and air. I was billed a $79 fee for the technician's visit, a common charge among similar businesses. Upon the technician's arrival, Chuck, he seemed solely focused on promoting a new unit. He dedicated most of his time to taking measurements and presenting me with a $9000 quote for a replacement. When I inquired if any repairs or replacements were made, he confirmed none were. Ultimately, I paid the $79 solely for a new unit quote. 

In my view, they dispatched a salesperson instead of a technician. 

After he departed, I sought a second opinion. I discovered a company that didn't impose a service charge for their visit. The new technician quickly diagnosed the issue within 10 minutes and offered to fix it for $149. That choice was clear to me. 

Benefit heating and air proved to be of no advantage to me. 

( In response to Michaels's reply )

I got in touch with Michael, who expressed regret for my negative experience and promptly issued a refund of my $79.  

I appreciate your assistance,

yelp:test:14805.orig: Huge fan of this place. I go there every couple of months. Amazing food!
yelp:test:14805.para: Enthusiastic supporter of this venue. I make it a point to visit every few months. Exceptional culinary offerings!

yelp:test:14849.orig: Checked in online and was in and out in under half an hour. Location was clean and my stylist, Tasha, was great. Conversational and adept at what she does - she knew exactly what I was looking for and completed it efficiently.
yelp:test:14849.para: Registered via the internet and completed my visit in less than 30 minutes. The place was spotless and my hairstylist, Tasha, excelled. She engaged in conversation and demonstrated proficiency in her craft, precisely identifying my needs and executing the task with speed and efficiency.

yelp:test:14864.orig: I am a hot wing fan and this place has some pretty awesome ones. They're always meaty and crispy. Sometimes they need more sauce, as I like them saucey, but the waitress will easily comply with that request. Their individual pizzas are very good, they have lots of topping choices and they have good crust. Reasonably priced and great for a loud night out with friends.
yelp:test:14864.para: I relish hot wings and this establishment serves some exceptional ones. They're consistently juicy and crunchy. Occasionally, I prefer them with extra sauce, which the server readily accommodates. Their personal pizzas are top-notch, featuring a variety of toppings and a solid crust. Affordable and perfect for a boisterous evening with companions.

yelp:test:14883.orig: I am a regular. I come every week and the bagels are just nothing like the others in town. Originally from the east coast, BB is the closest thing to a nice chewy bagel from home. \n\nI get the Tijuana hot. Omg it's amazing. The boys that work are so pleasant and such a great staff.
yelp:test:14883.para: I am a consistent patron. Every week, I visit and the bagels here surpass those found elsewhere in the area. Hailing from the east coast, BB offers the closest experience to a delightful, chewy bagel reminiscent of home. \n\nI opt for the Tijuana hot. Wow, it's incredible. The staff, particularly the boys, are incredibly amiable and form an exceptional team.

yelp:test:14898.orig: Do not go here for a check up.  They made me wait in the room for an hour before the doctor came to see me.  And she just walks in like nothing is wrong.   The doctor sat down and just asked me a few basic questions about my health history and squeezes my legs and arms and says \""you seem healthy\"".  I ask for a blood test and they send the lab work OUTSIDE of my insurance network.  A month later, I get a bill for 1500 bucks for a blood test -____-.   Save yourself the money and the headache.  Go elsewhere
yelp:test:14898.para: Avoid this location for a medical examination. I was kept in a room for an hour before the physician arrived, appearing indifferent to my situation. The doctor inquired about my past health briefly and casually examined my limbs, declaring me in good health. I requested a blood test, which was sent to an external lab not covered by my insurance. A month later, I received a bill of $1500 for the test, causing unnecessary financial and mental strain. It's advisable to seek services elsewhere to avoid such expenses and stress.

yelp:test:14902.orig:
Came here for a special event. Based on the food served, I would not come as a paying customer. Bland penne with blander, sparse sauce. Overdone broccoli. Nice looking Caesar with big croutons and... ranch dressing? Ew. Chicken slimy something. Not sure what it was. 

Bathrooms were gas-station dirty.

Two stars for free food.
yelp:test:14902.para: Attended this occasion and, considering the culinary offerings, I wouldn't return as a patron. The pasta was uninspired, accompanied by a lackluster sauce. The broccoli was excessively cooked. The Caesar salad appeared appealing with substantial croutons, but the ranch dressing was unappetizing. The chicken had an unpleasant texture, leaving me uncertain of its identity. \n\nThe restrooms were unclean, resembling a gas station. I'm awarding two stars due to the complimentary food.

We arrived around midnight and took over 2 hours to check in.  Although we had a reservation, we had to let about 100 people with no reservations check in before us.  A plane was cancelled and a large group sent to SouthPoint.  I am happy for SouthPoint getting business, but what is advantage to prebook a room.  After 2 hours we finally got checked in however they could not make room keys - so although we got a room, we could not get in the room another 20 minutes or so.  In the morning we called to ask if we could get another room since the one we were given had a brick wall as our window and supervisor said for more money we can upgrade you.  When I mentioned long checkin issue, as a supervisor she said there were people before you checking in.  We were there a month ago - paid half what we paid for this weekend and had a great room.   The staff (Supervisor) basically blamed me for booking a cheap room? Did not have any reason to believe paying more than last visit would get us such a poor room.  Last month cheaper and b
yelp:test:14915.para: We recently spent our extended Valentine's weekend at SouthPoint, a hotel we've visited before and appreciate for its location away from the main strip and abundant facilities. Upon our arrival around midnight, we experienced a lengthy check-in process, taking over two hours despite having a reservation. During this time, approximately 100 individuals without reservations were accommodated before us. A cancellation of a flight led to a significant influx of guests at SouthPoint. While I'm glad SouthPoint is benefiting from the increased business, I question the value of pre-booking a room. After finally checking in, we were informed that room keys were unavailable, delaying our access to the room by an additional 20 minutes. In the morning, we inquired about an alternative room due to the subpar one we were assigned, which featured a brick wall as a window. The supervisor suggested an upgrade for a higher price. When I brought up the previous long check-in experience, the supervisor pointed out that others had checked in before us. Reflecting on our previous visit a month prior, where we paid half the price for a superior room, I feel the staff unfairly implied that my choice of a less expensive room was to blame. I had no reason to expect that paying more would result in a less satisfactory room.

yelp:test:14933.orig:
For a place that I have expected to be trendy with amazing food, this place falls flat.  

The cocktails were mediocre, and food was mediocre.  The only thing that was sort of OK was the atmosphere.  

We were first there for drinks, but later decided to have dinner.  The bartender that day didn't seem too happy and had a straight face the whole time.  He didn't try to make any kind of conversation and just made drinks and took our order.  Ok, I don't mind it too much because as long as he made great drinks and didn't mess up our orders I didn't mind.  The drinks as I said, were mediocre.  

We had a couple rolls and it was still mediocre, which was very disappointing.  I had hanabi with spicy tuna which I thought the flavors just didn't mesh well at all.  The tuna itself was amazing, but with the fried cube of sushi rice dipped in sweet soy sauce... it just doesn't fit.  The seaweed salad was a little bit on the salty side, and that it was nothing more special than the ones I can get from a Japanese market.  
I also had Shima roll, which was shrimp wrapped with spicy tuna, avocado, and cilantro.  It was not bad, but not good either. Just bland I guess.  Not impressed. 

O
yelp:test:14933.para:
This location, anticipated to be fashionable with exceptional cuisine, did not meet expectations.  

The drinks and meals were average at best, with the only slightly acceptable aspect being the ambiance.  

Initially, we went for cocktails, but later opted for dinner.  The bar staff member present that evening appeared disinterested, maintaining a neutral expression throughout. He didn't engage in any dialogue and focused solely on preparing drinks and taking orders. I tolerate this as I didn't encounter any errors in his service or drink preparation. However, the drinks were just average.  

We sampled a few rolls, and they were still average, leading to disappointment.  I tried hanabi with spicy tuna, but the flavors didn't blend well. The tuna was excellent, but the fried sushi rice cube dipped in sweet soy sauce didn't complement it. The seaweed salad was slightly too salty, and it didn't stand out compared to what I can find in a Japanese market.  

I also sampled the Shima roll, which consisted of shrimp, spicy tuna, avocado, and cilantro. It was neither bad nor good, just bland. I was not impressed.

yelp:test:14947.orig: we had a great server but we came with a whole soccer team and apparently the other server helping them can't do her job and the manager didn't seem too concerned with the poor service.
yelp:test:14947.para: Our server provided excellent service, yet we arrived as a soccer squad and it seems the other server assisting them struggled with her responsibilities. The manager appeared indifferent to the subpar service we received.

yelp:test:14986.orig: If you are a big fan of slow service then this is the Taco Bell for you . I say that the average time of waiting is about 15 minutes and that is just for a burrito. And this isn't just an isolated slow time this is every single time I go to this Taco Bell. And don't think just because you go to the drive through that it be quick though the drive through is  super slow too.  Every time I go there I can be guaranteed that my wife says to me when I get home what took you so long? Also they suck at making your order right too. I had the stuff nacho griller thing the other day and it looked like a four-year-old had folded it up. Pay the extra couple bucks for Del Taco is my advice.
yelp:test:14986.para: If you appreciate leisurely service, this Taco Bell might be your spot. I've observed that the wait time averages around 15 minutes, specifically for a burrito, and this sluggishness is consistent with every visit. It's not merely a one-off occurrence; it's a recurring issue. Even the drive-thru isn't any faster, as it's also notably slow. Each time I visit, my wife inquires about the duration of my stay. Additionally, their order preparation often falls short of expectations, exemplified by a poorly assembled nacho griller I encountered recently. My recommendation is to consider Del Taco, as it's worth the extra expense for a more efficient experience.

yelp:test:14987.orig: terrible service; pay with debit card and get an attitude plus an additional $1 for the privilege.  Typical service of a business that couldn't care less, and think THEY are doing YOU the favor.   Do YOURSELF a favor and go somewhere they actually value their customers.  Here they DO NOT!!
yelp:test:14987.para: Experience poor customer service; use debit card and expect a rude response plus an extra $1 charge. This is indicative of a business that doesn't prioritize customer satisfaction, as if they're doing you a favor. It's advisable to patronize establishments that genuinely respect their clientele. Unfortunately, this isn't the case here.

yelp:test:15000.orig: Great steaks, salads, ambiance, decor. Highly recommend coming.
yelp:test:15000.para: Exceptional cuts of meat, fresh salads, inviting atmosphere, and tasteful decor. Highly suggest visiting.

yelp:test:15005.orig: I've used the north location without problems in the past. I live in the SW now so went here despite the bad reviews. I have a q5 with 45k miles on it and only had 4mm left on my front pads. I was told by just brakes that I needed new rotars and told that there's \""not enough metal\"" on them to be re surfaced. The bill would be 650 bucks. (Better than 900 which the dealership quoted me) but I decided to get a 2nd opinion anyway. I took it to another garage on trop/dec and they said they can resurface them and change the pads for under 200 bucks. Always get a 2nd opinion.
yelp:test:15005.para: In previous experiences, I've navigated the north area without any issues. Currently residing in the SW, I chose to visit this place even though it had unfavorable feedback. My q5 has 45k miles and only 4mm of front pads remained. The brake specialist informed me that new rotors were necessary due to insufficient metal for resurfacing, costing around 650 dollars. However, I opted for a second opinion. At a different garage servicing the trop/dec area, they offered to resurface the rotors and replace the pads for less than 200 dollars. I always recommend seeking a second opinion.

yelp:test:15076.para: I've been contemplating writing this feedback for a while. I needed a haircut and was interested in trying a new establishment. yelp:test:15137.orig:
Sadly, the steak was disappointing! 

So we were in vegas for a quick trip and wanted desperately to go to The SW Steakhouse. We tried making last minute reservations but they only had 5pm and 10pm available and since we didn't want to eat with the blue haired patrons or eat with the wait staff, we decided to explore our options. 

Cut also only had a 5:15pm available and Carnevino had no openings... so I went down my steakhouse list and found Charlie Palmer Steakhouse. Anticipating a booked night, I still called and was surprised by how many openings they had. I originally asked for 8pm and then changed it later to 7pm and with each call, there was a ""sure no problem""... All of this should have been a precursor to our meal. 

My steak preferences are as follows:
I like when steak is seared with a crust and then finished in a really HOT oven. I like when steak is seasoned with a bit of salt and pepper prior to being cooked. Good steak should never be covered in a sauce. Finally, I like when they take out a really hot steak and finish it with a little bit of butter. Is that too much to ask? 

Well the steak that I ordered at CP did not have any of the above. In fact the
yelp:test:15137.para:
Regrettably, the steak didn't meet our expectations. 

During our brief visit to Vegas, we longed to dine at The SW Steakhouse. We attempted to secure a last-minute reservation but were limited to 5pm and 10pm slots, which we preferred to avoid due to the presence of blue-haired patrons and wait staff. Consequently, we sought alternative dining establishments. 

Cut's only available slot was at 5:15pm, and Carnevino had no openings, prompting me to consult my list of steakhouses. I discovered Charlie Palmer Steakhouse, which, despite the anticipation of a fully booked evening, had ample availability. I initially requested an 8pm reservation, later adjusting to 7pm, and with each call, the response was consistently "no problem." This should have been a warning sign for our meal. 

My ideal steak preparation includes a seared crust, finishing in a very hot oven, seasoned with salt and pepper before cooking, and served without any sauce. I also appreciate a hot steak finished with a touch of butter. Is that too much to request? 

Unfortunately, the steak I ordered at CP failed to meet these criteria. In fact, it lacked all of the above.

yelp:test:15187.orig:
I like this mall a lot, but I get a headache EVERY EFFIN TIME I come!  I seriously think it has to do with the massive amount of cologne/perfume you can smell walking it.  Or maybe I just have a real heightened sense of smell....?

They have a ginormous Forever 21 (just like in Cerritos, CA) but I couldn't find anything this time around. Nothing in Wet Seal either :/  Usually I leave with something but I had bad luck this weekend. The layout/architecture of this mall is so random.  You have to come here to kind of see what I'm talking about.  They have a nice food court too.  Me having worked in a mall for most of my working career, I can appreciate a mall with a good food court.  

They have some higher end stores so be ready to ball out!
yelp:test:15187.para:
I really enjoy this shopping center, yet I suffer from migraines EVERY TIME I visit! It seems the intense fragrance of cologne/perfume in the air might be the culprit. Perhaps my acute sense of smell is to blame as well. 

There's a huge Forever 21 here, similar to the one in Cerritos, CA, but I couldn't locate anything this time. Wet Seal was also disappointing. Typically, I leave with a purchase, but I had unfortunate luck this weekend. The mall's layout and design appear haphazard. To understand my point, one must experience it firsthand. The food court is commendable, especially considering my extensive experience working in malls. 

The presence of luxury stores means you might need to splurge!

yelp:test:15219.orig:
Having never been to vegas to drink my friends took me here and boy oh boy was I in for a treat.

I'm not much of a drinker but taking the advice that the only way to really experience vegas is to constantly drink. After getting Lobster Me next door I came over here to get a yard stick

the cool thing i like about here is the samples and how they served it, how unique and their service phenomenal, being patient and informative 

anyways i opted for the 190 octane its kind of strong but man it was good, get it with an extra shot or maybe even two and it'll definitely be different

other then that i couldn't explain the taste but all i could remember was next time i come back i guess i'll get another one
yelp:test:15219.para:
I've never indulged in Vegas's drink scene with my companions, but they guided me here, and I was pleasantly surprised.

Although I don't usually partake in drinking, I heeded the notion that true Vegas vibes come from continuous imbibing. After sampling Lobster Me next door, I ventured here for a yard stick.

What I appreciate about this place is the samples, their distinctive presentation, and exceptional service, which is both patient and informative.

In the end, I chose the 190 octane, which is robust but enjoyable. I recommend adding an extra shot or two for a unique experience.

Beyond that, I couldn't fully articulate the flavor, but I'll remember to return for another one next time.

yelp:test:15247.para: I desire for you to cease dispatching your promotional materials, as they continue to arrive at my location.

yelp:test:15262.para:

My spouse's numerous courses and higher education sessions are scheduled here biannually. The property's location is highly practical for us, as we don't favor the strip. We appreciate the convenience and enjoy preparing meals in the kitchen.

yelp:test:15307.para: It's an outrageous overcharge! I purchased a 750ml bottle of Kraken Rum for $28.99, which is $10 more than the price of $18.99 available at Wal-Mart, located on Eastern Avenue near the airport. A valuable lesson was indeed learned.

yelp:test:15317.orig: I joined Massage Envy during my second pregnancy because I experienced severe pain in my lower back and hips (sometimes I couldn't walk). After trying a few different therapists, I got Tim. He is awesome! He gives the best massages, and has been the only therapist to alleviate the pain in my lower back and hips. If you want a massage, go to Tim!\nThe front desk staff is always friendly and polite, and the rooms are always clean and relaxing. If you have chronic problems with muscle tension, Massage Envy is well worth the commitment.
yelp:test:15317.para: During my second pregnancy, I sought relief from intense lower back and hip discomfort by enrolling at Massage Envy. After experimenting with several massage therapists, I found Tim to be exceptional. His massages are top-notch and uniquely effective in easing my lower back and hip pain. For those seeking a massage, Tim is the go-to person. The reception team consistently exhibits warmth and courtesy, and the environment is always tidy and soothing. If you suffer from persistent muscle tension, Massage Envy's dedication is definitely worth it.

yelp:test:15345.orig: Best Costco experience. Ever. Seriously, I don't know if it was a fluke, or the time change or what. A typical outing to Costco brings on short tempers, honking horns in the parking lot, and ridiculously crowded aisles as kids grab for every free sample they can. Not here. No horns, plenty of open parking spaces, no crowds for the samples, short lines and actual room at the food court. It was great.
yelp:test:15345.para: An unparalleled shopping experience at Costco. Absolutely, it's hard to attribute it to a mere coincidence, or perhaps the shift in time. Usually, a visit to Costco is associated with irritated moods, car horns blaring in the parking area, and overly packed aisles with children voraciously snatching every available sample. However, this was different. There were no instances of car horns, ample parking availability, no frenzy for samples, brief queues, and genuine space in the food court. It was truly fantastic.

yelp:test:15349.orig: Fast service & food. They have quick daytime drive through staff. Have been coming here for about a year and a half. Sometimes the WiFi works, which is always nice, if you're inside. The free drink refills are good, as some places inside of casinos, charge the entire price for a refill. It is conveniently located across the street from Mandalay Bay and is frequented by people who work on the strip, so you know it's easy to deal with.
yelp:test:15349.para: Expedited dining and service. The establishment boasts prompt daytime drive-thru personnel. I've patronized this spot for roughly 18 months. Occasionally, the WiFi functions, a welcome feature when indoors. The complimentary drink top-ups are appreciated, especially since other venues on the strip often impose full price for a refill. Situated conveniently adjacent to Mandalay Bay, it's a popular choice among strip employees, ensuring smooth interactions.

yelp:test:15405.orig: Sampled some great chocolates with my boyfriend and he ended up purchasing the $40 box.  I wasn't feeling well so I didn't try very much, but what I did try was so good, especially one with sea salt.  Sea salt and chocolate are kind of a problem for me when they join forces.  Sooo delicious. \n\nBUT what stood out to me that day (in 100+ degree Vegas heat where we'd already had BEAUTIFUL pastries purchased from another store MELT just from walking outside for a bit!!) was they offer you ice packs to put around your chocolate purchase in case you will be heading outside. Brilliant! I wish the bakery I'd gone to had done the same!
yelp:test:15405.para: Sampled delicious chocolates with my partner, who opted for the $40 box. I wasn't in the best of health, so I didn't sample much, but the few pieces I did try were exceptional, particularly one with a hint of sea salt. Sea salt and chocolate often clash with me, yet they were incredibly tasty. \n\nWhat really caught my attention that day, amidst the scorching 100+ degree Vegas heat and after indulging in stunning pastries from a different shop that melted upon a brief walk outside, was the bakery's thoughtful offer of ice packs for your chocolate purchase to keep it cool if you plan to go out. I wish the bakery I visited had provided the same consideration!

yelp:test:15442.orig: A+ for seating at the bar during a busy Las Vegas lunch time. The bartender there gave us the best service, always attentive to filling drinks if needed and also even giving us hot towels after first squeezing lemon juice into our hands after digging into the succulent Joe's Stone Crabs.\n\nI had high expectations for this place after having it first from a previous trip to Miami and this place did not disappoint. The service, decor, ambience were impeccable, and matched with the Vegas setting. I ordered the lunch combination that included 5 medium sized claws, as well as cole slaw, potato hash and also the key lime pie for dessert. The hubs got a dry aged rib-eye sandwich with fries shaped like thick potato chips that were delicious. We left really full and satisfied and would definitely come back again.
yelp:test:15442.para: Exceptional seating at the bar amidst the bustling Las Vegas lunch hour, where the bartender provided outstanding service, promptly refilling drinks and even offering hot towels post-lemon juice application during our indulgence in the delectable Joe's Stone Crabs. Having previously enjoyed this establishment in Miami, I anticipated nothing less than perfection. The service, decor, and atmosphere were flawless, seamlessly blending with the Las Vegas vibe. I opted for a lunch combo featuring five generous claws, cole slaw, potato hash, and a key lime pie for dessert. My partner savored a dry aged rib-eye sandwich with uniquely shaped fries that were utterly delicious. We departed feeling completely satiated and eager to return.

yelp:test:15463.orig: Service was slow and snooty. Lots of seating. I tried their meat jun. Its okay but their tiger roll makes me go \""grrrrrr\"".  They took their time on this work of art, it took me a fraction of that time to devour. I ate so fast that I wasn't sure if I even really ate it. Well, the plate was the proof, I guess.
yelp:test:15463.para: The service was leisurely and haughty. Ample seating was available. I sampled their meat jun, which was passable but their tiger roll was unappetizing, causing me to grimace. They lavished attention on this culinary creation, yet I consumed it in mere moments, leaving me uncertain if I had truly tasted it. The evidence lay on the plate, I suppose.

yelp:test:15472.orig: I'm really suprised to see that this place has gotten 4 stars.  I thought it was flat out gross.  My lamb was extra gamey, and I'm a season lamb eater.  Sides were nothing to ride home about.  I probably could have had a better meal at Chili's and paid half the price.\n\nI would give this place 1star for just food.  But the ambience was nice, so I'm gonna bump to 2.
yelp:test:15472.para: I'm astonished that this establishment has achieved a 4-star rating. I believed it to be utterly unappetizing. The lamb was excessively gamey, which is unusual for someone who frequently enjoys lamb. The accompanying sides were underwhelming. I could have likely enjoyed a superior dining experience at Chili's for a fraction of the cost. Despite this, I'm inclined to award it a 2-star rating solely based on the food quality. However, the ambiance was pleasing, prompting me to increase the rating slightly.

yelp:test:15493.orig: Honestly, the WORST SERVICE I have ever had at a restaurant in Las Vegas. I have lived here for 12 years and this was the first time I made it out to Lake Las Vegas. I am so disappointed. The prices are unreasonable for the amount of food you get and for a tapas place they are slow. It took us two hours before we got our food and some items were missing. Granted the food is amazing, it was just absolutely ridiculous with the service.
yelp:test:15493.para: Truly, the poorest dining experience I've encountered in Las Vegas's eateries. Having resided here for a decade, this was the inaugural visit to Lake Las Vegas. I am profoundly disheartened. The cost is exorbitant relative to the food portion and for a tapas establishment, the service is painfully sluggish. It took us a full two hours to receive our meal and certain items were notably absent. Despite the food's exceptional quality, the service was utterly preposterous.

yelp:test:15498.orig: Great food fast service..that's Chicago style at tasty dogs that what I got great place to eat...and if you where anything Chicago you get a discount\nvery nice faces when you walk in. Many people miss that Chicago feel and great taste. Pictures on the wall represent the city and the culture well. If you ever in Vegas you have to stop by and grab a dog and dress it the way you want.
yelp:test:15498.para: Enjoy delicious eats with swift service, embodying the essence of Chicago at Tasty Dogs. This is where you'll find a fantastic dining spot. Chicago enthusiasts receive a special discount. The welcoming smiles upon arrival are heartwarming. Many overlook the authentic Chicago vibe and exceptional flavor. The city's culture and spirit are vividly depicted in the displayed images. Should you visit Las Vegas, make it a point to stop by and customize your dog to your liking.

yelp:test:15526.para: High cost and subpar pizza quality!

yelp:test:15598.orig:
This is the most self-inflicted adrenaline I've felt since bungee jumping.

First, let me say that guns scare the crap out of me. I don't even like being near a police officer with a holstered weapon... so walking into a shop full of assault rifles is like my adult version of a horror movie.  Still, I was with 5 other guys who were up for the adventure, so I got hold of my nerves and jumped into the breach.

We paid $110 each for some version of a party package that gave each of us the chance to shoot (a) a clip full on each of 4 different machine guns and (b) 2 rounds from a 50 caliber desert eagle handgun. For all those boys (and girls) out there who grew up with plastic guns or even shooting a rifle out somewhere at a range, it's fair to say that this is in a whole different league.

For the machine guns, we chose the Uzi, Mac-10, M-5 and Grease Gun. The M-5 and Grease Gun were scarily easy and accurate to shoot, whereas the Uzi and Mac-10 felt a bit more wild but were fun just because they show up so often in the gangster movies.

The Desert Eagle handgun was intense. I'm not a big guy, so this thing felt like I could barely hang onto it. Still, we were able to shoot it
yelp:test:15598.para:

The Desert Eagle handgun was intense. Despite being on the smaller side, it felt like I could barely keep it steady. Nevertheless, we managed to successfully fire it.

The dressing is very light, non-oily and you can order your heat accordingly.   Loved it!

I ended with the steamed green buns.  They are little pillows of deliciousness!   HINT: Order the steamed

The chicken satay appetizer was substantial, featuring five skewers of succulently grilled chicken, accompanied by the classic peanut sauce and a refreshing cucumber salad. It was delicious, and I used the peanut sauce judiciously, just enough to enhance the taste.  

Their papaya salad surpassed Ping Pong's rendition. The payaya was grated slightly larger, providing an excellent texture and crunch. Instead of thin tomato slices, they used halved baby roma tomatoes, bursting with a rich tomato flavor. The long beans were cut just right, identifiable as beans. The dressing was light, non-greasy, and customizable in terms of heat. I thoroughly enjoyed it!  

I concluded my meal with the steamed green buns. These were little

yelp:test:15768.orig:
Sticky, sticky, oh so sticky crispy garlic chicken!

I don't know exactly what goes on in this dish at Penn's but I like it. There is something in that sauce that makes you want to lick the entire foil plate clean. (Not even kidding) That sauce goes great with everythingggg and the chicken is so crispy and tender that it just makes for a delight in your mouth :O

Other than the chicken, the other Thai dishes are really tasty and good quality. I've have the pad thai and fried rice from here and I can definitely taste the difference here compared to other Thai establishments in Henderson. 

But that chicken though!

I have to admit that the first time I came to Penn's was not what I expected. It is located in... a less desirable? side of town and you wouldn't even think there would be a Thai restaurant in this plaza but behold!

Parking has never been a problem here so that's another plus. Have I mentioned the chicken yet?
yelp:test:15768.para:
Crispy, sticky garlic chicken at Penn's is a delight to devour! I'm not entirely sure what's in the recipe, but I adore it. The sauce is irresistible, tempting you to wipe the foil plate clean (seriously). It pairs perfectly with all dishes and the chicken's crispiness and tenderness are simply mouthwatering. 

Aside from the chicken, the other Thai offerings are also delicious and of high quality. I've tried the pad thai and fried rice here, and the difference is noticeable compared to other Thai spots in Henderson. 

The chicken, however, is truly exceptional. When I first visited Penn's, it was located in an unexpected part of town, but it's a pleasant surprise to find a Thai restaurant there. Plus, parking is always available, which is a bonus. The chicken, without a doubt, deserves the spotlight.

yelp:test:15809.orig:
For anyone who says, doing half and half pizza sauces, as in half margherita and half banana peppers and sausage, is ""weak"", lemme tell you...they're making the pizza in the kitchen. They are under pressure, orders flying in from all different angles, take out here, order in there, medium with extra sundrieds, sub black olives for broccoli add pine nuts, extra sauce...it's no joke. So, that being said, they can't always split a pizza in half because the sauces just don't mix and they gotta cook it and prep and all that jazz.

So, is the pizza good? Yes, hands down, this pizza is really friggin' good. The BBQ chicken is wet my pants good. The Algo Malgo or whatever it is called is truly delicious. 

If you're looking for a quick lunch spot, get your ass in there and enjoy the pizza/salad lunch deal, for it will not disappoint. Order the cheese slice if you like, but since they have the dozens of toppings to choose from, live a little and put some meatballs or eggs or fresh artichokes and make it the way you dream it. 

OVERALL: One of the top pizza place in Madison or Middleton.
yelp:test:15809.para:
For those who criticize the concept of combining half margherita and half banana peppers and sausage pizza sauces, consider this: the kitchen staff are working tirelessly, juggling numerous orders with varying preferences, from takeout to dine-in requests, all while trying to maintain quality. The sauces may not blend seamlessly, making it impractical to divide the pizza evenly. However, the resulting pizza is undeniably excellent. The BBQ chicken is exceptionally flavorful, and the Algo Malgo is a delightful treat. If you're in search of a speedy lunch venue, this place is a must-visit. Opt for the cheese slice, but don't hesitate to experiment with a variety of toppings like meatballs, eggs, or artichokes to create your ideal pizza.

In summary, this establishment stands out as one of the premier pizza joints in Madison or Middleton.

I have been at other hotels that did not have to do that and were glad to have my CC info but did not hold funds on my CC.

When I opened the door the room reeked of cigarette smoke! Then I found an ashtray so I called the front desk. Turns out that the cashiers just put us in a sm
yelp:test:15911.para:
I chose that location primarily for the convention at Planet Hollywood, but I was dismayed by the "resort." The parking required a 15-minute walk, and motorcyclists couldn't use valet services, necessitating a long walk with luggage. I inquired about motorcycle parking beforehand and was assured there would be ample space, but upon arrival, I had to navigate an 800-pound motorcycle through a chaotic arrangement of bicycles and scooters. 

After reaching the reservation counter, the cashier told me I couldn't avoid paying with cash at the end of my stay. My credit card would be put on hold, essentially holding the money hostage. This was unlike other hotels where I was pleased to provide my credit card details without any funds being held. 

We discovered Britney Spears's images everywhere in the elevators, and the decor seemed outdated, lacking the cleanliness I anticipated. Upon entering the room, I was greeted by the smell of cigarette smoke, leading me to call the front desk. They informed me that the cashiers had simply placed us in a smoking room.

yelp:test:15914.orig: Spent the midweek at a safety conference here. Last day a large amount of attendees contracted Norovirus and became violently ill. I will say, however, that before that incident, the room service was actually pretty good, both dinner and breakfast. The blinds in the room didn't completely block out the sunlight in the morning and you can't adjust them  horizontally because of their vertical design. We believe the Norovirus came from the food served at the conference.
yelp:test:15914.para: Attended a safety seminar this week, with the final day seeing a significant number of participants falling severely ill due to Norovirus. Prior to this unfortunate event, the quality of room service, including both dinner and breakfast, was commendable. However, the blinds in our accommodation failed to fully obstruct the morning sunlight and their vertical orientation precluded any horizontal adjustments. Our suspicion is that the Norovirus originated from the conference's catered meals.

yelp:test:15949.orig: 5-6pm is free sangria, all you can drink wine, along with appetizers.  Staff is super friendly, accomodating, and just darn wonderful.  Concierge helped us book tours.  Staff changed our room for us.  We forgot tons of stuff, and they were able to hook us up with a steamer for my blouse, hair straightener that I forgot.  Pool has a sandy beach.  Wifi free if you you're inTouch member and we got $10 free money for frig bar.  We dock one star for wiFI always being out in the morning, which was inconvenient.  Also the \""resort' is more of an overstatement as it's not a really a resort.  More a very nicely remodeled old hotel complex with 2 pools, 1 pretty lagoon, and 1 spa service area.  It's not a Scottsdale resort that you would imagine.  No bike trails, no golf course.
yelp:test:15949.para:
From 5-6pm, enjoy complimentary sangria and unlimited wine with snacks. The team is incredibly welcoming, helpful, and delightful. They assisted us in arranging tours and upgraded our room. They also provided us with a steamer for my blouse and a hair straightener that we had left behind. The pool area features a sandy beach. Wifi is complimentary for Touch members, and we received a $10 voucher for the bar. We docked one star due to the wi-fi being unreliable in the mornings, which caused some inconvenience. The establishment is more accurately described as a well-renovated old hotel complex with two pools, a charming lagoon, and a spa service area, rather than a typical resort like Scottsdale. It lacks bike trails and a golf course.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, sentiment, emotion, and intent while altering the wording and sentence structure. The length is approximately the same as the original text.)

yelp:test:15953.orig: STAY AWAY! My husband and I checked this place out online and every search engine had nice reviews, so we booked. Upon arrival, we went to our room, which was more like a motel. The smells in the breezeways were as if they sprayed potpourri over an existing musty stench. Our room was facing a parking lot and smelled musty. We requested another room not facing a parking lot, they moved us over to an \""oasis\"" view,which was hardly an oasis. After spending just a few minutes, we checked out. The smells were horrific. I must say the staff was very nice and refunded our money through booking.com. The lobby looked lovely but nothing like the online pictures. For $250+ a night, we took our money elsewhere.
yelp:test:15953.para: Avoid this location! We researched it online and found positive feedback across various platforms, leading us to make a reservation. However, when we arrived, our room resembled a motel more than a hotel. The aroma in the corridors was a mix of artificially scented potpourri and a lingering musty odor. Our room, situated next to a parking area, was also musty. We asked for a different room with a view away from the parking lot, but it turned out to be a "paradise" view that was hardly a paradise. After a brief stay, we left. The smells were unbearable. Despite this, the staff was courteous and issued a refund through the booking platform. The lobby appeared charming, but it didn't match the online images. Given the high cost of over $250 per night, we decided to spend our money elsewhere.

yelp:test:15966.orig: Just finished dining here. Best meal I've had in Vegas on this vacation. Beautiful view, friendly service and incredible food. They paced the four course meal well. If you don't mind spending the little extra dough go for it, you won't be disappointed.
yelp:test:15966.para: Concluded my meal at this establishment. The most delightful culinary experience in Vegas during my trip. Enjoyed the stunning scenery, warm hospitality, and exceptional cuisine. The four-course meal was expertly timed. For those willing to invest a bit more, it's a worthwhile choice and will surely satisfy.

yelp:test:15984.orig:
Another one of those things you have to try at least once if you are visiting Pittsburgh for the very first time.  I had seen them on Travel Channel as one of the Top 10 places in the country to Pig Out.  So when we came to Pittsburgh, PA, and was on vacation, I had to try it.  

It was as good as advertised.  They put the French Fries in the Sandwich and it is definitely quite unique.  

If I am ever back in Pittsburgh, I will definitely grab me another Primanti Brothers Sandwich to Pig Out On!!!
yelp:test:15984.para:
If you're a first-time visitor to Pittsburgh, it's essential to experience this at least once. I'd seen it featured on the Travel Channel as a top spot in the nation for indulging in excess. Hence, during our vacation in Pittsburgh, PA, I couldn't resist trying it. 

The experience lived up to expectations. The French Fries were ingeniously incorporated into the Sandwich, making it distinctively different. 

Should I return to Pittsburgh, I'm certain I'll order another Primanti Brothers Sandwich for a hearty indulgence.

yelp:test:16015.orig: The Pork Empanada was AMAZING!  My mom & daughter both got the Bistec and it was wonderful!  Very tender and delicious beef.  The Cuban Sushi roll, Asian Tartare & Ginger Tataki were also very good.  The Sangria of the Day was ok.   We'll definitely go back.  A perfect place to stop before or after the theater.
yelp:test:16015.para: The Pork Empanada was absolutely fantastic! Both my mother and daughter enjoyed the Bistec, praising its tender and delectable beef. The Cuban Sushi roll, Asian Tartare, and Ginger Tataki also received high marks for their excellent taste. The Sangria of the Day was satisfactory. We're eager to return. This spot is an ideal choice for a pre- or post-theater break.

yelp:test:16041.orig: I have been back several times before writing this review update just to make sure all the inconsistency that I have been experiencing is now the way of Bagel Cafe and not just an off day they were having. I'm prepared for the loyal fixtures to be upset, but if you really have been eating here since it opened then you know it's not the same. I first started eating here at Bagel Cafe (I was a teenager) after it opened. It was worth the long wait to get a table as the food was spot on excellent. Sure we all know the best breakfast in town is at the Omelet House on Charleston, but this place definitely came close behind at one point. In the last 6 months I have experienced meals here at Bagel Cafe that were just not worth the money or wait for what you got. They don't even use Boar's Head deli meats anymore! WTH?!?!?!? They use some brand I have never heard of. The taste and quality of the deli meat just isn't the same as it used to be. They claim the bagels are made fresh daily yet they are rock hard. I have never liked the bagels here, but if it's in your name.... live up to it!\n\nAs you can tell from my previous review and pictures, I really used to like this place. Consistency is
yelp:test:16041.para:
I've revisited Bagel Cafe multiple times prior to this review to confirm whether the inconsistency I've encountered is now a regular occurrence or merely a one-off incident they were dealing with. I anticipate some long-standing patrons might be displeased, but if you've been frequenting this establishment since its inception, you're aware that it's not the same anymore. I began dining here as a teenager shortly after its opening, and the wait was worth it for the exceptional quality of the food. While the Omelet House on Charleston is renowned for the best breakfast, Bagel Cafe has been a strong contender in the past. However, in the past six months, I've had several dining experiences here that didn't justify the expense or the wait for the meal. Notably, they've stopped using Boar's Head deli meats and now use an unfamiliar brand, which has significantly compromised the taste and quality. Despite their claim of daily fresh bagel production, they've become excessively hard. Although I've never been a fan of their bagels, they should strive to meet the expectations set by their reputation.

As evidenced by my previous reviews and images, I used to enjoy this place. Consistency is key.

yelp:test:16045.orig:
5 stars for a simple market and deli with some killer good freshly prepared food.

I've been coming here for years.  I find the portions to be reasonable, and the quality of the food top notch.  Go to the counter, place  your order, and they'll call you up to do a pick up when it's ready.

Nothing like going in for a quick lunch and walking out with a bunch of grocery items, a chunk of feta, a pound of tabbouleh, and a bag of freshly baked pita breads.

I'm a fan of their food overall.  There are excellent options for vegetarians.  They also make outstanding stuffed grape leaves.  True story- during one of my pregnancies I craved these, and went twice a week to get them.  They are as good now as they were then.

There is seating here, so you can go with a small group and have lunch easily.

Don't forget to pick up some freshly prepared baklava for dessert!
yelp:test:16045.para:
Rated 5 stars for an uncomplicated market and eatery that serves exceptionally freshly made dishes.

I've frequented this place for many years. The portion sizes are fair, and the food quality is impeccable. Simply order at the counter, and they'll notify you when your order is ready for pickup.

Enjoying a swift lunch and leaving with a variety of groceries, including feta cheese, tabbouleh, and freshly baked pita breads is a delight.

I appreciate their cuisine in general. They offer fantastic vegetarian choices and their stuffed grape leaves are a standout. I remember craving these during one of my pregnancies and visiting twice a week. They maintain their excellence.

There's seating available, making it convenient for small groups to enjoy a meal.

Remember to grab some freshly baked baklava for dessert!

yelp:test:16122.orig: Without a doubt one of the better (and quieter) hotel options in Vegas. Room amenities - as described by previous reviewers - are unbelievable. 5 stars if Platinum introduces a shuttle service to the Strip !
yelp:test:16122.para: Undoubtedly, this hotel stands out as a superior (and more serene) choice in Las Vegas. The room features, as praised by past guests, are truly exceptional. A 5-star rating would be justified if Platinum were to offer a shuttle service to the Strip.

yelp:test:16183.orig:
All my animals that have been apart of my life have come from being adopted from Arizona Humane Society.  

My last mut was only $35 to adopt but he's truly a mut so if I didn't adopt him I don't think anyone would have LOL nonetheless he's my little guy.

I like the AZ Humane Society because I know the animals are well cared for and have been given all the up to date shots that they need.  

They are netured and given a wellness exam plus you get get complimentary medicine if needed for the common colds that animals can catch at places like these.  You also get a free basic office visit at participating veternarians.

Sadly, if you have to put one of your animals down like I did about eight months ago you can do it here much cheaper than at a vet who charge astronomical prices to euthanize.

I don't get how death of a loved one and or animal is such big business.
yelp:test:16183.para:
All the creatures that have played a part in my existence were acquired from the Arizona Humane Society. 

My most recent mut, which cost a mere $35 to adopt, is genuinely a mut. Without my adoption, I doubt anyone else would have taken him, and I affectionately refer to him as my little buddy. 

I appreciate the Arizona Humane Society as I am confident the animals receive proper care and are up to date with necessary vaccinations. 

They are nurtured, undergo wellness checks, and if needed, you can obtain complimentary medication for common illnesses that animals may contract in such establishments. Additionally, you are entitled to a free basic check-up at affiliated veterinarians. 

Regrettably, if you must euthanize one of your animals, as I had to about eight months back, it can be done here at a significantly lower cost compared to veterinary clinics that charge exorbitant fees for such services. 

I struggle to understand how the business surrounding the death of a cherished individual or animal has become so lucrative.

yelp:test:16184.orig: I love the Arizona Humane Society !\n\nThey are the only organization I will adopt my pets from.  The employees are nice and truly care about the animals.  The adoption fees are reasonable and the kennels are always clean.
yelp:test:16184.para: The Arizona Humane Society holds a special place in my heart! I exclusively choose them for adopting my pets. The staff members are amiable and genuinely devoted to the welfare of the animals. The adoption charges are fair, and the kennels maintain a consistently spotless condition.

yelp:test:16189.para: Oh, the delightful sensation of velvety richness.

yelp:test:16218.orig: I've never had a bad time at Koi, I don't know why it seems so many other reviewers hated it. Yes they do add a 18% gratuity but I appreciate that cause I don't have to tabulate a tip. I love their sushi, specifically The Minnesota I think it's called. It comes out really hot with yummy spicy mayo and it is to DIE for. There's a older asian lady who works there who is a hoot! She has a great sense of humor, you really must talk to her.
yelp:test:16218.para: I've always enjoyed my experiences at Koi, and it's puzzling why numerous other reviewers expressed dissatisfaction. The 18% service charge is welcomed as it eliminates the need for manual tip calculation. Their sushi, particularly the one named The Minnesota, is exceptional, served piping hot with a delightful spicy mayo topping. The older Asian woman employed there brings a lot of laughter and charm, and engaging in conversation with her is highly recommended.

yelp:test:16234.orig: Terrible experience there today. I got our food to go, and it was packaged improperly. Refried beans got all over everything-- everything in the same bag and my vehicle. The lettuce on the tacos de carne asada was cooked, and the chorizo cheese dip was atrocious. The container was quite literally half filled with orange grease. It was disgusting. It's sitting, uneaten, on my counter right now, and I paid $4 for said dip.  Finally, most of the food was too salty to eat.  I was never head-over-hills for this place, but now I will never go again.
yelp:test:16234.para: I had a horrible encounter at this establishment today. I ordered takeout, but the food was haphazardly packaged. Refried beans spilled across all items in the same container, even contaminating my car. The tacos de carne asada had overcooked lettuce, and the chorizo cheese dip was revolting, with half of it being just orange grease. It was revoltingly unappetizing. Currently, it's untouched on my counter, despite costing me $4. The majority of the food was excessively salty, and although I wasn't a fan initially, I've decided I'll never return here.

yelp:test:16240.orig:
This event is over-hyped and is nothing but a hipster infestation.

The amount of galleries to look at aren't much, and half of them have a snobby feel to them. Some of the street vendors can be like this as well.

Parking is absolute hell, and you must park far away from the event. It will take a while to even find parking since downtown is so convoluted.

However, a tip is to park at the Las Vegas Academy student parking area. You won't get towed for this. Besides, there's some students present who have to stay late a night for theatre rehearsals. Plus, LVA itself promotes First Friday to its students (particularly the 'art majors'), so feel free to park at LVA if you don't mind walking a bit to the event.

The food sold at First Friday is overpriced, although they do have very good funnel cakes. Still though, I suggest you save money and eat at any of the nearby restaurants instead. You get more bang for your buck that way.

Considering the type of event First Friday is, you'll find all sorts of people dressed in eccentric fashion. It's got everything from goths to rockabilly chicks. It's a great place to go people watching and even get some photo ops.

Regardless, F
yelp:test:16240.para:
