The number of exhibit spaces is limited, and many exude an elitist vibe. Some street merchants also share this characteristic.

Finding a parking spot is a nightmare, necessitating a long walk from downtown due to its complex layout.

However, a recommendation is to use the parking lot at the Las Vegas Academy. You won't face towing there. Additionally, there are students who must stay late for theater practice. Despite this, F

yelp:test:16243.orig: Good food can be quickly forgotten by bad service.  I'm sorry that you've got the table from hell, but out table is important too!\n\nThe micro brew samplers were interesting and tasty, but nothing else screamed repeat and come back here.
yelp:test:16243.para: Excellent cuisine can be overshadowed by poor service. I apologize for the unpleasant dining experience, yet the quality of our table is equally significant! The microbrew tasting samples were both intriguing and delicious, but the overall experience didn't compel us to return.

yelp:test:16302.orig: Overall the food is pretty good. Worth going back. Flavorful and moist. I've been here multiple times and it's consistent. I think being consistent is one of the most important attributes of a restaurant. You can't have a great time one time and not the other. This place is better than good but don't go in with the expectation of great.
yelp:test:16302.para: The cuisine is quite commendable and merits a return visit. It boasts a rich and succulent taste, which has remained unchanged through several visits. I believe that consistency stands as a crucial characteristic of a dining establishment. It's not about having an exceptional experience every single time, but this venue surpasses the standard of good. However, don't anticipate it to be extraordinary.

yelp:test:16307.orig: This was the worst \""Japanese\"" food my husband and I have ever had. We ordered 5 maki rolls. The pieces were so small they could not be considered pieces of maki. Two of the rolls supposedly had fish, but most of the pieces of maki had no recognizable fish inside. The rolls were so poorly made that they fell apart when we picked them up with the chopsticks. The taste was terrible. The wasabi wasn't real. It had the consistency of diarrhea and was dyed green. We felt sad after the meal, and cheated out of $45. First and last time ever eating here.
yelp:test:16307.para: Our experience with this "Japanese" cuisine was the most disappointing meal my spouse and I have ever endured. We requested 5 maki rolls, but the slices were minuscule, hardly qualifying as maki. Although two rolls were advertised to contain fish, the majority of the maki pieces lacked any discernible fish. The rolls were crafted with such poor quality that they crumbled upon being handled with chopsticks. The flavor was abysmal, and the wasabi was far from authentic, resembling the texture of diarrhea and artificially colored green. The meal left us feeling disheartened, and we felt deceived, having spent $45. We will not be returning to this establishment ever again.

yelp:test:16315.orig: We used to shop there on a regular basis, as well as use the pharmacy.  Not anymore.  Tired of the long lines and 2 cashiers working and employees who are there just to make their paycheck and go home.  Managers are completely clueless and do not know how to respond to a complaint.   The pharmacy never has what I need, never calls to let you know when something is ready, even when they said, \""we will call you when it is in\"" Never, not even once.  That is extremely poor customer service and that makes people like me to stop using this store.  They need to hire a customer service guru or just someone who has some common sense to retrain every employee.   If you work someplace, own it, respect your customers or you lose business, it's that simple. To the managers constantly standing around, maybe you should be checking on your departments and customers to see if everything is going ok.  That's what makes a good store and you get repeat business.    It's to bad, this was close to home but we've decided that our last visit was the final straw, we will not be returning.
yelp:test:16315.para: Previously, we frequented this location for shopping and pharmacy needs, but we've grown weary of the endless queues and the presence of only two cashiers. The staff seemed solely focused on earning their wages and leaving. The managers appeared oblivious to customer grievances. The pharmacy consistently failed to provide the required items and neglected to inform us when they were ready, despite assurances to the contrary. This lack of customer service has led us to cease patronizing the store. It's imperative that they recruit a customer service expert or someone with basic common sense to retrain all employees. If you're employed, take pride in your work and show respect to your customers, as failing to do so will result in the loss of your business. The managers should be more proactive in monitoring their departments and customers to ensure everything is functioning smoothly. This level of attentiveness is what fosters repeat business. Unfortunately, our last visit marked the point of no return, and we will not be returning.

yelp:test:16316.orig: Okay. I think it's safe to say that the Cine Capri at Tempe Marketplace is the best screen to watch any movie. There's usually a couple dollar increase in the ticket price, but it's worth is if you want to enjoy the movie you are there to watch. This theater gets the most attention from staff as well so it's always clean. It's also the best place to watch a movie on opening night. Go see TRON at this theater December 16th.
yelp:test:16316.para: It's reasonable to conclude that the Cine Capri within Tempe Marketplace offers the premier viewing experience for films. While there may be a slight surcharge in ticket costs, the value is undeniable for those seeking to fully immerse themselves in the cinematic experience. The theater garners significant staff focus, ensuring a consistently pristine environment. Moreover, it stands out as the ideal venue for witnessing a film's debut, such as TRON on December 16th.

yelp:test:16323.orig: Switch really was an interesting place. I love the atmosphere, it's definitely high-end. My down-to-earth jock/geek husband wouldn't go there with me on date night, so I went with a girl friend of mine.\nThe food was really great, and the server was lovely. If you want a fun night out, and a place that's worthy of your little black dress and sky-high heels, this is it!
yelp:test:16323.para: The venue Switch was quite intriguing. I adore the ambiance, it exudes a luxurious vibe. My laid-back athlete/nerd partner wouldn't accompany me on a romantic evening, so I opted to go with a female companion. The cuisine was exceptional, and the waiter was charming. For an enjoyable evening out and a spot that complements your elegant attire and elevated footwear, this is the perfect choice!

yelp:test:16376.orig: This is a hard review, I've never experienced anything like this place. Usually food is either good or bad, end of story. I love the entrees , they are inspired and tasty, the chef has a deft hand with his spices and flavors (not just the usual garlic and oyster sauce) BUT (and this is a HUGE but) the appetizers have proved to be consistently disappointing. These were the smallest wontons I have ever seen. The filling was rolled into a ver
yelp:test:16376.para:
This review is challenging, as I've never encountered a dining experience like this before. Typically, food falls into the categories of either excellent or poor, with no in-between. I appreciate the entrees, which are both innovative and delicious, showcasing the chef's skillful use of spices and flavors beyond the common garlic and oyster sauce. However, there's a significant issue with the appetizers, which have repeatedly let me down. Despite my initial praise for the main courses in a previous review, I was underwhelmed by the appetizers and decided to return for a second opportunity. It's understandable that even the best can have a bad day in the kitchen. Unfortunately, my second visit was equally disappointing. I ordered the "Award Winning" creamy crab puffs, a dish I hold dear, and some dried, fried won-tons. The crab puffs were overdone and tough, requiring me to remove the edges to consume the bland, average center. The fried won-tons were similarly overdone, resembling small marbles in texture and hardness. These were also the tiniest won-tons I've ever seen. The filling was tightly packed into the wonton wrappers.

yelp:test:16384.orig: I almost always have a great experience here! The food has never disappointed & the portions are very generous. MOST of the time the staff is very friendly and if you show up on the weekends for breakfast, do expect a wait but you shouldn't be disappointed. \n\nToday, however, the service from my waitress Brittany wasn't great, I'd honestly give her a D+ at best, she wasn't rude by definition but she was very impersonable, she was more of an order-taker than a person of service, she'd walk by and look but really wouldn't even ask if all was good or if we needed anything, she never even stated her name(I got it from the receipt)... I needed her a few times and had to like waive her down or signal her over. I felt like my boyfriend and I were just inconvenient to her and she was JUST there to do her job, nothing more, nothing less.
yelp:test:16384.para: Generally, my visits here are filled with delight, as the cuisine consistently meets expectations and the servings are ample. On weekends, especially for breakfast, a bit of patience is required due to longer waits, but it's unlikely to lead to dissatisfaction. \n\nNonetheless, on this occasion, my interaction with Brittany, the waitress, was less than stellar. I'd rate her performance a D+ at most, as she wasn't outright unpleasant but lacked a personal touch. She seemed more focused on taking orders than providing genuine service, often glancing but not engaging in meaningful conversation or inquiry about our needs. I had to repeatedly get her attention, and she never introduced herself, with her name only visible on the bill. I felt like we were a hassle to her, and she seemed solely committed to her job duties, with no additional effort.

yelp:test:16394.orig: ehhh...barely edible. Went for breakfast on a Sunday morning with a party of 5, typically busy. Bad layout of restaurant...lots of booths around the perimeter and tables squished in the middle. I had 2 eggs, 2 sausage patties and 2 biscuits & gravy. Everything but the sausage was cold, the biscuits weren't homemade and the gravy tastes like raw flour. Mother-In Law's food was also cold and one order of \""toast\"" came out as bread- not toasted at all. There was no point in sending it back because no one ever checked back. My husbands food came out steaming hot, needs better timing in the kitchen. We won't be back...
yelp:test:16394.para: Ugh, it was barely acceptable. On a Sunday morning with a group of five, usually bustling, we found ourselves in a restaurant with a poor arrangement. There were numerous booths along the edges and tables crammed in the center. I ordered 2 eggs, 2 sausage patties, and 2 biscuits with gravy. Unfortunately, everything except the sausage was cold, the biscuits lacked homemade quality, and the gravy had a raw flour flavor. The food served to my mother-in-law was also cold, and a "toast" order was mistakenly delivered as untoasted bread. Despite the opportunity to return, it was futile as no one followed up. My husband's meal was served piping hot, indicating a need for improved kitchen timing. We've decided not to revisit.

yelp:test:16448.orig:
Look, bad experiences happen to everybody sooner or later. Sometimes customers are rude and won't acknowledge it. Other times, employees have a bad day and don't handle situations appropriately.

But I have to say, after having flown United on the last four trips I took - three of them multi-leg international trips and one of them a direct flight coast-to-coast - I gotta say that United is just an awful airline.

That's just sad. Fortunately, it's the 21st century (everywhere but on United flights) so I can bring an iPod and watch a movie with my earbuds (but I can't plug it in to keep it charged!!! Because this is United - christ, the AC outlets in the lavatories don't even work. Psych!)

Flight attendants - CLEARLY hate their jobs and the customers, ALL of them. Well, except of course if they think you are a rich sugardaddy who can rescue them from their shitty jobs. I am painfully polite at all times to people who have to deal with the general public, I know it can be hard and
yelp:test:16448.para:
It's a universal truth that negative encounters are inevitable for all. Occasionally, passengers are impolite and fail to recognize it. Other times, staff members have a rough day and don't manage situations correctly.

However, I must express my disappointment with United Airlines, based on my recent experiences on four flights - three of which were multi-leg international journeys and one was a direct coast-to-coast flight. The airline's condition is truly disappointing.

The aircrafts are old and in poor condition, all dating back to the 1980s. The in-flight entertainment system is outdated, offering only a single movie for everyone from an outdated Hi-8 videotape. It's disheartening.

The flight attendants appear to despise their jobs and the passengers, with the exception of those who they perceive as affluent individuals capable of improving their circumstances. I always maintain a courteous demeanor towards those who interact with the public, understanding the challenges they face.

yelp:test:16461.orig: Well done! Had a delicious, full of flavor dinner and great customer service. We will be coming back
yelp:test:16461.para: Congratulations! Savored a flavorful, satisfying meal and received excellent service. We plan to return again.

yelp:test:16473.orig:
Tropical themed restaurant.  Been here for buffets which were decent.  Wanting to avoid the long buffet line, we opted to be seated for the cafe.  Getting seats for 6 seemed to be a challenge.  We were directed to the back and was told someone would be waiting for us to seat us.  Alas, no one was so we just seated ourselves.  What appeared to be confusion as another server asked us if we were supposed to be seated there or not.  Turns out, it was the right place.  Anyway, we waited....hmmmm... quite a while. He appeared to be on the verge of a hissy fit.   
We waited AGAIN even longer.  Finally, annoyed with the wait since we had just arrived to Vegas after roadtripping 5 hours, I walked over to the waiter station and asked for someone to bring us drinks.  
A minute later, our huffy server shows up with no greeting and asks us for our drink order.  We were already ready to order.  
Again,  another long wait.  I looked at my watch and noticed it's been over 20 minutes with NO DRINKS!  This has been my worst experience at th
yelp:test:16473.para:
Tropical-themed dining establishment. We've enjoyed satisfactory buffets here. To bypass the extensive buffet queue, we chose to dine at the cafe. Securing a table for six proved difficult. We were guided to a secluded area and informed that a host would soon seat us. Unfortunately, no host materialized, so we settled ourselves. Another server seemed puzzled, questioning our seating choice. It turned out we were in the correct spot. We endured a lengthy wait, exacerbated by two restless children openly expressing their hunger. The server rushed by, visibly close to losing it. 

We endured a further delay. Frustrated by the wait, especially after a long drive to Vegas, I approached the service counter and requested drinks. 

Shortly after, our irritable server arrived without any pleasantries, inquiring about our drink preferences. We were prepared to order. 

Another extended wait ensued. I glanced at my watch and realized it had been over 20 minutes without any drinks. This has been my most disappointing dining experience thus far.

yelp:test:16500.orig: Great food, horrible service. The bad outweighs the good. Not worth spending your cash in that dough factory. Pass
yelp:test:16500.para:
Exquisite cuisine, poor service. The negatives surpass the positives. Not a wise investment of your money in that culinary establishment. Avoid.

yelp:test:16501.orig: I love the food here.  And it is super convenient.  Those are 4 stars.  But the service is just painful.  Slow.  Uninspired.  Bothersome.  The sense it get is that I am interrupting them by actually wanting to spend money.  I would be a weekly customer if this weren't so.  As is I come maybe twice a year.
yelp:test:16501.para: The cuisine at this place is delightful and highly accessible. I've rated it 4 stars. However, the service leaves much to be desired, being sluggish, uninspired, and irritating. Ideally, I'd be a regular patron, but due to these service issues, I only visit approximately twice annually.

yelp:test:16502.orig: Note: I didn't enter this beauty, simply observed it.\nFrom the boulevard, it's quite stellar especially during the night time. yelp:test:16502.para: Note: I merely witnessed this spectacle, not participated in it.\nViewing it from the avenue, it shines remarkably at night. Combined with the hot air balloon and the Bellagio fountains ahead, it stands out with its unique glow (though I yearn to experience the genuine version in Paris, but that's life for now...)\nWhen you visit to watch the aquatic performance, don't overlook this attraction on the avenue - capture images of "Paris" with your camera!

yelp:test:16571.orig: So my second experience was alot better!I did come hungry and I ordered one of my go to breakfast items I eat which is chicken fried steak and eggs with country potatoes. They have redeemed themself and I enjoyed a great meal with great service.I'll be back to have this again
yelp:test:16571.para: My second visit turned out to be significantly improved! I arrived on an empty stomach and opted for my usual breakfast choice, chicken fried steak and eggs accompanied by country potatoes. They have made amends and I relished a fantastic dining experience with excellent service. I'm planning to return for another taste of this delightful meal.

yelp:test:16576.orig:
I have a few things to report on this place.  Since this place appeared on Restaurant Impossible it is good to report that the decor and menu are still just about the same when on the show.  Sadly, the management and higher ups haven't really changed, same mentality.

What drew us in here was a sign on the side of the street: ""All You Can Eat Pasta Bar."" Great we thought, let's go in and try it out.  Then everything seems to have gone down the toilet.  When we got inside and attempted to order the pasta bar we were told it wasn't available due to the street festival going on outside.  Hmm, funny, because there is still a sign, if not two, posted outside advertising this.  If you were not going to honor this special (which I believe runs Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday) then maybe you should have taken in the signs for that week.

When we decided we weren't going to dine here and let our waitress know our intentions we got this great, drawn out excuse why we shouldn't go.  Instead of honoring the all you can eat portion of this, they would hand you a card with options on it to fill in for the pasta bar.  Mind you, it wasn't even all you can eat, just whatever you checked on
yelp:test:16576.para:
I'd like to share some updates about this location. Following its appearance on Restaurant Impossible, it's notable that the interior design and menu offerings remain largely unchanged as depicted on the show. Unfortunately, the leadership and decision-makers have not evolved, maintaining the same mindset.

Our initial attraction to this place was a street sign proclaiming, "All You Can Eat Pasta Bar." Excited, we decided to give it a try. However, our experience quickly soured. Upon entering and attempting to order the pasta bar, we were informed it was unavailable due to an ongoing street festival. It was ironic, considering the signs still prominently displayed the offer. If they were not committed to upholding this special, which I understand is available on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, they should have acknowledged the signs for that week.

When we chose not to dine there and informed our server of our decision, we were met with a lengthy, elaborate excuse as to why we shouldn't go. Instead of honoring the all-you-can-eat pasta bar, they offered us a card with various options to choose from. It's worth mentioning that it wasn't a true all-you-can-eat experience, just whatever we selected from the card.

yelp:test:16590.orig:
The first thing that struck us is how cocky this young waiter was.He was probably thinking ""WE AT SWAGAT ARE THE BOMB!!"". Son, I just moved here from the San Francisco bay area.I know and cook Indian food and trust me you are NOT the bomb.Far from it.
Food was OK.Nothing exceptional and definitely not what the reviewers here are going ga ga about but that is personal choice.We tried the chicken tikka and the vindaloo which was flavorful but definitely not worth the price we were paying. Quantities were not adequate for the amount we were paying.Is Indian food really that expensive here in Madison? The prices here are ridiculously overpriced for Indian food and every single Indian restaurant has the same price range for all dishes which would make me believe that they have some sort of Indian restaurant owners union that decides on what the prices are going to be!!
Another thing that irks me is the inclusion of south Indian food along with your Rogan Josh menu which raised a big flag for us regarding the quality of the food. No serious Indian restaurant owner would EVER include a idli sambar dosa on a menu that has Rogan Josh or biryani on it.PERIOD!
Just looking at the quant
yelp:test:16590.para: The initial impression was the young server's overconfidence. He might have believed he was "THE BEST" at Swagat. I recently relocated from the San Francisco bay region, where I'm familiar with and prepare Indian cuisine. I assure you, you're far from being the best. The food was satisfactory, but it didn't live up to the hype of the reviews here. It wasn't exceptional, and the pricing was questionable. The chicken tikka and vindaloo had flavor but didn't justify the cost. The portion sizes didn't match the price tag. It seems Indian food in Madison is exorbitantly priced, with every Indian eatery following a similar pricing structure for all dishes. This uniformity suggests a possible collective decision-making body among Indian restaurant owners, setting the prices. Another concern is the presence of south Indian dishes like idli sambar dosa on a menu that also features Rogan Josh or biryani. It's a clear indication of compromised food quality.

yelp:test:16608.orig: I met the owner, Sam when he worked at a chain prior to opening Goodfellas.  I wanted my son to have time to feel like a boy because he's stuck with his single mom and big sister all the time so I took him to a \""real\"" barber shop for the first time when he was 3 and gratefully we got Sam when we walked in.  Sam left the chain to open Goodfellas and he personally called me to tell me where he would be so we could continue coming to him.  My son is now 8 and looks forward to his visits to Goodfellas every 7-8 weeks and adores Sam.  Sam knows my family and genuinely cares for me and my children.  I always buy gift cards for the men in my family and I have never heard anything bad from them about the service they receive.  These people will treat you like family and always go above and beyond what is expected of their services.  I HIGHLY recommend them.
yelp:test:16608.para: When I encountered Sam, who was employed at a franchise before establishing Goodfellas, I sought to give my son a sense of boyhood, as he was primarily with his mother and older sister. I introduced him to a genuine barbershop at age 3, and upon entering, we were fortunate to meet Sam. Sam departed from the franchise to start Goodfellas and personally reached out to me to ensure our continued patronage. Now, at age 8, my son eagerly anticipates his bi-monthly visits to Goodfellas and has a deep affection for Sam. Sam is well-acquainted with my family and shows authentic concern for us and our kids. I habitually purchase gift cards for the men in my family, and they have never expressed dissatisfaction with the service. These individuals treat you as part of the family and consistently exceed service expectations. I strongly endorse them.

yelp:test:16630.orig: Liars. Rude. Don't fix what they say. I went with my sister and our men and they wanted it to be the best night and dinner. It was the special with the Chris Angel tickets. We were told on the phone filet mignon, and they brought out chuck steak pretending we wouldn't know it wasn't filet. That's just insulting and pathetic. $100 a plate that's ridiculous.
yelp:test:16630.para: Dishonest individuals are disrespectful. Avoid correcting their falsehoods. I accompanied my sibling and their companions, aiming for an exceptional evening and meal. We were informed over the phone that filet mignon would be served, but they presented chuck steak, masking the deception. This act is both demeaning and pitiful. A $100 charge per plate is utterly absurd.

yelp:test:16656.orig: This was my first time eating here and well.....it was the most disgusting soul food I've ever eaten in my life!!! I ordered fried chicken, sweet potatoes, & red beans. The chicken had no seasoning or flavor. I bet my 10 yr old brother could cook better chicken. The red beans same thing, no seasoning & nasty at that!! Sweet potatoes, where's the brown sugar butter cinnamon/nutmeg?? The soul was definately missing in this so called soul food. If u like wasting $$ on crappy food, then this is your place! yelp:test:16656.para: My initial visit to this establishment left me utterly repulsed by the soul food I consumed. I chose fried chicken, sweet potatoes, and red beans. The chicken lacked any seasoning or taste, making it inferior even to what a 10-year-old might prepare. The red beans were equally devoid of seasoning and unappetizing. The absence of brown sugar, butter, cinnamon, and nutmeg in the sweet potatoes was glaring. The soulful essence was conspicuously absent in this so-called soul food. If you're inclined to spend money on subpar cuisine, this is the spot for you. In comparison, Frys deli chicken was noticeably superior.

yelp:test:16658.orig: overpriced for overfried food. We went about an hour before closing and they took forever to bring food. just no customer service it was like you were inconvience to them being there.. I'm sure at one time this place was great at one time but no longer.

yelp:test:16661.para:

yelp:test:16665.orig:
The service was terrible - the food was not much better. We waited forever for our drink orders, but tried to give them the benefit of the doubt because our kids had to get milk from the bar. When we had to get the chip guy to refill our drinks, I knew it was no fluke. 

We then pulled up the Yelp reviews and read all about what we were living at that moment. But as we hasn't gotten our food yet, we still had to wait.

Won't be back-ever. Wasn't all  bad, but with so many good restaurants within a couple of miles, eating here would be a waste of time and money.
yelp:test:16665.para:
The dining experience was dreadful, with the meal quality not much improved. We endured a lengthy wait for our beverage orders, but we gave the staff the benefit of the doubt due to our children's need for milk from the bar. Upon realizing we had to request a drink refill, it became clear it wasn't a one-time occurrence. 

We then browsed through Yelp reviews to understand our current situation, but we hadn't received our meal yet, so we remained on hold. I was satiated with chips and water, rendering me unable to consume the main dish. The only reason I took it home was because I was raised to avoid food waste. 

I will not return, despite it not being entirely terrible. However, with numerous excellent dining options nearby, choosing to eat here would be a misuse of time and resources.

yelp:test:16684.para: Returned to Aureole after nearly 2 years and enjoyed a particularly delightful dish. Mandalay Bay has taken on a somewhat tainted reputation, similar to the rest of the strip. yelp:test:16697.orig:
IF YOU DONT HAVE A SENSE OF HUMOR- dont go.
this place is hilairious!! Everyone there is having a blast, and everyone is always laughing... staff is really funny and there is a great ENERGY.. if you get offended easy,  you will not like this place.  Staff will make you a paper hat, and make you wear something that says something really funny, possibly degrading..etc etc.

The live band is AWESOME.. they play all songs by request....  (steve miller band, eagles, sublime, etc etc..). .. great place to go to- to just kick back, have some drinks and chill out!
yelp:test:16697.para: Should you lack a sense of humor, this venue is not for you.\nThis location is absolutely comical! The atmosphere is filled with joy, as laughter echoes from every corner. The staff's humor is infectious, contributing to the vibrant ambiance. However, if you're prone to offense, this might not be your cup of tea. Perfect for unwinding, enjoying a drink, and relaxing in a laid-back setting.

yelp:test:16703.orig: I've always wanted to try this place and I personally wouldn't go back. Food was OK, def get something bbq b/c it's better. I had the wings and they sucked. Being treated like s*** was interesting but they prob could do w/o that angle if you ask me. The atmosphere was cool and they guy working the bar was super cool! He totally sold us on getting one of the insulated cups with the slushy drinks and he did his own mixture that none of the refills could beat down the strip. I would do the outside bar again but that's about it.
yelp:test:16703.para: I've consistently desired to visit this spot and I personally wouldn't return. The cuisine was satisfactory, but I'd recommend opting for BBQ as it's superior. I sampled the wings and found them disappointing. The experience of being disregarded was peculiar, yet they might consider omitting that aspect upon request. The ambiance was enjoyable and the bartender was exceptionally engaging, convincing us to purchase an insulated cup with a homemade slushy drink that outperformed any refills on the strip. yelp:test:16707.orig:

Everything was overpriced. For 2
Cokes, 2 small margaritas, chips and cheese salsa, fish
And chips, and wings , the price was $85 !
yelp:test:16707.para: The wings were satisfactory but the legs were more prominent. I have a preference for wings. The cheese dip was chilly yet the taste was acceptable. The team was amusing and welcoming. The fish and chips were excessively fried. \n\nOverall, the cost was high. For 2 Cokes, 2 small margaritas, chips, cheese salsa, fish and chips, and wings, the total was $85 !

yelp:test:16733.orig:
At first thought I would have given this place 3 stars, then I actually thought about the service and dropped it down 1 star. The food is pretty good, nothing special though. The prosciutto and mozzarella was pretty good and I kind of liked the chicken parm panini, but I definitely thought the amount of chicken on the sandwich was stingy. The price isn't high so there are your 3 stars. 

Here is your review on service, SUCKED. I walked in and the waitress/hostess/bartender said hello and walked away. Then a couple minutes later she remembered that her job is to get people to a table so she told me to sit anywhere. She also was able to bring me chips instead of the side salad that was ordered and somehow I needed to turn my entire body around and stare at her to let her know I wanted to order something. She also brought my date the wrong drink, which was supposed to be cider, but instead my date took a big sip of an ale which she thought was gross. I am surprised looking back that I didn't give her a 10% tip. 

I wanted to like this place, it's in walking distance from where I live, but the brain dead waitress was able to convince me to never go back again.
yelp:test:16733.para:
Initially, I would have rated this establishment 3 stars, but after considering the service, I reduced it to 2 stars. The cuisine is satisfactory, though not exceptional. The prosciutto and mozzarella were commendable, and I found the chicken parm panini enjoyable, albeit the chicken portion seemed meager. The cost is reasonable, justifying the 3-star rating. 

Here is my critique of the service, which was subpar. Upon entering, the server greeted me briefly and then left. A few minutes later, she recalled her role in guiding patrons to their seats and directed me to sit anywhere. She also managed to serve chips instead of the requested side salad, which required me to turn completely and make eye contact to indicate my desire to order. Additionally, she mistakenly gave my companion the incorrect beverage, a cider instead of the ale, which she found unpleasant. Reflecting on the experience, I'm astonished I didn't tip her a mere 10%. 

Despite its proximity to my residence, the inattentive server persuaded me to avoid returning to this place.

yelp:test:16759.orig: LOVE Earl of Sandwich!!!! My husband and I make this one of our stops every time we're in Vegas! The last time we were in town we stopped by Earl of Sandwich 3 or 4 times I think. Yummy sandwiches, good hours, good service most of the time, best food value in the Planet Hollywood Hotel and Casino! I'm craving it now!!! I may have to stop by on my way to the airport next time and bring some home with me. =) You think i'm kidding lol.  \n\nHighly recommend you try every sandwich on the menu once....well, as many as you can lol.  The Caribbean Jerk Chicken is amazing! The American and The Original 1762 are tops on my list also. And make sure to save room for one of their delicious ice cream cookie sandwiches!
yelp:test:16759.para: Earl of Sandwich is a must-visit for my spouse and me whenever we're in Las Vegas! I believe we frequented the place around 3-4 times during our last visit. The sandwiches are delectable, the service is generally excellent, and it offers the best food value in the Planet Hollywood Hotel and Casino! I'm currently yearning for it and might consider grabbing some on my next trip to the airport. I'm not joking! I highly suggest sampling every sandwich on the menu at least once, if not more. The Caribbean Jerk Chicken is outstanding, and I'd also highly rate The American and The Original 1762. Don't forget to leave room for their scrumptious ice cream cookie sandwiches!

yelp:test:16772.orig: Ah yes, Earl of Sandwich. Every Vegas mans hangover preference. All I have to say is, FULL MONTAGUE! (and tomato soup... With lots of water, mind you) will cure that hangover.
yelp:test:16772.para: Indeed, the Earl of Sandwich. The go-to choice for Vegas post-party remedies. Simply put, I assert, a complete Montague, complemented by ample tomato soup and water, will alleviate that hangover.

yelp:test:16786.orig:
6...6....6 dollar sandwiches????
Earl doesn't mess around.  As much as I don't like writing reviews for chains, this one is an exception.   

Earl of Sandwich has brought me back from the brink after getting the drunken hangover shakes.  Conveniently located on the floor of Planet Hollywood, EoS serves Quiznos type of sandwiches, only wayyyyy better.  He's good for pregaming before a 12 hour rager.  I've had two types of sandwiches here. 

The Caprese is your standard mozzarella, tomato sandwich with balsamic reduction. The Hawaiian is also your standard chicken, ham, cheddar and BBQ sauce.  

Their broccoli soup is chunky good, and their cookie will give you diabetes.  Earl Earl mm mm good
yelp:test:16786.para:
6...6....6 dollar sandwiches????
Earl is no joke. Despite my usual reluctance to write about chain restaurants, this place stands out. 

Earl of Sandwich has saved me from the aftermath of a night of heavy drinking with its convenient location on Planet Hollywood's floor. Here, they offer superior Quiznos-style sandwiches, perfect for pre-partying before a marathon event. I've sampled two varieties of their sandwiches. 

The Caprese features mozzarella, tomato, and a balsamic reduction. The Hawaiian offers a classic combination of chicken, ham, cheddar, and BBQ sauce. 

Their broccoli soup is hearty, and their cookie is so indulgent it could potentially affect your blood sugar levels. Earl Earl is exceptionally good.

yelp:test:16822.orig: LOVE THIS PLACE!  We eat here every Saturday as long as we are in town.  My husband eats here during the week too!  Weekday lunches are a great deal and quick!  The veggie soup is delicious.  The golden wings - Delicious... chicken satay is good too.  For an entree... we always get Pad Prik King chicken or sometimes shrimp but its always always delicious!  Have been trying to find a thai place with this dish closer to home (east valley) but haven't found one yet!  Service is terrific!  FYI for those of you who just order Pad Thai... it is very sweet here so if you don't like it sweet... order something else.  Other things we've tried that were good... pepper steak - very good - just dont eat a lot of red meat, massamum curry with chicken good... also we order everything medium to thai hot... like very spicy!
yelp:test:16822.para: We adore this location! We dine here every Saturday while we're visiting. My spouse enjoys it during weekdays as well. Weekday lunches offer great value and speed. The veggie soup is scrumptious. The golden chicken wings are delectable... and the chicken satay is tasty too. For a main course, we consistently choose Pad Prik King chicken or occasionally shrimp, and it's always delicious. We've been on the hunt for a Thai restaurant with this dish nearer to East Valley, but haven't found one yet. The service is outstanding! Note for those who order Pad Thai: it's quite sweet here, so if you prefer it less sweet, opt for a different dish. Other dishes we've tried and liked include pepper steak (excellent, but we don't consume much red meat), massaman curry with chicken (also good), and we generally prefer our food medium to extra spicy, like very hot Thai cuisine.

yelp:test:16836.orig: Over-hyped and overpriced.  Located in the forum shops in Caesars, Trevi is located right in the middle of the mall.  My boyfriend and I did not have to wait, luckily, but were sat right next to the greek gods water fountain which turned out to be very loud/distracting.  Service was slow because it was a busy.  The food (Italian themed) was nothing special.  I ordered the linguine ai frutti di mare, one of their specialties, which was delicious but expensive for the small portion and lacked enough seafood.  My boyfriend's sausage pizza had onions that were way overcooked.  Overall, I will not be returning and am surprised at the poor value of their food for the great location.
yelp:test:16836.para:
Positioned centrally in the Caesars forum shops, Trevi's placement is surrounded by the mall's bustle. Fortunately, my partner and I avoided queues, yet we found ourselves seated beside the boisterous Greek gods' water feature. The service lagged due to high traffic. The Italian-themed cuisine failed to impress, with my linguine ai frutti di mare being a costly, modestly sized dish that was under-seafooded. My boyfriend's sausage pizza was marred by excessively cooked onions. Despite the prime location, I'm not planning a return and am taken aback by the subpar food quality.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, sentiment, emotion, and intent while altering the wording and sentence structure. The length is approximately the same as the original text.)

yelp:test:16846.orig: Saucy. And nearby. Its convenient that it's so close. I cant stress the closeness more.
yelp:test:16846.para: Nearby and quite close. The proximity is highly beneficial. I cannot emphasize the closeness enough.

yelp:test:16852.orig: First time and I wasn't impressed. Chicken is flavorless, dry and way too pricey. Will not return.
yelp:test:16852.para: Initial visit and I found it underwhelming. The chicken lacked taste, was overly dry, and excessively costly. I have no intention of coming back.

yelp:test:16871.orig:
so bad ! bad service and nasty food.. sorry I have to give 1 star ..never had such a bad experience!

Server was rude when we ask no ice he gave us this bad look you never forget!

My chicken inside the pho was stale! I had to take it out of the soup

WE FOUND A HUGE PIECE OF PLASTIC INSIDE MY BOY FRIEND THE PHO! (I wish we took a pic of that but we didnt)

in that point we paid and left.. never again
yelp:test:16871.para: The service and cuisine were utterly disappointing, leading to a 1-star rating. Regretfully, I had to share this experience. The server was unpleasant when we requested ice, leaving a lasting negative impression. Additionally, the chicken in my pho was stale, necessitating its removal from the broth. To our dismay, we discovered a significant piece of plastic in my boyfriend's pho, though we didn't manage to capture it on camera. Consequently, we paid and left, vowing not to return.

yelp:test:16880.orig:
Cheese = Amazing

Cheese curds = amazing x2

The hidden gem of this place, however is the red velvet fudge.  Snatch some up immediately.

Service was also very helpful.  

Summing it up:  stop here if you can.
yelp:test:16880.para:
Cheese is fantastic

Cheese curds are twice as fantastic

The secret delight of this location is the red velvet fudge. Grab some right away.

The service was also exceptionally supportive.

In summary: If possible, make a stop here.

yelp:test:16883.orig: Just ok. The service was good, the food, not so much.
yelp:test:16883.para: The service was satisfactory, but the quality of the food was less impressive.

yelp:test:16907.orig: Horrible service and my food was cold. If they had been busy, I MIGHT understand, seeing as I used to be a server myself. But we were the only people in the place. And considering that I've had such great experiences at other King's locations, I was very disappointed.
yelp:test:16907.para: The terrible service and chilled meal left me dismayed. Had there been a bustling crowd, I might have been more forgiving, given my past experience as a server. However, we were the sole patrons, and my previous enjoyable encounters at other King's establishments only heightened my sense of letdown.

yelp:test:16922.orig: Little Las Vegas with all their cultural imitation crap, except without the fun.
yelp:test:16922.para: Tiny Las Vegas, filled with superficial cultural replicas, yet devoid of enjoyment.

yelp:test:16968.orig:
This is a chain restaurant, but they are fanatical about the quality of their food and service.  It's a little pricey at around $20-$25 a plate for a dinner entree but the food is high quality.

Let's get our priorities in order:

In terms of drinks, I had a vodka tonic (Well vodka there is Smirnoff but they also carry Ketel One) and a Watermelon Margarita.  The vodka tonic was about what you'd expect.  A decent neutral drink with a splash of citrus.  The Watermelon Margarita was a little sweet for my taste but it was definitely an interesting experience and certainly strong enough and big enough.  It's a $9 drink but it comes with a sidecar caraffe that will completely refill the Margarita glass and then some so it's really like 2 margaritas for under five bucks each.

Now that that's out of the way let's discuss dessert:

I had a bite of the cheesecake which was tasty, but not award winning.    

Entrees:
I tried the NY strip and a lobster tail, both of which were well prepared though I'm not a huge fan of their spice rub.  It's not bad mind you, I just prefer my steaks either naked or marinated.  The good news is their steaks are never frozen and the quality of the cu
yelp:test:16968.para:
This eatery operates as a franchise, yet they are extremely dedicated to the excellence of their culinary offerings and customer service. The cost per dinner plate, priced between $20-$25, reflects the superior quality of the food.

Let's prioritize our discussion points:

Regarding beverages, I sampled a Smirnoff vodka tonic and a Watermelon Margarita. The vodka tonic delivered a standard, balanced drink with a hint of citrus. The Watermelon Margarita was slightly overly sweet for my palate, but it provided a unique experience and was robust and generous enough. Priced at $9, it comes with a sidecar carafe that can refill the Margarita glass multiple times, effectively offering two margaritas for less than $5 each.

Now, let's turn our attention to desserts:

I sampled a portion of the cheesecake, which was enjoyable but didn't win any awards.

When it comes to main courses:

I sampled the NY strip and lobster tail, both of which were well-prepared. However, I'm not particularly fond of their spice rub. It's not terrible, but I usually prefer my steaks either unseasoned or marinated. The positive aspect is that their steaks are never frozen, and the overall quality of the meat is comm

yelp:test:17017.orig: We went this afternoon for a late breakfast. I've heard a lot about this place so we decided to do the drive up to North Phoenix.   We walked in and the whole \""Man vs Food\"" situation was posted everywhere.  We decided to order the claim to fame giant king cavalier torta and ordered to split.  I ordered an agua de pi\u00f1a and it was great and when we asked for chips and salsa the server let us know they only had potato chips and no tortilla chips.............. (weird)........ Ok- so no chips LOL.  Our torta arrived and it was HUGE!!! So I'm all excited about this giant Mexican sandwich but then I realized that I'm not going to be able to bite into it because it's so huge (that's what she said- I know) ok so I split the sandwich in half to only have one top portion half to start ingesting.  There is every animal inside of this thing. Literally.  Ham, pork chop, hot dog, shredded chicken, carne Asada, and fried chicken, and chicken fried steak ( I think?) ok so like the top half started out good but then I got grossed out with all the meat and then took off the fried chicken an chicken fried steak.  Then I threw off the hot dogs.  Then I just decided I was done once my boyfriend
yelp:test:17017.para: This morning, we opted for a late brunch and chose to visit North Phoenix, a place I'd heard much about. Upon arrival, the "Man vs Food" theme was evident throughout the venue. We settled on the renowned giant king cavalier torta, splitting it between us. I indulged in an agua de pi\u00f1a, which was delightful, but we were informed they only had potato chips, not tortilla chips. Laughing it off, we proceeded with our meal. The torta was colossal, prompting me to split it in half for easier consumption. Inside, it was packed with various meats like ham, pork chop, hot dog, shredded chicken, carne Asada, and fried chicken, possibly chicken fried steak too. Initially, the top half was enjoyable, but the abundance of meat soon turned me off. I discarded the fried chicken and chicken fried steak, and eventually, the hot dogs too. I decided to call it quits after my partner's reaction.

yelp:test:17035.orig:
Recently went to a work holiday party at Arsenal Bowling Lanes. This place has been here forever and I can remember coming here as a kid when you had to keep track of your own score with paper.

Arsenal Bowling is in a very cramped space (for a bowling alley) so there's not much space to hang out and enjoy your drink behind your lane.  Srangers are constantly walking through your group and bumping into you.

The bowling balls are pretty beat up, there's not much selection, and most of the balls don't even have their weight on them.  The food is typical fried bar food and overpriced.  The drinks are very overpriced.  Only one bartender was working so the wait at the bar was terribly long.  We had to keep skipping turns for the people going for drinks becuase it took them so long to get back.

Compared to a fancy bowling alley like Jillian's in Boston, Arsenal is extremely ghettotastic.

This is really a 1-star kind of place, but I'm giving a 2nd becuase it's a Pittsburgh Classic.
yelp:test:17035.para: I recently attended a work celebration at Arsenal Bowling Lanes, a venue that has stood the test of time, where I recall playing and manually recording scores as a child. The location is quite compact for a bowling center, resulting in limited space for socializing and enjoying beverages while waiting for your turn. The bowling balls appear worn out, with a limited variety and many lacking proper weight. The menu consists of standard fried snacks and drinks at a high cost. The bar service was slow due to a single bartender, causing guests to frequently skip their turn. In comparison to upscale establishments like Jillian's in Boston, Arsenal Bowling Lanes is quite underwhelming. Despite its shortcomings, I'm rating it a 2-star due to its affiliation with Pittsburgh Classic.

yelp:test:17056.orig:
I was excited to eat here after reading the reviews. Then I ate there and I was less excited. 

I was prepped for some hot spicy New Mexican food. That did not arrive on my plate. It was tasty for sure but I was lead to believe that I would experience the food I grew up with in New Mexico. I didn't. 

It is possible that my expectations were too much for this restaurant to handle.
yelp:test:17056.para: I anticipated a thrilling dining experience based on the positive feedback I had read. However, my actual visit left me somewhat underwhelmed. \n\nI was expecting a fiery, authentic New Mexican cuisine. Regrettably, it was absent from my meal. While it was enjoyable, it didn't fulfill the nostalgic flavors I associate with New Mexico. It's plausible that my anticipations were beyond the scope of this eatery's capabilities.

yelp:test:17059.orig: Taste was bland!  you are better off going to Genghis Grill instead.  YC's only has 3 meat choices and no seafood!  It was fresh, but flavorless.  You had to get the noodles in your bowl too so you get less here than you do at Genghis Grill.
yelp:test:17059.para: The flavor was underwhelming! Opt for Genghis Grill as it offers a wider variety of meats and seafood. Although fresh, the taste at YC's lacks zest, and you'll receive fewer noodles in your serving compared to Genghis Grill.

yelp:test:17084.orig: One of my favorite hotels to stay in Vegas.  Be aware of the resort fees when you book, but you get lots of free stuff with the paid fee.\n\nRooms & Casino & extras all very nice
yelp:test:17084.para: In Las Vegas, one of my preferred accommodations stands out. Remember to consider the resort charges upon reservation, yet you'll receive numerous complimentary items in return for the paid fee. The rooms, gaming area, and additional amenities are all exceptional.

yelp:test:17091.orig:
We were only outside at the pools here for the Epicurean Affair in May. Highly anticipated event, I encourage all to go next year.  

All the pool areas were lovely and arranged really nicely. The food event was the bomb and was done very well. 

Food was incredible!
yelp:test:17091.para:
The Epicurean Affair in May was a highly awaited occasion, and I urge everyone to participate in the following year. 

The pool areas were charmingly set up and the food event was exceptional, executed flawlessly. 

The culinary offerings were truly outstanding.

yelp:test:17097.orig: Have stayed here a few times and it wasnt bad until my last experience. We got to our room and found wet dirty womens underwear inside the bed covers. Called front desk but they didnt seem to be beothered and just asked us to move to another room. The second room had a view if you call that an upgrade. But we stayed over the weekend and the first day i understand we forgot to remover our do not disturb so they didnt clean our room, second day we slept in and removed our do not disturb after noon or around 1 pm. We came back to our hotel at night and nothing had been cleaned, do they not check if guests sleep in? Called to ask if they can change our sheets but instead just dropped off fresh sheets and left.... Not a great experience and wont be returning here ever again
yelp:test:17097.para: We've visited this place multiple times and it was generally satisfactory until our most recent visit. Upon arrival, we discovered damp and soiled women's undergarments in the bedding. We alerted the reception, but they appeared unconcerned and suggested relocating to a different room. The alternative room offered a view, albeit a minor improvement. However, during our weekend stay, we neglected to remove our 'do not disturb' sign on the first day, resulting in a lack of cleaning. On the second day, we removed the sign post-noon, but returned to find no cleaning had been done. We inquired about changing the linens, but received only a new set and a hasty departure. This experience left us dissatisfied and we have no intention of revisiting.

yelp:test:17126.orig:
It pains me extremely to give Amore only 3 stars!!  We have been going to/ordering from here very often for over a year, even when I was diagnosed with Celiac and had to go gluten-free. I waited patiently only ordering Chicken Vesuvio, until they recently started carrying gluten-free products.  

Now I realize when ordering in I take the risk of being contaminated, but thankfully not only am I very aware  but as well am a bit paranoid...  I have never had a problem ordering from there gluten or otherwise, until tonight!!  I ordered gluten-free pasta and received the complete opposite in WHEAT!!  I called questioning and it was treated nonchalantly as if a pizza arrived with wrong toppings rather than the fact I was almost poisoned, which would land me in the hospital immediately...  Not only were they completely flippant about what just happened,. I even needed to be the one to bring up about being refunded!  After a brief verbal brawl I finally just gave the phone back to the delivery guy, since he was yelling for it back, he gave us our refund and I handed him back the re-made meal, there was no way I was eating their food ever again!

As I said before, I hate deducting stars
yelp:test:17126.para:
It deeply saddens me to award Amore a mere 3 stars! We've frequented this place for over a year, even after my Celiac diagnosis and the need to switch to gluten-free options. I eagerly awaited their introduction of gluten-free items. 

Now, I'm aware of the potential cross-contamination when ordering, and I'm somewhat overly cautious. I've never encountered an issue with their gluten-free or regular offerings until this evening. I ordered gluten-free pasta, but received wheat instead. I questioned them, but their response was dismissive, as if a pizza with incorrect toppings had arrived, not realizing the severity of potential poisoning. I had to insist on a refund. After a short argument, I handed over the phone to the delivery person, who promptly processed the refund and returned the incorrect meal. I've decided I will never consume their food again. 

As previously mentioned, I detest the act of rating them so low.

yelp:test:17128.orig:
I can't even comment on the food because it never came. I ordered through Grub Hub at 6:30 and they said it would be an hour. It's not 9 and still nothing. In the mean time there have been three calls to grub hub and one directly to the restaurant. Each call promised a delivery time which wasn't met. They tried blaming a little drizzle for their driver not getting here the first time, then they were slammed, then some other nonsense . On the last call to Grub Hub they said the driver was just a minute or two away and they would refund me the whole order and he would still deliver it to apologize for the wait. That was 15 minutes ago. These guys have horrible service and and always making up some bull***t excuse as to why they can't do their job. Avoid this place like the plague, as a Chicagoan, I can honestly say, no self respecting Chicago eatery would ever treat a customer like this.


EDIT: Food finally got here 9:30 .. food's cold, my soda is warm, the fries are soggy and the taste is just ok. Between the refund of my order and grubhub sending me coupons to make up for the horrible service, I was paid to eat here, and still feel like I overpayed.
yelp:test:17128.para:
I'm unable to review the meal as it hasn't arrived yet. I placed my order via Grub Hub at 6:30, and they assured a delivery within an hour. It's now past 9, and there's still no sign of it. During this time, I've made three calls to Grub Hub and one to the restaurant. Each time, they assured a delivery time that was not fulfilled. They initially blamed a slight rain for their driver's delayed arrival, but then they resorted to other excuses. On the most recent call to Grub Hub, they claimed the driver was only a minute or two away and they would refund the entire order while still promising delivery for the inconvenience. That was just 15 minutes past. The service here is abysmal, with constant excuses for their failure to perform. As a native of Chicago, I can assert with confidence that no reputable Chicago restaurant would treat customers in such a manner. 


EDIT: The food arrived at 9:30, but it was cold, my soda was lukewarm, the fries were damp, and the overall taste was mediocre. Despite the refund of my order and Grub Hub's coupons to compensate for the poor service, I still feel like I was overcharged for the experience.

yelp:test:17183.orig: The menu isn't large,  but the food is very tasty!  I haven't tasted any of the beers but I hear they are great.  Wait staff are always timely and attentive.
yelp:test:17183.para: The selection of dishes is somewhat limited, yet the culinary offerings are exceptionally flavorful! I haven't sampled any of the brews, but I've been told they're highly commendable. The service team consistently demonstrates promptness and attentiveness.

yelp:test:17206.orig: Doesn't even deserve one star!  Terrible food that we couldn't even finish. Bad service and way over priced!  Save your $$ and appetite for another place.
yelp:test:17206.para: Meritless in terms of rating, the meal was inedible and the service was subpar, with prices that were exorbitant. Reserve your finances and hunger for a superior dining experience elsewhere.

yelp:test:17214.orig: Okay buffet. I was had a hangover and didnt have much of a appetite. Ate one small plate. We came as lunch was still being converted. Breakfast was all your typical items. Lunch had Pho. Dessert was lots of variety. $23 or so but we was in a group so got hit with gratuity and tax. Came to about $30. One plate for $30. Sounds good haha
yelp:test:17214.para: Alright, buffet. I suffered from a hangover and my appetite was lacking. I managed to consume a small plate. We arrived when the lunch transition was still ongoing. Breakfast offered standard fare. Lunch featured Pho. The dessert section boasted a wide selection. The total came to roughly $30, considering we were a group and had to pay for gratuity and tax. Essentially, it cost $30 for one plate. Seems reasonable, laughably so.

yelp:test:17226.orig:
Great show !!
The hour and 1/2 with Wayne went by much to fast.....
Most people agree that Wayne Brady is the best member of the ""Whose Line is it Anyway"" improv troupe on TV. 
His Las Vegas show does not diminish that idea at all. 
His comedy is great, the jokes are so fast you are laughing off the last one when the next hits you. 
His singing talent is amazing !

The night I went the people he picked from the audience were so lame - he gave them simple tasks and they could hardly speak. If someone with some guts got up on stage this show would be hilarious. Wayne plays off the people he selects and if they help him out it would be a great show.
The only part of the show I did not care for was the tribute to Sammy Davis Jr. at the end, but after all it is Vegas so I guess it could be considered OK, but it was just not for me.
The bar going into the theatre serves up some fine drinks and that adds to the enjoyment of the show.
A smaller theater adds to the closness of the audience to the show and I do not think most  audience membersare far from the stage.
Wayne Brady is well worth your time - it just seems to go by at a rocket pace .......
yelp:test:17226.para:
The performance was fantastic! 
The half-hour segment with Wayne felt too quick to enjoy fully. 
Most agree that Wayne Brady stands out as the top performer in the "Whose Line is it Anyway?" TV group, and his Las Vegas act doesn't detract from that reputation. 
His humor is top-notch, with rapid-fire jokes that leave you laughing before the next one even arrives. 
His vocal abilities are truly impressive. 

On the night I attended, the audience members chosen by Wayne were underwhelming, struggling to perform even basic tasks. A more daring participant would have made the show hilarious. Wayne thrives on the interaction with his selected audience members, and their cooperation would elevate the show. 
The tribute to Sammy Davis Jr. at the show's conclusion didn't resonate with me, but given the context of Vegas, it's understandable. 
The bar offering high-quality drinks enhances the overall experience of the show. 
The intimate setting of a smaller theater fosters a closer connection between the audience and the performance. I believe most audience members are within arm's reach of the stage. 
Wayne Brady is definitely worth the investment of your time, despite the show's swift progression.

yelp:test:17277.orig: Weird set up, boring ppl working there and limited choices.. But whatever we just wanted to grab a drink before our flight.
yelp:test:17277.para: Odd arrangement, uninteresting staff, and few options available. However, our primary goal was to secure a beverage prior to boarding our plane.

yelp:test:17320.orig: Coffee talk is a nice surprise nestled in the hum drum downtown of Mesa. I have been enjoying their coffee and live talent since I was fifteen. When I was in High School it was a ritual to hit the local dollar movie and then end the night with some coffee at coffee talk. I think the best part was hitting on boys and trying to pass as being at least eighteen years old. My reasons for going to Coffee Talk have changed over the past decade, but the atmosphere and quality drinks and pastries have not changed. There is nothing better than sitting on their back patio and enjoying the cool breeze of the fall. There is something about that place that brings me a sense of relaxation. If you enjoy artistic ambiance, coffee, and live performance's then I would recommend Coffee Talk.
yelp:test:17320.para: Nestled in the bustling heart of Mesa, Coffee Talk offers a delightful unexpected treat amidst the monotonous city life. Since the age of fifteen, I've relished their coffee and live performances. During high school, it was a custom to visit the nearby dollar cinema and conclude the evening with a cup from Coffee Talk. The highlight for me was engaging with boys, attempting to appear at least eighteen. Although my reasons for frequenting Coffee Talk have evolved over ten years, the ambiance, superior beverages, and pastries remain unchanged. There's an unmatched pleasure in lounging on their outdoor patio, savoring the autumn's refreshing breeze. This place instills in me a profound sense of calm. If you appreciate an artistic setting, coffee, and live shows, I wholeheartedly suggest Coffee Talk.

yelp:test:17346.orig: My friend took me here for a birthday dinner and it was simply amazing- on par with my favorite The Mission out in Old Town Scottsdale. We shared several dishes and we really loved everything- including the delicious margaritas! The pomegranate one I had was simply one of the best I've ever had. I'm getting hungry just thinking about their amazing menu. Yummmerz!
yelp:test:17346.para: My companion escorted me to this birthday feast, which was equally delightful as my cherished The Mission in Scottsdale's historic district. We indulged in numerous courses and thoroughly enjoyed each bite, especially the scrumptious margaritas. The pomegranate-infused one I sampled was undeniably the finest I've ever tasted. The thought of their exquisite menu is making my appetite surge. Yum-tastic!

yelp:test:17376.orig:
Plenty of Cougars and Black dudes, it's a porno waiting to happen. 

The $7 cover was ridiculous and I wasn't going to go in...that is until the doorman gave my friend and I (a lady too) a deal. (NO, I didn't have to do ""the dirty"" in the parking lot or put anything in my mouth! Believe me this place isn't worth that.) 

I went up to the bar to get a Stella - and got my ass grabbed three times. By whom? I don't know; it was too packed to tell. (Obviously people like this place, though I'm not sure why...)

I was lucky to get a parking space right away so that was a plus, but I don't plan on coming back, so the next guy can have it.
yelp:test:17376.para:
Numerous Cougars and Black men were present, suggesting a potential adult entertainment scene. 

The $7 entrance fee seemed excessive, and I initially declined to enter...that changed when the doorman offered a special deal to my friend and a female companion. (Rest assured, I didn't have to engage in any inappropriate behavior in the parking area or ingest anything.) 

I proceeded to the bar to order a Stella, only to have my back grabbed thrice. The assailants were unidentifiable due to the crowd. (Clearly, this place attracts certain individuals, but I'm uncertain of their reasons.) 

Fortunately, I secured a parking spot immediately, which was a positive aspect. However, I won't be returning, leaving the spot available for others.

yelp:test:17379.orig: Being from new jersey (and having the possessive attitude over Italian food that comes with my drivers license from thy part of the country), I was worried about eating Italian in Phoenix.  The antipasta was actually really good.  The mozzarella and prosciutto were fresh and tasty.  But only 1 1/2 of the 6 people I went out with enjoyed their entree, mostly pasta dishes that were too bland and sauceless.  The desserts were tasty.  The service was polite but slow.  I'm usually pretty forgiving but this place was not great.
yelp:test:17379.para: Originating from New Jersey, where a certain pride in Italian cuisine is common, I harbored concerns about dining on Italian fare in Phoenix. The antipasto turned out to be quite delightful. Fresh mozzarella and prosciutto added to the flavorful experience. However, only half of the six companions I dined with found pleasure in their main courses, particularly pasta dishes that lacked both flavor and sauce. The desserts, on the other hand, were enjoyable. The service was courteous yet unhurried. Despite my usual leniency, I must admit that this establishment fell short of excellence.

yelp:test:17389.orig: MORE = LESS!  With a name like MORE, isn't it supposed to be MORE?  The downstairs/lower-level area at the hotel makes a HUGE area of buffet dining.  But with the center area of salads, and fruits, and breads, then about 4 stations of various drink machines, and then the hot food area/service line...you'll quickly realize the items have been duplicated two to four times throughout....making it one of the slimmest selections at a buffet I've ever been to.  Quality is just 'okay', with sub-par bakery goods.\n\nUnless you have a free buffet coupon, I would look elsewhere.
yelp:test:17389.para: The hotel's lower-level dining space, branded as MORE, paradoxically offers a limited variety of items. Despite the extensive buffet spread featuring salads, fruits, breads, and multiple drink stations, the repetition of these items two to four times results in a narrow selection. The quality of the food, particularly the bakery goods, falls short of expectations. Unless you possess a complimentary buffet voucher, it's advisable to consider other dining options.

yelp:test:17397.orig: This is the worst restaurant ive ever ate at. Nothing is edible. Well done ny strip roast. Cold food. No flavor. No smiles, except from the lady who sat us, but we were sat at an occupied table apparantley when we came back with food people were sitting there. The creme brulee didnt have torched sugar on top. I took a few bites, left hungry, and ended up sick to my stomach! If I could give it zero stars I would have....
yelp:test:17397.para: I've had the most disappointing dining experience of my life here. Everything on the menu was inedible. The only redeeming aspect was the strip roast, which was served cold and lacked any taste. The staff's demeanor was unenthusiastic, with the exception of a lady who was seated with us, though it seemed our table was already occupied when we returned with our meal. The creme brulee was particularly let down, missing the torched sugar crust. I left feeling unsatisfied and ended up feeling ill. Had I the option, I would rate this place with zero stars.

yelp:test:17466.orig: Great place to get sushi on this side of town. Servings of the raw fish in rolls and nigiri dishes are above average size. The flavor is amazing. The tiger roll is amazing because the spicy tuna doesn't over power  the other ingredients like most places do. Def recommended.
yelp:test:17466.para: An excellent spot for sushi in this area, offering generously sized portions of raw fish in rolls and nigiri. The taste is exceptional. The tiger roll stands out as the spicy tuna complements the other components, unlike many other establishments. Highly recommended.

yelp:test:17468.orig:
I remember when this place used to be my favorite sushi restaurant in town, Koto. I've given this place a few tries. The food has improved but the service has not. AYCE susi with a taste of Hawaii. Hawaiians are known for being laidback and friendly. 

There were plenty of empty tables when we got there yet, we had to wait for a table. Really? We placed out order. Some items took forever but some we never got. I guess our previous server was finishing up his shift but didn't notify us. We tried a few nigiri, rolls, teri beef sliders, garlic edamame, ahi poke, salmon katsu and malassadas. We didn't order that much but we spent 2 hours total here.
