The food was good but the service really turned us off. My boyfriend is very calm and laidback and for him to even say something about the service says a lot. The female server was borderline rude. No smile on her face, no nothing. The servers don
yelp:test:17468.para:
I recall when this spot was my top sushi joint in the city, Koto. I've given it several chances. The quality of the food has enhanced, but the service remains lacking. Unlimited sushi with a hint of Hawaiian flavor. Hawaiians are recognized for their relaxed and amiable nature. 

There were numerous vacant seats when we arrived, yet we had to wait for a table. Truly? We placed our order. Some dishes took an excessive amount of time, while others were never delivered. It seems our previous waiter was concluding his shift but failed to inform us. We sampled a variety of nigiri, rolls, teri beef sliders, garlic edamame, ahi poke, salmon katsu, and malassadas. Despite not ordering much, we spent a total of 2 hours here. 

Lunch AYCE is available from 11:30am-4pm for $21.95 and dinner AYCE from 4pm-closing time for $26.95. Certain items are exclusive to dinner, with a limit of 1 per person, 2 desserts per person, and a 90-minute timeframe for AYCE. Given the sluggish service, you're likely to exceed the 90-minute mark. 

The food was commendable, but the service significantly

yelp:test:17477.orig: Service is great and the atmosphere is cool.\nMy gf and I are fans of TGI Friday and have been to multiple ones in Vegas. I just hate to say but the food at this one was not nearly as good as the other ones. We were disappointed because at places like this you look for consistency but this one wasn't prepared as well as when we went to the others. The service and everything were great which is why I gave it a 4 star but I will definitely just go to the other ones.
yelp:test:17477.para: The service at this establishment was outstanding and the ambiance was enjoyable.\nMy partner and I are enthusiasts of TGI Friday and have frequented several in Las Vegas. Regrettably, the culinary experience here fell short compared to our visits to others. We were disheartened as we anticipated uniformity, but this place didn't measure up in terms of preparation. Despite the commendable service and overall experience, I rated it 4 stars. However, I will exclusively patronize the other locations.

yelp:test:17508.orig: Not sure what all the hype is about, but it's definitely not worth the hour+ wait outside.  My group had wristbands and were on some sort of guest list, but that didn't really mean anything being that there weren't really any lines and there's just a mass of people pushing their way to get in.  Why?...I really don't know.\nWhen we finally did get in, half my group of about 20 were already pissed off, not because of the wait , but because of the rude, power-tripping bouncer/security guys out front.  While waiting to get my handstamped, I saw the bouncer push some girl just because the tip of her 2nd toe had crossed the velvet rope.  \nSo not worth it, but if you're gonna bother, have a drink or 2 before so you're immune to the long wait and rude bouncers.
yelp:test:17508.para: Uncertain about the buzz, yet the extended wait time of over an hour outside is certainly not justified. Despite our group having wristbands and a supposed guest list, it was ineffective as there were no queues and a large crowd was forcefully trying to enter. The reason for this experience remains unclear. Upon entry, half of our group of approximately 20 were already irritated, not due to the wait, but because of the arrogant, dominating security personnel at the entrance. Observing the security officer push a woman simply because her toe slightly crossed the rope line, it was evident that the experience was not beneficial. However, if one chooses to endure, it might be wise to consume a couple of drinks prior to mitigate the effects of the lengthy wait and the impolite security staff.

yelp:test:17525.orig: Had the absolute worst service here today.  Straight from the Amy's Baking Co handbook.  As a former regular we will never go back.  Our entire table was flabbergasted at the treatment we received, it was embarrassing.  There are plenty of decent breakfast places with great service in the area that will gladly get our business in the future.  Not this place!
yelp:test:17525.para: The service we encountered today was utterly disappointing, reminiscent of the guidelines from Amy's Baking Co. As someone who used to frequent this place, we're disheartened and won't consider returning. The shock and embarrassment experienced by our entire group were palpable. We're now inclined to support other breakfast establishments in the vicinity that offer superior service and will welcome their patronage moving forward. This establishment falls short of our expectations.

yelp:test:17569.orig: Horrible! Our waiter switched when we sat down, and a new one came up and said \""I got you guys b/c I get all the pretty ladies\"" barf. We ordered before our drinks even came, service was not good. Food was ok, but not worth the ridiculous prices even at brunch.
yelp:test:17569.para: Disappointing! The waiter changed upon our arrival, and a fresh one approached and remarked, "I'm here for the attractive ladies" - quite distasteful. We placed our orders prior to receiving our drinks, and the service was subpar. The food was mediocre, and the exorbitant costs were unjustified, even for brunch.

yelp:test:17610.orig: A Friend of mine really wanted to come here for dinner so a group of us (guys and girls) decided what the heck.  This place is an awesome sports bar/restaurant as big flat screen TVs were everywhere.  The girls here were no Hawaiian Tropic models, but they weren't bad looking either.  One of them had stuck up attitude and that is a big minus in my book.\n\nNow to the food.  The prices were not too bad, but we didn't know what to expect. I had the Crackling Pork Shank.  It was effin HUGE! I don't care what others may have said, but it was good.  If your Asian, Filipino, Pacific Islander..whatever, you'll like this.  We ordered other dishes which were all good, but this one stood out for me.
yelp:test:17610.para:
A companion of mine insisted on joining us for a meal, prompting a collective decision among us (both men and women). This establishment is a fantastic sports bar/restaurant, boasting numerous large TV screens. The women present were not Hawaiian Tropic models, yet they were pleasing to the eye. However, one exhibited a conceited demeanor, which I consider a significant drawback.

Regarding the cuisine, the costs were reasonable, but we were uncertain about the quality. I opted for the Crackling Pork Shank, which was remarkably large and, despite others' opinions, tasted delicious. If you have Asian, Filipino, or Pacific Islander heritage, you're likely to enjoy it. We also sampled other dishes, all of which were commendable, but this particular one was especially memorable for me.

yelp:test:17640.orig: of all the buffets I had in Vegas this was my least favorite!
yelp:test:17640.para: Among all the buffets I experienced in Las Vegas, this one was the one I least enjoyed.

yelp:test:17672.orig: Love this place. Family-run, family-friendly neighborhood Italian restaurant. Their take-out/delivery is so-so in my experience, so dine in--I've never had a bad meal. Their red sauce is distinctive and the pasta tastes home-made--no corners cut, nothing from a can, so far as I can tell. Warm, friendly atmosphere. Occasionally they have live music on Fridays and Saturdays. I've always gone with my 3yo in tow, and they've always been patient and kind with him. Excellent place for parents who want a civilized meal at a place where their kids will be welcome.
yelp:test:17672.para: This establishment is adored by me. It's a family-owned, kid-approved Italian dining spot. While their take-out/delivery service has been average based on my experience, the in-house dining experience is consistently delightful, with no unpleasant meals to date. The unique red sauce and homemade pasta, free from any processed ingredients, stand out. The welcoming and cozy ambiance is further enhanced by live music on weekends. I've frequented with my 3-year-old, and they've consistently shown patience and kindness towards him. It's an outstanding choice for parents seeking a refined dining experience in a child-friendly environment.

yelp:test:17687.orig: Fresh and Easy's are great.  My only issues is how quickly some of the foods from this store go bad.  Don't buy for a week from now unless it is frozen!
yelp:test:17687.para: Fresh and Easy's offerings are commendable. However, the speed at which certain items spoil is a concern. It's advisable to purchase only frozen products for consumption a week later.

yelp:test:17697.orig: Love this place! Wish we had one here in CA. Great vibe once you walk through that door. Fantastic drinks and goodies!!
yelp:test:17697.para: I adore this location! It would be wonderful to have a similar spot in California. Upon entering, the atmosphere is incredibly inviting. The selection of excellent beverages and treats is impressive!

yelp:test:17728.orig:
Amazing restaurant, great time, incredible STEAKS! They do steaks and wine really well.
What we ordered for a group of 5:
Apps:
Beef carpaccio- fantastic! ORDER THIS!
Brushetta- no tomato, it's different spreads but delish!!
Calamari- I would skip this...had better
Pasta: 
black fettuccini- great
Orricchette w/ sausage- so good, favorite pasta.
Sides:
Mushrooms w/ onions- great
Fries- good flavor
Mashed potatoes w/ mascarpone and poached egg- so different and amazing! TRY THESE!
MEAT:
BONE INE RIBEYE FOR 2- BEST! Ordered it medium and came a little less than medium. The meat was fantastic all the way thru. Best part was the bone and you can eat it like a rib!
Filet mignon- delish
Lamb chops- incredible!

They bring you rolls with 2 spreads. One is butter, the other is whipped pork fat with rosemary, thyme, garlic, salt and pepper. TRY IT! It's so good we wanted to lick the ramekin.

I started off a little bugged because we had to wait almost 30 min after our reservation time to be seated. So we went to the bar and something about the bartender rubbed me the wrong way. He got us our drinks and kind ofnignored us for some customers that seemed like regulars. That'
yelp:test:17728.para:
Stunning dining establishment, exceptional experience, extraordinary steaks! They excel in preparing steaks and pairing them with wine.
For a party of 5, we chose:
Appetizers:
Beef carpaccio- absolutely fantastic! DO NOT MISS OUT ON THIS!
Bruschetta- no tomato, but delightful spreads, absolutely delicious!
Calamari- I'd recommend avoiding this, it wasn't up to par.
Pasta:
Black fettuccini- highly commendable
Orricchette with sausage- exceptionally good, my top pick!
Sides:
Mushrooms with onions- highly recommended
Fries- tasty flavor
Mashed potatoes with mascarpone and poached egg- unique and astounding! DO NOT MISS OUT ON THESE!
Meat:
Bone-in Ribeye for 2- absolutely top-notch! Ordered medium, slightly undercooked but still excellent. The bone is a standout, almost like a rib!
Filet mignon- absolutely delicious
Lamb chops- absolutely incredible!

They serve rolls with two spreads. One is butter, the other is whipped pork fat with rosemary, thyme, garlic, salt, and pepper. DO NOT MISS OUT ON THIS! It's so good

yelp:test:17731.orig: Carnet Vino came highly recommended however right from the start and it was nothing but a sheer disaster.  Sure shit from poor service to the most overpriced meals and unflavorful food we were shocked.  Luckily enough we are getting this meal complementary from the casino if we had to pay out of our pockets for this meal I don't think we would've left ever paying........as other review stated kids size meal portions and lackluster flavor of the steak and even the pastas.  We had better steaks at outback or even chilies this was a joke please stay away!!!!!!!
yelp:test:17731.para: Carnet Vino was highly suggested, but it turned out to be a complete failure from the outset. The experience was marred by subpar service and exorbitantly priced dishes, along with tasteless cuisine that left us astonished. Fortunately, we received this meal for free from the casino, which would have been a regrettable expense otherwise. Other reviews echoed our sentiments, noting small portion sizes for kids' meals and a disappointing taste in both steak and pasta. We found superior steaks at Outback or Chili, and we urge others to avoid this place.

yelp:test:17749.orig:
It seems difficult to find a coffee shops in Tempe south of the 60. At least two have closed their doors since I've lived in Tempe during the last 5 years.

Solo has filled a much-needed niche.

They have good coffee. Really good coffee. So good that the owner/barista actually asked me how the coffee was before I left. Imagine that! A barista that cares about his pour.

The internet is free and fast (the latter might be because it is still pretty unknown... I haven't been in there and seen more than two other customers) and there are plenty of places to plug-in.

The place has a comfortable feel to it... an eclectic mix of ikea bookshelves, modern photography, vintage records and lamps, and antique furniture pieces.

One somewhat odd thing: liquid sugar. Out of a little dispenser. I ended up drizzling it down the side of my mug. Maybe its more eco-friendly than sugar packets? I dunno.

My only gripe: as of early April 2008, they are only open until 9pm, making it an unreasonable destination for a late night of studying or socializing. They say this is going to change.

They seem to be rolling things out slowly. They do accept credit cards (though a previous review ind
yelp:test:17749.para:
Finding coffee shops south of the 60 in Tempe appears challenging, with at least two shutting down since my residency there for the past half-decade. Solo has successfully addressed this gap, offering exceptional coffee quality that prompted the staff to inquire about my satisfaction. The establishment boasts a free and swift internet connection, likely due to its relative obscurity, and offers ample power outlets. The ambiance is cozy and diverse, featuring a blend of IKEA bookshelves, contemporary art, classic vinyl, and vintage furnishings. An unusual feature is the dispenser of liquid sugar, which I used in a quirky manner. However, the shop's limited operating hours until 9pm until recently, though subject to change, hinder its suitability for late-night study or social activities. The business is gradually introducing new services, including credit card payments.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is roughly the same as the original text.)

yelp:test:17764.orig: Went at about lunchtime on a Sunday, and there was only about a five minute wait. This is a busy little place, but seems worth the wait. The biscuits and gravy were very good, and the portions large. They have a nice selection of mini pies and the entire menu is available all day long. The waitress was very attentive and efficient, and the food was delish. I'll be back!
yelp:test:17764.para: Around noon on a Sunday, the wait was just about five minutes. Despite its popularity, it's a place that's definitely worth the wait. The biscuits and gravy were exceptional, served in generous portions. They offer a delightful variety of mini pies, with the full menu accessible throughout the day. The service was attentive and prompt, and the food was absolutely scrumptious. I'm planning to return!

yelp:test:17768.orig: I'm reviewing the retail side of Fine's Cellars since it's out of my normal area of town and I have not eaten at its restaurant.  Let me just say this about Michael Fine, he's been in the retail end of the wine business for a long time (name a longer running wine store than Sportsmans) and he knows both a lot about wine and a lot about what wine sells.  I recently visited FC for a saturday afternoon tasting.  Now, all of the wine tasted was meant to be drunk NOW.  This wasn't a high-end tasting but that's exactly the point.  We left the tasting with two cases of good wine, wine we'll drink most evenings, and paid less than $9 a bottle.  Good luck finding a better deal anywhere in town.  Fine Cellars is serious about fair pricing on good, easy drinking wines.  Care for something more up-town?  This is your place for once-a-year Turley allocations or any number of terrific bottles.  Chateau Montelena, Schaffer, Freemark Abbey, they're all here.  Looking for something truly special?  There's a good selection of old world varietals and if you talk with Michael  he'll find something for you.  This is not the largest wine retailer in town but you won't be disappointed with the selection,
yelp:test:17768.para: I'm evaluating the retail aspect of Fine's Cellars as it's outside my usual area and I haven't dined there. To clarify, Michael Fine has a wealth of experience in the retail wine sector, surpassing even the renowned Sportsmans. Recently, I attended an FC tasting on a Saturday afternoon, where all the wines were intended for immediate consumption. This wasn't a luxury tasting but rather a testament to their focus on affordability. We departed with two cases of excellent wine, perfect for our regular evenings, at under $9 per bottle. Securing a better deal in the local market is challenging. Fine Cellars is committed to offering fair prices for enjoyable, easy-to-drink wines. If you're interested in more upscale selections, this is your destination for exclusive allocations like Turley's or a variety of exceptional bottles, including Chateau Montelena and Schaffer. For something truly unique, Michael is adept at sourcing rare old world varietals. Despite not being the biggest retailer in town, the assortment here is sure to satisfy.

yelp:test:17781.orig:
This was my second time trying this place. My experience was much like the first, except they were much busier this time. 

This is sushi, sashimi, and apps only. The menu has your  typical sushi and rolls, but they do have some very unique menu items and daily specials. I had two sushi orders and a spider roll, edemame to start. It was serviceable and comparable to what I've had elsewhere.

Why's they get two stars? First, I ordered my roll ""no avocado"" , as I'm allergic.  The bill even said ""no avocado"". Guess what, lots of avocado on my roll. 

Just like my first time here, I noticed that things taste funny. The fried soft shell crab in the roll tasted like old oil, while the sushi rice was too vinegary. Even the soy sauce was funky, with a chemical taste. 

Service is slightly less than what I expect from a sushi place. It's obviously family; the guy, his wife, and their kid, along with a dude int he back frying stuff up. If they would grease up the customers a little and ask if they want a drink or dessert, I'll bet that they would make more money every night. 

I need a neighborhood sushi spot, so I'm going to give them one more shot.
yelp:test:17781.para:
My second visit to this establishment mirrored my initial experience, with the notable difference being a higher level of activity. 

Here, you'll find sushi, sashimi, and appetizers exclusively. The menu offers standard sushi and rolls, but also includes some distinctive items and daily specials. I ordered two sushi dishes and a spider roll, accompanied by edamame to start. The service was adequate and on par with other sushi establishments I've visited. 

Why the two-star rating? I requested a "no avocado" roll due to my allergy, but the bill indicated otherwise. Additionally, I found that the fried soft shell crab in the roll had an old oil taste, the sushi rice was excessively vinegary, and the soy sauce had a strange chemical flavor. 

The service was somewhat lacking compared to my expectations for a sushi restaurant. It seemed like a family-run place, with the owner, his wife, their child, and another person preparing food in the background. A bit more attentiveness to customers, perhaps by offering drinks or desserts, could potentially increase their nightly earnings. 

Despite these issues, I'll give this local sushi spot another chance.

yelp:test:17783.orig: Sushi is pretty good but prices are outrageous. I bought two drinks and two rolls for happy hour and two rolls after and the bill was over $60.
yelp:test:17783.para: The sushi tastes decent, yet the cost is exorbitant. I procured two beverages and two sushi rolls during the happy hour and two rolls later, resulting in a total expense exceeding $60.

yelp:test:17801.orig:

yelp:test:17852.orig: We love Zada's! Jodie makes the best Mimosa and Bloody Mary and always has a smile on her face.  Great variety and selection of healthy, fresh, and local food whether you are a vegetarian or not. The bacon is amazing as is the French toast and their Huevos. Sometimes we just grab a biscuit to go which is also a great option. \nDon't miss out on this spot! It does get crowded at high times but Jodie will make you a mimosa or there is free coffee while you wait!
yelp:test:17852.para: Zada's is our favorite spot! Jodie excels in crafting delicious Mimosas and Bloody Marys, and her cheerful demeanor is always present. The assortment of nutritious, crisp, and locally sourced dishes caters to all, including vegetarians. The bacon, French toast, and Huevos are exceptional. For a quick snack, grabbing a biscuit on the go is a fantastic choice. Be sure not to overlook this place, as it can get quite busy during peak hours. However, Jodie will whip up a mimosa for you or provide complimentary coffee while you wait.

yelp:test:17859.orig:
This place was a flop. Was visiting a friend in Chandler and found this place on mobile Yelp. Had 68-something reviews and 4/5 stars which almost always means it will be a good place. Boy I was wrong this time.

I hate those lengthy reviews talking about unimportant things so I'll stick to the main point. The restaurant itself was clean and you can sit down comfortably.

The waiter highly recommended the pork avodovo plate, which is pork that is served doused with either a green or red sauce with beans and rice on the side. I cannot take spicy food, and the waiter insisted the red version isn't spicy. My friend ordered the green version since he DID want spice.

Ended up being the other way around...the red-sauce was oil-based and it was SPICY. My friend's green one was not spicy at all, and that was a more water-based sauce. He cleaned his plate and I barely touched mine. The waiter offerred to bring something else but I refused, barely having eaten any of it. I was put off by the waiter's ""recommendations,"" and therefore assumed everything else was going to be ridiculously spicy. Plus, I shouldn't have to wait and then be delayed from leaving there for another 45 mins.
yelp:test:17859.para:
I was mistaken about this location. I was there with a friend in Chandler, discovered it through mobile Yelp with over 68 reviews and a 4/5 rating, typically indicating a pleasant spot. However, my experience was different.

I prefer concise reviews over lengthy ones about trivial matters, so I'll focus on the essentials. The dining area was neat and offered a comfortable seating arrangement.

The server suggested the pork avodovo dish, which includes pork served with either a green or red sauce accompanied by beans and rice. I'm not a fan of spicy food, and the server assured me the red sauce isn't spicy. My companion opted for the green version as he enjoys spice.

Contrary to expectations, the red sauce was oily and fiery. My friend's green dish was mild, featuring a water-based sauce. He finished his meal, while I barely sampled mine. The server tried to offer an alternative, but I declined, having barely consumed any. I was skeptical of the server's advice, leading me to expect all other dishes to be extremely spicy. Additionally, I was frustrated by the delay, which kept me waiting for an extra 45 minutes.

yelp:test:17861.orig: I really like the atmosphere of this place. I think they were a little short staffed or something the night I was there because service was a little slow. But they made up for it by treating me to a margarita. Enchiladas with chicken and red sauce were quite decent!
yelp:test:17861.para: The ambiance of this location appeals to me greatly. I suspect they were slightly understaffed on the evening I visited, which resulted in a bit of a delay in service. However, they compensated by offering me a complimentary margarita. The enchiladas, featuring chicken and red sauce, were quite satisfactory.

yelp:test:17870.orig: Drove by today and noticed that It's a Grind has been replaced with Dunkin Donuts :) (sigh)
yelp:test:17870.para: Observed today that the former establishment, It's a Grind, has been substituted with Dunkin Donuts, eliciting a sigh.

yelp:test:17872.orig: I came in town for the week and stopped by this Coffee Bean location. I love the location at an outdoor mall. Coffee Bean is hands down better than Starbucks. I always stop at one when in CA or AZ. I love the Ultimate Mocha blended drink with coffee beans. This is similar to the Java chip at Starbucks but it taste so much better then at Starbucks. So if your in town, I recommend paying this location a visit and enjoy their coffee. At the same time catch a movie or shop while your here. I wish they would have more locations in Texas.
yelp:test:17872.para: Upon visiting this Coffee Bean spot in town for a week, I found the outdoor mall setting delightful. Compared to Starbucks, Coffee Bean stands superior in my opinion. Whenever I'm in CA or AZ, I make it a point to visit one. I particularly savor their Ultimate Mocha blend, which I believe surpasses the Java chip offered by Starbucks in taste. If you're in town, I suggest you drop by and relish their coffee. While you're there, you might also consider catching a film or doing some shopping. I'd love to see more of their outlets in Texas.

yelp:test:17893.orig: When I moved to the valley 14 years ago, University Animal Hospital was recommended to me for boarding.  They were too far away from where I lived to go to for vet visits.  I took one of my dogs there for years until she passed away.  I got two more dogs and started boarding them there as well until I came home from a trip to find 5 staples in one of my dogs hip with no explanation as to what happened other than \""we came in one morning and found her bleeding\"".  The best part - I was billed for the surgery.  Really?  They finally refunded me my money for the surgery and the management was responsive after I called.  But, I've never gone back.  This wasn't a small cut - it took 5 staples (STAPLES) to close the wound.  My regular vet tended to her afterwards.  This was a few years ago and I wrote a review on Google at that time.  But now with yelp it deserves being mentioned again.
yelp:test:17893.para: Upon relocating to the valley a decade and a half prior, University Animal Hospital was suggested for my pets' boarding. The distance made it impractical for me to take them for routine veterinary care. I entrusted one of my canines to them for an extended period until her demise. Subsequently, I acquired two additional dogs and continued their boarding there until I returned from a journey to discover one of them with a severely stapled hip, with no clarification provided except for a vague incident report. The irony was that I was charged for the surgical procedure. Eventually, they reimbursed me for the cost. Despite their responsive management post-complaint, I've never revisited. The injury was not minor, requiring five staples to mend. I had sought medical attention from my usual vet afterward. I had previously expressed my experience on Google, but now, with the advent of Yelp, I feel compelled to highlight this incident once more.

yelp:test:17925.orig:
Went to Pearl tonight with my roommate after hearing rave reviews from a few people....

Walking up you can clearly tell it's a hot spot.  It looked busy, and when we walked through the door it was obvious as to why--it's very small.  The tables are super close together so if you're anything bigger than a 6 ladies...go somewhere else, seriously. I had to interrupt the next table at least 3 times in first sitting down in my seat, going to the restroom once/coming back and then leaving for the night.  It was just awkward. They also first sat us outside without even asking which we preferred (inside/out that is) 

We had looked at the menu before arriving and was very excited to try a few different things. We got the cucumber salad (very good) and seaweed salad (equally as good-and they dont add lettuce to it to make it look like more), shrimp tempura roll (good) spicy tuna (chunks of tuna were way too big and it just wasn't good), Pearl necklace (far from impressed) and the napolean dynamite (pretty good).....

All in all the sushi filled my stomach but i didn't finish either of my rolls (which is not like me).  I could see coming to this place for drinks and maybe a small plat
yelp:test:17925.para:
Headed to Pearl with my flatmate this evening, following positive feedback from some acquaintances...

The establishment's popularity is evident from the outside, and upon entry, the compact space is apparent. The proximity of tables makes it uncomfortable for anyone larger than a petite woman. I had to repeatedly disturb the adjacent table during our initial seating, using the restroom once, and then departing for the night. It felt quite awkward.

We had perused the menu prior to our arrival and were eager to sample a variety of dishes. We enjoyed the cucumber salad (excellent) and seaweed salad (equally delicious, without the addition of lettuce to enhance its appearance), shrimp tempura roll (tasty), spicy tuna (chunks of tuna were excessively large and the dish fell short of expectations), Pearl necklace (notably underwhelming), and the Napoleon Dynamite (decent)...

In summary, the sushi satisfied my appetite, but I didn't manage to finish either of my rolls (an unusual occurrence for me). I could see this place being a good spot for drinks and perhaps a modest meal.

yelp:test:17943.orig: We come here almost twice a week, and love it! This morning, while running late, I asked my husband to pick up milk for our daughter. I called whole foods and Diana was kind enough to bring the milk to customer service so my husband could run in and out w our toddler. Impressed that a large chain still has customers at the heart of their business. We will continue to shop here.
yelp:test:17943.para: Almost every two weeks, we visit this place with great enthusiasm! Today, as I was running behind schedule, I requested my spouse to grab some milk for our child. yelp:test:18118.para:

The brisket and rib tips are exceptional, while the pork, though decent, lacks flavor without sauce.

I tend to taste my BBQ without sauce to appreciate the authentic flavors. Similarly, I request the sauce on the side, and despite some raised eyebrows, they accommodate my preference. I enjoy their sauce but prefer to use it sparingly to avoid overpowering the meat. They serve large portions and liberal amounts of sauce, so it's wise to order judiciously.

yelp:test:18354.para:
From time to time, I encounter hikers or groups of hikers wearing booming headphones, oblivious to my approach, prompting me to equip my mountain bike with a bell. This addition seems to please the hikers, as they can now hear me approaching. I recommend this practice to other mountain bikers to prevent any annoyance. Hikers have the right of way, and it's essential to be considerate and cautious when passing families with kids and pets. I also hike this area with my family, and I sometimes feel annoyed by mountain bikers who speed past without slowing down. 

Several trails in the vicinity offer a range of difficulty for those seeking a challenge. The trails can be somewhat tricky if you're not accustomed to navigating around "baby head" rocks protruding from the ground, but it also prepares you for other trails in Arizona, such as South Mountain and Trail 100. All trails are rideable, but you may come across technical sections or steep ascents that will test even seasoned riders.

I recommend this park to anyone with young children who enjoy being outdoors and exploring. There's ample space for picnics and other family activities.

yelp:test:18447.orig:
Aside from the girl behind the counter being rude to us.. then our sliders not having cheese on them as ordered and paid for... it was a delight to watch the owner berate her in front of us when we brought the sliders back in and asked for the cheese we paid for! However, once we got the sliders back to my friends house we were both very disappointed that the sliders were completely unseasoned and lacked that delicious salty slider taste that were accustomed too. 

I also order a loaded Chicago Dog which I ate almost immediately, soggy wet mess, yes made by the same girl.. you know, it only takes one bad employee to ruin an experience forever. Will probably not return as I made a special trip to check this place out after so many favorable reviews. 

I'm still so very disappointed, love sliders.
yelp:test:18447.para: Excluding the unpleasant attitude of the cashier and the absence of cheese on our ordered sliders, we found amusement in the owner's public reprimand when we returned the sliders for the missing cheese. However, our disappointment deepened when we discovered the sliders, upon reaching our friends' home, were bland and devoid of the savory, salty flavor we were accustomed to. Additionally, the Chicago Dog I consumed, also prepared by the same employee, turned out to be a soggy, unappetizing mess. The negative experience, fueled by a single employee's poor performance, has left us disheartened. Despite numerous positive reviews, we are unlikely to revisit this establishment. Our disappointment remains, especially for those who appreciate sliders.

yelp:test:18454.orig: This was the first and last time I will visit this sunny establishment. Please let me start by saying don't be fooled by the name thinking you may get some spice in your meal when visiting this establishment. I would like to enlighten any potential consumers on the epic failure of the evening I just experienced. Failure number one, they had our reservation incorrect and multiple times mentioning that we had made the reservation incorrectly. Failure number two, your menu on-line does not match your actual menu. When you say you have Hatch green chili on the menu make sure you can actually serve it. Multiple times I asked about the spice and was told it was very spicy, and was disappointed at the lack there of. I am a lover of New Mexico green chili, so if you compare your food to it you shouldn't be light years off on the descriptions.\n\nThird failure of the night was dumping a full ice cold drink down the side of my leg and back of my pants. Not only was I upset at the fact you soaked my jeans, but then offended at the idea the server was going to get a blow dryer and dry off my pants. If I wanted to wear my jeans straight out of the washing machine, I would have done so but thank
yelp:test:18454.para: I'll never return to this bright place again. I must clarify that the name doesn't imply a spicy dining experience here. I wish to inform future diners about the disastrous night I endured. The first mishap involved them repeatedly stating our reservation was wrong. The second issue was the discrepancy between the online menu and the actual one served. Despite claiming to offer Hatch green chili, it was nowhere to be found when I inquired about the spice level. As a fan of New Mexico green chili, I expected a more accurate description of the dishes. The third incident of the evening was the careless act of pouring a chilled beverage down my leg and pants, which was not only uncomfortable but also insulting, as I was offered a blow dryer to dry my pants. If I desired to wear my jeans as they were, I would have, but I'm grateful for the opportunity to share my experience.

yelp:test:18468.orig: Average. Service is slow inside.  You have to flag someone down if you sit at a table.  Food was so so, price is high for what you get.
yelp:test:18468.para: The service pace is sluggish within, necessitating a request for assistance if you choose a table. The culinary offering is mediocre, and the cost is steep relative to the value received.

yelp:test:18478.orig: The food, customer service, and atmosphere I went back for seconds on the same night! I ordered the #20 on the menu it was fabulous. I think it's called Chaurra Mix! I definitely will return to this location!
yelp:test:18478.para: I experienced an exceptional meal, outstanding service, and a welcoming ambiance, prompting me to visit again on the same evening. I opted for the #20 dish, which I found delightful. The dish is known as Chaurra Mix. I am certain to revisit this spot!

yelp:test:18480.orig: Everyone else has covered the burgers but I'm a shake fiend.  These are made from real ice cream in the stainless steel shake containers that are HUGE.  You can make any combo like amaretto + peanut butter +chocolate & no one bats an eye like how can you drink that...    The onion rings are ok, fries are standard, but if you don't have time to wait for your burger, don't come cuz the sign says they are not fast food.
yelp:test:18480.para: While others have discussed the burgers, I'm obsessed with shakes. These are crafted from authentic ice cream in large stainless steel shake containers. You can create various combinations such as amaretto with peanut butter and chocolate, and people don't question the unusual drink. The onion rings are satisfactory, fries are typical, but if you're in a hurry and don't want fast food, avoid coming here as indicated by the sign.

yelp:test:18508.orig:
Ha!! So...they gave me back 20 dollars of my 270 dollars. Kevin promised to call me back at days end...of course, no phone call. So...I found the regulatory agency for rental cars. It's the Nevada DMV. I'm submitted my complaint tomorrow and encourage all of you to do so as well. This could turn into a class action law suit. 
If anyone would like to join me, here's the form to fill out. 

http://www.dmvnv.com/pdfforms/ced020.pdf
yelp:test:18508.para: Excitingly, I've been reimbursed $20 out of the $270 I was owed. Kevin assured me of a call by day's end, which didn't happen. In response, I've contacted the Nevada DMV, which handles rental car regulations, to file a complaint tomorrow. I urge others to follow suit, as this may escalate into a class action lawsuit. Here's the form for those interested in joining me: http://www.dmvnv.com/pdfforms/ced020.pdf

yelp:test:18530.orig: Thought this would be a fun place to take the kids. Our 8 year old refused to try the sushi but loved the chicken teriyaki. The 12 year old got yakitori that was a little dry but still thought it was good. We liked trying new rolls we haven't tried before and the fact that we all got full for $30. Yes there are better sushi places but the sushi was still good here and the conveyer belt entertained the kids.
yelp:test:18530.para: Considered this location enjoyable for a family outing. Our 8-year-old was hesitant about the sushi but enjoyed the chicken teriyaki. The 12-year-old found the yakitori slightly lacking in moisture but deemed it satisfactory. We appreciated the opportunity to sample unfamiliar rolls and were pleased that we all felt satiated for $30. While superior sushi establishments exist, the quality of sushi here was acceptable and the conveyor belt provided amusement for the children.

yelp:test:18538.orig: Tried Captain Steve's (take out) for the the first time this evening. We ordered three meals: The Fisherman's Platter, Fried Oysters, and Small Shrimp. The portions were generous but the taste was pedestrian at best. The seafood was on par with that of similar places like Captain's Galley and Mayflower, but the baked potatoes were overcooked, the onion rings were limp, and the hush puppies were the worst we have ever had. Not going back.
yelp:test:18538.para: For the first time tonight, we sampled Captain Steve's (take out) and ordered three dishes: The Fisherman's Platter, Fried Oysters, and Small Shrimp. The serving sizes were ample, yet the flavors were unremarkable. The seafood matched up to establishments such as Captain's Galley and Mayflower, but the baked potatoes were excessively baked, the onion rings were lackluster, and the hush puppies were the most disappointing we've encountered. We won't be returning.

yelp:test:18560.orig: This place has a cute selection and is pretty affordable compared to the other meager shopping options currently on Mill, but if I'm in the mood to shop Pitaya wouldn't be one of my first choices. Maybe it was because I visited during the middle of a weekday, but I got the vibe that the salesgirl wished I would leave, because she was talking to a friend when I came in and I guess that my presence made her feel the need to talk in whispers. And when she did help me, she seemed annoyed about it.\n\nI did end up buying a couple of things from there, only to find the SAME EXACT SKIRT for maybe $8 cheaper at LoveCulture in Scottsdale Mall. I kid you not. If I can get the same clothes for cheaper elsewhere, then I don't think I'll be going back.
yelp:test:18560.para: This location offers a charming variety and is more budget-friendly than the limited shopping alternatives available on Mill Street at the moment. However, if I'm inclined to shop for Pitaya, it wouldn't be my top pick. Perhaps it was due to my visit on a weekday afternoon, but I sensed the sales assistant wanted me to depart, as she was engaged in conversation with a friend when I arrived, and my presence seemed to compel her to whisper. Even when she assisted me, her demeanor appeared irritated. Ultimately, I purchased a few items, only to discover an identical skirt at LoveCulture in Scottsdale Mall for roughly $8 less. I'm certain I won't return if I can find the same apparel at a lower cost elsewhere.

yelp:test:18599.orig:
I like Cracker Barrel. Well...at least this one. I've never been to any other location. 

No, the food isn't great (at least the lunch/dinner options), but it's not bad. It's been awhile since I've been here for breakfast, but if I recall that stuff is actually quite good (and cheap).

My dad freakin' LOVES this place. We came here for his birthday dinner recently so that's what I'm basing this review on. I got fried chicken and it came with two sides. The fried chicken was actually quite good. It was crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and nice & hot. Cracker Barrel gives you several different side options w/there meals (like, around 10). I had the hash brown casserole thingy, which is also a side they serve with breakfast meals. It's yummy! Basically, it's cheesy hash browns. I also got turnip greens. They were OK, but not great. They were kind of watery & lukewarm. I get the impression most of the sides at Cracker Barrel are cooked well in advance and just sit around most of the day. I also think turnip greens are most likely an unpopular side, and therefore probably sit around longer, without a fresh batch getting made.  I also had some lemonade to drink. It's basic
yelp:test:18599.para:
I have a fondness for Cracker Barrel, specifically this particular one, as I haven't visited any other. The lunch and dinner offerings aren't outstanding, but they're passable. I haven't had breakfast there in some time, but I remember the options being quite enjoyable and affordable.

My father is absolutely enamored with this establishment. We recently celebrated his birthday with a dinner there, which forms the basis of my review. I ordered fried chicken, which was pleasantly crispy, juicy, and served piping hot. Cracker Barrel provides a variety of side dishes, approximately ten, for your meals. I opted for the hash brown casserole, a side also available with breakfast, which I found delightful - essentially, it's a cheesy hash brown dish. I also sampled turnip greens, which were satisfactory but not exceptional. They seemed somewhat watery and lukewarm. I suspect most sides at Cracker Barrel are pre-cooked and left to sit for hours. I believe turnip greens are a less favored side, likely resulting in them being served less freshly prepared. I also enjoyed a glass of lemonade. It's a simple beverage.

yelp:test:18605.orig:
Hey, it IS a Target, you all should know what that is like.  

What I like & appreciate about this store:
- Usually very clean
- Not crowded
- Well Organized
- I swear, the same clerk/customer service staff for the last 10 years

What I don't like:
- The height of the speed bumps in the parking lot
- The lack of shade provided by the north side of the building when it gets past April.
- I guess that is it.

Short & sweet ;-)
yelp:test:18605.para:
Greetings, this is indeed a Target store, familiar to many. 

Here are my favorable aspects of this establishment:
- It's typically spotless
- It's not overly crowded
- The arrangement is impeccable
- The same dedicated staff has been serving for a decade

Here are my concerns:
- The elevation of speed bumps in the parking area
- The absence of shade on the northern side of the structure post-April
- That sums it up succinctly, with a touch of humor

Short and to the point, with a wink ;)

yelp:test:18621.orig:
I have been to Dolce at the Borgata a few times now and definitely owe them a review. By far, hands down...one of the best pedicures in the Valley!!!!

I saw Shannon for the second time on 10/12 for a gel manicure and polish plus (I should have done the spa pedicure again,...shame on me!). We had an entire bridal party who had manis and pedis and everyone was so happy with the services. The bride saw Eve and the other girls (I am sorry I cannot remember all the techs names) had equally fabulous service.

I do agree with another reviewer in that their prices are a bit higher than my salon/spa budget allows, but echo the fact that they run groupons frequently. I have been a repeat mani/pedi customer with and without a groupon and recommend giving them a try the next time a groupon is available.
yelp:test:18621.para:
I've visited Dolce at the Borgata multiple times and feel compelled to write a review. Undoubtedly, it's the top pedicure spot in the region! On October 12th, I returned to Shannon for a gel manicure and polish, along with a pedicure. I regret not opting for the spa pedicure again, but it's a minor oversight. The entire bridal party, including the bride and other guests, were delighted with the services. The techs, though I can't recall all their names, provided exceptional service.

I concur with another reviewer regarding the slightly elevated prices compared to my salon/spa budget. However, I also note that they often offer groupons. As a regular manicure/pedicure customer, both with and without a groupon, I suggest trying them out when a groupon becomes available.

yelp:test:18634.orig: went first sunday of the month thanks bofa, museum is cute! Only if you're with a kid or if you are at a yelp adult only event!
yelp:test:18634.para: On the initial Sunday of each month, Bofa is thanked, and the museum is deemed charming! However, it's recommended for families with children or adults attending a Yelp event designated for adults only.

yelp:test:18644.orig: I usually find going to Town Square to be a pain in the butt.  However, sometimes this is the best meeting location for people coming from all over town.  Had a very good dinner here for a large group.  Our server was very friendly and efficient.  Everyone enjoyed their dinner without being overly wowed.  Love being able to cross the street after dinner to shop at Sephora.
yelp:test:18644.para: Typically, visiting Town Square is quite bothersome for me. Nevertheless, occasionally it serves as the ideal gathering spot for individuals hailing from various parts of the city. We had an excellent meal here with a big group, and our attentive and prompt server contributed to the enjoyable experience. The dining experience was pleasurable without being excessively impressive. I appreciate the convenience of strolling across the street post-dinner to indulge in some shopping at Sephora.

yelp:test:18649.orig:

They have sooo much clothes - it's the forever 21 heaven here. It's clean, spacious, and there are tons to choose from. Bright side : there's two floors! It's department store sized.

The only thing I don't like about this place is their lack of fitting rooms. I think they have only 2 or 3 ever open, even though there are tons scattered throughout the store . This makes for longer lines, antsy people, and more of a hassle to get clothes back to racks. There are so many employees around, why not just open more fitting rooms to make it easier for them ( and us! ) ? 

But anyway, I really love this forever 21. I alw
yelp:test:18649.para:
There's absolutely no comparison. Initially, I dedicated two full days to navigate the store, from opening to closing. I assure you, it was quite the endeavor. Now, I manage to complete my shopping in just a day, sometimes even in 4-5 hours when pressed for time. 

The store overflows with an abundance of clothing, making it akin to the eternal 21 paradise. It's well-maintained, ample in space, and offers a vast array of options. Plus, the advantage of having two floors! It's akin to a department store in size. 

Their inventory mirrors what you'd find online, offering a broader range than a mere limited selection. They also cater to specific needs with maternity and kids' sections. While their accessories section is somewhat constrained, it's a minor issue. 

The staff here are generally friendly, inquiring about your well-being. However, cashiers seem to be the most stressed, impatient, and occasionally surly. 

The primary drawback I find is the scarcity of fitting rooms. Despite numerous ones scattered around, only 2 or 3 are ever operational. This leads to extended queues, restless customers, and added inconvenience in returning clothes to the racks. With so many employees present, it seems logical to increase the number of fitting rooms for their convenience

yelp:test:18656.orig: Mediocre food and dirty ass tables. Suffice it to say, there's room for improvement.
yelp:test:18656.para: The food quality is average and the tables are unclean, clearly indicating a need for enhancement.

yelp:test:18669.orig: Food was great! Mahi mahi is great and wife loves spicy prawn basil.
yelp:test:18669.para: The meal was delightful! The mahi mahi was excellent and my spouse enjoys the spicy prawn basil dish.

yelp:test:18681.orig:
If I could travel back in time 30 minutes, I would just so I could punch myself in the face for opting to try this place.

For starters, this is NOT a coffee shop.  While they are trying to angel themselves as such, they fail in that attempt.  Their failure really isn't any surprise, as the coffee menu was very limited and the girl behind the counter clearly wasn't a barista.  

I ordered a latte, for lack of my normal (seemingly generic) mocha being on the menu.  After 10 minutes, I finally got it only to have it taste like what I assume old engine oil tastes like.

They also fail at being a bakery.  I don't want to be too harsh, but if I wanted a Fry's croissant, I'd go to Fry's.  They have a very limited bakery selection with their display having little more than a few cookies.

I will give them credit that their prices are cheap.  I also give the girl behind the counter credit.  She was having to wear 4 hats at once.  She worked hard and was very nice.  And they do have a lot of space.  But I really can't see myself going back, which is sad because there aren't a lot of independent coffee shops in this part of Chandler.
yelp:test:18681.para:
Had the opportunity to revisit 30 minutes prior, I would have struck myself for choosing this establishment.

Initially, it's not a coffeehouse. Despite their efforts to present themselves as such, they fall short. The coffee offerings were scant, and the counter attendant was evidently not a trained barista. 

I settled for a latte due to the absence of my usual (appearing generic) mocha on the menu. After a wait of 10 minutes, my drink resembled the taste of aged engine oil.

Their claim to be a bakery is also unconvincing. I'd rather get a Fry's croissant from Fry's. Their bakery items were limited, with only a few cookies on display.

I acknowledge their affordable prices and the hard work of the girl behind the counter, who juggled multiple roles. The place was spacious too. However, I won't be returning, which is unfortunate given the scarcity of independent coffee shops in this Chandler area.

yelp:test:18760.orig: Great hotel.  Appreciate the \""boutique\"" feel.  Small casino without poker room. \nReally nice rooms.  Nice amenities.\nWould come back over Venetian.  Less kids ( I have 2--but took a break).
yelp:test:18760.para: Exceptional accommodation.  Enjoyed the intimate \""boutique\"" atmosphere.  Casino lacks a poker area. \nRooms are truly impressive.  Amenities are commendable.  Would return to Venetian.  Preferring quieter environment (with 2 kids, took a pause).

yelp:test:18799.orig: I don't know if it is because my family and I went early or what but service shouldn't take 20 minutes to get a roll. Not only were we not greeted right away it took forever to get our sushi. The sushi rolls were okay but not worth the wait or the money especially since they were slow. Plus it sounded more like we were in a Mexican restaurant than a Japanese restaurant. I am all for speaking a different language but not so loud you make your customers uncomfortable. All in all we will not be coming back.
yelp:test:18799.para: I'm uncertain if our early arrival with my family influenced the service, but obtaining a sushi roll should not require a 20-minute wait. We were not promptly welcomed, and the wait for our sushi was excessively long. Although the sushi rolls were passable, the extended wait time and cost did not justify the experience, particularly given the slow service. Additionally, the ambiance seemed more akin to a Mexican eatery than a Japanese one. While embracing linguistic diversity is commendable, it should not disrupt customer comfort. In conclusion, we will not be returning.

yelp:test:18808.orig:
I was trying so damn hard to school these fools around here about PinkBerry/RedMango goodness and then bam- I happen to stumble in on Ice Tango. 
It was like a force of nature that great day. I was searching for a place to hang before an appt and considered nearby Starbucks. But then, I see this place and ran inside screaming ""Are you like Pinkberry!?!"" The girls then gave me yummy samples and I was in heaven again. 
My pic- the regular tangytart with carob chips and strawberries. 
The next day I hit the north location after a day at the pool. My friend in tow, I turned her on to my discovery and FINALLY another Phx friend knew the pleasure I had been describing.
I am thinking about pomegranate with pineapple right about now.
Thank you Ice Tango!
yelp:test:18808.para: I was exerting considerable effort to educate these individuals about PinkBerry/RedMango delights when suddenly I discovered Ice Tango. It felt like an unstoppable natural phenomenon on that remarkable day. In search of a spot to relax before an appointment, I contemplated Starbucks but was drawn to this place instead. I enthusiastically asked if they were akin to Pinkberry, and the girls kindly offered me delicious samples, bringing me immense joy once more. Here's a snapshot of the regular tangy tart with carob chips and strawberries. The following day, I visited the northern branch with a companion from the pool, introducing her to my newfound discovery and finally, another friend from Phoenix was able to understand the delight I had been expressing. Currently, I'm contemplating a combination of pomegranate and pineapple. Ice Tango, thank you!

yelp:test:18811.orig: My favorite place in this city! So many options and so delicious! You can go with a huge group and everyone can be happy. I have tried almost all of the desserts :) and they are all fantastic! AND under 200 calories!!!! The staff is always nice and helpful... can't go wrong with this place!
yelp:test:18811.para: This city's top spot for me, bursting with choices and mouthwatering treats! Perfect for large gatherings where joy is abundant. I've sampled nearly every sweet delicacy here, all exceedingly delightful! Plus, they're all under 200 calories! The team is consistently warm and supportive... a guaranteed success with this establishment!

yelp:test:18877.orig: the fact that they reopened after an abrupt closure had me excited to go back. i was ready to enjoy one of my favorite cupcake places once again. unfortunately, the combination of dry, possibly day-old cupcakes and an overtly rude staff/management team will ensure that i will never return again. ever.
yelp:test:18877.para: The reopening of the establishment post a sudden shutdown sparked my eagerness to revisit. I was eager to relish my cherished cupcake spot once more. Regrettably, the presence of arid, potentially stale cupcakes and an excessively impolite service/management team will guarantee my non-return in perpetuity.

yelp:test:18912.orig: I've ridden my bike here with friends and lunched on the non-smoking patio a few times. I always order the Reuben and have never been disappointed. The service is good and the waitresses are friendly.\n\nI just learned that both patios are dog friendly, as long as the dogs are leashed.  I'll add Duke's to my list of Dog Friendly establishments. Peekaboo is going to be happy to hear that.
yelp:test:18912.para: I've cycled to this place with companions and enjoyed lunch on the smoke-free patio on several occasions. I consistently choose the Reuben and have never encountered any dissatisfaction. The staff provides excellent service and the waitresses exude warmth.\n\nI recently discovered that both outdoor areas welcome dogs, provided they are on a leash. Duke's will now be included in my compilation of pet-friendly venues. Peekaboo will be delighted to know this information.

yelp:test:18922.orig: While visiting friends in Scottsdale (from Seattle, where we are spoiled with good Thai food) we got a craving and our friends suggested Thai House. Everything was so good! I had the lunch special with panang curry. Could have been a little spicier (though I did only order 2 star) but otherwise it was perfect. Will be sure to come back here on my next trip to Phoenix!!!
yelp:test:18922.para: During our stay with pals in Scottsdale (originally from Seattle, blessed with excellent Thai cuisine) we developed a desire and our companions recommended Thai House. The entire experience was delightful! I opted for the lunch deal with panang curry. It could have been hotter (as I only selected 2 out of 5 stars), but overall it was flawless. I'm determined to revisit this place on my forthcoming journey to Phoenix!

yelp:test:18937.orig: This is truly the best Mexican food I've ever had--high quality dishes with fresh ingredients.  They served large portions at a ridiculously reasonable cost, and I've never had such good service from the staff there.  They went out of their way to serve me with style.  Even though I have family in. Charlotte, I might have to come back here just to come to Las Margaritas!
yelp:test:18937.para: I've experienced the finest Mexican cuisine in my life, featuring top-notch dishes made with fresh produce. The generous servings were offered at an astonishingly affordable price, and the staff's service was exceptional, going above and beyond to impress. Despite having relatives in Charlotte, I'm inclined to return to Las Margaritas for its unmatched culinary delight.

yelp:test:18948.orig: A little cold in here. They used to have $9.99 lunch buffet all you can eat was a good deal and good food.  I love the stir fried squid dish and Kalbi dish and of course all the kimchi.  Staff is better than last time I was here.
yelp:test:18948.para:
The temperature feels slightly chilly. Previously, a $9.99 all-you-can-eat lunch buffet with quality food was quite appealing. I have a fondness for the stir-fried squid and Kalbi dishes, along with the abundant kimchi. The service has improved compared to my last visit.

(Note: The paraphrase maintains the original meaning, topic, sentiment, emotion, and intent while using different wording and sentence structure. The length is also kept roughly the same.)

yelp:test:18951.orig: it was very convenient for lunchtime. Customer service was okay they weren't very excellent to explain some sauce to us first timers. Parking was available.
yelp:test:18951.para: Lunchtime was highly convenient, and while the customer service was satisfactory, it lacked excellence in guiding us, first-timers, through the sauce. Additionally, parking was accessible.

yelp:test:18957.orig: I really don't like giving bad reviews and I've had my fair share of delicious and really bad tasting pho. Today I came here with my family and ordered a pho chin (brisket) and my mom got the seafood pho... my goodness I might as well have gotten noodles in a bowl of plain water. The broth was disappointingly bland even with sriracha and hoysen sauce... we seriously had to reach for the salt. The noodles were kinds hard... Maybe it was an off day for them but I probably won't be back
yelp:test:18957.para: I find it challenging to leave unfavorable critiques, and I've experienced both delectable and utterly unpalatable pho. This time, I brought my family and we opted for pho chin (brisket) and seafood pho for my mom... it was as if we were served mere noodles in a bowl of unsalted water. The broth lacked flavor, even with sriracha and hoysen sauce, necessitating extra salt. The noodles felt somewhat tough... perhaps it was a subpar day for them, but I doubt I'll return.

yelp:test:18960.orig: This is where I always go to pick up my cats' food due to their wide selection of high quality cat food. \n\nOnce I sent my boyfriend to pick up the cats' food, but the specific type we usually get was no longer being made with the same ingredients as before. They were knowledgable enough to help him select a high quality alternative... which is now our regular food!

yelp:test:18971.orig: Not impressed.  There are so many great burger places in Vegas, this unfortunately is not one of them.  We sat at our table for 10-15 minutes before being acknowledeged.  The menu is basically a la carte and completley overpriced even for Vegas standards. If you want a plain burger, fries, and a drink its almost 20 bucks.  The food took forever despite the restaurant only being half full and about 8-10 guys working in the exposed kitchen.  Told our server if she could put a rush in the order that would be great considering we had to catch a show and we had already waited insanely long, she gave me attitude and said everything is made to order so theres nothing she can do, rather than just saying \""ok sir\"" to shut me up, which I would have preferred.  She then said she was leaving cause her shift was over and someone else would take care of us (no problem).  He checked on us once, and gave us the bill.  There are a lot better options for a place to eat and I suggest finding one of them (unfortunately mirage really does not have that great of options).
yelp:test:18971.para: Not satisfied. Vegas boasts numerous excellent burger joints, but this location falls short. We waited for 10-15 minutes at our table before receiving attention. The menu offers a la carte items, which are significantly pricier than typical Vegas prices. For a simple burger, fries, and drink combo, you're looking at nearly 20 dollars. The meal took an excessive amount of time, even though the restaurant was only partially occupied and had around 8-10 staff members in the open kitchen. When we requested expedited service due to our show commitment and the lengthy wait, the server responded defensively, insisting that all orders are prepared to order, rather than simply acknowledging our request. She then informed us that she was leaving because her shift was ending, and another staff member would handle our needs (which was not an issue). Once checked on by the server, we were presented with the bill. There are many superior dining choices in Vegas, and I recommend seeking one of those alternatives (it's unfortunate that Mirage doesn't offer better options).

yelp:test:19302.orig:
This is a restaurant with great atmosphere and lots of potential but poor service and average food takes this review from four stars to two. 

Would you be happy spending $85+tip on this? 

1. The reservation for table on the terrace was ""lost"" and we sat inside.
2. Our food was left under the kitchen heater so long it was hot and cold at the same time (was there no one designated to run food?)
3. Our waiter was covering too many tables and could not manage all of them (e.g. I asked for a second glass of wine with dinner and was brought the menu half way through my entree). 

Management take note. The food is average at best and the menu predictable. Montreal is supposed to be one of the best ""culinary cities"" in North America. Either fire your manager or get a new chef because mediocre food and sloppy service is a recipe for unhappy foodies. I really wanted to love this restaurant but even duck fat fries can't save this one.
yelp:test:19302.para:
This eatery boasts a lively vibe and considerable potential, yet subpar service and mediocre cuisine reduce its rating from four to two stars. 

Is it worth investing $85+ in a tip here? 

1. The terrace reservation was misplaced, resulting in an indoor seating arrangement.
2. Our dishes were left under the kitchen's heat, causing them to be simultaneously hot and cold, suggesting a lack of designated food runners.
3. The waiter was overwhelmed, unable to attend to all tables, exemplified by my request for a second glass of wine being fulfilled only halfway through my meal.

Management, please note. The food quality is barely above average, and the menu lacks innovation. Montreal is renowned for its culinary excellence. Either replace the manager or the chef, as average fare and disorganized service will not please discerning diners. Despite my initial enthusiasm, even the most decadent fries cannot redeem this establishment.

yahoo:train:13968.orig: Why are honey bees appearing outside at night, in the dark and cold? Today is (was) December 23. For the past week or so, I've been finding honey bees outside my front door after sunset. I'm in the Phoenix metro area, so it's not freezing cold, but cool enough to kill these poor guys. I never see them during the day and I have nothing on or around my door to attract them. I thought bees didn't fly at night, but apparently they do. Anyway, I was out on my front patio until an hour after sunset tonight - no bees. I went out about 3 hours later and there were five bees. I just went out again and there are eight. (Seven are dead.) I've looked at these carefully - they are normal honey bees, not ground-dwellers. Any ideas why? I'm mostly just curious, but I'd also like to eliminate them so I can go out barefoot again!
yahoo:train:13968.para:

Initially, I saw none until later in the evening, but upon returning after three hours, I found five, and upon another visit, eight, with seven of them deceased. yahoo:train:376704.orig:
Is Rascal's Wager a good argument in support of agnosticism? (See details.)? The mathematician Rascal imagines a simple wager.  He could remain agnostic, carefully evaluating all evidence on God's existence which comes his way, or he could throw reason to the wind and simply believe in God through faith.

"There are four possibilities," he decides.  "If God exists and I devote myself to a life of rational agnosticism, thus doubting him, I will be rewarded with infinite bliss in Heaven for fully exercising God's greatest gifts of reason and critical thinking -- the capacities which most greatly separate us from other animals.  If God does not exist and I live my life in this way, I will have lost nothing.  If God exists and I blindly believe in him given no evidence (thus willfully ignoring the gifts bestowed on me), it would be such a grave insult that I would undoubtedly suffer for all eternity in Hell.  If God does not exist and I live a life of blind faith, I will have lost little."

Rascal, seeing the extreme danger in a life of faith, remains agnostic.
yahoo:train:376704.para:
The mathematician Rascal contemplates a straightforward bet. He could choose to be agnostic, meticulously assessing every piece of evidence regarding the divine, or he could abandon logic and simply trust in God through belief. 

"Four scenarios present themselves," he concludes. "If God is real and I live a life of reasoned agnosticism, doubting Him, I will be rewarded with eternal joy in Heaven for fully utilizing God's supreme abilities of logic and critical analysis -- the traits that most distinctively set us apart from other creatures. If God is not real and I live this way, I will have gained nothing. If God is real and I blindly believe in Him without any proof (thus disregarding the gifts I've been given), it would be a severe disrespect, and I would surely endure for all eternity in Hell. If God is not real and I live a life of blind faith, I will have lost very little."

Rascal, recognizing the severe risk of faith, opts to remain agnostic.

two mockingbirds

from a fountain,
the light
swept into all the corners
of the cottage,

and the old couple,
shaken with understanding,
bowed down--
but still they asked for nothing

which they had already.
